jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
Worker Type
Regular
Job Description
Position Summary
The Space, Cyber and Directed Energy Segment Vice President of Engineering serves as the senior engineering authority for the segment and is responsible for establishing the technical vision, engineering rigor, and product development discipline required to support a rapidly scaling portfolio of defense and national security programs.
This leader oversees a diverse mix of engineering services and product-based businesses, balancing lightweight governance for mature service programs with rigorous systems engineering, execution oversight, and technical risk management for high-priority product development efforts.
The role partners closely with the business leadership, CTO, program management, manufacturing, and growth teams to ensure engineering excellence, product commonality, rapid deployment capability, affordability, and successful transition from development into scalable production.
The Vice President of Engineering will help mature the segment engineering organization over time, including the future establishment and leadership of Chief Engineers aligned to business units and major product lines.
Position Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance
Serve as the senior engineering authority across the segment portfolio.
Establish engineering standards, technical review processes, and development rigor appropriate for both services and product organizations.
Ensure technical execution aligns with customer mission requirements, affordability targets, schedule commitments, and long-term product strategy.
Drive engineering best practices across systems engineering, software, hardware, integration, test, cybersecurity, reliability, and manufacturing readiness.
Lead independent technical assessments and support executive decision-making related to technical risk, investment priorities, and program execution.
Product Development & Productization
Support the transition from bespoke engineering efforts to scalable, repeatable product solutions.
Ensure engineering organizations are structured to move rapidly while maintaining technical discipline and mission assurance.
Promote modular architectures, common product frameworks, reuse strategies, and product commonality across programs.
Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to improve producibility, reliability, and lifecycle affordability.
Drive engineering alignment with enterprise initiatives focused on speed, agility, commercialization, and rapid deployment.
Partnership with CTO & Enterprise Engineering Alignment
Partner directly with the CTO to flow enterprise engineering strategies, processes, tools, and governance into the segment.
Support implementation of common engineering frameworks, digital engineering approaches, model-based systems engineering, and enterprise product development standards.
Ensure engineering organizations adopt enterprise technology roadmaps and modernization initiatives where appropriate.
Talent Strategy & Organizational Development
Support engineering workforce planning, hiring strategies, succession planning, and capability development across the segment.
Monitor engineering staffing requirements against strategic growth objectives.
Help shape future engineering organizational structures, including eventual establishment of Chief Engineer roles aligned to business units or product portfolios.
Foster a culture centered on accountability, innovation, technical excellence, collaboration, and mission focus.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with:
Business Unit leaders
Program Management
Manufacturing & Supply Chain
Quality
Finance
Growth & Capture
Security and Contracts
Support customer engagements, technical roadmap discussions, milestone reviews, and strategic captures.
Participate in executive operating rhythms including program reviews, investment reviews, and annual operating planning activities.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field required; advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within defense, aerospace, space, directed energy, RF systems, autonomous systems, or related national security sectors.
Demonstrated experience leading complex engineering organizations supporting both development and production environments.
Strong background in systems engineering, product development, and transition to manufacturing.
Experience operating within high-growth, fast-paced technology organizations.
Ability to balance technical rigor with speed and execution urgency.
Experience collaborating across enterprise engineering and business leadership organizations.
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with executives, customers, and technical teams.
Top Secret/SCI Clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance
Other Qualifications and Desired Competencies
Experience supporting defense acquisition programs, rapid prototyping efforts, and productized defense systems.
Familiarity with digital engineering, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and modern product development environments.
Experience scaling engineering organizations following acquisition or integration activities.
Background supporting products transitioning from R&D into operational deployment and production scale-up.
Leadership Expectations
People First Culture
Results & Ownership
Innovate & Simplify
Dedicated to Customers
Evolve to Dominate
Clearance Level
TS/SCI
The salary range for this role is:
$245,500 - $393,000
AeroVironment considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the location, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.
ITAR Requirement:
This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants must qualify as a U.S. person under the ITAR and the EAR, or a person to be approved for an export license by the governing agency whose technology comes under its jurisdiction. Please understand that any job offer that requires approval of an export license will be conditional on AeroVironment’s determination that it will be able to obtain an export license in a time frame consistent with AeroVironment’s business requirements. A “U.S. person” according to the ITAR definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee or asylee. See 22 CFR § 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements.
Benefits: AV offers an excellent benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401K with company matching, a 9/80 work schedule and a paid holiday shutdown. For more information about our company benefit offerings please visit: .
We also encourage you to review our company website at to learn more about us.
Principals only need apply. NO agencies please.
About AV:
AV isn’t for everyone. We hire the curious, the relentless, the mission-obsessed. The best of the best.
We don’t just build defense technology—we redefine what’s possible. As the premier autonomous systems company in the U.S., AV delivers breakthrough capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. From AI-powered drones and loitering munitions to integrated autonomy and space resilience, our technologies shape the future of warfare and protect those who serve.
Founded by legendary innovator Dr. Paul MacCready, AV has spent over 50 years pushing the boundaries of what unmanned systems can do. Our heritage includes seven platforms in the Smithsonian—but we’re not building history, we’re building what’s next.
If you're ready to build technology that matters—with speed, scale, and purpose—there’s no better place to do it than AV.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans. AeroVironment, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Qualified applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic data, sexual orientation, gender identity or other legally protected status.
ITAR
U.S. Citizenship required

jobs.title: Vice President, Product
jobs.text:
*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**
About SafelyYou
SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.
Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.
SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.
Your Role at SafelyYou
Our product works; how we build hasn't kept up. Our product and technology teams own customer outcomes, built on shared platforms. As VP of Product, you lead the product management team and own the portfolio: one committed roadmap, where investment goes, and which bets get funded, changed, or stopped. The CPTO sets overall direction and the VP of Engineering owns delivery; you own product execution You'll inherit a capable team ready for a stronger operating model, and part of the job is deciding what to keep, rebuild, and stop. Operators are choosing their technology partners for the next decade, and you'll have a seat at the leadership table as we earn that choice. Every improvement you ship reaches residents, families, and caregivers. You'll work daily with the CPTO and VP of Engineering, and closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, our clinical team, Operations, and Strategy.
Key Responsibilities:
The Numbers You'll Own
Customer NOI. Own SafelyYou's impact on operator NOI per resident, proven with outcome data in each care setting.
Wellness AI and staffing intelligence. Build both into scaled product lines alongside Safety AI.
Throughput. Double the rate of committed features launched to customers within the next year, measured by release to market and adoption, not tickets closed.
What You'll Own
One roadmap. A single customer-facing roadmap tied to company objectives. Sales sells what's committed.
The portfolio. Allocate investment across customer-facing teams, shared platforms (AI, data and integrations, devices, hardware), and longer-horizon bets, and make stage-gate calls on evidence.
The operating model.With the VP of Engineering, run annual strategy, quarterly planning, and published decision rights. Build the operations support PMs need to focus on outcomes.
The ecosystem. Drive partner adoption so SafelyYou insights reach caregivers inside the EHR and eCall systems they already use.
Trusted AI. Clear accuracy and false-alarm standards, privacy by design, and evidence before anything reaches the field.
The market. Be in the room with our largest operators, shape pricing and packaging with Sales and Marketing, and represent product at industry events and with investors.
The team. Coach, level, and hire product managers, and build a bench of future leaders.
The Ideal Candidate:
The hard requirement:you've led product managers through an operating-model change, such as functional teams to outcome and platform teams, on products that combine hardware, AI/ML, and cloud software.
10+ years in product, including 5+ years leading PMs across multiple product areas.
AI/ML, hardware, and platform or partner-ecosystem products shipped to market, including stage-gated development, certification, and field reliability.
Enterprise B2B credibility. You've carried a product number, not just supported one.
A decisive player-coach and clear writer who earns engineering's respect.
Strongly preferred, and learnable:healthcare or senior living experience, and regulated products (HIPAA, life-safety).
Salary Range:$260,000 - $280,000 USD commensurate with experience
Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!
SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:
A mission-driven company culture
Fully remote
Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision
401k Program
Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends
Non-accrual PTO
Growth Potential
Company Retreats
Medical & Family/Parental Leave
At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Secure File Gateway and ICAP
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Why This Role Matters
At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is not an abstract mission. It is real, urgent, and growing. Our ICAP product is a proven, high-impact solution that is trusted by customers who depend on us to secure their most critical systems. We are now ready to take ICAP to the next level.
This Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of ICAP, including the evolution toward a next-generation Proxy, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. If you are energized by building success, driving innovation, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.
What You Will Be Doing
As Director of AI Product Management, you will be the end-to-end owner of ICAP’s product strategy and growth trajectory.
You will:
Set and own the ICAP product vision and roadmap, including the strategic evolution into a Proxy-focused solution.
Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, and customer adoption.
Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with a close partnership with our Vietnam-based teams.
Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring ICAP continues to deliver reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
Represent ICAP with confidence to customers, partners, and internal leadership.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:
A clear, compelling ICAP roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.
Progress toward a Proxy-focused architecture that positions ICAP for long-term growth.
A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.
Who You Are
You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
You bring:
Proven experience leading enterprise or security products at scale.
Deep hands on experience building with AI.
Strong understanding of proxy technologies, ICAP, networking, or adjacent security domains.
A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.
Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.
Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Vietnam.
Clear, confident communication and the ability to influence across functions.
A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.
Why OPSWAT?
OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow.
In this role, you will:
Own a successful, revenue-generating product with a meaningful runway.
Shape the future of ICAP and Proxy innovation.
Work with smart, committed teams across the globe.
Have direct visibility and influence within Product leadership.
If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. GM, Head of Data
We are seeking someone to lead the Talos data business and position it for strong, sustainable growth. You’ll own the P&L, product strategy and client relationships for our digital assets data offering, built on the Coin Metrics acquisition. Working closely with engineering, sales and executive leadership, you’ll shape how our data products are built, packaged and taken to market. jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands at saas.group.
Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within the saas.group portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike.
Profile Overview
Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find.
To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter.
This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way.
You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources from saas.group's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you.
So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries.
We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies.
Your responsibilities
Technology Vision and Strategy:
Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces.
Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend.
Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting.
Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market.
Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability.
Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team.
Security and Compliance:
Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible.
Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure.
Team Management and Growth:
Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here.
Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them.
Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization.
Execution and Delivery:
Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence.
Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems.
Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows.
Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands.
Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management:
Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board.
Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs.
Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth.
Ownership & Autonomy:
Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships.
Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made.
Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement.
What You bring to the table
10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company.
Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned.
Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity, with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume.
Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation.
A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick.
A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed.
Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility.
Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else.
Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing.
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings.
Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously.
Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across the saas.group portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise.
Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to.
Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources.
Prerender is part of saas.group, and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Platform & Data Engineering
jobs.text:
Keyloop is a leading automotive retail software business, operating across 100+ markets and backed by Francisco Partners. As we accelerate our transition to a modern, cloud-native SaaS platform, Platform & Data Engineering sits at the heart of our technical strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role reporting directly to the CTO, responsible for setting and executing the platform strategy that enables Keyloop's product engineering teams, powers our data and AI capabilities, and provides the integration fabric for an acquisitive, multi-product business.
Responsibilities:
1. Leadership & Team Development
Lead and develop a diverse, distributed team of platform and data engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and clear career pathways to ensure high performance and professional growth.
Build and refine the organisational structure of the platform function, including defining team topologies that support product engineering teams as internal customers.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement, with a strong emphasis on developer productivity and platform reliability.
2. Platform & Technology Strategy
Ensure security, stability, and scalability are foundational properties of the platform - not afterthoughts - with clear ownership of reliability targets, security-by-design standards, and the capacity to serve a growing SaaS customer base across 100+ markets.
Co-own the multi-year platform engineering roadmap with the Platform Product Leader, translating commercial and product priorities into a coherent engineering delivery plan.
Lead the evolution of Keyloop’s shared services, API gateway, integration layer, and internal developer platform (IDP) to serve as the technical foundation across all product lines.
Establish API-first as a non-negotiable architectural principle - every platform capability must be accessible via a well-governed, versioned API surface before any other access pattern is considered, enabling both internal product teams and external ecosystem partners to build reliably on top of Keyloop infrastructure.
Drive cloud-native architecture decisions, leveraging AWS services and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform/Pulumi) to ensure scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
Champion platform security-by-design, ensuring adherence to enterprise security standards, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2), and Keyloop's obligations as a custodian of sensitive automotive retail data.
3. Integration & Acquisitive Platform Capability
Architect and evolve the integration platform that enables Keyloop to onboard acquired businesses and codebases efficiently, reducing time-to-integration across M&A activity.
Define and maintain shared platform capabilities including identity, authentication, multi-tenancy, data residency, and OEM connectivity standards.
Ensure the platform acts as the enabling layer across Keyloop’s product portfolio, providing consistent APIs, event streaming, and shared infrastructure rather than duplicating capability across product teams.
Design and deliver low-code/no-code integration capabilities that enable rapid, standardised connectivity with third-party systems across the automotive ecosystem, including OEM partners, dealer group platforms, and acquired businesses. Build on modern integration tooling (including n8n) to reduce time-to-integration and enable non-engineering teams to configure and operate integrations where appropriate.
4. Data & AI Platform
Lead the design and delivery of Keyloop's data platform, including data lakes, data pipelines, and analytical infrastructure to power BI, reporting, and AI-driven product capabilities.
Build and operate the infrastructure layer for AI and ML workloads, including feature stores, model serving infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, and experimentation frameworks.
Drive strategic adoption of technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, AWS Athena, EMR, Glue, Snowplow, and Kafka, ensuring robust data governance and quality practices.
Partner closely with product and data science teams to ensure the data and AI platform directly enables Keyloop's AI product initiatives, including KARA and AIME.
5. Enabling the Agentic Development Lifecycle
Lead Keyloop's transition to an agentic software development lifecycle, defining the strategy, frameworks, and delivery model for AI-augmented engineering at scale.
Develop and roll out the methodologies, toolchains, and workflows that enable engineering teams to work with AI coding agents, autonomous test generation, agentic PR review, and AI-assisted architecture decisions.
Build and own the internal platform capabilities required to support agentic workloads, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) server infrastructure, LLM gateway services, context management systems, and agent orchestration layers.
Drive the skills and capability development agenda across engineering, partnering with engineering directors to upskill teams in prompt engineering, AI-native development patterns, and responsible AI tooling practices.
Establish guardrails, security controls, and governance frameworks that allow teams to move fast with AI tooling without introducing risk to code quality, IP, or data security.
Drive and report on engineering AI maturity progression using Keyloop’s established AI maturity framework, setting stage-based targets, tracking adoption across teams, closing capability gaps, and accelerating teams from early experimentation to production-grade AI-augmented delivery.
6. Delivery Excellence & Observability
Oversee the execution of platform engineering initiatives, ensuring timely delivery, adherence to quality standards, and effective resource utilisation.
Define and embed observability standards across the platform (OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SLO/SLA frameworks), giving engineering teams clear visibility into platform health and performance.
Drive FinOps discipline across platform infrastructure, owning cloud cost governance and optimisation in partnership with the infrastructure leadership.
7. Strategic Collaboration
Collaborate closely with the CTO, engineering directors, architects, and product leadership to align platform capabilities with business priorities and product roadmaps.
Act as a strategic partner to the broader engineering organisation, ensuring platform decisions accelerate rather than constrain product delivery teams.
Represent platform and data engineering at the executive and board level, communicating strategy, progress, and investment cases clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Required Skills & Experience:
Technical & Architectural
Deep experience in cloud-native platform engineering on AWS, including IaC (Terraform or Pulumi), containerisation (Kubernetes/ECS), event streaming (Kafka), and API gateway patterns.
Proven track record designing and operating shared platform services - integration layers, identity, multi-tenancy, and developer-facing APIs - in a complex, multi-product enterprise SaaS environment.
Hands-on background in data platform engineering: data lake architecture, ELT pipelines, and familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS data services (Athena, Glue, EMR).
Experience building AI/ML infrastructure: feature stores, model serving, MLOps pipelines, and LLM-enabling platform capabilities such as MCP server infrastructure or LLM gateway services.
Strong understanding of platform observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SLO/error budget frameworks, and production reliability engineering.
Security-first mindset with hands-on experience in enterprise security practices, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2), and zero-trust architecture patterns.
Leadership & Delivery
Extensive engineering leadership experience, with a proven record of building, scaling, and developing high-performing distributed engineering teams of 60+ people.
Experience operating within an acquisitive software business, with the ability to lead M&A technical integration and platform standardisation across acquired codebases and teams.
Familiarity with modern delivery frameworks (SAFe, Shape Up, or equivalent) and the ability to adapt methodology to the needs of a platform organisation serving multiple internal customers.
Strong FinOps capability, including cloud cost governance, unit economics thinking, and the ability to frame infrastructure investment in commercial terms.
Agentic Engineering & AI Tooling
Practical experience adopting and scaling AI-native development tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) across engineering organisations.
Understanding of agentic software delivery patterns: autonomous agents, human-in-the-loop workflows, agentic code review, test generation, and AI-assisted architecture.
Ability to define governance frameworks that enable AI-augmented development at pace while managing code quality, IP protection, and data security risks.
Passion for driving engineering culture change, with the ability to take a sceptical or early-majority engineering team on a credible AI adoption journey.
Communication & Stakeholder Management
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex platform and data engineering decisions into clear narratives for executive, commercial, and board audiences.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with product, commercial, and finance leadership in a PE-backed, high-growth software environment.

jobs.title: CTO - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
jobs.text:
Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et de réalisation en technologie digitale. Ces dernières années, nous avons construit une expertise forte sur deux axes qui convergent : la donnée (plateformes data, gouvernance, qualité) et l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, agents, ML, vision par ordinateur). Ces deux expertises sont portées par notre entité Theodo Data & AI, qui accompagne les organisations à toutes les étapes de leur trajectoire data et IA.
Le marché est à un point d'inflexion. Les entreprises disposent de volumes considérables de données internes mais peinent à les exploiter, tandis que l'IA générative ouvre des possibilités inédites d'automatisation, d'aide à la décision et de transformation des processus métiers. Nos clients attendent un partenaire capable de couvrir toute la chaîne de valeur, de la stratégie data à l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA. Nous avons une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en nous appuyant sur notre approche Lean Tech® et nos partenariats stratégiques (Google Cloud Partner of the Year France 2025, AWS, Snowflake).
C'est cette practice que nous vous proposons de piloter.
Votre rôle
En tant que CTO Data & IA, vous êtes le leader qui fait le pont entre le business et la tech sur l'ensemble du périmètre Data & Intelligence Artificielle. Concrètement, vous portez quatre responsabilités.
Offre & expertise technique : vous positionnez Theodo à la pointe du marché. Vous benchmarkez les architectures data modernes (data platforms, data mesh, lakehouse) et les architectures IA (RAG, agents, semantic layer, fine-tuning, MLOps). Vous développez des accélérateurs et des enablers internes réutilisables, vous animez la communauté des leaders tech et data scientists, et vous formalisez les apprentissages pour capitaliser sur les retours de mission.
Vente & Solution Architecture : vous êtes le référent technique du cycle de vente. Vous intervenez en avant-vente comme solution architect de référence sur nos offres Data & IA, vous co-construisez les propositions techniques avec les équipes commerciales, et vous challengez et crédibilisez les réponses techniques face aux CTO, DSI et CDO de nos clients. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec notre Head of Sales sur le closing des deals stratégiques et sur nos partenariats.
Delivery : vous garantissez l'excellence et faites grandir les équipes. Vous communiquez en interne autour de nos offres pour attirer les meilleurs profils, et vous recrutez et formez nos ingénieurs data, data scientists et AI engineers.
Marketing technique : vous construisez notre visibilité et notre crédibilité sur le marché. Vous bâtissez et maintenez notre showroom (démos, cas d'usage de référence), vous produisez du contenu à fort impact (articles, livres blancs, tech radars), vous intervenez en conférences et événements (Nuit de la Data, Google Cloud Next, AWS Summit…), et vous alimentez nos partenariats technologiques avec du contenu technique.
Les défis qui vous attendent
Vous couvrirez un périmètre large qui va de la data platform à l'IA générative, en passant par la data science classique et le MLOps sans vous disperser.
Vous rejoindrez une équipe déjà expérimentée, avec une culture Theodo forte.
Vous articulerez une vision unifiée Data & IA là où le marché tend à séparer ces deux mondes, tout en conservant une équipe pluridisciplinaire (data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, MLOps) pour scaler la delivery.
Vous naviguerez dans un écosystème de partenaires technologiques variés (Google Cloud, AWS) en maintenant une posture agnostique crédible.
Et surtout, vous transformerez la vague GenAI en offres industrialisables et vendables, avec un ROI démontrable pour nos clients.
Votre environnement
Vous travaillerez avec les fondateurs du groupe pour définir la stratégie go-to-market et les priorités de la practice, avec les leaders de la practice et notre Head of Sales pour le closing des ventes et la structuration du pipeline, et avec les leaders tech Data et IA pour renforcer l'expertise collective.
Vous vous appuierez sur notre Head of Delivery pour garantir le respect de nos engagements clients, et sur nos partenaires technologiques (Google Cloud, AWS) pour co-construire des offres et maintenir nos certifications.
Vous managerez les équipes techniques de la practice Data & IA : data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers et MLOps engineers.
Ce que nous recherchons
Nous cherchons quelqu'un de passionné par la Data et l'IA, animé par un drive fort dans la durée et une curiosité insatiable pour les avancées technologiques (LLM, agents, data platforms, MLOps).
Vous êtes très fort en tech sur un spectre large : architectures data modernes (data mesh, lakehouse, governance frameworks) et architectures IA (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, évaluation de modèles, MLOps).
Vous avez un sens business affirmé : vous comprenez les job-to-be-done métier des clients, vous savez articuler la valeur délivrée et le ROI, et vous parlez le langage des CTO, DSI et CDO.
Vous êtes un très bon leader, capable d'aligner des profils data et IA variés autour d'une vision commune et de fédérer une communauté technique.
Vous êtes à l'aise en marketing technique : vous savez valoriser l'expertise créée, vous avez envie d'être visible, et vous êtes autant à votre aise en conférence qu'en rédaction de contenu.
Vous avez une grosse capacité d'exécution - focus, intensité, orientation delivery - et vous savez passer de la stratégie à l'opérationnel.
Enfin, vous avez la posture d'un solution architect : vous challengez et proposez des architectures techniques en avant-vente face à des interlocuteurs seniors.

blocks.text: Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et de réalisation en technologie digitale. Ces dernières années, nous avons construit une expertise forte sur deux axes qui convergent : la donnée (plateformes data, gouvernance, qualité) et l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, agents, ML, vision par ordinateur). Ces deux expertises sont portées par notre entité Theodo Data & AI, qui accompagne les organisations à toutes les étapes de leur trajectoire data et IA.

Le marché est à un point d'inflexion. Les entreprises disposent de volumes considérables de données internes mais peinent à les exploiter, tandis que l'IA générative ouvre des possibilités inédites d'automatisation, d'aide à la décision et de transformation des processus métiers. Nos clients attendent un partenaire capable de couvrir toute la chaîne de valeur, de la stratégie data à l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA. Nous avons une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en nous appuyant sur notre approche Lean Tech® et nos partenariats stratégiques (Google Cloud Partner of the Year France 2025, AWS, Snowflake).
C'est cette practice que nous vous proposons de piloter.
Votre rôle

En tant que CTO Data & IA, vous êtes le leader qui fait le pont entre le business et la tech sur l'ensemble du périmètre Data & Intelligence Artificielle. Concrètement, vous portez quatre responsabilités.

items: Offre & expertise technique : vous positionnez Theodo à la pointe du marché. Vous benchmarkez les architectures data modernes (data platforms, data mesh, lakehouse) et les architectures IA (RAG, agents, semantic layer, fine-tuning, MLOps). Vous développez des accélérateurs et des enablers internes réutilisables, vous animez la communauté des leaders tech et data scientists, et vous formalisez les apprentissages pour capitaliser sur les retours de mission.

Vente & Solution Architecture : vous êtes le référent technique du cycle de vente. Vous intervenez en avant-vente comme solution architect de référence sur nos offres Data & IA, vous co-construisez les propositions techniques avec les équipes commerciales, et vous challengez et crédibilisez les réponses techniques face aux CTO, DSI et CDO de nos clients. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec notre Head of Sales sur le closing des deals stratégiques et sur nos partenariats.

Delivery : vous garantissez l'excellence et faites grandir les équipes. Vous communiquez en interne autour de nos offres pour attirer les meilleurs profils, et vous recrutez et formez nos ingénieurs data, data scientists et AI engineers.

Marketing technique : vous construisez notre visibilité et notre crédibilité sur le marché. Vous bâtissez et maintenez notre showroom (démos, cas d'usage de référence), vous produisez du contenu à fort impact (articles, livres blancs, tech radars), vous intervenez en conférences et événements (Nuit de la Data, Google Cloud Next, AWS Summit…), et vous alimentez nos partenariats technologiques avec du contenu technique.

blocks.text: Les défis qui vous attendent

items: Vous couvrirez un périmètre large qui va de la data platform à l'IA générative, en passant par la data science classique et le MLOps sans vous disperser.

Vous articulerez une vision unifiée Data & IA là où le marché tend à séparer ces deux mondes, tout en conservant une équipe pluridisciplinaire (data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, MLOps) pour scaler la delivery.
Vous naviguerez dans un écosystème de partenaires technologiques variés (Google Cloud, AWS) en maintenant une posture agnostique crédible.
Et surtout, vous transformerez la vague GenAI en offres industrialisables et vendables, avec un ROI démontrable pour nos clients.

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO | AI & ML Startup
jobs.text:
About us
Expertise is the bottleneck in technical field service. We are building the AI that makes it scale – and learns from every visit, from every job.
Stealth-mode AI venture building a copilot that guides technicians at every job like an experienced master craftsman – before, during and after every job
Built in the field, not behind closed doors: our product is developed with direct access to thousands of technicians with a leading European real estate industry partner – every feature is tested on real jobs, with results in days instead of months
Backed by Founders Factory; founding team in Berlin, MVP built and tested with technicians, now heading towards spin-out and first funding
Vision: Europe’s leading field service intelligence layer.
The role
We have built and tested our MVP. Now we are looking for a hand-on Co-Founder & CTO who builds the technology and product that grows and scales the company.
What you will do
Own the technology end to end: architecture, roadmap, build-vs-buy decisions, reliability and security
Take the tested MVP to a production-grade product used daily by technicians in the field
Build reliable AI workflows and repeatable integrations into customer systems such as work orders and asset data
Continuously improve the Machine Learning core: retrieval over manufacturer and expert knowledge, multimodal input (photo, voice) and diagnostic reasoning
Design and build the learning engine that makes the product smarter with every visit: capturing, reviewing, evaluating and reusing confirmed outcomes – the core of our knowledge moat
Set up evaluation, safety and monitoring: expert-reviewed benchmark cases, grounding, escalation and regression testing
Build a state-of-the-art UX/UI that technicians want to use every day
Spend time with technicians in the field and turn their feedback into product within days
Recruit and lead the engineering team as we scale
Shape the company as a co-founder: strategy, culture and investor conversations alongside the founding team
What you bring
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning/AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field
Machine Learning experience, ideally 3+ years applying it in production products (e.g. LLMs, retrieval/RAG, NLP, computer vision, model evaluation)
Entrepreneurial mindset: you want to build a company, not just a product – full ownership, bias for action and comfort with ambiguity
Experience leading the technical build of a product from zero to one, e.g. as tech lead or founding engineer
Strong hands-on software engineering across backend, APIs, data pipelines and cloud – you still build and ship yourself
Sound technical judgement: you know the limits of LLMs, how to test them and when not to use them
Product empathy: you enjoy learning from users in the field and making complex work simple
Fluent German and English – German is needed for working with technicians and technical source material
Nice to have
PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Information Retrieval or a related field
Previous founder or early-stage startup experience
Experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise B2B requirements (security, GDPR, multi-tenant SaaS)
Background in field service, industrial, maintenance or proptech software
Experience with multimodal AI, voice interfaces or decision-support systems
Experience hiring and leading engineering teams
What we offer
Competitive compensation package, including a meaningful co-founder equity stake
A true co-founder role with ownership of the technology and a real say in the direction of the company
An unfair head start: a cooperating partner with thousands of technicians and real repair data from day one – the fuel for a system that learns from every job
A tested MVP and a clear path to spin-out and funding
Support from Founders Factory’s network across tech, design and growth
A mission with real-world impact: helping close the skilled-trades gap in Europe
Location & start
Berlin / hybrid, flexible
Full-time; start as soon as possible
How to apply
Send your CV or LinkedIn profile with a short note on why you want to build this company with us and an example of Machine Learning work you have shipped

jobs.text:
Building anAI‑first organisationis central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function — to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve, must drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.
Clinisys has built an unrivalled reputation for deploying complex diagnostic networks and academic centres – and is the only provider to repetitively deliver to all disciplines end-to-end – at scale. Fostering healthier communities.
Lead Product Strategy and Growth for the Future of Healthcare Technology
Building an AI-first organisation is central to Clinisys' purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI-enabled, cloud-based platforms that enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. We expect our leaders to embrace AI, drive innovation, and create measurable business and customer value through intelligent technology.
Clinisys is seeking a Director, Product Management - UKI to lead strategy, growth, and portfolio direction for a critical healthcare technology portfolio.
This role combines UK market leadership with global product influence. You will own product vision, commercial outcomes, and roadmap execution while helping shape the evolution of our Order Communications portfolio into a unified global platform.
This is an opportunity to drive growth, lead AI-powered innovation, and influence products that support healthcare providers and diagnostic services worldwide.
What You'll Do
Define and own product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management.
Own commercial outcomes across adoption, retention, renewals, expansion, and revenue growth.
Lead the UKI Order Communications product strategy while influencing global portfolio direction.
Drive convergence of regional products into a scalable global platform, balancing local market needs with global efficiency and reuse.
Lead go-to-market strategy and execution in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Services, and Support.
Leverage customer, market, competitive, and industry insights to inform product investment decisions and strengthen market positioning.
Improve customer value, adoption, and time-to-value through outcome-driven product leadership.
Define and deliver AI-led product innovation that creates measurable customer and business value.
Represent Product Management within UKI leadership and strategic planning discussions.
What You'll Bring
Senior Product Management leadership experience with accountability for business and commercial outcomes.
Demonstrated success growing enterprise software, SaaS, or healthcare technology products.
Proven experience translating product strategy into measurable growth across revenue, adoption, retention, or market share.
Experience defining and executing platform and portfolio strategies at scale.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and investment priorities.
Experience leading go-to-market initiatives alongside Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success functions.
Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, and influencing skills.
Experience working within regulated software environments.
Experience defining, launching, or scaling AI-enabled products, capabilities, or product strategies.
Preferred
Healthcare, diagnostics, pathology, laboratory, NHS, or LIMS experience.
Experience consolidating multiple products into a common global platform.
Experience delivering products within highly regulated healthcare environments.
Experience bringing AI-enabled capabilities successfully to market.
Advanced degree or equivalent leadership experience.
Why Clinisys?
This is an opportunity to shape the future of healthcare technology while leading strategy for a portfolio supporting critical clinical and diagnostic workflows.
You will influence both UK and global product direction, drive AI-powered innovation, accelerate commercial growth, and play a key role in the evolution of a unified global platform.
Working alongside executive leaders across Product, Engineering, Services, Sales, and Support, you will help determine what we build, how we win, and how we scale.
This role requires a working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and the ability to leverage them to improve processes and outcomes. A core understanding of AI concepts is required and must be able to demonstrate the use of AI tools in a professional setting.
Onboarding
As part of our onboarding process, all new employees will be required to attend / travel to the office on their first day of employment. This requirement is essential for onboarding activities, including the identity verification, completion of necessary documentation, receiving your IT equipment, introductions to key team members, and orientation to Clinisys policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Head of Product
Our mission for you
European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.
trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.
We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.
trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.
We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.
Your team
You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.
You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:
Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.
Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.
Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.
Who we are looking for
Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.
Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.
Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.
Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.
Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.
AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.
Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.
At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.
90 Day Goals
After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):
You deeply understand trawa's business and product
You have established your philosophy of running Product & Tech teams’ delivery
You shape new quarterly roadmap and OKR plans for your teams
Month 3 (Ramp-Up):
You have assembled the company around your product vision for the entire customer journey
Your vision for the customer journey comes to live - first key metrics are moved
Your teams follow your rhythm of value delivery in fast measurable iterations
Why us?
Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.
The Role: This is a rare opportunity to own product end-to-end at a company where product is the business. You won't be managing a feature backlog — you'll be shaping a platform that spans energy trading, real-time asset steering, and enterprise software. Few product roles in Europe offer this combination of complexity, commercial impact, and speed.
Responsibility & Support: You'll join the leadership team with direct impact on company strategy. We support you through regular leadership sessions, cross-department leadership initiatives, and experienced mentors who want to see you succeed.
Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.
Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.
Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

jobs.title: Manager CTO Office

blocks.text: Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.
Wat ga je doen?
Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.
Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.
Sturing en beheersing

Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.
Verandering en verbetering

Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.
Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:
Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;
Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;
Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;
Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;
Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;
Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;
Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.
Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;
Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.
Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.
Dit breng je minimaal mee:
WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;
Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;
Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;
Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;
Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;
Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.
Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur.
