jobs.title: Director of Customer Service Technology & Systems
jobs.text:
About the role
Our Customer Experience team is growing fast, and we want our technology to grow its capacity as well. We're looking for a Director of CX Technology and Systems to own the CX technology stack: set the multi-year vision, then personally configure, test, integrate, and ship against it.
You'll lead our biggest contact center initiatives, including modernizing our CCaaS and telephony platforms, expanding AI agent capabilities, and deepening integrations across our e-commerce, OMS, and ERP systems in partnership with our Product / Engineering teams. This is an owner-operator role, not a vendor-management role. You'll build the first version yourself and grow into leading a team as the business need dictates.
You'll measure success by the efficiency you gain, the friction you remove for agents and customers, and the long-term capacity you create.
About FCP Euro
FCP Euro is the trusted home and online destination for European car owners and professionals. Family-owned since 1986, our mission is to make European vehicle ownership more enjoyable and enduring by delivering the highest quality parts, knowledge, and support people can rely on. At FCP Euro, we exist to empower owners and professionals with the confidence and support to care for their European cars properly. That commitment has made us more than a retailer, but a long-term partner for those who value quality, expertise, and trust throughout the life of their vehicle.
What you'll do
Lead platform migrations and implementation
Lead CCaaS and telephony upgrades and migrations through every phase: discovery, requirements, design, build, testing, cutover, and hypercare.
Personally design and configure contact flows, IVR logic, queues, routing profiles, skills-based and priority routing, and disaster recovery behavior.
Build test and cutover plans, including parallel run strategy, rollback criteria, and service-level protection during transition.
Manage implementation partners and vendors, owning scopes of work, milestones, acceptance criteria, and post-launch support.
Lead agent and supervisor training with our Knowledge Management and Learning team, and set platform administration standards with IT.
Put AI and agent augmentation to work
Own optimization of Zendesk Copilot and other agent assist tools, from procedure design and macro hygiene to suggested-response tuning and adoption tracking.
Identify, pilot, and launch AI agent and agent augmentation capabilities across voice, email, chat, and self-service.
Define how every automation is measured: containment, deflection, escalation rate, resolution quality, CSAT, and handle time.
Partner with Voice of Customer and QA to make sure automation improves the customer experience, and speak up when a tool isn't meeting the bar.
Maintain an efficiency ledger showing capacity created, cost per contact impact, and headcount avoided.
Set the CX technology strategy
Own a rolling multi-year roadmap for the CX stack, sequenced against growth plans, contact volume forecasts, and the budget cycle.
Build business cases for major investments, covering total cost of ownership, implementation effort, and expected efficiency gains.
Scan the CCaaS, agent assist, and AI agent market, run structured evaluations and pilots, and make clear build, buy, or defer recommendations.
Define the target-state architecture for how Zendesk (or alternative platform), telephony, Solidus, Coresense, and future systems share data.
Connect systems and listen to the front line
Serve as the primary CX partner to Product and Engineering, writing requirements and user stories and following work through to adoption.
Drive integrations so agents can resolve orders, returns, replacements, and Lifetime Replacement Guarantee claims without switching systems.
Spend regular time on the floor and on the phones, and run a transparent process for capturing and prioritizing friction reported by the team.
Partner with Service Delivery so workforce management, quality, and other tools fit the way the team actually works.
What you bring
8+ years in customer experience, contact center, or service operations, including 3+ years owning systems, tooling, or technology for a CX organization.
Ownership of at least one end-to-end CCaaS or telephony migration, from platform selection through cutover and stabilization. Amazon Connect experience is strongly preferred; Genesys, NICE, Five9, Talkdesk, or comparable experience is relevant.
Hands-on Zendesk administration across Support, Talk, Guide, Explore, triggers, automations, SLAs, and APIs, including sandbox and release practices (or comparable system).
A track record of optimizing a CCaaS or CRM environment after go-live, with measurable gains in throughput, handle time, or cost per contact.
Practical experience deploying AI or automation in a service environment, with a clear view of what worked, what didn't, and how you measured it.
Integration literacy: REST APIs, webhooks, middleware or iPaaS tools, CRM/OMS/ERP data mapping, and enough SQL to validate your work.
Experience selecting and managing vendors and implementation partners, from RFPs through acceptance.
Experience partnering with Product and Engineering, including writing requirements, joining sprints, and driving adoption after release.
Strong project and change management: realistic sequencing, dependency and risk management, and clear communication to leadership.
Comfort with CX metrics such as contact rate, contacts per order, handle time, occupancy, cost per contact, containment, and deflection.
A scrappy, hands-on style and customer-first judgment, including the willingness to slow down an efficiency initiative that hurts customers or agents.
A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
This is a remote job with some travel to our Connecticut facility required.
Compensation
The base salary range for this role is $145,000 to $165,000 depending on experience, with a total compensation opportunity of $160,000 to $185,000 annually plus eligibility for participation in our FCP Euro equity program.
Benefits and Perks
Company-subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, including a zero-premium Medical plan for employees. Company HSA contribution.
120 hours of PTO (Paid Time Off), 40 hours of Paid Sick Time plus Company Holidays
401k with Company deposit and match.
Discounted prices on our catalog of European car parts!
No phone calls or agency referrals, please.
FCP Euro provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination or harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, sex, gender identity or expression, national origin, cultural heritage, ancestry, political belief, age, marital status, family status, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, intellectual disability, learning disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by the law

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
Our Story
At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline. Our software empowers sales associates to have more personal, effective conversations with customers through AI-powered tools that drive measurable revenue.
Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, most platforms overlook the in-store experience. We’re changing that. We’re helping brands like Reformation, Gorjana, Glossier, Frame, and Mizzen+Main turn real customer relationships into growth powered by intuitive software and thoughtful design.
With rapid growth ahead, we’re scaling our Product organization and need a steady, capable leader to help us get there.
Position Overview
Endear is hiring a VP of Product to take day-to-day ownership of the product organization during a pivotal phase of growth. Partnering closely with leadership on long-term vision, you will translate company goals into clear product priorities and lead execution against the agreed mission.
This role is central to making Endear’s product team AI-native. You will improve how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, make decisions, and accelerate shipping—not just shape Endear’s AI product direction. You will bring a zero-to-one mindset, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and build the operating model needed for product, design, and engineering to move faster together.
This is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You will lead and develop the product team, partner deeply with Design and Engineering, assess team structure and resourcing, and hire additional product talent as needed. We are looking for someone who has shipped products in lean environments, can go deep when needed, and knows how to build scalable processes without adding unnecessary overhead
What You’ll Accomplish
In your first 6 months, you’ll…
Take clear day-to-day ownership of product, turning company priorities into an actionable roadmap and measurable outcomes.
Align leadership, Product, Design, and Engineering around a cohesive product vision and a clear path to execution.
Assess the current team, operating model, and resourcing; identify what needs to change to improve speed, ownership, and accountability.
Establish stronger product rituals and decision-making systems that help the team ship with more focus and less friction.
Build practical customer-feedback loops into roadmap and prioritization decisions.
Make the product organization more AI-native by improving how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, prioritize, and ship.
In your first year, you’ll…
Build a high-performing product organization with clear ownership, strong psychological safety, and the right team structure for the next stage.
Hire and develop product talent, including an additional PM, while evaluating the capabilities and resourcing the team needs.
Deliver high-impact roadmap work that improves product adoption and business outcomes.
Establish scalable planning, execution, and communication systems that keep teams aligned as Endear grows.
Help shape and execute Endear’s AI product direction while ensuring the team can move quickly from idea to shipped product.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If…
You Have Experience With
Leading product at a lean B2B SaaS company, with both strategic ownership and hands-on execution.
Turning company goals into clear product priorities, success metrics, and decisions.
Building and communicating product vision, then translating it into focused execution.
Partnering deeply with Design and Engineering, including going technical when needed.
Leading, mentoring, and growing Product Managers while maintaining a high bar for delivery.
Building product processes that add clarity and speed without creating unnecessary overhead.
Using AI tools in day-to-day product work—from research and problem framing to prototyping, prioritization, and execution.
Transforming how product teams work in an AI-native environment.
Using customer feedback, usage data, and market insight to guide roadmap decisions.
Operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving growth-stage environments.
Align With What We Value
At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:
Customer First: Prioritize real customer problems over internal assumptions. Use research, feedback, and product data to ensure the roadmap delivers meaningful value to merchants and sales associates.
Take Ownership: Own outcomes, not just outputs. Take responsibility for product direction, team performance, and the impact product decisions have on the business.
Enable Autonomy: Build clear product strategy, priorities, and processes so product, design, and engineering teams can execute with confidence and independence.
Under Promise, Over Deliver: Set realistic expectations for product initiatives and deliver consistent, measurable improvements that build trust with customers and the team.
Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: Balance thoughtful strategy with a bias toward action. Test ideas, iterate quickly, and ship improvements that create real business impact.
About the Team
You’ll partner most closely with:
Executive Team: Align product strategy with company goals, provide visibility into roadmap priorities and performance, and partner on key decisions around growth and product direction.
Head of Product Design: strategy, feedback, and design system development
Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, and merchant needs
Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration
We’re a small team with big ambitions—collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter Screen
Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager + Co-Founder
Panel interview with key Product and Engineering team members
Final conversation with Co-Founder + CTO
Offer 🎉
Compensation & Benefits
Base Salary: $190+240k
Equity Eligible
Fully remote team
Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
Co-working or home office stipend
Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation
Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry
Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box
If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. We care about skills, motivation, and how you think more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Data Governance and Analytics Architecture Director
jobs.text:
Overview
The Data Governance & Analytics Architecture Director is a leader within the Health Enablement Analytics organization responsible for ensuring all data, analytics, and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, standardized, and governed foundation. This role serves as a subject matter expert for data governance, analytics architecture, and AI/ML best practices across Health Enablement. This role provides advisory leadership, technical guidance, and architecture standards to ensure analytics and innovation efforts are aligned to enterprise data strategy and built in a scalable, sustainable manner.
This position operates as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Analytics, and Reporting teams helping shape how solutions are designed and delivered; enabling Health Enablement Analytics to operate as a reliable, high-impact capability, driving measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
Data Governance & Standards
Contribute to the development of data governance standards, and best practices across analytics and reporting.
Provide guidance on data quality, consistency, and appropriate use of enterprise data assets.
Support the standardization of data models, business metrics, and reusable data assets to improve consistency and efficiency.
Implement governance frameworks, ensuring policies are embedded into day-to-day data and analytics workflows.
Establish clear data stewardship accountability across business and analytics teams.
Oversee data quality processes, metadata management, and governance monitoring to ensure sustained data integrity.
Serve as the primary point of contact for Information Governance, data risk, and compliance alignment.
Data Architecture & Platform Alignment
Drive standardization of data assets to reduce fragmentation and enable consistent cross-domain insights.
Provide subject matter expertise on analytics architecture across BI, reporting, and advanced analytics.
Partner with teams to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise data platforms and long‑term strategy.
Recommend architectural approaches that support scalability, interoperability, and reuse.
Technical Enablement & Scalable Delivery
Serve as a technical SME contributing to AI/ML standards and best practices.
Provide guidance to ensure analytic and AI solutions are designed for scalability and sustainability.
Advise on approaches to monitor performance, manage technical debt, and identify architectural risk.
Assess technical feasibility of innovation and analytics initiatives and provide input on viable solution approaches.
Consult on solution design to support production readiness and scalability.
Identify constraints in data or architecture and propose practical workarounds to enable business outcomes.
Define guardrails that enable faster decision-making and reduce execution friction.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
Serve as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Data Science, Reporting, and broader enterprise teams.
Translate business and analytics requirements into technical solutions and executable designs.
Provide input on feasibility, architecture, and standards to support solution development.
Collaborate across teams to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with enterprise direction while meeting business needs.
Contribute technical expertise to vendor evaluations and platform decisions as needed.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field required.
10+ years of experience in data governance, data architecture, data engineering, and analytics roles.
5+ years of leadership experience driving data governance, data architecture, and analytics platform initiatives at enterprise scale.
Proven ability to define and implement data governance frameworks, standards, and data quality processes.
Strong expertise in: data modeling, data warehousing and lakehouse architectures, cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems.
Experience enabling analytics and AI/ML solutions to scale from prototype to production deployment.
Strong understanding of BI platforms, ETL/ELT frameworks, and data lifecycle management.
Experience working across analytics, product, engineering, and innovation teams in complex environments.
Ability to translate business and analytics priorities into scalable technical architecture and design.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making capabilities.
Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment as part of a distributed team with effective communication and collaboration skills.
Proven ability to handle stressful situations, multiple tasks, and deadline Enterprise project management methods and process management experience preferred.
Shares information with all appropriate stakeholders and escalates to director in a timely, effective.
Strong written and oral communication The ability to communicate effectively (clear, concise, and professionally) at all levels within Cotiviti.
Demonstrated teamwork, leadership, and project management discipline.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally to drive business outcomes.
Cognitive/Mental Requirements:
Communicating with others to exchange information.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Critical thinker and problem solver with strong analytic modeling and technical skills.
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
No adverse environmental conditions expected
Base compensation ranges from $150,000 to $200,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

jobs.text:
Description
We're seeking an exceptional, hands-on Data Scientist with deep expertise in data science, MLOps, and building GenAI solutions to join our Enterprise Data & Data Science team. In this role, you'll identify, evaluate, and develop solutions at the intersection of data science, generative AI, and enterprise data strategy—including GenAI evaluation frameworks and semantic data layers. You'll also serve as a community champion, driving the adoption of best practices across a large, collaborative data science organization.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and evaluate generative AI solutions and agentic systems
Develop and maintain data semantic layers and knowledge graphs for enterprise-scale data accessibility
Build evaluation frameworks and tools to assess GenAI systems' performance, reliability, and safety
Collaborate with other data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and business partners
Champion best practices and tooling across a broad data science community
Lead cross-functional working groups and contribute to innovation in AI/ML methods
Communicate complex technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Serve as a technical consultant on complex, high-impact projects
Please note this is an individual contributor role
Qualifications
Broad knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
Advanced knowledge of predictive toolset; reflects as expert resource for tool development.
Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely.
Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the organization.
Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
Ability to use results of analysis to persuade team, department management or senior management to a particular course of action.
Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Master`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
Preferred Experience:
Strong foundation in data science and machine learning
Proven MLOps expertise across the complete data science lifecycle
Experience building GenAI solutions and agentic systems
Familiarity with GenAI evaluation methodologies
Experience with data semantic layers and/or knowledge graphs
Track record of cross-functional collaboration in a large enterprise environment
Ability to work ET hours

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. jobs.title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
jobs.text:
Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.
The Role
The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.
Top Responsibilities:
Client Measurement & Data Strategy
• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.
• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.
• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.
• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.
• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.
Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving
• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.
• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.
• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.
• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.
Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.
• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.
• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.
• Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.
Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership
• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.
• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.
• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.
• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.
What Success Looks Like:
By 6 Months
The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.
By 1 Year
The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.
Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:
• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity
• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences
• Commercially minded
• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels
• Naturally curious and innovative
• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader
Minimum Qualifications & Skills:
• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy
• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams
• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing
• Experience leading teams and developing talent
• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing
• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)
• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics
• SQL and data querying experience preferred
WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?
Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.
AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER
100% remote work for everyone
Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
401K with matching
Open Paid Time Off
Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
Focus Fridays
Paid Parental Leave Benefits
Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!
Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience.
Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.
Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
jobs.text:
The role
As an Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will be a senior member of a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.
This role balances corporate development / M&A with corporate strategy. You lead projects across both areas as the day-to-day owner and guide a small number of more junior colleagues and internal functional experts. You operate with minimal direction and take projects from a vague problem statement to a CEO-ready recommendation. You also stay hands-on, personally building the models and analysis and preparing the executive-level outputs that drive investment and strategy decisions.
What you’ll do
M&A Strategy: Lead M&A projects end to end (owning small and mid-sized transactions independently and partnering with the Director on the largest, transformational deals), from target screening and valuation through due diligence, negotiation preparation, and post-deal integration. Run deal teams day to day, coordinate external advisors and act as the lead with target management teams or their advisors. You are not just a process manager but can form and defend a point of view on whether and why a deal makes strategic sense and present it directly to senior leadership.
Portfolio Optimization: Lead the strategic analysis and recommendations for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.
Corporate Strategy: Contribute to the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, owning the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
Capital Allocation: Own and develop analytical frameworks and models to support strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.
Business Unit Strategy: Act as a senior internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.
What you’ll bring
Experience: 6+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team. This includes leading projects or deal teams with minimal supervision.
Process and deal leadership: You have led complex, multi-stakeholder processes to a deadline, coordinating internal functions and external advisors and managing senior counterparties such as target or client management teams. This can come from running M&A transactions (in-house corporate development or advisory) or from leading strategy projects with transaction exposure, such as due diligence, carve-outs, partnerships or market entries. Direct M&A process experience is a strong plus; the ability to learn it quickly is essential.
Leadership and Influence: You have guided and developed more junior colleagues and influenced senior stakeholders, including through negotiation and building rapport with counterparties.
Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You structure ambiguous problems and set direction for others, not just solve them yourself. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
Financial Acumen: Expert-level financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended complex models used for high-stakes investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentations and memos for an executive audience.
How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.
What you will get in return:
70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
Company pension scheme
Gym membership
Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
Nursery support scheme
Cycle to work scheme
Group Life Assurance
Location: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London
Hybrid Working Policy
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.
Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.
To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.
You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Implementations - Workflow
jobs.text:
Job Purpose The Director, Technology Implementations - Workflow is responsible for leading the successful implementation, adoption, optimization, and ongoing support of the collections workflow platform. The Director, Technology Implementations - Workflow serves as the primary bridge between Product, Analytics, Data, Operations, Client Delivery, and Support teams to ensure that the platform continues to evolve while delivering measurable client outcomes. The Director, Technology Implementations - Workflow will own the implementation roadmap, guide product enhancements, manage a team of implementation and support professionals, and drive continuous improvement across implementation, onboarding, and support processes. Duties & Responsibilities
Serve as the owner and primary advocate for the collections workflow platform
Lead implementation efforts for new collections clients and existing client expansions
Oversee solution design, workflow configuration, testing, training, go-live, and stabilization activities
Ensure successful integration of client data, workflows, and operational processes into the platform
Drive implementation best practices, standards, templates, and governance
Identify implementation risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies
Establish scalable implementation methodologies to support continued growth
Partner with Product, Operations, and Engineering to define product vision, priorities, and roadmap
Gather feedback from implementations, operations teams, and clients to identify enhancement opportunities
Build, mentor, and lead a team of implementation consultants and solution analysts
Create a culture of accountability, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning
Establish performance metrics, implementation of KPIs, support SLAs, and operational dashboards
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across onboarding, support, and product adoption processes
Develop team capabilities in technical troubleshooting, workflow optimization, and client consulting
Act as the primary escalation point for complex implementation and support issues
Facilitate alignment between business requirements and technical execution
Ensure stakeholder transparency through executive reporting and regular status communications
Oversee post-go-live client support and transition to steady-state operations
Partner with support and development teams to resolve high-priority client concerns
Other duties as assigned
Use, protect and disclose patients’ protected health information (PHI) only in accordance with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) standards.
Understand and comply with Information Security and HIPAA policies and procedures at all times.
Limit viewing of PHI to the absolute minimum as necessary to perform assigned duties.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field
7+ years of experience in healthcare technology, software implementations, product management, or technical operations
3+ years leading implementation, support, consulting, or product-focused teams
Experience serving as a Product Owner, Solution Owner, Technical Lead, or Implementation Leader
Proven experience managing complex software implementations
Comfortable presenting to executives, clients, and technical teams with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively
Strong SQL skills with the ability to write complex queries, analyze datasets to validate implementation results
Knowledge of healthcare data transactions including 837, 835, 277
Knowledge of AWS Cloud technologies, AI/ ML-enabled healthcare applications preferred
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
Strong interpersonal skills, ability to communicate well at all levels of the organization
Strong problem solving and creative skills and the ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions based on accurate and timely analyses
High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results oriented
Excellent written and verbal communication skills required
Working Conditions
Willingness to work a flexible schedule and outside of normal business hours as needed
Travel to client sites may be required up to 5% annually
Must possess a smart-phone or electronic device capable of downloading applications, for multifactor authentication and security purposes
Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to move around the work area; Sit; perform manual tasks; operate tools and other office equipment such as computer, computer peripherals and telephones; extend arms; kneel; talk and hear
Mental Demands: The employee must be able to follow directions, collaborate with others, and handle stress
Work Environment: The noise level in the work environment is usually minimal
Med-Metrix will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, veteran status, other non-merit based factors, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
The Mission: Club Arran delivers complex digital services across UK Central Government. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together Product, Delivery, UCD, Architecture and Engineering to solve problems and deliver sustainable outcomes.
We are now building on that foundation to become an AI integration consultancy for government: helping clients take AI and emerging technologies beyond experimentation and into real services, safely and sustainably.
We are looking for a Head of Product to champion user-centred design and product strategy, ensuring that as we integrate advanced technologies, we never lose sight of the user's needs.
Reporting to the Club Executive and sitting on the Club Leadership Team, you will be accountable for product and UCD excellence across Arran's portfolio and act as the Head of Profession for our Product and UCD capabilities.
In this role, you will split your focus between high-impact client engagements, acting as an executive advisor and strategic lead on flagship accounts, and practice leadership, capability development, and driving commercial growth across the club.
You will create the conditions in which multidisciplinary teams can build impactful government services: aligning stakeholders around a clear vision, navigating GDS Service Assessments, discovering true user needs, and ensuring our solutions deliver tangible value to citizens and civil servants alike
Your priority will be leading our Product, BA and UCD disciplines on an evolving AI journey, driving practical upskilling, leveraging AI to unlock efficiencies, and empowering teams to confidently articulate AI opportunities to clients, while assuring deliverable quality, maximising project outcomes and learning, navigating government service assessments, and coaching teams.
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio product leadership & quality assurance: Own the product strategy and user-centred design quality across Arran’s portfolio. Act as a strategic advisor to senior civil servants and the senior escalation point for product vision, quality, and GDS Service Assessment risks. Establish outcome frameworks (KPIs/OKRs) and roadmapping standards across the full product lifecycle from Discovery through to live service operationalisation.
GDS & Service Standard excellence: Champion the GOV.UK Service Standard and UCD best practice across the club. Set the benchmark for Discovery, Alpha, Beta, and Live phases, assuring high-confidence outcomes in rigorous government Service Assessments.
Product management for AI & emerging tech: Lead the product vision for AI-enabled government services. Ensure AI integrations solve real, validated user problems rather than being technology-led, addressing ethical considerations, accessibility, and safe service design.
Problem-focused leadership & integrity: Provide the critical counterweight across Arran's leadership team and senior stakeholders, possessing the standing and conviction to challenge groupthink and tie technical ambition back to validated user needs, ethics, and measurable public value. Obsess over unpicking complex problems rather than jumping to prespecified solutions. Be ready to pivot strategy or halt unviable initiatives when user research, data, or operational realities dictate.
Product & UCD profession leadership: Act as Head of Profession for Product Management, Business Analysis, and UCD. Recruit, manage, and inspire practitioners. Define professional standards, conduct SFIA reviews, manage career and pay progression, and foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation. Support and actively participate in our Community of Practice, collaborating with other Heads of Product to develop and support career pathways, training, and learning opportunities.
Client leadership & consulting: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior government stakeholders. Advise senior civil servants on digital strategy, organisational reform, and policy delivery, cutting through ambiguity, defining product visions, and transitioning from traditional IT mindsets to agile, user-centric product management. Influence both explicit and implicit stakeholder needs.
Multidisciplinary team leadership: Partner closely with the Head of Delivery and Head of Engineering to balance user needs, technical feasibility, and delivery constraints. Create multidisciplinary teams focused on outcomes, collaboration, and continuous improvement while maintaining sustainable delivery, accountability, and product quality.
Growth, propositions & bids: Play a pivotal role in winning new business, shaping and pitching product and UCD approaches, estimating team sizes and makeups, and writing compelling technical and commercial responses for strategically important public sector bids.
Club leadership & commercial management: Share accountability with the Club Executive and leadership team for Club Arran’s overall financial and operational performance. Co-manage the Club P&L, maintaining oversight of commercial health, revenue, margin, utilisation, and forecasting. Ensure Statements of Work (SoW) are deliverable and financially viable, balancing client outcomes, team wellbeing, quality standards, and commercial performance to protect and grow client accounts.

jobs.title: VP & GM: Product Platform
jobs.text:
Why Entersekt
Founded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks. We offer highly scalable products with a track record of success across multiple continents.
Entersekt enables secure digital transactions for leading financial institutions globally. We exist to create a world where everyone can transact digitally without fear or compromise. Currently, we protect the digital transactions of over 210 million active users on our platform and hold 120 active patents that recognize innovation in digital security, payments, and user experience. Entersekt offers customers secure authentication and digital payments experiences that remove unnecessary friction. Entersekt has a diverse product portfolio and aggressive roadmap that positions the company well to sustain competitive advantage as it expands globally with emphasis on North America and European markets.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded product leader who combines strong platform thinking with a relentless focus on adoption and business value. You’re comfortable operating across product, technology and commercial considerations, turning complex and sometimes competing needs into clear priorities and scalable platform solutions.
You build credibility quickly and influence effectively across teams, including where you don’t have direct authority. You’re equally comfortable shaping strategy with senior leaders, making tough roadmap and investment trade-offs, and developing a high-performing product team.
The Role
Owns the end-to-end success of the Platform components, as a horizontal capability that other portfolio solutions build on and consume. Accountable not just for the health of the platform components individually, but for the penetration and value they deliver when embedded across the broader portfolio. Success is measured as much by cross-portfolio adoption as by each component’s standalone quality.
Responsibilities
Own the strategy, roadmap, and business performance for the Entersekt Platform including Portal, Administration, Reporting, Detection & Decisioning capabilities.
Set the product vision for how these & future components serve as reusable building blocks rather than siloed products
Partner with your Pier GMs to drive an explicit adoption strategy and targets for each component across all portfolio solutions (e.g., % of solutions integrated, active usage within each solution, time-to-integrate) and identify evolving needs that should be served via reusable platform components
Remove adoption blockers - technical debt, integration friction, packaging/pricing barriers, or lack of awareness - that slow uptake
Build the internal "go-to-market" motion for the platform itself: enablement, documentation, migration support, and success stories that make adoption easy for other product teams
Balance platform roadmap decisions against the sometimes-competing needs of multiple consuming product lines - arbitrating trade-offs transparently
Own cost, investment, and value-capture model for the platform
Define and track health metrics per component (usage, reliability, performance, satisfaction)
Build and lead product management (and potentially design/eng-partnership) for the three components
Represent Platform in executive/portfolio planning forums
Skills and Experience
Successful candidates for this role will generally possess the following qualifications and experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Commerce or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience essential.
Postgraduate qualification such as an MBA, Master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent executive/business education advantageous.
10+ years’ experience in Product Management, Product Leadership or a related technology product discipline, including significant experience in a senior product leadership role.
Proven experience owning product strategy, roadmaps and business performance for complex B2B technology, SaaS or platform products.
Demonstrated experience building or scaling platform products/shared capabilities consumed by multiple products, solutions or product teams.
Strong track record of driving platform adoption and measurable usage, including identifying and removing technical, integration, commercial and organisational barriers to adoption.
Experience balancing the competing requirements of multiple product lines and making transparent roadmap, investment and prioritisation trade-offs.
Experience developing business cases, investment models and value-capture approaches, with strong commercial and financial judgement.
Experience defining and managing product health and performance measures covering areas such as adoption, usage, reliability, performance and stakeholder/customer satisfaction.
Proven experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical leadership on architecture, integration, technical debt and platform scalability decisions.
Demonstrated experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders across functions, including achieving alignment without direct authority.
Proven people leadership experience, including building, developing and leading product teams and holding teams accountable for outcomes.
Personality Attributes
Strategic and systems-minded, able to connect customer, product, technology and business considerations.
Influential and collaborative, building alignment across diverse stakeholders and conflicting perspectives.
Commercially pragmatic, balancing long-term platform strategy with business and portfolio needs.
Decisive in ambiguity, comfortable navigating complexity and making clear trade-offs.
Low ego, high conviction, open to challenge and feedback while confident in making difficult decisions.
Clear and candid, able to simplify complex topics and communicate decisions with impact.
Outcome-focused, measuring success through adoption, value and results rather than output alone.
Accountable and dependable, taking ownership, following through and setting a strong standard for others.
We place a lot of value on how we treat prospective employees and appreciate the time and effort that goes into job hunting. That is why we aim to keep the hiring process as quick and seamless as possible while ensuring the best possible fit for both you and the company.
Working at Entersekt is truly a dream. You get exposed to cutting-edge technology, colleagues who are leaders in their fields, and an awesome working environment that includes flexible hours, remote work, and plenty of growth opportunities.
Apply for this position by following the "apply now" tab and or viewing our other roles at Entersekt Careers page.
Entersekt is an Equal Opportunity Employer:
We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. For all South Africa-based roles, preference will be given to candidates from historically disadvantaged groups, in accordance with local Employment Equity objectives.

jobs.title: Director of Product, EQA
jobs.text:
Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) is seeking a Director of Product to lead and scale a high-performing product organization responsible for both defining the future of our portfolio growth investments and delivering strong in-market performance today.
In this role, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle of hardware and software products in the healthcare equipment quality assurance market. You will lead a team of Product Managers and Product Planners to ensure clear decisions on what to build, when to build it, and how to win in-market.
You will operate at both the strategic and business operations level, balancing long-term growth strategy with near-term results and influencing key stakeholders across the organization. Success in this role requires the ability to drive transformation, scale teams and processes, and consistently deliver measurable business outcomes.
Who You Are
Product leader with a demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels across a complex portfolio
Strong decision-maker who drives clarity on investment priorities, portfolio tradeoffs, and resource allocation
Builder of high-performing and engaged teams
results oriented leader, focused on driving growth, profitability, and competitive advantage
Influential communicator who can align senior stakeholders on a path for action
Key Responsibilities Portfolio Leadership & Business Performance
Own the end-to-end performance of the product portfolio, including revenue, margin, growth, and competitive positioning
Drive strategic alignment between maximizing new product introductions and sustaining investments across product lines.
Establish accountability for delivering business outcomes across the organization
Ensure data-driven and financially grounded roadmap decisions through innovation funnel stage gate processes
Product Strategy & Innovation Oversight
Lead front-end innovation and product planning, ensuring focus on high-impact opportunities
Drive use of market insights, Voice of Customer, and competitive intelligence in decisions
Oversee product strategies, business cases, and portfolio roadmaps
Drive enterprise-level prioritization and tradeoff decisions
Portfolio Execution & Lifecycle Management
Ensure successful execution of price changes, launching new products, and end-of-life transitions
Ensure timely investment required to sustain mature product lines
Ensure responsiveness to market and competitive dynamics
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers and Product Planners
Evolve product organization structure to support scale and growth for hardware and software products
Establish clear expectations, metrics, and development pathways for your team
Build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Cross-Functional Leadership & Operating Cadence
Partner with Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations, and Quality to achieve business outcomes
Drive consistent operating cadence across teams including portfolio management and operations reviews
Align priorities, tradeoffs, and execution plans
Represent product leadership in executive forums
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of product management or portfolio leadership experience
Proven track record of delivering results through a team in a matrix org structure
Experience across strategy, product development, and business operations processes
Ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders
Growth mindset and adaptability
Preferred
MBA or equivalent strategic leadership experience
Experience in biomedical, healthcare, or technical product markets
Experience with continuous improvement tools and methodologies
Key Skills & Attributes
Strong portfolio leadership and business ownership mindset
Ability to integrate strategy and execution
Strong decision-making under ambiguity
Organizational leadership and team-building skills
Results-oriented with focus on business outcomes
What Success Looks Like
Lead and develop a high-performing product organization
Strong revenue growth, margin, and competitiveness in the marketplace
Robust pipeline of innovation opportunities
Aligned and well-executed product strategies that incorporate hardware and software
Effective product launches and product lifecycle management
Fortive Corporation Overview
Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.
We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.
We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.
At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.
At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.
At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.
Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.
About Fluke Health Solutions
Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe.Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. LANDAUER measures radiation exposure with dosimeter and radiation monitoring badges. RaySafe is the worldwide leader of X-ray test equipment, real-time staff dosimetry, and radiation survey meters. And Victoreen instruments are the trusted source for radiation monitoring systems and quality assurance for nuclear power professionals.At FHS, we believe in your potential — your ability to learn, grow and contribute in meaningful ways. And we believe in giving you the opportunity, accountability, and visibility to do just that.
We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at .
Pay Range
The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 133,600.00 - 248,500.00.
Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge; skills; experience; and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and several programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe.Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. LANDAUER measures radiation exposure with dosimeter and radiation monitoring badges. RaySafe is the worldwide leader of X-ray test equipment, real-time staff dosimetry, and radiation survey meters. jobs.title: Head of Field Engineering, EMEA
jobs.text:
About Exa
We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.
Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.
About the Role
You'll build and lead Field Engineering in EMEA from our London office. In EMEA you'll lead both motions: Solutions Architects, who win new business in presales, and Forward Deployed Engineers, who get customers to production and grow them after the sale. You're measured on revenue: new business won and existing accounts retained and expanded across the region.
You'll be one of our first leaders in the region, so this is a player-coach role. You hold the same technical bar as the SAs and FDEs you'll hire, and you'll be hands-on in deals and customer integrations while you build the team.
In this role, you will:
Build Field Engineering in EMEA: hire, onboard and lead SAs and FDEs, and split into dedicated SA and FDE leaders as the team grows
Own the technical win on new business in EMEA, in partnership with the regional Sales leaders
Own post-sales technical success: onboarding to production, adoption, consumption growth, and early detection of churn and contraction risk on EMEA accounts
Stay hands-on: run discovery, demos, POCs and competitive evaluations on key deals, and step into critical customer integrations
Generate pipeline with Marketing in EMEA: webinars, technical content, events and meetups
Run the global operating model locally: SA to FDE handoffs, account health reviews, escalation paths, and the product feedback loop
Represent EMEA customers in product and roadmap conversations, ranking gaps by the revenue that depends on them
Requirements
A hands-on engineering background: you can build demos, review production integrations and run rigorous evals yourself, at the same technical level as the team you'll hire
6+ years in technical customer-facing roles, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, technical consulting or forward deployed engineering, including 2+ years leading teams, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company
A track record of winning technical evaluations, and experience getting customers live after the sale
A track record of building a team or a region from an early stage
Clear communication with CTOs, engineers and executives across EMEA markets
Willingness to travel across EMEA and to our San Francisco HQ
You might excel if you...
Have opened or scaled a new region for a US-based technology company
Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality
Have owned or co-owned a revenue number as a technical leader
Speak one or more additional European languages
Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines
This is an in-person opportunity in London.
Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
Compensation: £180K – £265K • Offers Equity

jobs.text:
Description
The Senior Director, Product Owner role is responsible for aligning Global Surety's business objectives to our technology investment portfolio. This includes deeply understanding surety's business objectives, how and where technology can best achieve those goals, and partnering with operations and technology to plan, estimate, deliver and measure results in furtherance of those goals.
You will also be responsible for leveraging strong Agile methodologies and standards to consistently improve performance, communicate with and integrate feedback from stakeholders, and drive delivery of our technology portfolio. In addition to the qualifications below, ideal candidates have successfully worked in a global environment, are confident with AI, and push themselves and others to find creative solutions to business problems.
Responsibilities:
Responsible for translating portfolio-level business objectives (increase sales to independent agents through improved digital quoting and binding) into technology product strategies
Responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction and overall progress of the transformation to Agile development methodology
Works closely with business units to take business strategy and translate into product strategies to support overall business objectives
Represents the business by communicating the product vision broadly and effectively to key stakeholders and Senior Management.
Allocates investment across products and ensures sufficient resources
Owns the overall product backlog and provides guidance to product owners on the scrum teams that comprise the complete effort
Uses the overall backlog to coordinate the work of product teams, through each team`s product owner
Functions as the final arbiter at the product level to order work and accepts the final release plan
Manages final escalation on trade-offs across the product portfolio Provides customer-oriented feedback on product and feature demos for scrum sub-teams
Provides leadership to agile product teams and has direct managerial responsibilities for Product Owners and other Agile development team roles
Defines objectives and development plans in alignment with IT and business objectives
Manages team to achieve business results
Champions Agile development methodology transformation across the company through contribution to Agile education initiatives and communicating agile principles to executive audiences
Monitors the application of Agile principles across product teams
Qualifications
Business expertise and knowledge of Agile development methodologies and IT project management as typically acquired through a Bachelors` degree in relevant field (business, computer science, etc
Minimum of 10 years` experience in business, engineering, technology and/or consulting
Master`s degree preferred
At least 5 years` experience managing product management teams
Proven business expertise needed to set clear priorities across the product portfolio and drive business value
Has in depth knowledge and ability to influence business strategy
Possesses strong communication and influence skills within reporting line as well as with IT and business peers
Excellent collaboration skills -- leading execution across teams, influencing across organizations, respected, experience of working across levels from developers and designers Demonstrates passion for improving customer outcomes and experiences
Embraces change and `outside of the box` ideas-does not feel attachment to the status quo
Encourages non-hierarchical culture
About Us
Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being.
