jobs.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering - Contract Intelligence
jobs.text:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.
Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.
Position Overview
AI is changing CLM, and Agiloft is building what comes next. As Senior Director, Software Engineering - Contract Intelligence, you will lead the engineering teams behind Astra Agents and the Contract Intelligence Graph (CIG). These are the capabilities that turn contracts into intelligence customers act on every day. You will own engineering strategy, organization, and execution across this portfolio, together with the shared platform components and interfaces that serve these experiences.
This is a rare chance to shape and build a converged platform that makes these products work as one and that future Agiloft experiences will build on. The shared platform scope includes common data models and database services, identity and access management (IAM), agent and AI Assistant capabilities, and a unified interface suite spanning APIs, user interfaces, and MCP servers. You will decide how each product consumes these capabilities while preserving the flexibility each experience needs.
Reporting directly to the CTO and working closely with Product, Design, Applied AI & Knowledge Engineering, Core CLM Engineering, and Cloud Operations, you will turn ambitious product priorities into an integrated technical roadmap and dependable delivery that drives measurable customer value.
You will lead managers, technical leaders, and distributed teams. This role is for a leader who stays close to the code, holds a high bar, and builds a culture where strong engineers do their best work.
Success means shared capabilities are adopted across Astra and CLM, the architecture remains secure and scalable, releases are predictable, and the organization can deliver customer value without sacrificing quality, reliability, or long-term maintainability. If you want to shape how enterprises manage their contracts in the AI era, and build the team that makes it happen, we’d love to talk with you.
Job Responsibilities
Contract Intelligence Strategy & Outcomes
Own engineering outcomes across Astra and the CLM cloud-native services for Agents and CIG, including the APIs, integrations, and orchestration capabilities that support them.
Partner with Product and Design leadership to shape strategy, roadmap, sequencing, and investment decisions, using customer feedback and adoption signals to guide priorities.
Translate portfolio priorities into integrated engineering plans, technical investments, clear ownership, and explicit cross-team dependencies.
Define and review measures of customer impact, adoption, business value, delivery predictability, and product quality.
Converged Platform Architecture & Interfaces
Define architecture direction and a convergence roadmap for shared data models, database services, IAM, Agents, and AI Assistants serving Astra and CLM cloud-native services for Agents and CIG.
Design shared components so they can be consumed consistently across Astra and CLM while allowing product-specific extensions where needed; establish clear service boundaries and ownership across Astra, Agents, CIG, and Core CLM.
Own a unified interface suite across APIs, user interfaces, and MCP servers, with consistent contracts and patterns for Astra and CLM cloud-native Agent and CIG services.
Guide cloud-native APIs and integrations, including MCP and other AI orchestration interfaces for Contract Intelligence workflows and customer systems; ensure services are secure, tenant-aware, scalable, observable, versioned, reliable, and backward compatible.
Improve API, UI, and MCP design standards, documentation, and developer experience for Agiloft teams, customers, and partners.
Agents, AI Assistants & Contract Intelligence Graph
Partner with Applied AI & Knowledge Engineering to translate AI and knowledge capabilities into production-ready Agents and AI Assistants, service interfaces, architecture, and engineering plans.
Establish practices for evaluating AI-enabled features, including output quality, permissions, privacy, latency, cost, and operational behavior.
Guide engineering evolution of CIG and the services used by Agents and AI Assistants so they provide a dependable foundation for Contract Intelligence experiences across Astra and CLM.
Set appropriate technical guardrails for AI-powered workflows and integrations with external systems.
Delivery Excellence & Operational Reliability
Own the software development lifecycle across the Contract Intelligence engineering organization, including planning, development, testing, release coordination, and post-release stabilization.
Coordinate dependencies and release plans across Astra, CLM cloud-native services, Core CLM, and other integration teams.
Establish operational measures such as service availability, API latency, error rates, integration reliability, and incident recurrence; use them to drive improvement.
Lead root-cause analysis and remediation for significant incidents and Level 3 technical escalations within the domain.
Balance roadmap delivery with reliability, security, modernization, performance, and long-term technical health.
Be a hands-on technical contributor to the codebase, code reviews, and architecture decisions.
Organization, Talent & Cross-functional Leadership
Lead managers and technical leaders responsible for Astra, Agents, CIG, and the supporting integration capabilities.
Align Astra team priorities and technical direction with shared components and CLM cloud-native services while maintaining clear accountability for each product outcome.
Develop managers and senior engineers through clear expectations, coaching, delegation, feedback, performance management, and career development.
Build an accountable, collaborative engineering culture with strong technical ownership, predictable execution, and continuous learning across distributed teams.
Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain strong engineering talent; identify capability, capacity, and organizational needs as the portfolio grows.
Partner across Product, Design, Core CLM, Applied AI & Knowledge Engineering, QA, Cloud Operations, Security, and Support to resolve dependencies and deliver customer outcomes.
Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, delivery risks, and investment needs clearly; serve as an engineering escalation point for complex Contract Intelligence issues.
Other duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications
BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and developing multi-team engineering organizations with managers and senior technical leaders with clear delivery accountability and performance management.
Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes for a substantial product portfolio, platform, or technical domain, measured by customer adoption, usage, and business value.
Deep experience with cloud-based SaaS systems, distributed services, APIs, enterprise integrations, and user-facing applications, with sufficient technical fluency to guide architecture and evaluate tradeoffs.
Demonstrated success building shared or converged components used by multiple products or services, including data models, database services, and IAM, with clear interfaces and ownership boundaries.
Hands-on technical fluency in production AI/LLM functionality, Agents, and AI Assistants, including the engineering practices needed to assess quality, privacy, reliability, and cost.
Strong understanding of engineering measures such as delivery predictability, service reliability and SLOs, defect trends, performance, and operational health.
Proven partnership with Product and Design to turn customer priorities into executable engineering roadmaps, including sound build, buy or partner decisions, and to deliver predictability against reliability and quality measure.
Clear communicator who translates technical risks, tradeoffs and decisions into business terms for executives and cross-functional partners.
Sound responsible AI judgement, with experience setting guardrails for accuracy, privacy, security, permissions, transparency and human oversight in customer-facing AI features.
Develops managers and technical leaders, builds succession and helps people do their best work.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading AI-enabled products, Agent architectures, or orchestration interfaces such as MCP.
Experience with knowledge graphs, graph-based systems, or other data-rich enterprise platforms.
Background in CLM, legal technology, workflow automation, or enterprise SaaS.
Experience scaling engineering organizations and operating practices as products grow, including in compliance-driven environments.
Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at .
Applicants from underrepresented groups such as minorities, veterans, or individuals with disabilities encouraged to apply.
Applications will be reviewed as submitted. There will be no application deadline for this opportunity.

Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.
Position Overview

AI is changing CLM, and Agiloft is building what comes next. As Senior Director, Software Engineering - Contract Intelligence, you will lead the engineering teams behind Astra Agents and the Contract Intelligence Graph (CIG). These are the capabilities that turn contracts into intelligence customers act on every day. You will own engineering strategy, organization, and execution across this portfolio, together with the shared platform components and interfaces that serve these experiences.

This is a rare chance to shape and build a converged platform that makes these products work as one and that future Agiloft experiences will build on. The shared platform scope includes common data models and database services, identity and access management (IAM), agent and AI Assistant capabilities, and a unified interface suite spanning APIs, user interfaces, and MCP servers. You will decide how each product consumes these capabilities while preserving the flexibility each experience needs.

Reporting directly to the CTO and working closely with Product, Design, Applied AI & Knowledge Engineering, Core CLM Engineering, and Cloud Operations, you will turn ambitious product priorities into an integrated technical roadmap and dependable delivery that drives measurable customer value.

You will lead managers, technical leaders, and distributed teams. This role is for a leader who stays close to the code, holds a high bar, and builds a culture where strong engineers do their best work.

Success means shared capabilities are adopted across Astra and CLM, the architecture remains secure and scalable, releases are predictable, and the organization can deliver customer value without sacrificing quality, reliability, or long-term maintainability. If you want to shape how enterprises manage their contracts in the AI era, and build the team that makes it happen, we’d love to talk with you.
Job Responsibilities
Contract Intelligence Strategy & Outcomes

items: Own engineering outcomes across Astra and the CLM cloud-native services for Agents and CIG, including the APIs, integrations, and orchestration capabilities that support them.
Partner with Product and Design leadership to shape strategy, roadmap, sequencing, and investment decisions, using customer feedback and adoption signals to guide priorities.
Translate portfolio priorities into integrated engineering plans, technical investments, clear ownership, and explicit cross-team dependencies.
Define and review measures of customer impact, adoption, business value, delivery predictability, and product quality.

blocks.text: Converged Platform Architecture & Interfaces

items: Define architecture direction and a convergence roadmap for shared data models, database services, IAM, Agents, and AI Assistants serving Astra and CLM cloud-native services for Agents and CIG.

Design shared components so they can be consumed consistently across Astra and CLM while allowing product-specific extensions where needed; establish clear service boundaries and ownership across Astra, Agents, CIG, and Core CLM.
Own a unified interface suite across APIs, user interfaces, and MCP servers, with consistent contracts and patterns for Astra and CLM cloud-native Agent and CIG services.

Guide cloud-native APIs and integrations, including MCP and other AI orchestration interfaces for Contract Intelligence workflows and customer systems; ensure services are secure, tenant-aware, scalable, observable, versioned, reliable, and backward compatible.
Improve API, UI, and MCP design standards, documentation, and developer experience for Agiloft teams, customers, and partners.

blocks.text: Agents, AI Assistants & Contract Intelligence Graph

items: Partner with Applied AI & Knowledge Engineering to translate AI and knowledge capabilities into production-ready Agents and AI Assistants, service interfaces, architecture, and engineering plans.
Establish practices for evaluating AI-enabled features, including output quality, permissions, privacy, latency, cost, and operational behavior.
Guide engineering evolution of CIG and the services used by Agents and AI Assistants so they provide a dependable foundation for Contract Intelligence experiences across Astra and CLM.
Set appropriate technical guardrails for AI-powered workflows and integrations with external systems.

blocks.text: Delivery Excellence & Operational Reliability

items: Own the software development lifecycle across the Contract Intelligence engineering organization, including planning, development, testing, release coordination, and post-release stabilization.
Coordinate dependencies and release plans across Astra, CLM cloud-native services, Core CLM, and other integration teams.
Establish operational measures such as service availability, API latency, error rates, integration reliability, and incident recurrence; use them to drive improvement.
Lead root-cause analysis and remediation for significant incidents and Level 3 technical escalations within the domain.
Balance roadmap delivery with reliability, security, modernization, performance, and long-term technical health.
Be a hands-on technical contributor to the codebase, code reviews, and architecture decisions.

blocks.text: Organization, Talent & Cross-functional Leadership

items: Lead managers and technical leaders responsible for Astra, Agents, CIG, and the supporting integration capabilities.
Align Astra team priorities and technical direction with shared components and CLM cloud-native services while maintaining clear accountability for each product outcome.
Develop managers and senior engineers through clear expectations, coaching, delegation, feedback, performance management, and career development.
Build an accountable, collaborative engineering culture with strong technical ownership, predictable execution, and continuous learning across distributed teams.
Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain strong engineering talent; identify capability, capacity, and organizational needs as the portfolio grows.
Partner across Product, Design, Core CLM, Applied AI & Knowledge Engineering, QA, Cloud Operations, Security, and Support to resolve dependencies and deliver customer outcomes.
Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, delivery risks, and investment needs clearly; serve as an engineering escalation point for complex Contract Intelligence issues.
Other duties as assigned.

blocks.text: Required Qualifications

items: BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and developing multi-team engineering organizations with managers and senior technical leaders with clear delivery accountability and performance management.
Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes for a substantial product portfolio, platform, or technical domain, measured by customer adoption, usage, and business value.

Deep experience with cloud-based SaaS systems, distributed services, APIs, enterprise integrations, and user-facing applications, with sufficient technical fluency to guide architecture and evaluate tradeoffs.
Demonstrated success building shared or converged components used by multiple products or services, including data models, database services, and IAM, with clear interfaces and ownership boundaries.
Hands-on technical fluency in production AI/LLM functionality, Agents, and AI Assistants, including the engineering practices needed to assess quality, privacy, reliability, and cost.
Strong understanding of engineering measures such as delivery predictability, service reliability and SLOs, defect trends, performance, and operational health.

Proven partnership with Product and Design to turn customer priorities into executable engineering roadmaps, including sound build, buy or partner decisions, and to deliver predictability against reliability and quality measure.
Clear communicator who translates technical risks, tradeoffs and decisions into business terms for executives and cross-functional partners.
Sound responsible AI judgement, with experience setting guardrails for accuracy, privacy, security, permissions, transparency and human oversight in customer-facing AI features.
Develops managers and technical leaders, builds succession and helps people do their best work.

blocks.text: Preferred Qualifications

items: Experience leading AI-enabled products, Agent architectures, or orchestration interfaces such as MCP.
Experience with knowledge graphs, graph-based systems, or other data-rich enterprise platforms.
Background in CLM, legal technology, workflow automation, or enterprise SaaS.
Experience scaling engineering organizations and operating practices as products grow, including in compliance-driven environments.

jobs.title: Head of Product Management & Transformation (Risk, Finance & Compliance)
jobs.text:
We are looking for an experienced and visionary professional to join as Head of Product Management (Risk, Finance & Compliance), taking strategic responsibility for a newly established Product Management division within a leading Swiss banking environment.
In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for the strategic direction, development and management of the product portfolio across Risk, Finance and Compliance. You will act as a central interface between business functions, IT and Senior Management, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective, sustainable and customer-oriented solutions.
The position combines strategic product management, leadership, digital transformation and stakeholder management, with a clear focus on measurable business value and the continuous development of end-to-end processes across the organisation.
Workload: 80–100%
Your Responsibilities
Take end-to-end responsibility for the Product Management division covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Define and implement the strategic vision, product portfolio and roadmap for the relevant business areas
Develop customer-oriented solutions aligned with the needs of Business Owners and specialist departments
Manage the implementation and continuous development of products within the Agile Release Train
Lead and develop the Product Management team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus
Act as the central interface between Risk, Finance, Compliance, IT, Business Owners and other relevant stakeholders
Ensure that business requirements are translated into effective and sustainable IT solutions
Further develop and digitalise end-to-end business processes across applications, processes and channels
Ensure a measurable contribution of the product division to the organisation's strategic objectives, particularly in the areas of growth, efficiency and customer satisfaction
Lead and support transformation initiatives across Risk, Finance and Compliance
Manage complex stakeholder environments and align strategic priorities with implementation and IT delivery
Ensure that processes and solutions comply with regulatory and compliance requirements
Work closely with Senior Management and relevant internal and external stakeholders
Monitor performance, priorities and value contribution across the product portfolio
Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimisation and further development of the product landscape
Your Profile
Several years of professional experience in a leadership position within the financial services or banking industry
Strong understanding of Risk, Finance and Compliance processes within a banking environment
Proven experience in product management, product strategy and/or business transformation
Excellent understanding of end-to-end processes and value creation within the financial services sector
Experience leading and developing teams and managing complex organisational structures
Proven track record in transformation projects, as well as experience with agile methodologies and modern organisational structures
Strong understanding of IT and technological interdependencies, with the ability to bridge the gap between business and IT
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly when working with Senior Management
Entrepreneurial mindset combined with a pragmatic, decisive and results-oriented approach
Ability to set clear priorities and successfully drive strategic initiatives through to implementation
Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a hands-on execution mindset
University degree in Business Administration, Banking, Business Information Systems or a comparable field
Very good written and spoken German and English
What We Offer
A strategic leadership position with comprehensive responsibility for an entire Product Management division
The opportunity to actively shape a newly established Product Management organisation covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Significant influence on the bank's digital transformation and future product landscape
A high degree of autonomy and entrepreneurial responsibility
Close collaboration with Senior Management, business functions and IT
A modern, agile and customer-oriented working environment
A flexible hybrid working model with home-office options
Attractive opportunities for professional development and career progression into leadership roles
A stable and future-oriented environment within an established Swiss financial institution

jobs.title: Director, Technology Strategy
jobs.text:
Job Description:
We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States.
As our new Technology Strategy Director, you will report to the Senior Director/ VP, Technology Strategy, and partner with other senior leaders, analysts and managers on each project. You will be called to master our frameworks and develop an advanced understanding of how the entire marketing technology stack comes together to promote our client's vision.
You will work across industries with subject matter experts and expertise to come together in sound consulting deliverables informing planning, main decisions and technical implementations.
You Will:
Provide expertise, vendor knowledge, and industry best practices across digital technology components including: Identity Resolution, Data Management and Architecture, Analytics/ Measurement & Reporting, Artificial Intelligence and Modeling, Audience Management, Testing and Optimization, Content Management and Delivery, Channel Personalization, Demand Generation, and AdTech
Connect technology capability goals to our needs and build compelling stories to explain value
Build relationships and manage client expectations by facilitating and driving client meetings and discussions
Lead daily delivery efforts partnering with the engagement team members to complete materials in PowerPoint, excel (can maintain spreadsheets), and Lucidchart.
Lead discovery meetings with clients, new partners, vendors or subject matter experts taking notes, gathering documentation and identifying follow-ups
Bring an industry-leading perspective / POV about an important area of the customer experience technology stack and create expertise
Provide opinions and recommendations in all manner of marketing-related technology use cases
Lead consulting engagements by building the storytelling and developing recommendations for how to best use information and technology to guide programs across all channels and media
Manage consulting analysts to guide work product development, coach storytelling skills, and educate on technology capabilities
Leverage existing frameworks and gather important assets and materials
Oversee internal projects to improve the offerings and capabilities of the team including bringing new consulting engagements to leadership for consideration
Develop materials to illustrate and educate teams on how CX technology components work together to support evolved customer experiences
Support business development opportunities across variety of industries as a technology strategy subject matter expert (SME) or finding opportunities within existing clients
You Have:
10+ years of experience consulting within technology or marketing OR 10+ years of experience working in a digital agency operating marketing technology in a specific field
Senior knowledge of Customer Relationship Marketing (CRM) technical concepts, customer experience technology, including loyalty, service, commerce, content, analytics and cloud technologies
Expert knowledge in a focused capability or capabilities around relational databases, customer data integration, analytic modeling, campaign management, content management, commerce, loyalty, messaging, service and business intelligence systems will be evaluated
Experience managing people and leading a diverse team
Expert proficiency in excel (can maintain spreadsheets), PowerPoint, Lucidchart, Miro and Vizio
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university
Ability to travel for clients up to 25%
Additional Qualifications (It's advantageous if you have these!):
Deep understanding and proficiency in how a technology ecosystem works and is implemented to be used by marketing/business teams, including platforms such as, Email Service Platform, CDP, Digital Asset Manager, Data Lake, or ID Resolution technology. This should include major requirements for successful implementation and the problems a technology is built to resolve. It may also include an understanding of different vendors for a technology and how they each provide unique solutions in the larger marketplace for the technology
Success in leading consulting work for clients and providing presentations and deliverables to a client
Demonstrated experience in testing, expanding, and correcting one's personal knowledge of a topic to improve existing skills
Desire to understand client systems and challenges naturally enough to provide insightful, nuanced, and recommendations specific to the client.
The annual salary range for this position is $113,000-$158,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.
Benefits available with this position include:
Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
Life insurance,
Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
401k,
Flexible paid time off,
At least 15 paid holidays per year,
Paid sick and safe leave, and
Paid parental leave.
Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit .
To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

jobs.title: Sr Director - AI Engineering, Discovery and Co-Design
jobs.text:
The Company
Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
Meet the team:
At Dexcom, we are reimagining how innovation happens across engineering, science, and product development through the power of Artificial Intelligence. The AI Engineering, Discovery & Co-Design team is responsible for building the platforms, tools, and capabilities that accelerate knowledge discovery, engineering excellence, scientific investigation, and cross-functional collaboration throughout our R&D organization.
As the Sr. Director, AI Engineering, Discovery & Co-Design, you will define and execute the vision for AI-enabled innovation across engineering and scientific disciplines. You will build and scale a world-class team focused on creating reusable AI capabilities that help engineers and scientists solve complex problems faster, make better decisions, and unlock new opportunities for innovation. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of how Dexcom discovers, designs, and develops life-changing technologies.
Where you come in:
You define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and vision for AI Engineering, Discovery & Co-Design capabilities across Dexcom's R&D organization.
You lead the development of AI-powered platforms, engineering workflows, knowledge systems, and scientific reasoning capabilities that accelerate innovation and engineering effectiveness.
You establish scalable co-design environments that enable collaboration across sensor, hardware, firmware, algorithm, antenna, mechanical, and systems engineering teams.
You partner with Engineering, Research, Systems Engineering, Product Development, Data & Analytics, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, IT, and Executive Leadership teams to identify and deliver high-impact AI solutions.
You evaluate emerging technologies and drive build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions that maximize business value and competitive advantage.
You build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of AI engineers, research engineers, architects, scientists, and technical leaders.
You establish strategic relationships with universities, research institutions, and technology communities to strengthen innovation pipelines and attract exceptional talent.
You foster a culture of experimentation, technical excellence, continuous learning, and responsible innovation while delivering measurable business outcomes.
What makes you successful:
You bring deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, scientific computing, engineering platforms, or related technology domains.
You have a proven track record of building and scaling high-performing technical organizations and developing future leaders.
You demonstrate success translating emerging technologies into practical, enterprise-scale capabilities that generate measurable business impact.
You have strong experience evaluating technology investments and making strategic decisions related to internal development, commercial solutions, and external partnerships.
You excel at influencing executive stakeholders and driving organizational transformation through vision, data, and execution excellence.
You possess outstanding communication and collaboration skills and can effectively convey complex technical concepts to technical, scientific, business, and executive audiences.
You have experience recruiting and retaining exceptional talent from industry, startups, research institutions, and academic environments.
You have experience building AI-enabled environments that support engineering innovation, scientific discovery, simulation, optimization, knowledge management, or collaborative design workflows.
You maintain credibility as a hands-on technology leader with a passion for innovation and continuous advancement of AI capabilities.
Your experience establishing external partnerships, participating in industry communities, and contributing to thought leadership is highly valued.
What you’ll get:
· A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
· A full and comprehensive benefits program.
· Growth opportunities on a global scale.
· Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
· An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.
Travel Required:
5-15%
Experience and Education Requirements:
Typically requires a Bachelors degree in a technical discipline with 17+ years of industry experience.
13+ years of years of successful leadership experience in relevant industry.
Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.
Please note: The information contained herein is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The duties and responsibilities in this job description may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Dexcom’s AAP may be viewed upon request by contacting Talent Acquisition at .
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact Dexcom Talent Acquisition at .

Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
Meet the team:

At Dexcom, we are reimagining how innovation happens across engineering, science, and product development through the power of Artificial Intelligence. The AI Engineering, Discovery & Co-Design team is responsible for building the platforms, tools, and capabilities that accelerate knowledge discovery, engineering excellence, scientific investigation, and cross-functional collaboration throughout our R&D organization.

As the Sr. Director, AI Engineering, Discovery & Co-Design, you will define and execute the vision for AI-enabled innovation across engineering and scientific disciplines. You will build and scale a world-class team focused on creating reusable AI capabilities that help engineers and scientists solve complex problems faster, make better decisions, and unlock new opportunities for innovation. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of how Dexcom discovers, designs, and develops life-changing technologies.
Where you come in:

items: You define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and vision for AI Engineering, Discovery & Co-Design capabilities across Dexcom's R&D organization.
You lead the development of AI-powered platforms, engineering workflows, knowledge systems, and scientific reasoning capabilities that accelerate innovation and engineering effectiveness.
You establish scalable co-design environments that enable collaboration across sensor, hardware, firmware, algorithm, antenna, mechanical, and systems engineering teams.

You partner with Engineering, Research, Systems Engineering, Product Development, Data & Analytics, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, IT, and Executive Leadership teams to identify and deliver high-impact AI solutions.
You evaluate emerging technologies and drive build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions that maximize business value and competitive advantage.
You build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of AI engineers, research engineers, architects, scientists, and technical leaders.
You establish strategic relationships with universities, research institutions, and technology communities to strengthen innovation pipelines and attract exceptional talent.
You foster a culture of experimentation, technical excellence, continuous learning, and responsible innovation while delivering measurable business outcomes.

blocks.text: What makes you successful:

items: You bring deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, scientific computing, engineering platforms, or related technology domains.
You have a proven track record of building and scaling high-performing technical organizations and developing future leaders.
You demonstrate success translating emerging technologies into practical, enterprise-scale capabilities that generate measurable business impact.
You have strong experience evaluating technology investments and making strategic decisions related to internal development, commercial solutions, and external partnerships.
You excel at influencing executive stakeholders and driving organizational transformation through vision, data, and execution excellence.
You possess outstanding communication and collaboration skills and can effectively convey complex technical concepts to technical, scientific, business, and executive audiences.
You have experience recruiting and retaining exceptional talent from industry, startups, research institutions, and academic environments.
You have experience building AI-enabled environments that support engineering innovation, scientific discovery, simulation, optimization, knowledge management, or collaborative design workflows.
You maintain credibility as a hands-on technology leader with a passion for innovation and continuous advancement of AI capabilities.
Your experience establishing external partnerships, participating in industry communities, and contributing to thought leadership is highly valued.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Platform
jobs.text:
Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
Role Purpose
The Director of Software Engineering, Platform will lead the design, scaling, and reliability of Neko Health’s core infrastructure. This platform underpins health data, member data, and system reliability across clinics and internal product systems.
This role is mission-critical: platform failures directly impact clinic operations and patient care. You will deliver an AI-first platform that ensures absolute resilience and regional scale, enabling the rest of the organization to scale our impact 10X faster.
What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months
Establish a scalable, secure infrastructure platform on Azure supporting health and member data
Enable significantly faster product deployment cycles through platform improvements
Increase system reliability and reduce operational incidents affecting clinics
Build and scale a high-performance platform engineering team (10-15 engineers initially)
Define long-term platform strategy in close partnership with Product and Data
Minimum Qualifications
Proven experience building and scaling large-scale infrastructure systems
Experience building infrastructure as a platform (PaaS mindset) or SRE-level systems
Strong hands-on engineering background; ability to code and design systems
Experience scaling infrastructure across regions
Experience using AI tooling platforms (Claude Code)
Experience leading managers and scaling to multi-team structures
Preferred Experience
Deep experience with Microsoft stack (Azure, Cosmos DB, Docker)
Experience supporting data platform infrastructure
Experience in highly regulated or mission-critical environments
Exposure to AI platform development

jobs.title: Head of, Financial Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
About Mistral
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
The Role
As a Head of Financial Systems, you will shape the future of Mistral’s Finance technology ecosystem.
The role exists to build a modern data, systems and AI-driven finance department that bridges finance, data, and business operations to drive financial performance and strategic decision-making.
You’ll collaborate closely with our CFO, our internal Applied AI resources, and teams like, HR, IT, Legal, and Security to assess current systems, identify gaps, and design a target architecture that supports Mistral’s growth.
Your impact will be felt across the organization, from improving profitability to automating accounting and ensuring reliable financial outputs.
What You Will Do
Lead the assessment of Mistral’s current Finance technology landscape, including tools, processes, data flows and pain points.
Define and prioritize business, functional, and technical requirements for Finance systems in collaboration with stakeholders.
Design a target Finance tech architecture, outlining system roles, integrations, and data flows and architectures
Develop a data governance framework, including ownership, quality controls, and maintenance processes.
Create and execute a prioritized plan to clean up and rationalize Finance datasets and execute it
Deliver a clear recommendation on the future Finance tech setup, including costs, risks, and a transition roadmap.
Ensure Finance data is migration-ready by addressing quality issues and defining ownership.
What We're Looking For
Strong project management skills, from defining vision, strategy, and roadmaps, to stelar execution
Engineering academic background, ideally from a tier-1 engineering school
Deep data architecture knowledge, including mastery of data sources, pipelines, storage, transformation, and metadata management, with hands-on experience designing and implementing architectures (e.g., APIs, workflows, BigQuery, DBT).
GenAI power user with Vibe coding skills, automation expertise, and experience building scalable, impactful products in a professional context. Basic coding skills and software development experience are a strong plus.
Experience in Finance technology assessment, system selection, and knowledge of tools such as SAP S4H, Kyriba, Lago, Payflows, etc
Solid financial knowledge, including experience working alongside finance teams, understanding FP&A, accounting, cash management, and procurement, and a strong interest in driving value through process automation and efficiency.
Builder and scaler with experience structuring IT systems (preferably in finance), building and scaling IT teams or departments from the ground up, and operating in multicountry environments.
Proven ability to build tools and processes from scratch to support company growth.
Strong analytical skills to evaluate data quality, consistency, and relevance.
Proficiency in prioritization and the use of performance metrics to drive impact.
What We Offer
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.
Privacy Policy
Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technical Product Management
jobs.text:
Job Description Summary
As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Senior Director, Technical Product Management leads product management across the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) portfolio. This is a people-leadership role covering capture management, government pricing, systems pricing, contracts, government property, government business, and the sustainment and fleet analytics portfolio. This person will own the product operating model: the roadmap standard, the prioritization framework, and outcome governance. This person will lead the technical product managers and UX designers who set direction, translate business outcomes into prioritized backlogs, and partner with Engineering to ship capabilities that move measurable results across Federal and commercial markets.
Job Description
Why This Role Exists
DSCX owns 30+ digital products for Defense & Systems. Today our technical product managers wear three hats for their products: product management, project management, and operations. We are dividing that load across three dedicated functions, and this role will build out the product management discipline. This role is planned to have 8-10 direct reports across product managers and UX designers. Your charge is to build a sustainable operating model including standard processes and artifacts, a clear prioritization framework, and a team you coach and train to execute against it. You should be experienced with AI and know where it creates opportunity to expand what the team can deliver.
Environment
The DSCX portfolio runs primarily on AWS, Palantir Foundry, or through SaaS based 3rd party solutions, with on-premise implementations supported for customers whose data sensitivity requires it. Delivery runs through Rally and Microsoft Teams and ServiceNow is our system of record for incident, change, and defect management. Monitoring and alerting tooling varies by application across the portfolio, and consolidating it is part of this organization's work. Vulnerability scanning is owned by the Defense & Systems security organization under the Business Information Security Officer (BISO); our teams are accountable for closing what they report inside the severity SLAs the BISO sets.
The portfolio carries a $25+MM annual budget across 30+ products.
Roles and Responsibilities
1. Strategy and Roadmap
Own the product roadmap standard used across all DSCX product areas, so roadmaps are consistent and comparable across teams.
Accountable for a two to three year roadmap (including NorthStar vision) for each product and product area.
Define the prioritization framework (e.g., RICE) each product manager uses to sequence work, and hold its application consistent.
Drive feature development one to two quarters ahead and story development one to two sprints ahead, in partnership with Software Engineering.
2. Outcomes and Governance
Define KPIs, success metrics, and OKRs for each product.
Run Daily Visual Management for the portfolio. Product health, delivery status, and blockers are visible daily rather than assembled monthly, and you own the KPIs that roll into the monthly operating review.
Hold the team accountable for measurable outcomes, not feature counts. Every shipped capability needs an answer to what it moved.
3. Technical Product Leadership
Ensure PRDs and INVEST-quality user stories with clear acceptance criteria across the portfolio.
Use opportunity solution trees so every roadmap item traces to a business outcome, and require the same of your product managers.
Partner with Engineering on technical design, sequencing, and delivery within enterprise architecture and data governance standards.
4. Stakeholder and Relationship Management
Serve as the key product relationship manager for the D&S business, operationalized through a maintained stakeholder map per product area covering who, cadence, and decision rights.
Run a recurring touchpoint cadence, including monthly business reviews per product line.
Own the funding and business case pipeline: what has been requested versus approved for each product area.
Maintain a log of open asks and decisions needed from the business, and drive each to closure.
5. People and Team Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop the product management and UX team; own hiring, performance management, and talent development.
Set the standard for product craft: discovery, roadmap management, INVEST-quality stories, and outcome accountability.
Build a bench of product talent and a culture of continuous improvement using FLIGHT DECK, the GE Aerospace lean operating model, latest AI technology, industry product best practices, and user-centric design.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience, OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 13 years of professional experience, OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 15 years of professional experience.
Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in Technical Product Management and IT.
Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.
Eligibility Requirement:
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.
Desired Characteristics
Technical Expertise
Five or more years leading product managers or product teams, including hiring and performance management.
Deep expertise in product management for enterprise digital products end to end: discovery, roadmap, backlog, delivery, and value realization.
Strong knowledge of software design and Agile ways of working (Scrum and Kanban), and fluency partnering with Engineering on technical design and sequencing.
Proven ownership of a portfolio of products across multiple areas, including the operating model: roadmap standards, prioritization frameworks, and outcome governance.
Experience with AWS, hybrid cloud and on-premise deployment models, and enterprise SaaS platforms such as Salesforce. Palantir Foundry experience is a strong plus.
Business Acumen
Breaks down ambiguous problems, documents clear problem statements, and estimates effort credibly.
Analyzes the impact of technology and sequencing choices on compliance, cost, and efficiency.
Demonstrates knowledge of the competitive and operational environment in Federal and commercial markets, including how funding and business cases move.
Familiarity with the compliance environment our products operate in: FAR, DCMA audit readiness, CMMC, CUI, and export control.
Leadership
Develops people through effective coaching.
Disagrees with business partners without spending the relationship.
Sets a high bar and explains the reason behind it.
Coaches with questions before positions.
Leads a distributed team on purpose.
Key Success Metrics
Business value: outcomes realized versus business case; win rate, cycle time, and cost-to-serve improvements across product areas.
Roadmap health: adherence to committed roadmap and prioritization discipline; feature and story readiness ahead of Engineering.
Adoption and satisfaction: active user adoption of shipped capabilities; user CSAT and NPS.
Team and talent: product manager capability growth, retention, and bench strength.
Location and Travel
Location: Cincinnati, OH (Evendale) strongly preferred. You will lead a team that is part hybrid and part fully remote, so a deliberate approach to running distributed product work is part of the job.
Travel: up to 20% for customer discovery, business reviews across Defense and Systems sites including Lynn, Erlanger, Clearwater, Grand Rapids, and Vandalia, and vendor engagement.
Notes:
The base pay range for this position is $176,000 to $270,000 annually. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 3rd, 2026.
GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.
GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.
This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).
Additional Information
GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.
Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
- This is a remote position

Own the funding and business case pipeline: what has been requested versus approved for each product area.
Maintain a log of open asks and decisions needed from the business, and drive each to closure.

blocks.text: 5. People and Team Leadership

items: Lead, coach, and develop the product management and UX team; own hiring, performance management, and talent development.
Set the standard for product craft: discovery, roadmap management, INVEST-quality stories, and outcome accountability.

Build a bench of product talent and a culture of continuous improvement using FLIGHT DECK, the GE Aerospace lean operating model, latest AI technology, industry product best practices, and user-centric design.

Deep expertise in product management for enterprise digital products end to end: discovery, roadmap, backlog, delivery, and value realization.

Proven ownership of a portfolio of products across multiple areas, including the operating model: roadmap standards, prioritization frameworks, and outcome governance.
Experience with AWS, hybrid cloud and on-premise deployment models, and enterprise SaaS platforms such as Salesforce. Palantir Foundry experience is a strong plus.

Disagrees with business partners without spending the relationship.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology (US, Remote)
jobs.text:
Reports to: CTO
Department: Technology
Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.
FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt
Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.
Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $190,000 - $220,000
Tier 2 (National Markets): $180,000 - $210,000
Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $170,000 - $200,000
About the Company
Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.
Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.
We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!
About the Opportunity
The technology behind Paleovalley and Wild Pastures is central to how customers shop, subscribe, and get help - and how our teams fulfill orders and run the business. Much of it was built in-house by our co-founder and CTO. As both brands grow, we need a technology organization that can keep these platforms strong, connect them with our business systems, and support the next stage of growth.
The Vice President of Technology will be the CTO’s trusted right hand and lead the full technology function across software engineering, business systems, and IT. This leader will set priorities and investment plans with the CTO, make consequential day-to-day decisions with substantial autonomy, and own the team, budget, delivery, and health of our technology. The role gives the CTO room to focus on company-wide direction and the technical work where he can add the most value.
Success here requires executive judgment, real technical depth, and a practical approach to AI and automation. You’ll work through architecture, code, and difficult incidents while building shared knowledge and ownership across the team. You’ll also guide AI adoption that improves how we build software and run the business, partnering with E-Commerce on reliable solutions for the shopping experience and commercial priorities.
What You’ll Do
Technology Strategy and Leadership
Set the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap with the CTO, turning business priorities into clear investments, sequencing, and delivery across both brands.
Lead engineering, business systems, and IT as one function, developing leaders, clarifying decision rights, and building the capacity needed for growth.
Own the technology budget, staffing, and vendor strategy; make sound build-versus-buy decisions and raise enterprise-level risks and architectural choices with the CTO.
Establish and oversee a centralized technology request intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, defining project scope, assessing business impact, allocating resources, and communicating realistic timelines to stakeholders across departments.
Develop scalable engineering workflows and project management practices that improve accountability, delivery predictability, and cross-functional communication without introducing unnecessary administrative complexity.
Custom Platforms and Engineering
Own the architecture and engineering delivery of our custom commerce, subscription, customer service, and internal platforms, balancing new capabilities with reliability and maintainability.
Stay close to the technical work through design and code reviews, hands-on troubleshooting, and selective coding when a critical problem calls for it.
Set practical standards for testing, releases, monitoring, and incident response so teams can move quickly while protecting the customer and employee experience.
Reduce dependence on any one person by documenting critical systems, sharing ownership, cross-training the team, and testing recovery procedures.
AI and Automation
Lead AI and automation strategy with the CTO, turning emerging capabilities into practical agents, workflows, and tools that improve efficiency, decision-making, and organizational capacity.
Evaluate where AI, conventional automation, and human expertise are best applied, measuring business value before scaling adoption across engineering and business functions.
Business Systems, IT and Security
Lead the strategy for business applications, integrations, and data flows that connect commerce with customer service, fulfillment, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance.
Oversee IT services, infrastructure, access, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor risk, including practical standards for AI reliability, data protection, and appropriate human oversight.
Maintain continuity and disaster recovery plans for revenue-critical and operational systems, and prioritize technical debt based on security, scalability, cost, and business impact.
Delivery and Cross Functional Partnership
Partner with E-Commerce and web experience teams to translate storefront and testing priorities into technical solutions; E-Commerce owns commercial outcomes while Technology owns platform delivery.
Partner with business leaders to evaluate processes, automation opportunities, and capacity needs before recommending additional systems, vendors, or headcount.
Set realistic commitments, manage competing requests, and give the CTO and executive team a clear view of progress, service health, and emerging risks.
Serve as a responsive and solutions-oriented technology partner to department leaders, ensuring incoming requests are properly evaluated, stakeholders receive clear updates, and technical priorities remain aligned with business impact and available capacity.
What You’ll Need to Succeed
8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering and technology leadership, including 4+ years leading technical teams and developing managers or other senior leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience and demonstrated technical leadership will be considered in lieu of a degree.
Strong command of software architecture, production code, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and engineering practices.
Hands-on experience applying AI tools and automation in software development or business workflows, with sound judgment about their limitations, reliability, and data risks.
Experience leading customer-facing commerce or subscription platforms alongside enterprise applications and IT services.
A track record of making custom or founder-built systems maintainable, documented, and independently operable.
Practical judgment in security, privacy, access, incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Business acumen to manage budgets, vendors, technical investments, and competing priorities across functions.
Ability to earn a technical founder’s trust while leading independently and building a stronger technology organization.
Bonus Points
Experience working in a startup, founder-led business, or high-growth e-commerce environment.
Experience with custom-built e-commerce platforms, legacy application modernization, or migrations involving PHP/Laravel-based systems.
Familiarity with platforms such as Shopify and the technical considerations involved in building or integrating e-commerce functionality.
Experience with RESTful APIs, MySQL or comparable relational databases, AWS or similar cloud infrastructure, and modern web development practices.
Experience with ERP, warehouse management, fulfillment, or customer service platforms, including systems such as Acumatica, Logiwa, Klaviyo, or Gladly.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or other structured project management practices; relevant certifications are a plus.
Interest in food, wellness, and regenerative agriculture.
Our Commitment to You
Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
Paid sick time for when you need it
Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
$300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for employees
Compliance & Employment Practices
Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to HRteam@paleovalley.com.
All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.
To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.
This role is open until filled.
