jobs.title: Vice President, Reporting and Data Analytics
jobs.text:
Are you passionate about making a difference in people's lives? Do you enjoy working in a service-oriented industry? If so, this opportunity may be the right fit for you!
The Vice President, Data, Reporting & Analytics leads the development and delivery of data, reporting, and analytics capabilities for Personal Care Services (PCS). This leader oversees the integration of operational, clinical, workforce, financial, payor, and enterprise data to establish reliable, governed information that supports business performance and decision-making.
Working closely with enterprise IT, Information Security, Finance, Operations, Compliance, and system owners, this role drives the PCS data strategy, integration roadmap, reporting architecture, business intelligence, and analytics capabilities to improve operational efficiency, financial performance, and strategic decision-making.
You will...
PCS Data, Reporting & Analytics Strategy
Develop and execute an integrated PCS data, reporting, and analytics strategy aligned with growth, service delivery, financial performance, workforce capacity, and compliance priorities.
Establish a multiyear roadmap covering data integrations, data quality, reporting modernization, business intelligence, advanced analytics, automation, and self-service capabilities.
Define and standardize KPIs, business rules, executive dashboards, and reporting methodologies for market performance, service utilization, caregiver capacity, referral conversion, revenue realization, and financial outcomes.
Translate business strategies, operational workflows, and requirements into actionable data, reporting, integration, and technology priorities in partnership with enterprise IT.
Evaluate predictive analytics, AI, and automation opportunities based on data readiness, business value, implementation feasibility, and appropriate governance.
Data Integration, Mapping & Reporting Architecture
Lead the development and delivery of PCS data integration and reporting solutions, including requirements, design, validation, deployment, and ongoing support.
Maintain an inventory of PCS source systems, data owners, interfaces, reports, dashboards, dependencies, and critical data elements.
Lead source-to-target data mapping across operational, workforce, financial, clinical, billing, scheduling, EVV, referral, CRM, HR, payroll, and other PCS platforms.
Define business rules, transformation logic, calculations, hierarchies, and acceptance criteria for data pipelines, interfaces, warehouses, data marts, APIs, master-data solutions, and business intelligence platforms.
Lead reconciliation and validation across source systems, integrated data environments, operational reports, financial records, and executive dashboards.
Establish controls to identify and resolve missing, delayed, duplicated, mismatched, or incorrectly transformed data, with clear ownership and resolution timelines.
Evaluate reporting and integration impacts associated with system implementations, migrations, acquisitions, market expansions, vendor changes, and operating-model changes.
Reduce reliance on fragmented spreadsheets, manual data manipulation, and duplicative reporting through scalable, governed solutions.
Enterprise Reporting & Business Intelligence
Oversee the PCS reporting portfolio, including executive, operational, financial, workforce, compliance, payor, market, and branch-level reporting.
Establish reporting intake, prioritization, and governance standards that balance strategic initiatives, operational needs, regulatory requirements, and delivery capacity.
Define standards for report accuracy, timeliness, usability, documentation, retention, access, testing, and change control.
Consolidate duplicative or conflicting reports and establish authoritative dashboards and standardized metrics for critical business measures.
Develop governed self-service reporting capabilities supported by standardized data models, training, and user support.
Maintain reporting documentation, business glossaries, metric definitions, and data lineage while monitoring adoption and retiring reports that no longer provide value.
Operational, Workforce & Financial Analytics
Partner with Operations, Finance, HR, and Growth to analyze caregiver recruitment and retention, scheduling, labor utilization, overtime, service capacity, and market productivity.
Assess authorized versus delivered hours, missed visits, referrals, intake conversion, payor mix, reimbursement, revenue leakage, and contribution margins to identify performance opportunities.
Develop forecasting, scenario planning, and business cases that support budgets, resource allocation, cost optimization, and profitable growth.
Quality, Compliance & Data Governance
Establish and lead the PCS data governance operating model, including accountable data owners and stewards, common definitions, quality standards, access, retention, validation, and change control.
Define and monitor data quality standards for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, uniqueness, and validity, coordinating technical implementation with enterprise partners.
Establish monitoring, reconciliation controls, and exception reporting for EVV, service documentation, authorizations, delivered hours, billing, payroll, financial accuracy, and state- and payor-specific requirements.
Partner with Compliance, Quality, Operations, and Finance to identify operational and financial risks, support audit readiness, and measure corrective action effectiveness.
Executive Partnership, Systems & Transformation
Advise PCS leadership on market performance, operating model improvements, growth opportunities, and risks through clear, decision-ready analyses.
Lead cross-functional performance improvement initiatives involving workflow standardization, operating dashboards, reporting adoption, and technology enablement.
Serve as the PCS business lead for data and reporting components of system implementations, integrations, conversions, acquisitions, and platform migrations, ensuring defined requirements, historical-data strategies, reconciliation controls, testing, and measurable acceptance criteria.
Supervisory Responsibilities
Lead and develop PCS teams responsible for data integration, analytics, business intelligence, reporting, governance, data quality, and performance improvement, establishing clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
Manage assigned budgets, vendors, service levels, reporting and integration backlogs, delivery commitments, technical dependencies, and business cases for new capabilities.
Build analytical, technical, and leadership talent while strengthening data literacy, succession planning, and collaboration across PCS markets and enterprise functions.
Establish a disciplined delivery model with transparent priorities, development standards, testing requirements, release schedules, and accountability for reporting accuracy, timeliness, usability, and continuous improvement.
We are excited to speak to someone with...
Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, reporting, business intelligence, data integration, data governance, healthcare operations, or related disciplines, with accountability for enterprise or business-unit reporting outcomes preferred.
5+ years of progressive people leadership, including leading cross-functional teams or business intelligence, analytics, or operational performance functions.
5+ years leading data, reporting, business intelligence, integration, analytics, or data-driven operational performance initiatives in complex, multi-system organizations.
Demonstrated success implementing KPIs, executive dashboards, forecasting or profitability models, and technology-enabled process improvements in complex, multi-site operations.
Experience partnering with IT, data engineering, Finance, and operational stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable data solutions and measurable outcomes.
Leadership experience in personal care services, home health, home and community-based services, managed care, or similarly complex healthcare delivery operations preferred.
Knowledge of Medicaid reimbursement, EVV, caregiver workforce dynamics, payor contracts, and state-specific reporting requirements preferred.
Experience with operational transformation, market expansion, acquisitions or integrations, Lean Six Sigma, predictive modeling, automation, or AI use cases preferred.
Advanced degree or relevant continuous improvement certification preferred; experience directly managing data engineering teams is a plus.
Deep knowledge of enterprise reporting, business intelligence, data integration, source-to-target mapping, data quality, data governance, master data, and KPI design.

jobs.text:
About Tiger Analytics: Shape the Future of AI. Transform the World's Leading Businesses.
Tiger Analytics is one of the fastest-growing AI services firms, partnering with some of the world's largest and most influential organizations to redefine how business gets done. We help Fortune 500 companies harness the power of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Data Science, Data Engineering and Advanced Analytics to solve their most complex challenges, unlock new growth opportunities, and create lasting business impact.
We are at the forefront of the AI revolution, helping enterprises move beyond traditional analytics to embrace Generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and cloud-native data platforms. A global presence across North America, Latin America, Europe, and India.
At Tiger Analytics, we don't just help businesses adapt to the future—we help them build it.
We are looking for someone with a good blend of business consulting skills and a data analytics background. If you are passionate to work on unstructured business problems that can be solved using data, we would like to talk to you.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work on the latest applications of data science to solve business problems in Pharma and Lifescience domain
Work directly with client stakeholders to translate business problems into high-level analytics solution designs
Knowledge of advanced analytics approaches and methodologies and best practices of leveraging data to drive informative decisions
Proficiency in using advanced analytics to drive business value including ROI/value assessment, digital KPI tracking, campaign measurement, etc
Experience in generating insights from reports and summarizing for brand teams
You will be responsible for account management, client relationships, and account growth
You will be responsible for scaling pilots / POCs to a long-term transformative program and delivering continuous business value
Fluency with pharma data sources such as Veeva and IQVIA (Plantrak, LAAD, PE, etc) including RWD sources such as TriNetX, Flatiron, Optum, Komodo etc.
Experience working with all levels of management and consulting with key business stakeholders.
Present analytic solutions to business audiences highlighting robustness of the solution and how it could help generate business value
Responsible for making presentations to senior management, communicating results to business teams, and develop plans to help operationalize analytics solution
You will explore opportunities with current and new buying centers and will collaborate with internal Tiger SMEs to create the right POVs / proposals to help drive growth. You will be responsible for P&L for your account portfolios managing revenue and margin goals

jobs.title: Director, Creative Technology (US)
jobs.text:
The Director of Creative Technology leads enterprise transformations by architecting scalable, AI-native visual production pipelines across 3D asset generation, motion design, and generative AI architectures. You will lead cross-functional pods of creative technologists, set production engineering standards, and navigate high-stakes technical diplomacy across executive marketing, IT, and creative leadership.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Architect enterprise visual automation systems connecting 3D DCC environments, motion graphics renderers, generative APIs (Adobe Firefly Services), and client DAM platforms
Establish technical standards for local GPU compute vs. cloud API load balancing, render token efficiency, and failover architecture across global rollouts (30+ regional markets)
Serve as the senior technical lead and creative diplomat in client engagements, building trust with skeptical Executive Creative Directors and lead 3D artists
Drive adoption of modern pipeline paradigms, including MCP-driven agentic workflows, custom node-graph architectures, and automated render pipelines
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
8+ years in Creative Technology, 3D Pipeline Engineering, or Visual R&D leadership
Track record of architecting scriptable 3D and motion pipelines (Python, USD/glTF, Blender, After Effects)
Expertise in enterprise generative architectures, hybrid render infrastructures (on-prem GPU vs. cloud API), and enterprise DAM integrations
Superior executive presence and technical diplomacy skills
ABOUT US
Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.
Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.
The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.
The compensation range for this role is $160,000 – $225,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.text:
About Avo
Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence-based decision-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high-quality care. Avo changes that.
We are product-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities.
The Role
Avo is hiring a Senior Director of Product to lead product strategy and execution across our platform. This is a leadership role and the ideal candidate will work with our CPO to refine, and operationalize Avo's product vision, driving roadmap decisions that accelerate customer value and long-term platform differentiation. You’ll work directly with our Engineering, Product, Clinical , Customer, and Commercial teams to shape what we build and ship fast.
You will report directly to our Co-Founder/CPO and be a key voice in how Avo evolves its AI copilots, clinical decision support capabilities, and enterprise platform. This role is ideal for someone who has shipped complex, technically sophisticated products in a fast-moving environment - ideally in healthcare or with a deep interest in clinical workflows - and who thrives owning problems end-to-end rather than coordinating around them.
Avo operates as a highly distributed organization, this leader will also be responsible for driving alignment and execution across Product and Engineering teams spanning the United States and South Korea, ensuring strong collaboration, communication, and delivery across multiple time zones.
What You'll Do
Drive the product roadmap across Avo’s suite of products and platform infrastructure, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation
Translate insights from customers, clinicians, sales, and the market into a clear product direction, turning complex clinical workflows and user needs into actionable product requirements and differentiated customer value.
Translate complex clinical use cases into product requirements that engineering can act on and customers can clearly recognize
Demonstrate deep expertise and understanding in UI/UX design by translating complex clinical workflows and product functionality into intuitive, scalable, and customer-centric experiences. Lead the application of user-centered design best practices, driving usability, adoption, and measurable customer value through thoughtful interaction and visual design
Partner with implementation and customer success to close the loop between what we promise, what we ship, and what actually works at the bedside
Work hand-in-hand with engineering leads to scope, sequence, and ship features - from early spec through rollout and iteration, tracking adoption and engagement and various impact metrics
Drive clarity on requirements and tradeoffs, unblocking engineering rather than adding process.
Lead cross-functional collaboration across distributed Product and Engineering teams , establishing effective operating rhythms and communication practices that enable rapid execution across time zones
Maintain a strong perspective on emerging AI technologies, market trends, and competitive dynamics to help define where Avo product should lead
Contribute to sales cycles and customer conversations as a product authority, helping close and retain enterprise accounts.
Mentor junior product team members and help build Avo's product culture as the team scales
What You Bring
7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead PM role
Experience in clinical decision support, or enterprise SaaS serving regulated industries, a plus
Hands-on experience building or managing AI-powered product experiences, with an understanding of how LLM capabilities and limitations impact user-facing workflows and UX
Track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products and iterating them to scale
Strong instincts for product strategy - you can identify the right problem to solve before prescribing the solution.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you write crisp specs, give clear demos, and can hold your own in a room with health system executives
Experience working closely with engineering and clinical teams - you understand technical architecture well enough to have useful tradeoff conversations
Prior experience at a startup or high-growth company, comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move quickly
Comfortable working across US and Asia-Pacific time zones, including early morning or evening hours as needed
Periodic travel to Korea 2–3 times per year, approximately one week per trip. This is not symbolic travel; dedicated in-person engagement is a core responsibility of the role.
Why Join Avo
Impact: Avo’s products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful.
Ownership: You will own the execution of our product roadmap from clinical discovery through roadmap decisions, launch, and iteration
High Agency: We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy.
Great Team: Work alongside a talented, low-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft.
Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you’re in the area we’d love the chance to work in-person together 2 days/week.
How We Take Care of Our Team
Generous Time Off: Flexible and generous PTO
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
401K Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future
Personal Device Allowance: Tax-free funds for personal device usage
Compensation and Equity: $200,000 - $225,000 base salary and equity
Avo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

You will report directly to our Co-Founder/CPO and be a key voice in how Avo evolves its AI copilots, clinical decision support capabilities, and enterprise platform. This role is ideal for someone who has shipped complex, technically sophisticated products in a fast-moving environment - ideally in healthcare or with a deep interest in clinical workflows - and who thrives owning problems end-to-end rather than coordinating around them.

Avo operates as a highly distributed organization, this leader will also be responsible for driving alignment and execution across Product and Engineering teams spanning the United States and South Korea, ensuring strong collaboration, communication, and delivery across multiple time zones.
What You'll Do

items: Drive the product roadmap across Avo’s suite of products and platform infrastructure, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation

Translate insights from customers, clinicians, sales, and the market into a clear product direction, turning complex clinical workflows and user needs into actionable product requirements and differentiated customer value.
Translate complex clinical use cases into product requirements that engineering can act on and customers can clearly recognize

Demonstrate deep expertise and understanding in UI/UX design by translating complex clinical workflows and product functionality into intuitive, scalable, and customer-centric experiences. Lead the application of user-centered design best practices, driving usability, adoption, and measurable customer value through thoughtful interaction and visual design
Partner with implementation and customer success to close the loop between what we promise, what we ship, and what actually works at the bedside
Work hand-in-hand with engineering leads to scope, sequence, and ship features - from early spec through rollout and iteration, tracking adoption and engagement and various impact metrics
Drive clarity on requirements and tradeoffs, unblocking engineering rather than adding process.

Lead cross-functional collaboration across distributed Product and Engineering teams , establishing effective operating rhythms and communication practices that enable rapid execution across time zones
Maintain a strong perspective on emerging AI technologies, market trends, and competitive dynamics to help define where Avo product should lead
Contribute to sales cycles and customer conversations as a product authority, helping close and retain enterprise accounts.
Mentor junior product team members and help build Avo's product culture as the team scales

blocks.text: What You Bring

items: 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead PM role
Experience in clinical decision support, or enterprise SaaS serving regulated industries, a plus
Hands-on experience building or managing AI-powered product experiences, with an understanding of how LLM capabilities and limitations impact user-facing workflows and UX
Track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products and iterating them to scale
Strong instincts for product strategy - you can identify the right problem to solve before prescribing the solution.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you write crisp specs, give clear demos, and can hold your own in a room with health system executives
Experience working closely with engineering and clinical teams - you understand technical architecture well enough to have useful tradeoff conversations
Prior experience at a startup or high-growth company, comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move quickly
Comfortable working across US and Asia-Pacific time zones, including early morning or evening hours as needed
Periodic travel to Korea 2–3 times per year, approximately one week per trip. This is not symbolic travel; dedicated in-person engagement is a core responsibility of the role.

blocks.text: Why Join Avo
Impact: Avo’s products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful.
Ownership: You will own the execution of our product roadmap from clinical discovery through roadmap decisions, launch, and iteration
High Agency: We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy.
Great Team: Work alongside a talented, low-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft.
Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you’re in the area we’d love the chance to work in-person together 2 days/week.
How We Take Care of Our Team

items: Generous Time Off: Flexible and generous PTO
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
401K Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future
Personal Device Allowance: Tax-free funds for personal device usage

jobs.text:
Job Description Summary
The ED, Analytics Engineering will collaborate closely with the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. We are seeking a visionary and pragmatic leader to build and institutionalize the foundation for analytics at scale. This role will architect the systems, standards, and capabilities that enable high-quality, consistent, and scalable analytics across our organization. By defining frameworks, ensuring rigor, and connecting cross-functional efforts, this leader will make analytics a repeatable, trusted, and efficient enterprise capability.
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Establish and champion analytics rigor, including statistical standards, validation protocols, and QA practices.
Define enterprise-wide frameworks for measurement, performance metrics, and reporting standards.
Enable cross-functional synergy by connecting analytics efforts across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, and other domains.
Institutionalize analytics engineering as a core discipline, including reusability of data pipelines, analytics automation, and production-grade analytics solutions.
Develop scalable capabilities that allow solutions to be transferred across use cases quickly and effectively.
Support governance and compliance, ensuring analytical outputs meet regulatory and ethical standards.
Essential Requirements:
Bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data/analytics, with demonstrated success in building scalable systems or frameworks.
Proven track record of establishing analytics standards, governance, or platform capabilities.
Strong cross-functional experience, ideally within Commercial, Medical, or Market Access analytics in life sciences or a regulated industry.
Experience with analytics engineering, BI tooling, and data infrastructure concepts.
Excellent communication and influence skills, especially with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Requirements:
Systems thinker with a deep understanding of how analytics drive decisions across an enterprise.
Builder mindset: enjoys creating structure from ambiguity and scaling impact.
Comfortable balancing strategic design and operational execution.
Deep understanding of data lifecycle, from data ingestion to decision-making impact.

The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.
Job description summary
The Director, Data Strategy defines and advances data strategies for priority US functional domains, translating business priorities into integrated roadmaps, investment recommendations, and scalable data capabilities.
This role leads two functional coverage areas, Customer Engagement and Integrated Marketing Organization and focuses on horizontal data needs that cut across brands and therapeutic areas while complementing therapeutic area-specific Data Strategy roles. The role identifies common functional use cases, data gaps, requirements, and reuse opportunities to support governed, reusable data assets across the US organization.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:
Lead functional data strategy for two priority US coverage areas, Customer Engagement and Integrated Marketing Organization, defining roadmaps, priorities, capability needs, and success measures aligned to enterprise data strategy.
For Customer Engagement and Integrated Marketing Organization, advance data strategies that scale customer engagement, omnichannel activation, field execution, marketing effectiveness, segmentation, and integrated customer experience across brands and channels.
Differentiate horizontal functional data needs from therapeutic area-specific, brand, launch, indication, and lifecycle needs, ensuring functional priorities are reflected in enterprise and therapeutic area roadmaps without duplicating therapeutic area-specific accountabilities.
Align business stakeholders, therapeutic area Data Strategy Leads, Insights & Analytics, Data Partnerships, Data Governance, Data Quality, technology, and vendor teams around prioritized data requirements, sourcing decisions, governance expectations, adoption plans, and value realization.
Drive portfolio transparency, reuse, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement of key functional data assets, including executive-ready updates, roadmap views, KPI summaries, investment recommendations, and trade-off assessments.
Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience establishing and managing data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the data partnership landscape, including industry best practices for collaborating with external data providers, platforms, and vendors. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, and compliance, while building mutually beneficial partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to continuous improvement in the organization’s data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.
Essential Requirements:
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred
Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience developing data, analytics, or data product strategies that connect business priorities to roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes for life science companies
Strong understanding of life sciences data ecosystems and how data sources, governance expectations, business needs, and enterprise capabilities come together across functions.
Demonstrated ability to develop functional or domain-level data strategies, requirements, capability priorities, and success measures customer engagement and/or marketing
Ability to distinguish horizontal functional data needs from therapeutic area-specific, brand, indication, launch, and lifecycle-specific needs.
Experience aligning business, Insights & Analytics, Data Partnerships, Data Governance, Data Quality, technology, procurement, and vendor stakeholders around prioritized data capabilities.
Strong strategic thinking, portfolio management, executive communication, and ability to influence senior stakeholders in a complex matrix environment.
Novartis Compensation Summary:
The salary for this position is expected to range between $185,500 - $344,500 per year.
The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.
Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.
US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together?

jobs.text:
Job Title: Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Oncology
Job Location: Remote Position (USA), Remote, US, US
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Job ID
REQ-10086352
Aug 21, 2026
USA
Summary
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.
Job description summary
The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products team, under the Data Products and Foundations pillar within Strategy, Platforms and Transformation, enables improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. The Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Oncology will play a critical role in establishing, managing, and strengthening oncology-focused data partnerships that sup-port the US Commercial organization and advance priority business needs across oncology brands, customer engagement, patient access, and field execution.
This role is responsible for overseeing Novartis’ strategic oncology data partnerships within SPT to ensure compliance, quality, business relevance, and effective use of external data assets. The Associate Director will bring depth in healthcare and oncology data, including experience working with or for a data vendor, and will help implement the data partnership strategy, monitor spend and partnership performance, enforce data stewardship practices, and partner with internal teams to identify the most relevant oncology data sets to support business needs and data-driven decision-making.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:
Implement the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, including the identification of critical data needs across US Commercial oncology brands, functions, and priority use cases.
Establish, manage, and strengthen strategic oncology data partnerships with external data providers, platforms, and vendors to maximize the value of external oncology data assets.
Apply deep understanding of oncology data sources, vendor capabilities, data limitations, and fit-for-purpose use cases to guide partnership decisions and business recommendations.
Monitor adherence to data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards for external oncology data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and internal data management policies.
Collaborate with data vendors, business stakeholders, analytics teams, field enablement, access, and cross-functional oncology teams to address data quality issues and communicate corresponding changes.
Implement oversight mechanisms for external oncology data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, governance expectations, and internal policies.
Implement data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions to verify that oncology data is properly managed, governed, and leveraged throughout the partnership lifecycle.
Track oncology data partnerships and spend, provide performance metrics and governance reporting to senior leadership, and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, improved governance, and enhanced collaboration.
Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand oncology business needs, recommend relevant data sets, and guide teams on how to extract actionable insights from available data sources.
Provide ongoing data advisory support to internal stakeholders, including guidance on recurring deliverables, interpretation of data outputs, data availability, limitations, and appropriate use of rare disease data to support business decisions.
Experience:
Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience establishing and managing oncology data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of healthcare and oncology data, including the strengths, limitations, governance considerations, and business applications of external data assets. Prior experience working with or for a data vendor is strongly preferred, as this role requires the ability to assess vendor capabilities, challenge data assumptions, manage partnership performance, and translate oncology business needs into practical data solutions. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, and compliance, while building mutually beneficial vendor partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to continuous improvement in the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights, vendor expertise, and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.
Essential Requirements:
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 6+ years of experience establishing and managing data partnerships, with a strong focus on oncology, healthcare data, data governance, data management, or related roles.
Prior experience working with or for a data vendor, data provider, healthcare data platform, or analytics organization is strongly preferred.
Deep understanding of oncology data assets, including data sourcing, data coverage, refresh cadence, linkage, quality considerations, and fit-for-purpose business use cases.
Expert understanding of data partnership principles, frameworks, and best practices, with a proven ability to forge strategic collaborations with external data providers and vendors.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to healthcare data privacy, security, quality, compliance, and appropriate use of oncology data.

Job description summary

The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products team, under the Data Products and Foundations pillar within Strategy, Platforms and Transformation, enables improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. The Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Oncology will play a critical role in establishing, managing, and strengthening oncology-focused data partnerships that sup-port the US Commercial organization and advance priority business needs across oncology brands, customer engagement, patient access, and field execution.

This role is responsible for overseeing Novartis’ strategic oncology data partnerships within SPT to ensure compliance, quality, business relevance, and effective use of external data assets. The Associate Director will bring depth in healthcare and oncology data, including experience working with or for a data vendor, and will help implement the data partnership strategy, monitor spend and partnership performance, enforce data stewardship practices, and partner with internal teams to identify the most relevant oncology data sets to support business needs and data-driven decision-making.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:

items: Implement the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, including the identification of critical data needs across US Commercial oncology brands, functions, and priority use cases.
Establish, manage, and strengthen strategic oncology data partnerships with external data providers, platforms, and vendors to maximize the value of external oncology data assets.
Apply deep understanding of oncology data sources, vendor capabilities, data limitations, and fit-for-purpose use cases to guide partnership decisions and business recommendations.

Monitor adherence to data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards for external oncology data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and internal data management policies.

Collaborate with data vendors, business stakeholders, analytics teams, field enablement, access, and cross-functional oncology teams to address data quality issues and communicate corresponding changes.
Implement oversight mechanisms for external oncology data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, governance expectations, and internal policies.

Implement data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions to verify that oncology data is properly managed, governed, and leveraged throughout the partnership lifecycle.

Track oncology data partnerships and spend, provide performance metrics and governance reporting to senior leadership, and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, improved governance, and enhanced collaboration.
Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand oncology business needs, recommend relevant data sets, and guide teams on how to extract actionable insights from available data sources.

Provide ongoing data advisory support to internal stakeholders, including guidance on recurring deliverables, interpretation of data outputs, data availability, limitations, and appropriate use of rare disease data to support business decisions.

jobs.text:
Position Summary...
What you'll do...
Walmart is building the future Commerce. We are seeking a Director of Strategic Partnerships & Business Development to build and drive ecosystem partnerships across AI, Commerce and Growth platforms and tech. From big tech to hyper-scalers and foundation model providers, you will identify and negotiate the foundational deals that integrate cutting-edge technology into the lives of millions. Operating at the high-stakes intersection of product, engineering, and commercial strategy, you will be the bridge between 'what’s next' and 'what’s possible at scale' - sourcing opportunities, structuring complex deals, and driving execution across the enterprise.
About the team: Our team leads strategic partnerships and business development at Walmart, collaborating closely with Business, Product, and Technology groups. We focus on shaping strategy, accelerating innovation, and delivering measurable value to customers and associates. By leveraging expertise in program and financial management, stakeholder engagement, and business operations, we drive impactful initiatives and foster strong partner relationships. The team is committed to aligning technology and business goals to support sustainable growth and operational excellence across the organization.
What you'll do:
Partnerships Strategy and Business Development:
Define, lead Walmart's top tech partnerships roadmap aligned to product and enterprise strategy.
Launch and scale new tech partnerships that enable AI and other experiences.
Develop exec-ready ready recommendations. Influence senior leadership on strategic direction.
Build, manage strategic partners portfolio that accelerates Walmart's top priorities.
Deal Structuring and Negotiation:
Lead end-to-end deal execution from exploratory discussions through term sheets and full contract negotiation and execution.
Structure complex agreements involving IP, data rights, co-development, platform integrations and commercialization models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Lead highly matrixed teams across Engineering, Product, Advertising, Payments, Marketing, Business.
Remove execution barriers and drive accountability across internal and external partners.
What you'll bring:
12+ years of experience in business development, partnerships.
8+ years of experience negotiating and managing the implementation and execution of term sheets and signed agreements with partners.
Proven track record sourcing, structuring, and scaling enterprise level partnerships that drive measurable business impact.
Experience influencing and presenting to executive leadership, including VP, SVP, Csuite, and external executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross functional teams, manage complex partner relationships, and drive adoption of new products and features

jobs.title: Games Creative/Design Director
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As Creative/Design Director, you will be responsible for guiding Incubator creators toward the successful development of novel games (Read about novel games, the Incubator program and its charter at https://create.roblox.com/build). This design & creative leader will be instrumental in helping Incubator participants find the right rich game dynamics for their games, whether these creators come from the Roblox creator community or the off-platform traditional game community. The ideal candidate has a history of creative leadership (including design) across a variety of games, along with a broad knowledge of design elements and their application in successful games across the industry. You will report to the Senior Lead, Incubator.
You will:
Own design feedback to all (external) Incubator creators
Oversee group feedback on specific builds and milestones
Ideate on alchemy of Roblox and traditional success to help creators find innovation and value in their games
Foster creator-to-creator community interactions, both individually and by creating sustainable processes and partnerships
Build and execute effective design related workflows between internal disciplines and Roblox creators
Collaborate cross-functionally (production, product, analytics, engineering, marketing, partnerships and more) to facilitate design related deliverables and deadlines
Work with marketing and creative teams to devise and execute on GTM strategies
Support analytics to set up goals, measure impact, and increase growth KPIs
Help the novel games initiative across non-Incubator projects as needed
You have:
15+ years of creative or game design experience with proven track record of conceptualizing, creating, guiding and refining game designs
Ability to adapt and learn new game and platform dynamics, in order to demonstrate expertise in both traditional and Roblox game design
Superb written and verbal communication skills that guide and convince
Experience leading cross-functional execution with various teams including production, product, analytics, engineering, marketing, partnerships and more
Domain experience with UGC, social and gaming; ability to understand and design for player behavior, expectations and trends
Understanding of game design, principles and mechanics
Experience working with 3rd party creators and developers
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile and iterative development environment
Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and ambiguity
Excellent organization skills
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$287,590—$336,450 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

jobs.title: VP, Data Strategy & Governance
jobs.text:
Become a part of our caring community
The Vice President, Data Strategy & Governance is a senior executive accountable for defining, advancing, and operationalizing the enterprise data strategy. This leader drives the full lifecycle of data governance — from policy design and sensitive data management to technology enablement, data quality, and regulatory compliance. Serving as a strategic advisor to executive stakeholders across all business units and technology functions, the VP partners closely with Cybersecurity,
Enterprise Architecture, and line-of-business leaders cultivate a data-rich, AI-ready environment grounded in trust, quality, and accountability.
The VP is a visionary organizational builder who attracts and develops world-class talent, shapes data culture, and influences enterprise-wide change. This individual would need to partner across business and technology leaders to drive a product mindset and promote adoption to realize business outcomes. This leader will promote a data product operating model by embedding accountability for data quality, metadata, lineage, access, and data lifecycle management across the enterprise. This leader brings deep command of applied data governance practices, data protection strategies, emerging ML/AI-based governance tools, and the legislative landscape governing personal and sensitive data. Their work directly enables the organization's digital and analytics ambitions while fortifying its cyber-breach resistance posture.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Initiatives & Program Outcomes
Establish and own the enterprise data strategy, translating organizational goals into a continuously evolving roadmap of data capabilities spanning people, process, technology, and budget.
Lead portfolio governance of enterprise data programs, ensuring initiatives are prioritized, resourced, and delivering measurable business outcomes aligned to financial and strategic objectives.
Partner with the Chief Data & Analytics Officer and executive peers to articulate the value of data assets, influence investment decisions, and embed data thinking into enterprise planning cycles.
Drive enterprise-scale data science and AI readiness by ensuring foundational data infrastructure, lineage, quality, and accessibility meet the demands of advanced analytics and generative AI use cases.
Develop and maintain a data product mindset across the organization — enabling reusable, trusted, and well-documented data assets that accelerate time-to-insight across business units.
Team Building & Organizational Development
Build, lead, and continuously develop a high-performing, world-class team of experts spanning sensitive data governance, data lineage and mapping, data enrichment, data quality, data democratization, and program management.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning; champion data literacy initiatives that upskill the broader organization and democratize access to trusted data.
Act as a Culture Shaper and Talent Builder — recruiting diverse, senior talent, establishing clear career pathways, and mentoring future data leaders across the enterprise.
Operate as a cross-functional influencer and collaborator, building strong relationships across Technology, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and business unit stakeholders to drive data governance adoption at scale.
Define team operating models, performance metrics, and OKRs that demonstrate the strategic and financial impact of the data governance function.
Technology Implementations & Tools
Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of enterprise data governance platforms, data catalog and marketplace solutions, data quality tooling, and metadata management systems.
Modernize data scanning, automated tagging, and labeling capabilities to improve governance efficiency, enable proactive data classification, and strengthen data loss prevention (DLP) outcomes.
Partner with Security Architecture and Enterprise Architecture to design and deploy solutions that deliver integrated data governance and data security at scale — on-premises and across cloud environments.
Invest in and operationalize innovative ML/AI-based approaches for data governance, including automated lineage discovery, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy techniques.
Maintain awareness of the evolving data governance technology landscape; drive a buy/build/partner strategy that balances innovation with cost discipline and commercial accountability.
Data Governance Process Improvements
Operate and continuously enhance enterprise data governance capabilities — including metadata management, data lineage, data quality standards, master data management, and access governance — through a structured and measurable capability roadmap.
Define, publish, and enforce enterprise data policies, standards, and controls ensuring consistent, compliant, and high-quality data usage across all business domains.
Champion data democratization by enabling self-service data access models backed by robust governance guardrails, role-based access controls, and data marketplace infrastructure.
Establish data stewardship programs and data domain ownership models that distribute accountability for data quality and governance across the enterprise.
Drive continuous improvement of data anonymization, de-identification, and synthetic data capabilities to enable broader analytics use while protecting sensitive information.
Risk Management & Compliance
Lead the enterprise Data Risk Assessment program, identifying, measuring, and managing data security risks across applications, platforms, and business and technology initiatives.
Ensure the organization's data practices comply with applicable data privacy regulations and industry standards, including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and other relevant legislation governing personal and sensitive data.
Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Cybersecurity to proactively identify regulatory changes, assess their data governance implications, and implement controls before compliance deadlines.
Strengthen data protection strategy and execution — including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and access control frameworks — to improve cyber-breach resistance.
Provide executive reporting and Board-level transparency on data governance risk posture, compliance status, and program maturity metrics on a recurring basis.
Use your skills to make an impact
Key Requirements
Experience
10+ years of senior leadership experience in data governance, data management, or data strategy roles within large, complex, matrixed corporate environments.
10+ years of hands-on data governance experience, including both on-premises and cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent).
Demonstrated track record of building and scaling data governance programs from concept through enterprise adoption, with measurable improvements in data quality, compliance, and business outcomes.
Proven experience managing and delivering large, multi-workstream programs — including strategic initiatives, technology implementations, and organizational transformation — on time and within budget.
Prior hands-on experience and/or leadership responsibility for technical data governance tools, including data catalogs, data lineage platforms, data marketplace systems, and data quality frameworks.
Relevant experience in consumer goods, healthcare, financial services, or technology industries strongly preferred.
Technical & Domain Knowledge
Deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, data quality processes, and enterprise data modeling.
Relevant experience with data protection strategies, including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and role-based access control design.
Working knowledge of cybersecurity assessment methodologies and data security controls, with experience partnering with CISO and Security/Enterprise Architecture functions.
Familiarity with ML/AI-based data governance approaches, including automated metadata tagging, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy.
Strong command of data privacy regulations including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and related legislative frameworks.
Champion and drive a product mindset across the enterprise data and analytics, treat data as a strategic asset and managing data products through their full lifecycle to maximize business value, adoption, quality and reuse.
Leadership & Influence
A visionary Culture Shaper, Talent Builder, Results Driver, Systems Thinker, and Accountability Partner who engages and aligns the broad enterprise toward common data goals.
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; able to translate complex data concepts into clear, compelling narratives for C-suite, Board, and business stakeholders.
Strong evidence of the ability to introduce emerging technologies and develop analytics-based capabilities while maintaining cost awareness and commercial strategy.
Proven ability to drive enterprise-wide change in matrixed organizations through influence, coalition-building, and stakeholder management without direct authority.
Leadership Competencies
Culture Shaper
Actively builds an inclusive, high-trust data culture. Champions data literacy, promotes ethical data use, and sets behavioral expectations that reinforce accountability and transparency.
Talent Builder
Recruits, develops, and retains diverse, world-class talent. Creates clear career pathways, coaches emerging leaders, and builds bench strength across the data governance organization.
Results Driver
Sets ambitious goals and holds self and team accountable. Translates strategy into executable plans, tracks progress with rigor, and delivers measurable financial and operational impact.
Systems Thinker
Understands interconnections across data, technology, process, and people. Designs holistic governance frameworks that scale and anticipate second-order effects on the enterprise.
Influential Collaborator
Builds trust and credibility across business and technology functions. Uses data to persuade, aligns diverse stakeholders around shared priorities, and navigates complex political dynamics with integrity.
Strategic Innovator
Brings intellectual curiosity and market awareness. Proactively identifies emerging technologies and governance practices, translating external trends into competitive organizational advantage.
Education
Advanced degree (Master's or higher) in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Law, Cybersecurity, or a related field required.
Ph.D. in a relevant discipline or an MBA is a significant additional asset.
Dual degrees combining technical and business or legal disciplines are highly valued.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, CIPP, CISM, CISSP, or cloud data platform certifications) are a plus.
Scheduled Weekly Hours
40

Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

jobs.title: Director, Brand Design
jobs.text:
About Betterment
Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings, and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors, as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We're headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).
About the Role
Betterment is entering its next phase of growth, and we’re looking for a Director of Brand Design to raise the ambition and craft of our brand everywhere it shows up.
This role is for someone who obsesses over the kerning in a web nav as much as over the motion piece that moves people. You have exceptional taste, a sense of curiosity to learn new things, and a strong point of view. You’ll be the brand’s primary design voice and the final word on our brand design system, knowing when to hold the line and when to evolve. You will make the brand feel like one brand across advertising, web, motion and sales collateral, for both our Retail and B2B businesses.
You’ll stay hands-on. You’ll lead concepting and art direction on our biggest initiatives and shape them from the first idea. You’ll polish the work that matters most and jump in wherever the craft needs you. You’ll also lead and develop a small team of designers, setting the bar for their work and trusting them to own execution in their areas. Stakeholders will come to you for creative direction, not just review.
Reporting to the VP, Brand Creative, you’ll partner closely with our Director of Copy and our Director of Brand Operations.
This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.
New York City: $175,000-$205,000
This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.
A Day in the Life
Act as the arbiter of our brand design system and standards; challenge the system when it starts to feel stagnant and keep a constant eye on how our visual identity needs to evolve.
Review and shape creative briefs before work begins, ensuring projects start with clear direction and objectives.
Hold the overall craft bar across advertising, web, motion, and collateral. Lead concepting and art direction on key initiatives, personally refining work at critical moments, and catching any execution misses or inconsistencies.
Manage and develop a team of senior designers: set clear goals, deliver regular and constructive feedback, and push design execution from good to great.
Build and pitch proposals for new design initiatives.
Work closely with marketing and sales stakeholders on assignments to understand goals and what success looks like.
Create a team culture where designers feel empowered to take creative risks, raise dissenting opinions, and learn from projects that don't land perfectly the first time.
Represent your team's work and point of view to senior leadership, translating creative decisions into business context.
Participate in hiring: lead portfolio review interviews, evaluate candidates, and help scale the team as it grows.
Source and direct vendors and agencies to supplement our work.
What We're Looking For
10+ years of brand/design experience, including experience leading or managing designers.
A strong, well-defined point of view on brand design systems, with experience evolving an identity system over time rather than just applying one.
Proven ability to translate business strategy, objectives, and growth goals into a clear creative point of view and compelling work, while shaping creative briefs and providing direction before execution begins
Experience managing and developing designers at varying levels of seniority, including supporting both craft-focused and people-leadership growth paths.
A strong track record of partnering cross-functionally with copy and brand voice, marketing, operations, and external agencies to keep creative work on-brand and on schedule.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to represent your team’s work and decisions to senior and executive stakeholders.
A portfolio that demonstrates range and craft across advertising, web, motion, and sales materials.
Bonus points if you have experience:
Working in fintech, wealth management, or another regulated industry, given the compliance and disclosure requirements that shape our creative work.
Join a team built on these core values
We change lives
Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.
We set audacious goals
We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.
We value all perspectives
When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.
We simplify financial services
We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.
Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being:
We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.
What happens next
We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.
In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.
On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.
We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!
Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.
Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
Come join us!
We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.
We set audacious goals
We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.
We value all perspectives
When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.
We simplify financial services
We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.
Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being:

items: We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.

blocks.text: What happens next

We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.

In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.

On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.

We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!
Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.

Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
Come join us!

We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Product
jobs.text:
Goodwall
Goodwall is a TIME100 award-winning social education app that believes learning should be as fun and easy as scrolling on TikTok. Goodwall exists to give every young person the opportunity to pursue a better future, regardless of where they come from or who they know. Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.
Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.
As a B Corp scale-up backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes. Our next chapter is to transform the lives of 10 million Goodwallers.
Your Role
You will lead Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with our Co-Founder. You will lead and grow your own team, including an additional Product Manager and Growth Marketing Manager. Your closest partner will be our Head of Engineering, who also leads Data Science.
Your responsibility spans how members discover Goodwall, experience its value, keep coming back and bring their friends. You will set direction and stay close to execution. Every product experience, notification, piece of ad copy, ambassador referral journey and Gen Z creator strategy sits within your remit.
What you will do
Scale a product members love returning to. Own the product roadmap and run product growth experiments that improve activation, retention and referrals. Use onboarding, personalisation, social features, rewards and game design to make learning more engaging.
Accelerate member acquisition. Expand organic growth through ambassadors, referrals, creators and influencers, supported by disciplined paid marketing. Lead our expansion into target markets such as North America.
Bring Product and Growth together. Align both teams around shared priorities. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn member insights into improvements, from idea through launch and measurement.
Set the standard for every detail. Take responsibility for the quality of the entire member experience, from the clarity of a notification and the simplicity of a product flow to the strength of an ad hook. Combine sharp copy, thoughtful design and precise execution.
Experiment with purpose. Speak with members, understand where they lose interest and test ways to keep them engaged. Run A/B tests, assess retention over time and use the findings to decide what to scale, improve or stop.
Hire and lead a strong team. Choose priorities, develop your people and direct budget toward lasting growth. Move quickly, remove obstacles and take responsibility for results.
What we offer
Competitivecompensation and equity: an ownership stake in a scale up raising its Series B.
Real authority across Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with the founders.
The opportunity to hire and lead yourownteam.
An establishedglobalcommunity and the chance to shape the experience of millions more members.
And most importantly, a mission to be proudof - helping millions of young people build skills, access opportunity and shape their futures
Requirements
What You Bring
You know how to scale. You have personally helped scale a digital product serving millions, ideally where what worked early stopped working and needed new methods. You can explain what you owned, what you changed, and the results.
Depth in product growth. You have shipped experiments that improved retention and referrals alongside acquisition. Experience in Social, Gaming or EdTech is particularly relevant.
Ownership and urgency. You take ownership of the outcome, move with urgency and follow through with intensity. You find ways forward with limited resources and stay close enough to the work to solve problems yourself.
Instinctive Gen Z fluency. You live and breathe the platforms, creators, communities and formats shaping how Gen Z communicates. You know what earns attention, what gets shared and what feels forced.
Exceptional attention to detail. You recognise strong design and sharp copy, and notice the friction others miss. You care about the small decisions that make an experience feel effortless.
Analytical and creative judgment. You can interpret a retention curve, improve a creator brief and work through a product decision with engineers.
Commitment to the mission. You want to use your expertise to transform lives. Helping millions of young people gain skills, confidence and access to opportunity is work you are ready to invest yourself in.
