jobs.text:
## Company OverviewBrainlyne is an innovative company at the forefront of technology, dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions and services. We are currently seeking a visionary Chief Technology Officer to join our international team and lead our technological advancements.## Job DescriptionAs the Chief Technology Officer at Brainlyne, you will be responsible for setting the company's technological vision, developing the tech strategy, and leading the development and implementation of cutting-edge software solutions. Your role will be pivotal in building and managing a competitive technical team that aligns with our business goals.## Responsibilities* Define the company's technological vision and strategy.* Lead the research, development, and deployment of new technologies.* Build and manage a high-performing technical team.* Collaborate with other departments to align technology with business goals.* Ensure the company's technological processes and service comply with all requirements, laws, and regulations.## Required Skills and Qualifications* Proven experience as a software engineer.* Strong leadership skills with experience building and managing technical teams.* Excellent knowledge of software development and infrastructure.* Ability to conduct technological analyses and research.* Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.## ExperienceCandidates should have between 4 to 11 years of experience in the technology field, with a significant portion of that time spent in leadership roles overseeing software engineering projects and teams.## LocationThis is an international position, and the successful candidate will have the opportunity to work with teams from around the globe.## Join Our TeamIf you are a seasoned software engineer with a passion for technology and leadership, and you're looking for an exciting new challenge at an international level, we invite you to apply for the Chief Technology Officer position at Brainlyne.

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology? As Head of Data at Digital Forms, you will be responsible for translating business goals into measurable outcomes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their challenges, design actionable KPIs, and implement the data flows and dashboards needed to drive decision-making. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on data expertise, and outstanding communication skills. You’ll be a key player in delivering high-impact digital transformation solutions for our international clients.
Requirements
Responsibilities
Lead the company’s data strategy in alignment with business objectives and client goals.
Work closely with clients to understand their business context, define success metrics, and design clear, actionable KPIs.
Design and implement efficient data flows, pipelines, and architectures for business intelligence and reporting.
Build and manage dashboards that support executive-level decision-making and operational optimization.
Translate complex data insights into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including tech, marketing, and sales, to deliver data-driven solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting, and automation internally and for clients.
Requirements
Hard Skills:
Proven experience in designing and implementing dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, or similar.
Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and modern data stacks.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and SQL proficiency.
Ability to design scalable data architectures and optimize performance across systems.
Demonstrated ability to set up data tracking and analytics for digital transformation use cases.
Soft Skills:
Excellent spoken and written English; able to work closely with international clients.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business goals and turn them into data solutions.
Comfortable leading discovery sessions, presenting insights, and defining success metrics with clients.
Clear, structured communicator who can explain data concepts to non-technical audiences.
Organized and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
Highlights
Lead the data strategy behind impactful digital transformation projects, translating business goals into measurable outcomes through smart KPIs, clear dashboards, and scalable data architecture.

jobs.title: Head of Solution Engineering
jobs.text:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Head of Solution Engineering to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in an innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.
Responsibilities:
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Solution Engineers.
Provide technical leadership throughout all stages of client engagement: pre-sales, solution architecture, and implementation.
Act as a key technical consultant throughout the sales cycle: clearly and convincingly present product capabilities and business value to prospective clients.
Work closely with sales, product management, and development teams to design and deliver optimal client solutions.
Oversee the integration and implementation of solutions for clients, ensuring smooth and timely deployment.
Take into account all aspects when developing solutions: liquidity flows, execution models, risk parameters, and infrastructure compatibility.
Create and maintain up-to-date documentation, technical guides, and training materials for clients and internal teams.
Actively identify customer needs and suggest improvements based on feedback and market trends.
Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess team productivity and customer satisfaction levels.
Represent the company in technical meetings with external stakeholders, maintaining high standards of professionalism and technical expertise.
Requirements
Extensive technical experience in financial technology, trading platforms, risk management systems, and enterprise SaaS solutions.
Proven experience managing technical teams, preferably in solution engineering, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales within the financial sector.
Deep knowledge of liquidity aggregation, order routing, execution models, the FIX protocol, and trading system APIs.
Expertise in trading technologies and market infrastructure, particularly in the FX, CFD, and digital assets segments.
Familiarity with institutional platforms such as MetaTrader, cTrader, OneZero, PrimeXM, and proprietary OMS/EMS solutions.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business audiences.
A proactive, client-oriented mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a successful track record of working with diverse stakeholders.

jobs.title: AVP, Data Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry. Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.
The Assistant Vice President, Data Solutions Engineering will be responsible for building operational data pipelines and delivering fully documented datasets that account for data integrations. This role is engaged and aligned with our business partners to understand their needs and build data engineering solutions to address these needs. The role will report to the VP, Data Solutions Engineering.
This role will be based remotely.
What You Will Do:
Deliver well-architected data solutions in partnership with data platform engineers, data governance, data science, and data analytics/visualization peers.
Partner with business teams to design data solutions with the ability to mentor early career data engineers.
Lead build-out and deployment of data pipelines.
Ensure reliability, scalability and governance of data pipelines.
What You Will Have:
Bachelor's degree in Math, Computer Science or Engineering.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, Cloud, data operations.
Domain knowledge of Actuarial, Investment and Finance within Insurance/Reinsurance industry is a plus.
Minimum experience of seven years in a growing data engineering role, with at least five years in programming (Python) and SQL.
Robust knowledge of data lakes, data governance and modern data quality techniques.
Excellent analytical, problem solving and conceptual skills.
Strong verbal and written skills.
The base salary range for this role is listed below and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, all employees are eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.
Base Salary Range
$160,000—$180,000 USD
At Fortitude Re, our strength has always come from our people. Our success is deeply rooted in our ability to embrace the unique attributes, perspectives and experiences of every individual within our company. Fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging where everyone—regardless of background, race, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity—feels valued and respected is a foundation of our culture.
We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer and evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, diversity of thought and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
To all recruitment agencies: Unless you have been requested to work on this position, or other positions with Fortitude Re, please do not forward any resumes to Fortitude Re employees. Fortitude Re is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
Check us out on YouTube: About Fortitude Re (youtube.com)
By submitting your application, you agree that Fortitude Re may collect your personal data for recruiting purposes. For more on how we handle your personal data, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice. Concerned about recruitment fraud? Learn how to verify Fortitude Re's recruitment process: Recruitment Fraud Notice

jobs.title: Director of Data Governance
jobs.text:
The Director of Data Governance sits within Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance and leads the evolution of DeepHealth's data ecosystem into a unified, high-quality enterprise asset. The role owns strategic design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Data Governance Framework so data is accurate, secure, and ready for advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Define and execute a Data Governance roadmap aligned with the Enterprise Information and Governance vision.
Review, maintain, and enforce the Data Management Policy and Data Governance Charter against current regulatory and business needs.
Facilitate decision-making on data standards and help resolve cross-functional data conflicts.
Implement Data Quality Management procedures and establish KPIs for data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Define enterprise-wide data standards, including metadata management, data lineage, and master data management protocols.
Partner with IT and Security so data pipelines support AI applications while maintaining security boundaries.
Work with Security to define data classification levels and manage high-risk data access policies.
Ensure data practices adhere to applicable global privacy regulations and internal Enterprise Information and Governance mandates.
Align data governance priorities with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
Mentor and develop team members as the data governance capability grows.
Requirements
Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).
7 to 10 years of progressive experience in Data Management, Data Governance, or Information Architecture in healthcare, medical technology, or another highly regulated industry (required).
Strong experience with DAMA-DMBOK frameworks and data quality lifecycle management (required).
Deep understanding of data profiling tools, metadata management, and modern data stack concepts (required).
Experience with AI systems in production or product development contexts (required).
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including explaining complex concepts to diverse audiences (required).
High level of integrity and confidentiality (required).
Preferred: Master's degree or advanced relevant certifications.
Quality Standards
Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
Practices universal safety precautions.
Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.
Travel
This position requires travel up to approximately 10%.
Working Environment
European Union. Remote-friendly or office-based role.
Physical Demands
The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Salary:
115,000.00-130,00.00 EURO
100,000.00-110,000.00 in France

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Product Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our ScraperAPIteam, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.
Profile Overview
We recently acquired Traject Data, home of SerpWow and Rainforest API, and now run an end-to-end data pipeline: from proxy and scraping infrastructure through to structured, ready-to-use data APIs. The next chapter is turning that into one coherent, AI-native platform and we're looking for a CTPO to lead the combined 25-person product and engineering org through it. You'll report directly to the CEO, sit at the leadership table, and be the person who understands the stack down to the proxy layer while also setting where the product goes next.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:
Get hands-on with the heart of the product: proxy dynamics and anti-bot evasion, working directly with our Head of Ops to optimise vendor relationships and build up capacity.
Build real fluency in the product and the backend so you can operate as a genuine technical sparring partner to the CEO, not just receive direction.
Start bringing the ScraperAPI and Traject Data infrastructure together on a coherent technical roadmap
Your responsibilities
Own end-to-end product and technology strategy across our scraping infrastructure, proxy networks, and structured data API products (ScraperAPI, SerpWow, Rainforest API).
Lead, scale, and develop a 25+ person product and engineering organisation spanning multiple countries and time zones, building the management structure it needs as it grows.
Set technical architecture direction for high-scale, high-reliability infrastructure, including proxy management, anti-bot evasion, and large-scale scraping systems.
Drive AI and modern ML tooling into both the product itself and how the team builds and ships it.
Define and execute one product roadmap across the merged ScraperAPI and Traject Data lines.
Represent product and technology to the board, and work closely with the CEO and commercial leadership to keep product direction and business strategy aligned.
Stay close enough to the code and infrastructure to go in and troubleshoot, fix, or challenge a technical decision yourself when it matters.
What You bring to the table
Experience leading product and/or engineering at a highly technical company (CTO, CPO, VP Engineering or similar), at a 25+ person org or larger
Real hands-on depth in web scraping, proxies, or closely adjacent infrastructure. You understand the operational reality of this space and you don't rattle when a source breaks overnight and it's suddenly all hands on deck
A genuine track record with AI/ML, both shaping AI-powered product capability and pushing AI-native ways of working through an engineering team
Experience owning product vision and technical architecture together, not just one side of that line
Comfort operating at board level: a clear communicator who can hold their own with an ambitious, hands-on CEO and knows when to push back
Bonus: experience integrating product lines after a merger or acquisition
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.
ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Head of Global Engineering Steriles Operations
jobs.text:
McDermott Laboratories Limited
Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.
We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.
Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference, and here’s how the Head of Global Engineering Steriles Operations role will make an impact:
Provide strategic leadership for engineering, facilities, utilities, projects and capacity expansion across the Steriles (Injectables and respiratory) network. Ensure compliant, reliable and cost-effective operations while supporting growth, operational excellence, audit readiness, and people development. A balanced combination between mastering capital management, and manufacturing operations reliability transformations is a key requirement.
Key responsibilities for this role include:
Lead engineering, facilities, utilities and capital project activities across all sterile manufacturing locations.
Top 1 prioritity will be Quality and Safety assurance across all the engineering related activities, for internal and for external collaborators
Drive Lean/Operational Excellence and Digital transformation agenda across the engineering function with a clear goal to optimize performance of our assets (e.g.: OEE) and optimize expenses
Ensure compliance with GMP, statutory, regulatory, safety and environmental requirements.
Drive standardization of engineering practices, utilities and technical standards across sites.
Manage CAPEX and engineering OPEX budgets and optimize resource utilization.
Lead capacity expansion, plant upgrades, automation and operational improvement initiatives.
Maintain audit readiness and support regulatory inspections.
Partner with Quality, Manufacturing and Projects teams to improve plant performance.
Mentor and develop engineering teams through coaching, training and succession planning. Developing a strong network of Engineering leaders across the site through active career development and rotation across sites.
The minimum qualifications for this role are:
Deep knowledge of sterile pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, engineering systems and project management.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management and strategic planning capabilities.
Knowledge of current sterile pharmaceutical technologies, including isolator filling lines, device assembly lines and plant management best practices
Bachelor of Science and Engineering with specialization in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical Engineering or related field.
Experience in people and process management within the pharmaceutical industry.
Significant experience in injectables manufacturing environments is required.
At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.
At Viatris, we offercompetitivesalaries, benefitsandan inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: VP, Systems Engineering NAR (Virtual, Texas, United States, 78701)
jobs.text:
In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.
At Ruckus, our mission is to deliver purpose-driven networks across vertical markets, that drive human experiences where we learn, live, work, and play. With core values focused on innovation and customer success, RUCKUS has an unbeaten track record of redefining what’s possible in connectivity and network performance with our portfolio of AI-powered access points, multigigabit switching, and Cloud and Edge services.
We’re looking for a dynamic, customer-focused technology leader to drive innovation and impact as our VP of Systems Engineering NAR (North America Region) at RUCKUS. In this role, you’ll lead a team of SE professionals, shaping strategy, fostering trust, and ensuring every customer interaction delivers real business value.
“How You'll help us to connect the world:”
As the VP of Systems Engineering, NAR you will lead a geographically distributed team of Systems Engineers and Managers supporting customers and channel partners across the region.
This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for driving technical sales success through partner enablement, customer engagement, and team development in a diverse and high-growth market. You will work closely with regional sales leadership, distributors, and partners to expand RUCKUS adoption and ensure strong technical alignment across countries.You will attract, recruit, and develop talented SEs and support the team’s efforts to successfully position, influence and grow the RUCKUS product portfolio to net new and existing installed base customers and channel partners
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of Systems Engineers across the NAR region
Develop and execute a strategic SE business plan to drive growth.
Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing SE team.
Partner with regional sales leadership to achieve revenue targets, pipeline growth, and market expansion
Guide pre-sales activities including solution design, demos, POCs, and RFx responses
Review and strengthen technical account plans and regional go-to-market strategies
Act as a technical escalation point for complex, multi-country deployments and customer situations
Build executive-level relationships with partners, distributors, and customers as a trusted advisor
Align cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing) to enhance customer experience.
Influence product roadmaps with field insights and market demands.
Optimize operational budgets and scale global SE initiatives.
Core Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience)
15+ years of pre-sales or systems engineering experience in at least one area of networking (Wi-Fi, switching, routing)
7+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams
Hands-on experience with enterprise networking solutions, including wireless and switching
Proven ability to operate across complex and matrixed organizations
Exceptional presentation and executive communication skills, with the ability to persuade and influence C-level stakeholders.
Proven ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and drive revenue growth.
Strong leadership in talent development, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration.
Exceptional presentation and executive communication skills, with the ability to persuade and influence C-level stakeholders.
Candidates can be located in any state across the U.S.
Requirements: “You will excite us if you have:”
3+ years of experience in a second-level technical management capacity, including oversight of escalations, team leadership, and operational support
A proficient understanding of pre-sales engineering including new customer acquisition strategies, technical influencing, objecting handling, how to develop technical and business skillsets of your team, program and case management, hardware and software networking solutions in IT infrastructures, channel partner engagements for growth, and critical account management
Strong understanding and experience with mid to large enterprise business models and technical requirements for verticals that include MDU, K-12, SLED, higher education, hospitality, manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, large public venues and others
Advanced understanding of customer business drivers and how to map these to customer requirements and network environments, migrations, and network refresh decision making strategies including identification of improvement areas in network design
Multi-tasker with strong ability to manage under pressure to address deadlines, program manage development of deliverables, and logistical champion when supporting multiple projects and events
Working knowledge or understanding of networking technical skills; specifically, 802.11 Wi-Fi technology evolution releases (Wi-Fi 5, 6, 7), best practices design and assessment, wireless troubleshooting, RF tools used for pre and post site surveys, wireless network optimization, IP routing and switching WAN/LAN design, setup and configuration, Layer 4-7 application services, security authentication methods and products, SASE, SD-WAN, RADIUS, AD, Virtualization environments/deployments, VM installations, (any of VM Ware, KVM, Hyper-V, GCE, Azure, AWS), secure device/user onboarding solutions, etc.
General knowledge of the following areas of specialization: Cloud services (SaaS); VLAN; network segmentation, personal identity networking, security (SASE); SD-WAN; wireless controller architectures; indoor and outdoor wireless deployments; general routing and switching
Strong program management experience, technical relationship building, verbal and written communications skills, presenting and thought leadership, and commanding a room of executive level decision makers
Our salary ranges consider a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to benchmarking by independent third-party consultants, skill sets, years of experience, training, education, geography, and other business needs. Depending on experience, the range can be higher for candidates with exceptional experience and a demonstrated history of successful performance. Expected Total Target Compensation for this role is $250,000 - $370,000. The candidate will be rewarded with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and accidental death insurance, a 401(k) plan, and participation in the Company’s Incentive Plan. Candidates starting with the Company will be eligible for eleven paid holidays in a full calendar year, two weeks of paid vacation (prorated based on start date), as well as other leave options.
What Happens After You Apply:
Learn how to prepare yourself for the next steps in our hiring process by visiting
Why Join Us?
Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. jobs.title: Global Product Owner / Global Head of Entity Management
jobs.text:
At GoGlobal, the Global Product Owner (GPO), Entity Management (EMT) owns the EMT product end to end — its global scope, standards, commercial logic, processes, and economics. Reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, you are accountable for the growth, profitability, and reputation of EMT worldwide.
This is a leadership role whose primary objective is business growth through flawless delivery. You are the senior product and delivery voice for EMT in the market — client-facing, trusted by prospects and key accounts, and the partner of choice for Revenue and Sales in winning and expanding business. As the ultimate subject-matter expert for EMT, you stay close to market trends and customer demands and translate them into how the service is designed, packaged, priced, and delivered.
You lead the EMT function globally through the Global Process Manager (GPM), the Regional Product Owners (RPOs), and the Outsourcing Control (OC) leads. You build the delivery organisation to meet both market opportunity and client expectation, set and defend global standards as the foundation for scalable and sustainable delivery, and act as an inspiring leader for the teams who deliver EMT every day.
Roles & Responsibilities
Commercial Leadership & Growth
• Act as the senior, client-facing product authority for EMT: anchoring strategic client engagements, pitches, high-stakes decisions, and escalations.
• Partner with Revenue and Sales as the expert in the room — qualifying opportunities, shaping scope and pricing, and helping convert and expand accounts.
• Define and evolve the commercial logic — packaging, bundling, premiums, and guardrails — so EMT can be sold and delivered profitably at scale.
• Own the reputation of the EMT product in the market.
Product Strategy & Standards
• Own the global scope, service definitions, and standards for EMT — what is in, what is out, and how it is delivered.
• Set global execution standards, SLAs, and compliance expectations across all regions and delivery models.
• Drive consistency of delivery across regions while enabling them to flex within agreed guardrails.
Market Insight & Service Design
• Act as the ultimate subject-matter expert for EMT, maintaining a deep, current view of market trends, competitor moves, and evolving customer demands.
• Translate market and client insight into the design of the service and the delivery organisation, so the function is structured to meet both demand and expectation.
• Shape the product roadmap and delivery-model choices (in-house, outsourced, automated) to capture growth opportunities.
Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
• Set the global EMT operating model and process standards; approve processes, SOPs, and control frameworks before they enter delivery.
• Direct the Global Process Manager (GPM) on process design, standardisation, controls, and scalability — turning product intent into repeatable, executable delivery.
• Support the enterprise AI direction and drive its adoption within EMT to enable scale and quality.
Cost Management & Commercial Sustainability
• Own product-level cost-to-serve for EMT, driving efficiency, productivity, and long-term economic sustainability.
• Make deliberate trade-offs across scope design, automation, sourcing, and delivery-model choices to keep delivery economics healthy as the product scales.
• Diagnose cost pressures, identify root causes, and lead corrective action, supported by Finance on modelling and analysis.
Regional Delivery Governance & Team Leadership
• Lead all Regional Product Owners (RPOs) for EMT as their global head, holding them and the Outsourcing Control leads accountable for regional delivery outcomes and economics.
• Provide the framework within which regional autonomy — in-house versus outsourced mix, capacity, and hiring proposals — is exercised, and arbitrate cross-regional or peer-function disagreements when escalated.
• Lead, mentor, and develop the GPM, RPOs, and OC leads; build product, commercial, and delivery capability across the global EMT team.
Scope & Commercial Governance
• Propose and own changes to product scope, service tiers, and commercial logic, routing them through the agreed approval framework for impact assessment and implementation readiness.
• Support enabling functions on scope-to-catalogue mapping, SKU registration, and pricing alignment.
• Validate post-implementation effectiveness of scope and commercial changes through defined metrics, and refine where needed.
Compliance, Audit & Risk
• Set the global compliance posture for EMT across company law, corporate-governance codes, and statutory filing and corporate-secretarial requirements.
• Ensure EMT delivery maintains internal controls and regulatory adherence in every jurisdiction the product serves.
• Engage with internal and external audit on EMT product-level matters.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with the Chief Delivery Officer, peer Global Product Owners, Revenue, Technology, and the enabling functions across Delivery.
• Represent the EMT product in cross-functional and executive forums.
Key Performance Indicators
• Revenue growth and win rate for the product.
• Retention and net revenue retention (NRR).
• Margin and cost-to-serve.
• Delivery SLA attainment and quality.
• Client satisfaction (NPS).

jobs.title: SVP of Software Engineering & Transformation
jobs.text:
At Emprise Bank, everything we do is focused on empowering people to thrive. We proudly work to provide an extraordinary customer experience to help our customers achieve their goals.
The Senior Vice President of Software Engineering & Transformation provides strategic leadership for the Bank’s enterprise technology transformation agenda, advancement and adoption of artificial intelligence, application development, and emerging technology capabilities. This executive is responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and delivering transformational opportunities that leverage AI, automation, modern engineering practices, and strategic technology partnerships to improve client experience, operational efficiency, resiliency, and business outcomes.
A successful candidate will have:
Exemplary customer service experience
Critical and analytical thinking skills
Confident and articulate written and verbal communications skills
Initiative and strong work ethic
Technical problem resolution skills
Strong attention to detail
The ability to treat highly confidential information with utmost urgency
An understanding of and commitment to our values
Attitude and aptitude to engage in continuous development
Essential functions of the role:
Software Engineering Enablement
Develop and drive adoption of modern software engineering practices such as CI/CD, DevSecOps, automation, AI-assisted development, and cloud-native development capabilities.
Partner with business and technology leaders through Software Engineering Center of Excellence to establish shared standards, practices, and capabilities that accelerate responsible software delivery.
Collaborate with engineering teams to improve delivery velocity, quality, scalability, and developer experience through modern engineering and AI-enabled capabilities.
Enable teams to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI, while maintaining appropriate security, governance, and architectural alignment.
Collaborate with enterprise and solution architects to establish reusable patterns, reference architectures, and technology standards and modern development capabilities.
Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for customer facing digital products and software capabilities that enhance experience, improve efficiency, and support business growth.
Enterprise AI & Innovation Strategy
Lead the identification, prioritization, and delivery of AI and agentic AI solutions that improve employee productivity, customer experience, operational effectiveness, and revenue growth.
Identify, prioritize, and implement agentic AI solutions that create measurable business value, enhance customer experiences, and improve employee productivity.
Partner with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Data leaders to ensure AI solutions align with established governance, security, risk management, and responsible AI standards.
Build organizational understanding and adoption of AI through education, enablement, and change management.
Transformation Leadership & Execution
Lead enterprise technology transformation initiatives from strategy through execution, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
Partner with executive leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and modernization.
Partner with external business partners and internal teams to identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities for custom software development, platform extensions, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
Establish transformation methodologies, prioritization frameworks, and reporting mechanisms to drive accountability and transparency.
Partner with technology leaders, engineers, and architects to drive modernization initiatives aligned with enterprise architecture standards and the strategic technology roadmap, enhancing scalability, resiliency, security, operational efficiency, and business agility.
Remove organizational barriers and enable cross-functional collaboration across Technology and business teams.
Identify opportunities to simplify technology environments, modernize legacy platforms, and reduce technical complexity.
Champion a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and customer-focused problem solving.
Executive Leadership & Partnership
Serve as a trusted advisor to the CTO, executive leadership team, and business leaders on emerging technology opportunities and transformation strategies.
Build strong partnerships across business lines, ensuring technology investments deliver meaningful business value.
Recruit, develop and lead high-performing teams through coaching, talent development, and organizational growth.
Represent the Bank externally with technology partners, industry groups, and innovation communities.
Other duties as assigned within the scope and responsibility of the job
Requirements
10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience spanning enterprise transformation, software engineering, digital strategy, AI adoption, and emerging technologies.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
Experience delivering AI-enabled products and capabilities, cloud technologies, modern software engineering practices, automation, and enterprise technology platforms.
Proven success in developing and executing technology strategies and leading large-scale modernization and organizational change within complex, regulated environments, with measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to drive delivery at pace through clear prioritization, decisive leadership, rapid decision-making, barrier removal, and accountability.
Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and effectively leveraging strategic technology partners, platforms, and ecosystem capabilities.
Strong executive presence, strategic thinking, communication, change leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across business and technology organizations.
Relevant professional certifications preferred, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, TOGAF, SAFe, PMP, ITIL, or recognized AI/ML certifications.
Benefits
In addition to a competitive salary and benefits, Emprise offers professional growth, a rewarding and challenging environment, opportunities to be involved in our communities, and a culture of integrity, passion, and success.
At Emprise Bank, empowering people to thrive means having an all-inclusive culture that honors our commitment to all dimensions of diversity in our workforce and embraces inclusion of all people. People of color, women, LGBTQIA+, veterans, and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
To learn more, please visit our website at.
Emprise Bank is an EEO/AA/ADA/Veteran Employer/Member FDIC/Drug Free Workplace.
Emprise Bank participates in E-Verify and will provide your Form-I 9 to the federal government to confirm authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Head of Data Intelligence & AI (m/w/d)
jobs.text:
Allgemeine Infos
Standort: Berlin
Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit
Start: ab sofort
StoryMachine ist eine 2017 gegründete Agentur mit dem Schwerpunkt auf strategischem Storytelling für Brands, Persönlichkeiten und politische Institutionen.
Die Basis unseres integrativen Storytellings ist journalistisch und komplett datengetrieben. Wir betrachten Social Channels nicht isoliert, sondern heben ihre Stärken und Besonderheiten hervor und bringen sie zum Vorteil unserer Kund*innen ein.
Unser Büro befindet sich in einem alten Varieté-Theater mitten im Herzen von Berlin. Dort triffst du auf einzigartige Charakterköpfe als Kolleg*innen und erhältst bei regelmäßigen Weiterbildungsimpulsen in unseren internen Academies frische Perspektiven aus der Politik-, Wirtschafts- und Medienwelt.
Über die Stelle
Daten und KI sind der Hebel, mit dem unsere Agentur schneller und smarter wird. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Du führst unser Data Team aus Data Scientists und Analysten, entwickelst datengetriebene Produkte für Kunden und Teams und treibst unsere interne KI-Offensive voran: LLMs in den Analyseprozessen, automatisierte Reportings, weniger Handarbeit, mehr Insights. Dabei bist du nicht nur strategisch unterwegs, sondern operativ ins Tagesgeschäft eingebunden: Du arbeitest selbst an Analysen, Automatisierungen und Kundenprojekten mit und packst dort an, wo es gerade gebraucht wird. Du berichtest direkt an COO und CEO und gestaltest mit eigenem Budget und echtem Entscheidungsspielraum.
Deine Aufgaben
KI-Offensive und Automatisierung:
➡️ Du treibst unsere interne KI-Offensive strategisch und operativ voran,
➡️ Du integrierst LLMs in Analyseprozesse: Textanalyse, unstrukturierte Daten, schnellere Insight-Generierung,
➡️ Du automatisierst Reportings und Standardanalysen und verkürzt den Weg von Rohdaten zum Insight,
➡️ Du baust Automatisierungen und API-Schnittstellen, die in Kundenprojekten und im Agenturalltag laufen,
➡️ Du bewertest neue Tools und optimierst unsere Tool-Landschaft, auch unter Kostenaspekten.
Teamführung:
➡️ Du führst das Data Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, inklusive Personalentscheidungen,
➡️ Du entwickelst deine Teammitglieder gezielt weiter und sorgst mit Feedback und Anerkennung für hohe Motivation,
➡️ Du schaffst klare Kommunikationswege und eine positive Arbeitskultur.
Produktentwicklung:
➡️ Du entwickelst datengetriebene Produkte für Kunden und für die interne Nutzung, iterativ auf Basis von Feedback und Performance-Daten,
➡️ Du erkennst Kunden- und Teambedürfnisse sowie Marktchancen durch Datenanalysen,
➡️ Du rollst Produkte gemeinsam mit den anderen Leads in der Agentur aus.
Kundenberatung und New Business:
➡️ Du bist Hauptansprechpartner:in für datengetriebene Fragestellungen unserer Kunden,
➡️ Du erstellst und präsentierst Analysen, Berichte und Dashboards und berätst zu Datenstrategien auf Augenhöhe,
➡️ Du unterstützt New Business und steigerst den Verkauf datenbasierter Produkte.
Strategie und Verantwortung
➡️ Du verantwortest das Budget des Bereichs Data Intelligence,
➡️ Du entwickelst unsere interne Datenstrategie und präsentierst sie als Whitepaper,
➡️ Du optimierst die Ressourcennutzung und das Verhältnis von gebuchten zu fakturierbaren Stunden.

jobs.title: (USA) Senior Director, Technology Operations
jobs.text:
Position Summary...
We are seeking a highly skilled Technology Operations & Strategy leader to join our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape and execute the technology strategy that enables Walmart Claims Services (WCS) while ensuring the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of critical business platforms. You will work at the intersection of technology, data, process transformation, automation, and AI, translating business needs into scalable solutions that drive operational excellence and business outcomes.
Who we are:
Walmart Claims Services (WCS) delivers claims management and risk-related services that help protect our customers, associates, and business across
Walmart U.S. and Sam's Club. Our team enables this mission by delivering and evolving the technology ecosystem that powers claims operations, including core platforms, system integrations, data capabilities, automation, analytics, and emerging AI solutions. Working closely with Operations, Product, Engineering, Data Enablement, and external partners, we connect strategy to execution by modernizing technology, improving workflows, and enabling smarter, data-driven decision making. This role is critical in driving alignment across stakeholders and ensuring technology investments deliver measurable business value.
What you'll do...
Lead the support, optimization, and continuous improvement of core business platforms and technology solutions that enable claims operations.
Develop and execute technology strategies, roadmaps, and transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, automation, data accessibility, and user experience.
Translate business problems and opportunities into technology solutions by partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, and vendor teams.
Drive system integrations, process improvements, and AI-enabled capabilities that create a more connected and intelligent technology ecosystem.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives by establishing delivery plans, success measures, risk mitigation strategies, and stakeholder alignment.
Manage vendor relationships and oversee system enhancements, issue resolution, compliance requirements, and operational performance.
Leverage data, analytics, and business insights to support decision-making and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
What you'll bring:
7+ years of experience in technology operations, business strategy, transformation, consulting, PMO, systems implementation, or related cross-functional leadership roles.
Strong understanding of enterprise business processes and experience using technology, data, analytics, automation, and AI to drive operational improvements.
Experience leading complex initiatives involving system implementation, platform support, process transformation, vendor management, or ecosystem integration.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools and platforms (e.g., Copilot, Wibey, Code Puppy, Semantic Search, RAG, LLMs) or demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply emerging technologies.
Proven ability to translate complex business problems into technology-enabled strategies, decision frameworks, and executable solutions.
Strong understanding of technology operations, systems integration, governance, compliance, and risk management principles.
Exceptional analytical, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across diverse stakeholders in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see . Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.
For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.
The annual salary range for this position is $130,000.00 - $260,000.00 Additional compensation includes annual or quarterly performance bonuses. Additional compensation for certain positions may also include :
- Stock

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
Position Title: Vice President, Product
Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer
Location: United States
POSITION DESCRIPTION
apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.
apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.
We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.
The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.
Trusted Advisor
Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.
Roles and Requirements
Product discovery
Discovery leadership. Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.
Continuous discovery habits. Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
Insight engine. Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
Discovery standards. Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.
Investment coordination
Single intake for engineering demand. Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.
Portfolio allocation. Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform health, security and compliance work, and technical debt, and makes the trade-offs explicit.
Outcome-based funding. Turns the shift from project funding to standing, outcome-funded teams into a working practice. Defines outcome goals per trio with finance and the CPTO, and reports progress against them.
Transparent decisions. Runs a regular investment review where requests are prioritized against outcomes and evidence. Makes sure stakeholders understand what was funded, what was not, and why.
Product strategy and leadership
Product vision and strategy. Sets a compelling product vision and a focused product strategy that connects company objectives to the problems each trio is asked to solve.
Product organization. Leads the Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence and Platform product leaders, and the product managers beneath them. Hires, coaches and develops product managers who are empowered to own outcomes, not manage backlogs.
India product presence. Builds Product Management in Noida, starting with the Platform product leader, so India-owned domains have product partners close to the engineers.
Product operations. Leads product operations: product analytics and instrumentation, research operations, the investment intake process, and the product operating cadence.
Trio partnership. Works as one team with design and engineering leaders at every level. Product, design and engineering share goals, plan together and review together.
Customer and market
Market leadership. Keeps apexanalytix ahead in supplier risk management and procure-to-pay controls, including AI-native and agentic capabilities.
Go-to-market alignment. Partners with Go-to-Market leadership on packaging, pricing input and launches, so customers see one connected platform aligned to the journey structure.
Compliance as a product requirement. Works with the Head of GRC so that regulatory, security and third-party risk requirements shape product decisions early, both for our own controls and for the compliance outcomes our clients buy from us.
First-Year Priorities
Publish a product vision and product strategy, approved by the CPTO, that sets the problems each of the four trios is asked to solve.
Agree first-year outcome goals for each trio with the CPTO, engineering leaders and finance, including a revenue goal for standalone data products.
Launch a single investment intake and review process for all engineering demand, with every request tied to an outcome and every decision visible to stakeholders.
Get every product trio running weekly customer touchpoints, with opportunity solution trees and assumption tests visible in quarterly reviews.
Set a baseline for discovery and delivery health (for example, share of shipped work validated in discovery, time from idea to validated learning, and adoption of what ships), and show measurable improvement against it.
Name or hire the product leaders for all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, and close gaps in the product manager bench.
Stand up product operations with reliable product analytics across the platform.
Work with the Head of Design and engineering leaders so that every team operates as a trio with shared goals, joint planning and joint reviews.
Required Skills
15+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading product organizations through product leaders and managers in B2B enterprise SaaS.
Deep, practical fluency in the product operating model as described by Marty Cagan (Inspired, Empowered, Transformed): empowered product teams, outcomes over output, product strategy, and the distinction between discovery and delivery.
A proven record of leading a transformation from a project- or feature-driven model to empowered, outcome-funded product teams, including winning over executives and stakeholders outside product.
Hands-on experience leading product discovery at scale, including addressing value, usability, feasibility and viability risk before committing engineering investment.
Experience owning portfolio-level investment decisions across multiple teams: setting capacity allocation, saying no with evidence, and making trade-offs transparent to executives and Go-to-Market leaders.
A track record of hiring, coaching and developing strong product managers and product leaders.
Strong analytical skills, with experience using product analytics, experimentation and qualitative research to make decisions.
Experience working in close partnership with design and engineering as a trio, and with distributed teams across US and India time zones.
Experience with AI-native or data products, and sound judgment about where AI and agents create real customer value.
Strong executive presence, able to represent product strategy credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.
Preferred Skills
Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits (Continuous Discovery Habits): weekly customer interviews by the product trio, opportunity solution trees, and rapid assumption testing, ideally introduced across several teams.
Background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) software or practice, especially third-party risk management (TPRM), supplier risk or vendor due diligence.
Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention or fintech.
Experience building product management in an India-based Global Capability Center.

blocks.text: Position Title: Vice President, Product
Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer
Location: United States
POSITION DESCRIPTION

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.

The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.
Trusted Advisor

items: Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.

blocks.text: Roles and Requirements
Product discovery

items: Discovery leadership. Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.

Continuous discovery habits. Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
Insight engine. Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
Discovery standards. Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.

blocks.text: Investment coordination

items: Single intake for engineering demand. Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.

Portfolio allocation. Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform health, security and compliance work, and technical debt, and makes the trade-offs explicit.

Outcome-based funding. Turns the shift from project funding to standing, outcome-funded teams into a working practice. Defines outcome goals per trio with finance and the CPTO, and reports progress against them.
Transparent decisions. Runs a regular investment review where requests are prioritized against outcomes and evidence. Makes sure stakeholders understand what was funded, what was not, and why.

blocks.text: Product strategy and leadership

items: Product vision and strategy. Sets a compelling product vision and a focused product strategy that connects company objectives to the problems each trio is asked to solve.

Product organization. Leads the Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence and Platform product leaders, and the product managers beneath them. Hires, coaches and develops product managers who are empowered to own outcomes, not manage backlogs.
India product presence. Builds Product Management in Noida, starting with the Platform product leader, so India-owned domains have product partners close to the engineers.
Product operations. Leads product operations: product analytics and instrumentation, research operations, the investment intake process, and the product operating cadence.
Trio partnership. Works as one team with design and engineering leaders at every level. Product, design and engineering share goals, plan together and review together.

blocks.text: Customer and market

items: Market leadership. Keeps apexanalytix ahead in supplier risk management and procure-to-pay controls, including AI-native and agentic capabilities.
Go-to-market alignment. Partners with Go-to-Market leadership on packaging, pricing input and launches, so customers see one connected platform aligned to the journey structure.

Compliance as a product requirement. Works with the Head of GRC so that regulatory, security and third-party risk requirements shape product decisions early, both for our own controls and for the compliance outcomes our clients buy from us.

blocks.text: First-Year Priorities

items: Publish a product vision and product strategy, approved by the CPTO, that sets the problems each of the four trios is asked to solve.
Agree first-year outcome goals for each trio with the CPTO, engineering leaders and finance, including a revenue goal for standalone data products.
Launch a single investment intake and review process for all engineering demand, with every request tied to an outcome and every decision visible to stakeholders.
Get every product trio running weekly customer touchpoints, with opportunity solution trees and assumption tests visible in quarterly reviews.

Set a baseline for discovery and delivery health (for example, share of shipped work validated in discovery, time from idea to validated learning, and adoption of what ships), and show measurable improvement against it.
Name or hire the product leaders for all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, and close gaps in the product manager bench.
Stand up product operations with reliable product analytics across the platform.
Work with the Head of Design and engineering leaders so that every team operates as a trio with shared goals, joint planning and joint reviews.

Deep, practical fluency in the product operating model as described by Marty Cagan (Inspired, Empowered, Transformed): empowered product teams, outcomes over output, product strategy, and the distinction between discovery and delivery.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.
A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.
The next InCommand is a new solution, built on a new technology stack, designed from the ground up for the way modern data centers, including high-density and AI infrastructure, are operated. It will be delivered as a cloud service and be deployable in customers' own environments, built API-first, and developed with an agent-assisted engineering practice in which coding agents work from specifications under human review. Our own facilities are the first customer, so everything we build is proven in real, live operations before anyone else sees it.
Someone has to decide what that product is: what it does, what it leaves behind, what comes first, and what the industry will pay for. As Head of Product that is your call, and the engineers and coding agents who build it work from what you write. You start with a rare advantage: a decade of operational knowledge about what the product has to do, and the people who use it every day sitting down the hall. You partner closely with Architecture, Integrations and Developer Platform, and you build the product function from there.
Key Accountabilities
Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the new InCommand, from the first capabilities we prove on our own facilities to a product the industry adopts.
Own the living functional specification repository that engineers and coding agents build from, and the acceptance criteria that define what "done" means for every capability.
Decide, capability by capability, what the new product does, what it does differently and what it leaves behind, using real usage data and the judgment of the operators who run data centers every day.
Define the AI-first side of the product: insights, recommendations and an assistant that operators can trust, with the provenance and control critical infrastructure demands.
Partner with Architecture, bringing operator and customer needs as requirements for the data model and the API, and with Product Marketing so the product is documented in a form the industry can adopt.
Shape packaging and pricing for a modular product delivered as a cloud service and in customers' own environments.
Work daily with our operations engineers as the voice of the customer, and grow the product function as the product grows.
Required Skills
8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform or infrastructure product: roadmap, specifications and pricing.
Experience building a product from scratch: defining what it is and what it is not, and making hard scoping decisions early with incomplete information.
A record of writing precise specifications and acceptance criteria that engineering teams, and now coding agents, can build from without guesswork.
Experience with operations-heavy users (operations centers, field or facilities teams, industrial environments) and turning their tacit process into explicit requirements.
Familiarity with AI-driven product capabilities (insights, recommendations, assistants) and what makes them trustworthy to users; hands-on use of AI tools in your own work.
Packaging and pricing experience for modular enterprise software.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to make a product case to executives and to engineers alike.
Preferred Skills
Knowledge of or experience with DCIM products: the data they manage, how data-center operators use them and how they are bought.
Product experience with observability, monitoring or other high-volume telemetry products, and a feel for telemetry economics: cost-to-serve, data value and packaging.
Having defined and shipped an AI assistant or AI-driven insight capability: evaluation, trust, provenance, retrieval over operational data.
Having worked as the product counterpart of a platform architect on an API-first product, turning customer needs into requirements the architecture team builds against.
Experience with specification-driven or AI-assisted development practices, where coding agents are first-class participants in how a product gets built.
Serverfarm is committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace and offers paid time off, paid holidays, 401k and FULL coverage medical, dental and vision. Our compensation philosophy rewards employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s goals and strategic initiatives.
The listed salary range for this position is an estimate based on the competitive job market. Final compensation will be based on your own individual skills, experience, and location.

They are not intended to serve as an exhaustive list of all possible responsibilities and duties. We encourage you to apply even if your experience isn't an exact match to the job description.

jobs.title: Engineering Director - Building Automation
jobs.text:
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Director to lead the engineering organization for Priva Building Automation and drive the successful development and delivery of our products.
Who are we?
Priva is a dynamic and innovative multinational company with 16 branch offices on all continents and almost 600 dedicated colleagues. We are passionate about tackling global challenges like food security, energy transition, and water management. Our mission, "Creating a climate for growth," means we aim to empower our customers to thrive and make the world a better place through our solutions in horticulture and building automation.
Building Automation is one of Priva's four business verticals, delivering the advanced climate control technologies behind comfortable, energy-efficient buildings. As the Engineering Director, you own end-to-end development, delivery, engineering quality and engineering performance.
