jobs.title: Workplace - Design Project Director (Urban Core) (REQ743)
jobs.text:
The Workplace Design Project Lead is responsible for leading the successful design, planning and delivery of the Workplace Interiors of the Qiddiya corporate headquarters which are being integrated into new base buildings. This includes managing the workplace project from early concept and business case development through developing comprehensive briefs, design, procurement, construction, and operational handover.
The proposed Qiddiya Headquarters will be a world-class Grade A+, future-ready workplace ecosystem spanning approximately 120,000 sqm and accommodating approximately 9,000 people. Designed to enhance human performance, foster innovation, and set a benchmark for sustainable workplace design, the campus will provide a flexible and resilient environment that evolves with the organization’s needs.
This role will ensure alignment between the corporate headquarters workplace and other QIC workplace projects, ensuring they support the company’s strategic objectives, governance requirements, and employee needs. The positionwill also represent the Qiddiya corporate workplace across senior leadership forums and act as a key liaison across internal departments.
The role will require working closely with the Base Building Development Directors to ensure workplace requirements are integrated into the base building design, infrastructure, and delivery strategy from the earliest design stages. This includes coordinating key interfaces such as spatial planning, building services, vertical transportation, access, security, technology, sustainability, and operational requirements so the headquarters workplace is seamlessly embedded within the broader development and capable of supporting QIC’s long-term business and employee needs.
The successful candidate will bring a depth of experience in the design management of large-scale corporate workplace projects, with proven capability leading front-end design phases from workplace strategy, briefing and concept development through to design coordination and approvals. They will combine strong technical understanding of workplace planning and fit-out design with strategic project leadership, ensuring design outcomes are aligned with business objectives, employee needs and delivery requirements. Exceptional stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead consultants, internal client teams and senior decision-makers through complex workplace design processes are imperative for the role.
Key Responsibilities
1. Project Leadership & Delivery
· Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of the company’s corporate headquarters workplace, ensuring alignment with workplace strategy, program, budget, quality, compliance requirements, and employee needs, while aligning to the consistency across other Qiddiya Investment Company workplace projects in line with the company’s strategic objectives and governance requirements.
· Work closely with internal stakeholders including the Office Development team who are delivering the base buildings, Corporate Workplace Team, HR, IT, Smart Buildings Team, DMO, ESG, and Corporate Governance to ensure the workplace reflects current and future needs.
· Manage external consultants, project management consultants, workplace design teams, quantity surveyors, and contractors on behalf of the company as client.
Coordinate all phases of workplace delivery, with particular emphasis on front-end design management, including workplace strategy, feasibility, briefing, concept design, design development, approvals, procurement, construction, fit-out, commissioning, and transition to occupancy.
· Work closely with Workplace Delivery teams to ensure construction procurement, phasing, quality and compliance are achieved in all workplace projects.
2. Strategic Vision & Internal Alignment
· Translate the company’s strategic goals, brand identity, and public mission into workplace design and delivery outcomes.
· Lead internal engagement to shape the headquarters as a high-performing, flexible, inclusive and sustainable workplace.
· Promote alignment between the physical workspace and the organization’s operating model, functional briefing, technology roadmap, and corporate culture.
· Support leadership in driving positive organisational change associated with the move.
3. Governance & Public Accountability
· Ensure robust reporting and project governance in line with organisational frameworks.
· Prepare and present business cases, board papers, risk reports, and budget updates for executive stakeholders.
· Ensure procurement activities meet probity, equity, and value-for-money principles in line with corporate guidelines.
· Demonstrate stewardship of funds through strong cost control, transparency, and risk management.
4. Stakeholder Engagement
· Engage with executive leadership and internal stakeholders to ensure project goals are well-communicated and supported.
· Coordinate user engagement, change management, and communication strategies to prepare the organisation for transition.
· Act as an internal point of contact and trusted advisor to the internal client team throughout the project lifecycle.
Qualifications & Experience
Education
· Tertiary qualifications in Project Management, Construction Management, Architectural or related fields are imperative.
· Professional certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or construction management are desirable.
Preferred Work Experience
Minimum 15+ years’ experience leading the design and delivery of complex corporate workplace interiors, including large-scale headquarters or campus-style workplace projects.
Proven track record leading medium-to-large commercial workplace projects through front-end design phases, including workplace strategy, briefing, concept design, design development, consultant coordination, and stakeholder approvals.
Experience in the design and delivery of integrated workplace fit-out projects would also be beneficial.
Understanding of ESG ratings and sustainability standards for commercial office development and workplace interiors, including LEED, Green Star, BREEAM, WELL, or equivalent frameworks.
Ability to take ownership and responsibility for all aspects of workplace projects, including preparation of project and design briefs, consultant procurement, design management, contractor procurement, delivery oversight, handover, and operational readiness.
Strong stakeholder management skills at all levels, including internal departments, client groups, consultants, contractors, and senior leadership.
GCC experience is desirable but not essential.
Technical Acumen
· Strong understanding of workplace strategy, workplace planning, and fit-out delivery.
· Skilled in project budgeting, procurement, program management, risk, and value engineering.
· Familiarity with government or public-sector procurement processes and contract management.
· Understanding and experience in delivering sustainability standards (e.g., Green Star, WELL) and accessibility compliance (e.g., DDA).
Strategic & Business Skills
· Demonstrated ability to translate organizational strategy into capital project outcomes.
· Skilled in writing and presenting business cases, executive reporting, and value-for-money assessments.
· Capable of balancing multiple internal priorities while delivering complex capital programs.
· High level of integrity and accountability in managing project budgets.
Leadership & Soft Skills
· Collaborative Leadership: Ability to lead through influence, build consensus, and foster alignment across departments.
· Strong Communicator: Skilled at engaging diverse internal audiences, from executives to staff groups.
· Change Leadership: Capable of guiding organizational change related to workplace transformation.
· Problem Solver: Analytical, pragmatic, and solutions-focused in managing challenges and decision points.
· Empathy & Inclusion: A people-centric leader who promotes a safe, inclusive, and high-performing workplace.
· Resilience & Adaptability: Maintains focus and calm under pressure, navigating ambiguity with professionalism.
Working Conditions
· Primarily Riyadh / Qiddiya City based with regular attendance at project sites, consultant offices, and workshops.
· May require travel within the GCC region and other international destinations (subject to project requirements).
Requires flexibility to engage cross-functional teams and consultants across various stages of planning and implementation, including consultants and stakeholders who may be based outside the region.

jobs.title: Sr. Director of Product Engineering
jobs.text:
The Sr. Director, Product Engineering is responsible for leading the architecture, development, delivery, maintenance, and support of EDETEK’s software platforms and products across eClinical, Clinical Informatics, and biometrics-related solutions. This role will lead product engineering organization and work closely with Product Management, QA, Validation, Cloud Operations, Security, Implementation, Biometrics, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, compliant, and high-quality software products for the life sciences industry.
The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth in Java, SAS, and R, proven success leading large software engineering teams, and substantial experience in life sciences companies that develop and support eClinical and Clinical Informatics software in cloud computing environment with leverage of AI, or other clinical technology and biometrics-focused companies. This leader should be able to operate both strategically and hands-on, guiding engineering direction while remaining close to architecture, design decisions, delivery execution, and product quality.
Essential Functions and Responsibilities
Lead and scale the product engineering organization responsible for EDETEK software products supporting eClinical, Clinical Informatics, data integration, review, analytics, and biometrics workflows.
Provide technical and organizational leadership to multiple engineering teams, including software developers, architects, engineering managers, and technical leads.
Define and execute engineering strategy, technical roadmap, delivery model, and resource plans aligned with company product goals and business priorities.
Oversee software architecture, system design, coding standards, release management, performance optimization, maintainability, and technical debt reduction.
Drive the design and development of enterprise-grade platforms and applications using modern software engineering practices and secure SDLC processes.
Serve as a senior technical leader with strong understanding of Java-based enterprise application development, SAS-based clinical and statistical programming environments, and R-based analytical and data science workflows.
Partner closely with Product Management, Biometrics, Clinical Data Management, Statistical Programming, Regulatory, and Operations teams to translate domain and client requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Support development of products and capabilities relevant to clinical trial technology, including areas such as EDC, data integration, clinical data review, SDTM, ADaM, TLF generation, analytics, reporting, and regulatory-supporting workflows.
Ensure software solutions are designed and maintained in accordance with relevant requirements for security, privacy, auditability, validation readiness, and quality in regulated environments.
Establish and track engineering KPIs, quality indicators, delivery metrics, and team performance measures to improve predictability and execution.
Build, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering teams. Develop managers and senior contributors and create a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Lead hiring, workforce planning, organizational development, and performance management for the engineering function.
Collaborate with QA and Validation teams to ensure appropriate documentation, testing discipline, traceability, and readiness for internal and external audits.
Partner with Cloud Engineering, DevOps, and Security teams to strengthen platform reliability, scalability, observability, disaster recovery, and operational support.
Guide investigation and resolution of critical technical issues, customer escalations, and production support challenges.
Drive engineering excellence in Agile execution, CI/CD, test automation, code review, documentation, and secure development practices.

jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
.
Freelance Associate Director, Marketing Effectiveness & Intelligence
Role Overview
We are seeking a Freelance Associate Director, Marketing Effectiveness & Intelligence to lead marketing performance management and measurement for the a major Auto client business. This person will be a key client-facing partner, helping both the client and the integrated agency team understand how marketing campaigns and efforts are performing, what is driving results, and where action is needed.
The role requires someone who can connect brand, media, digital engagement, campaign, and business performance into a coherent story and translate complex information into clear recommendations for clients and senior stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as a day-to-day client partner on marketing effectiveness, measurement, and performance.
Synthesize results across campaigns and channels into a clear view of overall marketing performance and business implications.
Identify emerging trends, performance opportunities, and areas requiring deeper investigation.
Translate analysis into concise, executive-ready narratives and recommendations.
Connect media and campaign metrics with brand performance, consideration, digital engagement, sales, and market-share indicators.
Use and interpret key measurement platforms and data sources including Dynata, YouGov, MarketCast, and BERA.
Partner across VML, WPP Media, and other integrated agency teams to create a holistic view of performance.
Guide analysts and channel teams in moving from reporting metrics to identifying insights and actions.
Ensure measurement frameworks, KPIs, and reporting are consistent and aligned to client objectives.
Qualifications
6–10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, effectiveness, measurement, or related disciplines.
Strong client leadership, communication, and presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to connect marketing activity to brand and business performance.
Experience synthesizing data across media, campaign, brand, digital, and business sources.
Ability to turn complex analysis into a clear “so what” and “now what.”
Strong cross-functional leadership across analytics, media, strategy, account, and client teams.
Automotive or similarly complex consumer marketing experience is a plus.
The core profile we are looking for is a trusted marketing performance partner to the client, rather than someone focused primarily on producing analytics deliverables.
The compensation for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package. jobs.title: Senior Director, System Software
jobs.text:
About the job
Lead the system software organisation that turns complex hardware platforms into reliable Graphcore systems. As Director of System Software, you will report to the VP of Software and turn software strategy into clear priorities, plans and outcomes. You will lead the teams delivering firmware, drivers, OpenBMC and system software QA. Your work will shape platform bring-up, production release and long-term support across Graphcore systems. You will align technical decisions with business priorities, delivery milestones and product readiness. You will build a strong engineering organisation, developing managers, technical leaders and engineers. You will own execution, quality and cross-functional delivery across hardware, silicon, software and product teams.
This is a role for a leader who can think big, act fast and take responsibility for complex system outcomes.
The team and culture
System Software works close to the hardware, where small decisions can shape product reliability at scale. The team operates through clear ownership, evidence-based planning and direct technical debate. You will lead managers and specialists across firmware, drivers, OpenBMC and QA. Decisions are made through engineering judgement, clear trade-offs and a strong focus on delivery impact. You will be expected to speak up, challenge assumptions and help resolve issues across hardware and software boundaries. Pace matters, but so do maintainability, security and long term quality.
What we’re looking for
· A strong track record leading system software teams across closely coupled hardware and software programmes.
· Experience managing managers or multiple technical teams, with clear ownership of delivery outcomes.
· Proven ability to build, coach and develop engineering leaders through change and technical uncertainty.
· Strong judgement across planning, resourcing, dependencies, risk and production release readiness.
· Experience embedding validation, automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing and clear release criteria.
· Credible technical breadth across firmware, drivers, OpenBMC, QA or related low-level software domains.
While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.
Benefits
· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn
We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
Join the Team at Graphcore
Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.
If you want to lead the system software organisation behind Graphcore’s next generation platforms, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.
Sponsorship
Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.text:
Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator.
Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do.
Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance.
We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions.
Job responsibilities
Website product strategy
Set the product vision, principles and roadmap for Thoughtworks.com
Prioritize work around customer and business outcomes rather than requests for individual pages
Connect the website roadmap to Thoughtworks’ go-to-market priorities, propositions and major company launches.
Customer journeys and experience
Build a deep understanding of our audiences, including enterprise buyers, technology leaders, practitioners, partners, prospective employees and alumni community
Design connected journeys that help people move from a question/problem/need to relevant services, expertise, evidence and action, where the site fuels journeys on AI platforms that might never have users interact with our site
Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities
Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey.
Narrative, copy and content quality
Own the quality and coherence of the website narrative, copy and information architecture
Translate complex technology services and Thoughtworks expertise into clear, credible experiences for different audiences
Challenge unclear propositions, duplicated content, unsupported claims and pages that do not serve a defined customer need
Work with the central Content team, service-line marketers and subject-matter experts, while keeping accountability for how content works within the overall experience
Work with content operations to establish reusable content patterns, editorial standards and clear ownership for maintaining important content.
Experiences for people and agents
Ensure the website is useful and understandable to human visitors, search engines and AI assistants
Partner with the SEO and LLM Discoverability Lead to improve how Thoughtworks is found, interpreted and represented to support buyers in their decision making process
Shape requirements for structured content, metadata, evidence, content relationships and reusable information
Balance machine readability with strong human storytelling, accessibility and brand expression.
Publishing model for the AI era
Own the spec for redesigning the publishing workflow from brief through design, production, approval, release and ongoing improvement
Work with the GTM tech and Global IT teams to replace manual, error-prone production with reusable patterns, clearer decision rights and proportionate automation
Identify where AI can improve research, prototyping, content preparation, metadata, accessibility checks, quality assurance and content maintenance
Turn good judgment into practical standards, templates, playbooks and automated checks
Build a model that allows teams to move faster without lowering the quality bar or creating uncontrolled publishing.
Design quality and experimentation
Set the direction and quality bar for UX, UI, interaction design and the website design system
Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to improve journeys, messaging and conversion over time
Sign off on experience quality before major launches.
Team and agency leadership
Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, experience production, transformation and discoverability
Give people clear outcomes, decision rights, constructive feedback and room to do excellent work
Build an effective working model with the central Content team, GTM technology, Global IT and service-line marketers.
Job qualifications
Technical Skills
10 - 15 years experience leading digital products, customer experiences, service design or product design
A strong record of turning customer insight and business strategy into coherent end-to-end experiences
Excellent judgment across product, UX, content and design, with the ability to recognize and explain what good looks like
Strong writing and editorial instincts, including the confidence to simplify complex ideas and challenge unclear copy
Experience working with marketing, product, design, engineering and senior business stakeholders
Commercial understanding and the ability to connect digital experience decisions to go-to-market outcomes
Systems thinking, including experience creating reusable patterns, design systems, operating models or publishing frameworks
Practical understanding of search, structured content and how AI assistants discover and interpret information
Experience using AI tools to improve how work is researched, designed, produced or assured
The ability to operate in ambiguity, make difficult prioritization decisions and move from strategy to delivery
Evidence of leading and coaching people or multidisciplinary teams.
Professional Skills
You have a natural ability to establish and nurture relationships with senior leaders across the organization
You have excellent context-switching capabilities
You thrive in situations where you are given little to no direction and have the ability to lead, organize and deliver commitments on time and within budget
You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives. You don’t shy away from risks, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them
You’re empathetic and use this ability to build solid working relationships and resolve issues quickly and thoughtfully
Other things to know
Learning & Development
There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.
Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment
At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.
Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.
We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.
About Thoughtworks
Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.
Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.
We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.
This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.
How we're set up
Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.
We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.
What you'll own
Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.
The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.
Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.
A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.
Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.
Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.
Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.
How we expect leaders to operate
Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.
Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.
End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.
No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.
Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.
Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.
Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.
What you bring
4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.
A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.
Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.
Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.
Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.
Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.
Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.
Strong pluses
Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.
Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.
Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.
What this role is, and isn't
It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.
About Moss
Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.
Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.
We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:
Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.
Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.
Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.
Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.
Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.
Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.

Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.
How we expect leaders to operate
Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.
Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.
End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.
No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.
Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.
Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.

Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.
What you bring

4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.
A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.
Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.
Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.
Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.
Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.

Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.
Strong pluses
Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.
Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.
Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.
What this role is, and isn't

It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.
About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:
Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.
Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.
Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.
Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Director, Operational Excellence & Advanced Engineering (RE925)
jobs.text:
Director, Operational Excellence & Advanced Engineering
Maryland Heights, MO
Spartech offers a competitive salary, incentives, and benefit programs!
Spartech, LLC, headquartered in Maryland Heights, Missouri, has over a dozen locations throughout the United States. We have a broad customer base with extensive product offerings and technologies. Many of our materials are used in products you might see every day - for example if you start your morning with a single serve yogurt, the container you ate from may be made from one of Spartech’s products or the refrigerator where the yogurt was stored could have Spartech products in its interior features. More unique uses of our products can be seen in military or security applications, for example in fighter jet canopies or bullet resistant windows. From routine daily-life to life-saving applications—we make a difference. Our broad scope of products and services keep our environment interesting and challenging with a culture focused on success. If you want to make a difference in a fast-paced environment with a company large enough to offer you room to grow but not so large that you become “just a number”, Spartech might be the ideal company for you.
General Summary and Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
The Director of Operational Excellence and Advanced Engineering leads enterprise-wide manufacturing improvement and technical capability across Spartech. The role owns the strategies, standards, and deployment systems for Lean, continuous improvement, performance management, automation, process engineering, and asset reliability. Equally, the role is accountable for delivering step-change advanced engineering solutions that improve equipment uptime, process control, capital efficiency, and error-proofing beyond incremental Lean gains. Reporting to the COO, this leader partners with plant management to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and equipment effectiveness while developing a sustainable culture of operational discipline.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics, DashOS
jobs.text:
About the Team
DashOS is DoorDash’s platform for helping restaurants grow. It connects Marketplace, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, and marketing (including SevenRooms) so restaurants can recognize the same guest across every channel, personalize how they bring them back, and use AI to automate manual work, all alongside the systems they already use.
Our portfolio spans 0→1 bets, early-stage products, and rapidly scaling offerings, so our work sits at the intersection of product innovation, commercialization, and long-term platform strategy. The analytics and data science team helps define the right metrics, guide product and go-to-market investments, and turn new product ideas into durable outcomes for restaurants and for DoorDash.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Data Science to lead a broad and high-impact portfolio supporting DashOS. In this role, you will shape how we measure success, guide product and commercial strategy, and build the data foundations that help teams move quickly and make better decisions across products at different stages of maturity. Success in this role means building a high-performing team, raising the quality and speed of decision-making, and helping DoorDash identify and scale the highest-ROI opportunities across the portfolio. You will report into a Senior Director on our Merchant Analytics team in our Analytics organization.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead and grow a team of data science and analytics leaders and practitioners across a portfolio that spans 0→1 products, products still being shaped and commercialized, and businesses already scaling quickly.
Own the analytical direction for the portfolio, including experimentation, KPI design, forecasting, decision support, funnel analytics, and foundational measurement.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy & Operations, and Go-to-Market leaders to influence roadmap, commercialization, and investment decisions.
Build the operating system for decision-making by improving instrumentation, creating single sources of truth, and connecting short-term execution with long-term business outcomes.
Operate with broad scope and high autonomy in a startup-like environment while benefiting from the support and talent density of a scaled analytics organization.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 10+ years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or a related quantitative field, including significant experience leading senior teams and developing managers.
You have strong product and business analytics judgment, with a track record of defining metrics, building decision frameworks, and influencing strategy in ambiguous environments.
You have deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, and you are comfortable making decisions in settings with imperfect data, evolving products, and small or noisy samples.
You bring hands-on technical fluency in SQL and statistical analysis, and you can go deep enough to raise the technical bar for the team while operating effectively at a leadership level.
You have experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and business leaders, and can translate complex analysis into clear recommendations that drive action
Compensation
The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.
To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.
See below for paid time off details:
For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$255,000—$375,000 USD
About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

jobs.title: Interim Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Who are we?
StoryToys, an independent subsidiary of Team17 Group plc, is a premier, award-winning developer and publisher of interactive educational apps designed to help children learn, play, and grow. We collaborate with the world’s most recognizable entertainment giants—including The LEGO Group, The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Entertainment, Mattel, and BBC Studios—to bring beloved characters like Bluey, Peppa Pig, and Barbie into engaging digital worlds.
Our global success spans all major distribution networks, amassing over 300 million app downloads and reaching millions of active families worldwide in up to 28 different languages. While headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, our internal team of over 130 professionals operates alongside a vast, highly agile global network of creators.
About the role
StoryToys is looking for an interim Head of Engineering to lead the engineering department behind our portfolio of award-winning children's mobile games.
This role is responsible for the performance and growth of our engineering function, ensuring teams can consistently deliver high-quality and engaging mobile experiences for children and families around the world. This is a product-focused role requiring deep experience in Unity, building and maintaining mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a senior engineering leader with a passion for mobile app development and an interest in children's play to join our dynamic and growing team.

blocks.text: Who are we?

jobs.text:
About us
Food waste costs the world over $1 trillion a year. At Winnow, we're on a mission to change that — bringing AI-powered technology into hospitality kitchens to help eliminate waste at scale, with an ambition to save our clients $1 billion annually.
We started in London in 2013 with a simple belief: technology could make kitchens smarter and food systems more sustainable. Today that belief has grown into a global team spanning the UK, Romania, Dubai, Shanghai, Singapore, Malaysia, North America, and Mexico, working across 90+ countries and 3,500+ sites.
We're proud of the results we help our clients achieve. Names like IKEA, Hilton, Accor, Marriott, IHG, Compass Group, Iberostar, and Mandarin Oriental trust us to cut their food waste by over 50% on average — and when our technology is fully adopted, it reduces pre-consumer waste by 50–70% and delivers food cost savings of 2–8%.
We're building something that matters, and the people who thrive here feel that every day. We're proud to have been named one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work and ranked #4 in the FoodTech 500 (2025) — recognition of both our innovation and our commitment to building a purpose-led company where people can make a real difference.
Our values
Our values sit at the centre of all that we do. If they resonate with you, we'd love to hear from you and for you to help us on our mission.
People of action - done is better than perfect. We move fast, learn faster
Equal parts head and heart - we balance passion with pragmatism
Hungry and humble - we're ambitious about our mission, not our egos
Bravely honest - we say what we think, respectfully, with colleagues and customers alike
Bound by food - it's what unites us, and it's what we're fighting for
People and planet positive - we're leaving both better than we found them

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
About Us:
Pacvue is the leading Commerce Operating System, unifying retail media, commerce management, and advanced measurement across 100+ global marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Instacart. Through Pacvue and Helium 10, our enterprise and SMB platforms, we empower over 70,000 brands, agencies, and sellers with AI-driven insights and technology to win in today’s rapidly evolving commerce landscape.
At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.
About the role:
We are seeking a Director of Product Management to drive execution across Helium 10’s product portfolio and to lead the product managers who deliver it. This role runs the discovery and delivery of our innovation agenda beyond the Amazon marketplace seller — into direct-to-consumer and multi-channel commerce, Walmart and TikTok, and AI-native experiences. This director will be responsible for turning agreed priorities into a sequenced, resourced roadmap and for making sure the team ships it on time and at quality.
Innovation is central to this role, and it is hands-on work. The Director of Product Management will run our new-product pipeline: validating, building, and launching the bets that open new revenue lines and new audiences. That means running structured discovery with sellers and brands, prototyping and testing quickly, defining what success looks like before we build, and retiring ideas that don’t earn their place. This leader will bring rigor to how we evaluate emerging opportunities — AI agents, autonomous workflows, and adjacent channels — and work with go-to-market teams to land them with customers.
Innovation into direct-to-consumer expansion is a core focus. As brands diversify across Shopify and their own storefronts, Google, and social commerce, our portfolio has to follow them. This director will lead the discovery, requirements, and delivery of the features that serve a DTC-first brand, and partner closely with product marketing, growth marketing, and sales to bring those products to market.
This is a hands-on, execution-first role. Sets strategy and direction for the function while also driving execution hands-on. You will run weekly operating cadences, review specs and requirements, unblock your team daily, and stay close enough to the detail to catch problems before they reach a release. The role is based in the United States and requires regular, direct contact with customers: discovery interviews, advisory sessions, and time in the field with brands and agencies. Deep familiarity with marketplace e-commerce, direct-to-consumer e-commerce, and SaaS product-led growth environments is strongly preferred.
This role reports to the VP of Product Strategy & Ops and manages the product management function globally, leading both the U.S. product management team and the China-based product management team. lteads the global product management function through a mixed structure — managing the U.S. product managers directly, and leading the China product management team through its manager. Sets direction and shared standards for both; delegates day-to-day execution oversight in China to that manager, while staying closely involved in the U.S. team's execution.Comfort leading and developing a team across time zones and cultures is essential.
Responsibilities:
Roadmap Development: Translate agreed priorities into a sequenced, multi-quarter roadmap and drive it to delivery. Run the planning process end to end, make explicit trade-offs between core platform work and new-growth bets, and keep commitments and dates honest.Priorities are revisited annually, but the trade-offs made here shape the business for years beyond the current planning cycle.
Innovation Delivery: Run the pipeline of net-new product opportunities — from problem identification through validation, prototype, pilot, and launch. Apply a repeatable framework for evaluating bets (market size, customer evidence, technical feasibility, time to value) and the discipline to kill the ones that don’t clear the bar.
Direct-to-Consumer & Multi-Channel Expansion: Deliver the products that take Helium 10 beyond the Amazon seller — Shopify and owned storefronts, Google, Walmart, and social commerce. Review the requirements, feature priorities, and release sequencing for the DTC and omnichannel brand.
AI-Native Product Development: Identify where AI agents, generative creative, and LLM-driven workflows create real customer value rather than novelty, and build them into the roadmap with clear adoption and quality measures.
Customer Discovery: Personally lead and scale customer discovery with sellers, brands, and agencies. Build the cadence, instrumentation, and synthesis practices that keep the team’s decisions grounded in evidence instead of opinion.
Market & Competitive Intelligence: Stay ahead of market developments, platform changes, and the competitive landscape across marketplace and DTC tooling. Translate that intelligence into product decisions and executive-level point of view.
Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with engineering, design, data, and QA — organizations this role influences rather than owns — to ensure roadmap commitments ship on time and at quality. Create clarity on ownership and decision rights so work moves quickly without escalation.
Commercialization Partnership: Work with product marketing, growth, and sales on positioning, pricing, packaging, and launch readiness. Ensure every release has a defined target persona, a clear value proposition, and a plan for adoption.
Business Impact: Define success metrics for every initiative and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not outputs. Use analytics tools such as Amplitude, Tableau, and SQL to measure adoption, retention, and revenue impact, and communicate results, learnings, and recommendations to executive stakeholders.
Hands-On Team Leadership: Manage the day-to-day work of the product management team across the U.S. and China — running standups and reviews, setting weekly priorities, reviewing specs and PRDs, and stepping in directly when a project is at risk.
Team Development: Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing product management team across the U.S. and China, setting clear expectations, priorities, and career development paths. Establish common standards for discovery, documentation, and prioritization so both teams operate as one function. Foster a culture of customer obsession, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Skills & Qualifications:
12+ years in product management, including 5+ years of senior leadership experience, with experience managing both individual contributors and managers across a global function10+ years in product management, including at least 3 years directly managing product managers in a SaaS, e-commerce, or data platform company.
Demonstrated 0-to-1 experience: you have launched net-new products or business lines that opened a new audience or revenue stream.
Proven track record of delivering a multi-team roadmap on time and at quality, across more than a single feature area.
Deep knowledge of the e-commerce landscape across both marketplace (Amazon, Walmart, TikTok) and direct-to-consumer (Shopify, owned storefronts) models,with the judgment to shape where the company competes next.
Working fluency with AI- and ML-enabled products — agents, generative creative, LLM-driven workflows — and the judgment to tell durable value from hype.
Strong customer discovery craft: comfortable running interviews and focus groups directly, synthesizing qualitative signal, and defending decisions with evidence.
Experience directly managing distributed product teams, and influencing engineering and design organizations outside your reporting line.
Analytical rigor with tools such as Amplitude, Tableau, or SQL, and proficiency in agile product development methodologies.
Exceptional operational execution and attention to detail, with the communication skills to influence senior stakeholders.
Benefits:
Flexible Paid Time Off
Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays
Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance
401k with Employer Match
Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization
Paid Parental Leave
Company-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton
Fertility and family-building support through Carrot
The annual base salary range for this position is $190,000-220,000 USD. The actual salary will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data for their location. This position is also eligible for an additional annual bonus compensation through one of Pacvue’s highly attractive incentive plans, full details will be provided during the recruitment process.
Helium 10 is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: [US DC] Associate Director, Production Technology
jobs.text:
Associate Director, Production Technology
The head of Fulfillment Technology & Support is responsible for the strategic direction, operational performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of the technology ecosystem supporting HelloFresh’s North American fulfillment network. This role bridges operations, engineering, IT, automation, and digital transformation to ensure fulfillment systems enable safe, reliable, efficient, and scalable operations.
The leader oversees the performance and integration of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Warehouse Execution Systems (WES), Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), material handling equipment, robotics, and supporting supply chain technologies. The position ensures that technology investments translate into measurable improvements in throughput, productivity, order accuracy, service levels, labor efficiency, and cost to serve.
Working in close partnership with Operations, Engineering, Product, IT, and external technology providers, the Head of Fulfillment Technology & Support establishes a proactive support model, drives technology standardization, and develops a scalable roadmap that supports HelloFresh’s continued growth, operational resilience, and customer experience objectives.
This role will require up to 50% travel
Key Responsibilities:
You Will…
Develop and execute a multi-year fulfillment technology strategy that supports HelloFresh’s North American supply chain, growth objectives, and operational excellence.
Establish an integrated technology roadmap spanning WMS, WES, WCS, robotics, automation, controls, system integrations, and operational support capabilities.
Optimize end-to-end fulfillment execution by improving coordination between enterprise applications, warehouse systems, automation platforms, and material handling equipment.
Partner with Operations, Automation, Engineering, and IT to deploy and optimize scalable automation solutions that improve throughput, flexibility, labor efficiency, and asset utilization.
Establish a standardized, proactive technology support model focused on system availability, predictive monitoring, rapid incident resolution, and long-term reliability.
Drive measurable operational improvements through performance analytics, root-cause elimination, process optimization, and technology-enabled continuous improvement.
Lead technology delivery for new fulfillment center launches, system implementations, automation deployments, and network transformation programs, ensuring technical readiness and operational adoption.
Build and develop a high-performing fulfillment technology organization while strengthening cross-functional partnerships, standardizing best practices, and delivering reliable, scalable solutions that protect customer commitments, product freshness, inventory traceability, and on-time fulfillment.
You Are…
A strategic technology leader with deep expertise in fulfillment technology, warehouse systems, automation, robotics, and supply chain execution.
A visionary who develops and executes multi-year technology strategies aligned with business growth, operational excellence, and network scalability.
An experienced leader who understands the interconnected roles of WMS, WES, WCS, enterprise applications, automation controls, and material handling systems.
A business-minded technology partner who translates complex technical challenges into measurable operational improvements and financial returns.
A champion of standardization, scalable architecture, and reusable technology solutions across multi-site fulfillment networks.
A collaborative leader who builds strong partnerships across Operations, IT, Automation and Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Finance, and external vendors.
A continuous improvement advocate focused on system reliability, labor productivity, throughput, order accuracy, and fulfillment cost.
A people-focused leader who fosters accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and a culture of continuous learning.
You Have…
A proven ability to develop technology roadmaps and prioritize investments based on business value, operational requirements, risk, and return on investment.
Extensive knowledge of warehouse management, execution, and control systems, including integrations with ERP, order management, inventory, transportation, and reporting platforms.
Experience integrating automation technologies, robotics, conveyor systems, sortation, automated storage and retrieval systems, and intelligent orchestration platforms.
A strong understanding of system architecture, integration standards, configuration management, testing, deployment, cybersecurity, and technology lifecycle management.
Experience establishing scalable technology support models, service-level agreements, incident management processes, escalation protocols, and root-cause analysis practices.
A track record of leading complex technology implementations, fulfillment center launches, facility expansions, automation upgrades, and network transformation initiatives.
The ability to translate system performance into measurable business outcomes through KPIs, dashboards, operational reviews, and continuous improvement programs.
Experience developing high-performing technical teams, managing vendor relationships, and leading cross-functional initiatives in complex, high-volume operational environments.
You’ll get…
Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities
Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)
Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.
Newark, NJ Pay Range
$196,560—$259,200 USD
Illinois Pay Range
$183,661—$242,190 USD

jobs.title: Engineering Director - Platform
jobs.text:
We are looking for an Engineering Director to own the technology platform behind the GoMining ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep engineering expertise with strong product and business thinking.
You will own the Platform end-to-end — technology strategy, architecture, engineering organization, roadmap, reliability, delivery, and its impact on the wider business.
The Platform powers multiple GoMining products and includes core application infrastructure, authentication and authorization, integrations, shared services, analytics infrastructure, user restrictions, native applications, reliability, and other foundational capabilities.
This is not a role where success is measured simply by uptime, delivery, or engineering output.
We expect the Engineering Director to understand where technology creates or limits business value, make trade-offs between long-term architecture and immediate commercial priorities, and build a platform that allows the entire company to move faster.
Responsibilities
Platform Strategy & Architecture
Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GoMining Platform.
Build scalable shared infrastructure used across multiple products and engineering teams.
Define which capabilities should be centralized at Platform level and which should remain within individual product teams.
Drive major architectural and technical decisions.
Identify scalability and architectural bottlenecks before they become business-critical.
Balance long-term platform investments with immediate product and commercial priorities.
Reliability & Engineering Excellence
Own platform reliability, availability, latency, scalability, and operational performance.
Define and improve SLAs, DORA metrics, engineering performance, and incident-management practices.
Improve release stability, engineering velocity, and system resilience.
Lead post-incident improvements and eliminate systemic reliability issues.
Maintain a high engineering bar without unnecessary bureaucracy.
Core Platform Capabilities
Own shared authentication, authorization, registration, and 2FA infrastructure.
Develop common account controls, user restrictions, and security mechanisms.
Own integrations and shared backend capabilities required across GoMining products.
Develop shared analytics and event infrastructure.
Support common infrastructure across web and native applications.
Partner with Product, Design, Security, and engineering teams on cross-company capabilities.
Product & Business Impact
Platform at GoMining is not an isolated infrastructure function.
You will work directly with product leaders, General Managers, and C-level stakeholders to understand where technology can unlock growth and where platform limitations are holding the business back.
Prioritize engineering initiatives based on technical risk and business impact.
Understand how platform decisions affect revenue, conversion, customer experience, and product velocity.
Identify technical changes that can unlock meaningful business results.
Balance competing priorities across multiple product teams.
Make clear trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security, and business value.
Measure Platform not only through technical metrics, but through how effectively it accelerates the company.
Engineering Leadership
Lead and develop the Platform engineering organization.
Own team structure, hiring, performance, priorities, and execution.
Build a culture of strong engineering ownership and accountability.
Stay close enough to architecture and technology to challenge decisions and make informed trade-offs.
Develop strong technical leaders within the team.
Raise the technical and execution bar across the organization.
AI-First Engineering
Actively use AI tools and agents in your own work.
Introduce AI-assisted workflows across engineering, specifications, QA, analytics, and operations.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work.
Use AI to increase engineering velocity and quality.
Build a team where AI becomes part of the engineering operating model.
