jobs.title: Director Data Strategy (Mensch)
jobs.text:
About WPP Media
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.
Das bieten wir dir:
Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.
Das bewegst du:
Als Director Data Strategy Consulting (Mensch) bist du das strategische Rückgrat, das Gesicht und das unternehmerische Bindeglied unserer Data-Strategy-Unit. Du verantwortest die End-to-End-Datenstrategie für unsere Fokus-Kunden – von der strategischen Gestaltung über die Steuerung von Technologie-Roadmaps bis zur kommerziellen Weiterentwicklung – und leitest, inspirierst und entwickelst dabei ein hochqualifiziertes Team von Data Strategists.
Teamführung: Du leitest, inspirierst und entwickelst ein hochqualifiziertes Team von Data Strategists und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem dein Team über sich hinauswachsen kann.
Strategische Datenanwendung & Kundenentwicklung: Du verantwortest die End-to-End-Datenstrategie für unsere Fokus-Kunden und agierst als strategisches Rückgrat unserer Data-Strategy-Unit. Durch die Priorisierung von First-Party-Data-Kollaborationen, Private Data Networks und KI-gestützter Planung entwickelst du audience-first-Strategien über 1PD-, 2PD- und 3PD-Daten hinweg und übersetzt Datenpotenziale in messbare Business-Erfolge – von Wachstum über Effizienz bis hin zu Effektivität.
Daten- & Technologie-Roadmap: Du gestaltest den Einsatz moderner Werbetechnologien wie Data Clean Rooms, CDPs und DSPs und verbindest Kunden-Roadmaps mit Innovationen in den Bereichen KI, Audience-Produkte und Measurement. Dabei triffst du strategische Entscheidungen zu Datenpartnerschaften und Aktivierungspfaden, bindest globale Lösungen wie WPP Open, Open Media Studio, Open Intelligence und InfoSum ein und bringst Marktanforderungen in globale Produkt-Roadmaps ein.
Kunden- & Stakeholder-Management: Als strategische:r Berater:in begleitest du Marketing-, Media-, Daten- und Commerce-Verantwortliche auf Entscheider-Ebene. Geschäftsziele übersetzt du in datengetriebene Strategien und Umsetzungspläne und verknüpfst Datenstrategie mit Media-Ergebnissen und messbarem Business Impact.
Enablement & Kompetenzaufbau: Du entwickelst marktreife Playbooks und etablierst Standards für Audience-Strategien, Governance und Entscheidungsprozesse. In Strategie-Workshops stärkst du datenstrategische Kompetenzen sowie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden- und Agenturteams.
Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du verantwortest das Kunden-Outcome-Portfolio und steuerst gemeinsam mit Client Analytics & Data Science, Data & Technology Consulting und Product Enablement die erfolgreiche Umsetzung datenstrategischer Lösungen. Dabei überführst du Erkenntnisse in konkrete Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen.
Unternehmertum: Du steuerst das Neugeschäft im Bereich Data Strategy, sicherst die Wirtschaftlichkeit deines Verantwortungsbereichs und entwickelst belastbare Business Cases. Auf Basis nachgewiesener Ergebnisse identifizierst du Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und treibst nachhaltiges Wachstum voran.
Thought Leadership: Du positionierst WPP Media als Vordenker für moderne Datenstrategie und machst den Business Impact datengetriebener Lösungen durch Executive Briefings, Case Studies und POVs sichtbar.
Führungskultur: Als Vorbild für Inclusive Leadership förderst du Diversität, Eigenverantwortung und eine Kultur der Wertschätzung, Zusammenarbeit und des gemeinsamen Erfolgs.
Das zeichnet dich aus:
Führungserfahrung: Nachweisbare, mehrjährige Erfahrung (mind. 2–3 Jahre) in der disziplinarischen und fachlichen Führung sowie in der Entwicklung von Teams.
Branchenexpertise: Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im datengetriebenen Marketing, der Media-, Beratungs- oder AdTech/MarTech-Branche, mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Datenstrategien.
Fachkompetenz: Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Dateninfrastrukturen, Data Clean Rooms (z. B. InfoSum), CDPs, DSPs, Tagging, Analytics sowie von KI/ML-Konzepten im Marketing – mit der Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu definieren und mit Fachspezialist:innen in die Umsetzung zu bringen.
Datenkompetenz: Sichere praktische Anwendung von 1PD/2PD/3PD-Daten sowie Kunden-, Business- und Marketingdaten in der Datenkollaboration und -aktivierung.
Methodenwissen: Fundiertes Wissen in den Bereichen Measurement, Incrementality-Frameworks sowie im agilen Projekt- und Change-Management; Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrgleisiger Programme mit klaren Routinen und Dokumentation.
Unternehmerisches Denken: Eine klare Vision für deinen Einflussbereich, ein ausgeprägter Gestaltungswille und ein exzellentes Standing bei Kunden und Kollegen.
Netzwerkkompetenz: Als kollaborativer Matrix-Networker suchst du aktiv den Austausch über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg und zeichnest dich durch hohe Problemlösungskompetenz aus.
Kommunikationsstärke: Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären und Vertrauen bei Kunden- und Agentur-Counterparts aufzubauen.
Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) erforderlich, ein weiterführender Abschluss ist von Vorteil.
Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamfähig #lösungsorientiert #kommunikativ
Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.
Arbeiten bei WPP Media:
Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering - Civil Government and Commercial
jobs.text:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.
Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.
Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.
As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.
We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.
About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to become our Senior Director of Engineering for Civil Government and Commercial. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. You will oversee the development, scaling, and delivery of our critical existing solutions, including Area Monitoring Service (AMS) for EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) compliance, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and a portfolio of Derived Data Products. You will also drive our "zero to one" product discovery, partnering closely with Product Management, Design, and Science teams to incubate, architect, and launch new, emerging solutions built on top of Planet’s high-frequency imagery and derived data products. AI is central to how Planet builds solutions, and you will make it a primary way your teams discover, build, and deliver for customers. This position is vital to delivering innovative applications to civil governments and commercial customers worldwide.
This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.
Impact You’ll Own:
Lead, mentor, and scale a global engineering organization of 70+ engineers, managers, and directors across multiple geographies and time zones.
Set a high bar for performance and accountability. Define measurable outcomes for every product and team, surface risks early and directly, and make the hard calls on people and priorities when results fall short.
Drive the day-to-day engineering execution and delivery for existing flagship products, ensuring reliability and performance for AMS, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, and the derived data portfolio.
Champion and lead "zero to one" engineering discovery, building the technical foundation and prototypes for new emerging commercial and civil government products.
Partner on a daily basis with Product Management, Design, and GTM teams to define product direction, prioritize feature development, and align technical strategy with business goals.
Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and secure for government and enterprise use, guiding architectural decisions and engineering best practices.
Align your team's daily output with Planet’s mission of using space to help life on earth, directly enabling governments and businesses to make critical, timely decisions.
What You Bring:
10+ years of relevant software engineering work experience, including 8+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing multiple layers of engineering management.
Experience leading and scaling distributed engineering teams of 50+ employees across multiple geographic locations and time zones.
Hands-on engagement with AI tools in your own work, and experience leading engineering teams through AI adoption.
Track record of "zero to one" product development, including the technical discovery, architecture, and successful launch of new software solutions.

blocks.text: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.
Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.
As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.
About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to become our Senior Director of Engineering for Civil Government and Commercial. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. You will oversee the development, scaling, and delivery of our critical existing solutions, including Area Monitoring Service (AMS) for EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) compliance, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and a portfolio of Derived Data Products. You will also drive our "zero to one" product discovery, partnering closely with Product Management, Design, and Science teams to incubate, architect, and launch new, emerging solutions built on top of Planet’s high-frequency imagery and derived data products. AI is central to how Planet builds solutions, and you will make it a primary way your teams discover, build, and deliver for customers. This position is vital to delivering innovative applications to civil governments and commercial customers worldwide.
This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.
Impact You’ll Own:

items: Lead, mentor, and scale a global engineering organization of 70+ engineers, managers, and directors across multiple geographies and time zones.

Set a high bar for performance and accountability. Define measurable outcomes for every product and team, surface risks early and directly, and make the hard calls on people and priorities when results fall short.
Drive the day-to-day engineering execution and delivery for existing flagship products, ensuring reliability and performance for AMS, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, and the derived data portfolio.
Champion and lead "zero to one" engineering discovery, building the technical foundation and prototypes for new emerging commercial and civil government products.
Partner on a daily basis with Product Management, Design, and GTM teams to define product direction, prioritize feature development, and align technical strategy with business goals.
Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and secure for government and enterprise use, guiding architectural decisions and engineering best practices.
Align your team's daily output with Planet’s mission of using space to help life on earth, directly enabling governments and businesses to make critical, timely decisions.

jobs.title: Director, Product-Led Growth
jobs.text:
About Upsun
Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It’s built for hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and people focus on the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale with confidence, without wrestling with backend infrastructure.
Upsun Dispatch, our newest offering, brings that same idea to the whole team. It’s the platform for governed collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional humans. Agents handle the volume in isolated sandboxes. People make the decisions that matter, with every approval and every cost on the record.
We give you your time back. You get:
Predictable performance, even at scale
Secure, compliant environments by default
Real-time observability and profiling built in
Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack
The name says it all. “Up” stands for uptime, reliability, and acceleration. “Sun” reflects our follow-the-sun support: a 24x7, globally distributed team keeping the lights on while you rest. We believe software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.
Upsunners are a remote, global team, and we thrive in a multicultural one. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment, and our people span the whole experience spectrum. What ties us together is curiosity, a thirst for knowledge, and an eagerness for new ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together when the environment frees you to do your best work.
Our values:
🌿 We make a positive impact.
✨ We aim for the stars.
💚 We care for each other.
Impact of a Director, Product-Led Growth
As Director, PLG, you’ll lead the strategy, execution, and commercial success of Upsun’s product-led revenue engine. Upsun is expanding its portfolio with Upsun Dispatch, a strategic new offer that joins Upsun Cloud, and this role will turn that expansion into measurable growth.
Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the revenue target for product-led experiences, building a scalable engine across developer recruitment, freemium conversion, and customer retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering, you will bridge technical platform capabilities with market-driven execution to scale Upsun’s global footprint.
What to expect
Own product-led revenue: Be accountable for ARR from self-serve experiences, from first signup through conversion, expansion, and retention.
Drive growth goals: Build and execute PLG programs to achieve clear top-line ARR milestones and hit aggressive user acquisition targets with specific focus in Europe and North America.
Connect growth and product: Partner closely with the Head of Growth (Marketing), Head of User Acquisition and Conversion (Marketing) and Upsun Dispatch Product Managers (Product/Engineering) to translate product strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes.
Optimize the funnel: Define in-product monetization levers, optimize self-service funnels, and partner with Sales to refine Product-Led Sales (PLS) handoffs for enterprise accounts.
Build tight feedback loops: Analyze intent data, user behavior, and churn metrics to continuously iterate on user onboarding, NPS, and lifetime value.
What you bring
PLG and growth leadership: A track record as a Senior Product Manager or Director with growth and commercial revenue responsibilities at a developer-focused, SaaS, or cloud platform company driven primarily by a PLG model.
Strategic judgment: Ability to turn complex developer platform capabilities into intuitive self-service user experiences that drive clear, measurable business value.
Cross-functional execution: A record of leading cross-functional growth initiatives across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering.
Data-driven approach: Hands-on depth in growth analytics, conversion funnels, freemium-to-paid activation, and retention.
Developer and AI fluency: Practical understanding of modern developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and how AI-assisted development tools are reshaping user expectations.
Bonus points
Dual-funnel experience: Running both self-serve funnels (PLG) and enterprise sales handoffs (PLS).
Platform background: Cloud infrastructure, PaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms.
Global scale: Scaling product-led revenue across remote-first, international teams.
Where we hire
At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.
How we hire
We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.
You can expect 5 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.
45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition
60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Chief Marketing Officer)
60 Minutes with Team (IC)
60 Minutes with Team (Head of Growth)
45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)
All roles require background checks.
What we offer
💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.
🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.
🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.
🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives
🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you
🏝 Flexible PTO
🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)
📈 Company stock options
🧠 Professional development budget
💻 Office equipment budget
💆‍♀️ Wellness budget
🧳 Annual team gatherings
👶 Inclusive parental leave
✈️ Remote work travel program
You belong here
At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

jobs.text:
Harlem Children’s Zone (HCZ) — a world-renowned education and poverty-fighting organization based in New York — seeks an enthusiastic, dedicated, and mission-aligned Data Aide to support our programming for our high school students.
The Assistant Director of Data within the College Success Office will bring a passion for the mission of Harlem Children’s Zone: to break the cycle of intergenerational poverty through comprehensive, on-the-ground programming that creates opportunities for children and families to thrive in school, work, and life.
We are currently seeking an Assistant Director of Data to oversee program and participant data, ensuring source accuracy and fidelity, organization, analysis, and reporting, and data governance compliance with HCZ operating guidelines. The Assistant Director will report to the Director of the College Success Office and manage program Data Managers and, as needed, data aides. This role will work in close partnership with the Evaluation department. The ideal candidate will have exceptional data management, team management, and analytical skills, and will be professional, creative, and energetic to work in a community-based organization.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

We are looking for a high-impact Vice President of Engineering / Senior Engineering Director to lead strategic engineering initiatives across OKX’s core products. You will guide engineering leaders and teams working across multiple disciplines, helping them deliver secure, reliable, and scalable experiences for users worldwide.
This role will set technical direction, strengthen collaboration across engineering and product functions, and improve how teams plan, build, and operate critical systems. You will help ensure that architecture, execution, and operational priorities support the company’s product strategy and growth.
What You'll Be Doing
Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence
Engineering Alignment & Delivery: Improve coordination across engineering teams and functions, clarify ownership and decision-making, and help teams deliver product priorities with fewer bottlenecks.
Organizational Design & Scale: Continuously refine engineering workflows, team structures, and operating rhythms to support business growth, team autonomy, and cross-functional collaboration.
Talent & Leadership Development: Mentor, manage, and scale engineering managers and senior leaders; establish high standards for engineering craftsmanship, career growth, and technical accountability.
Technical Direction & Architecture
Technical Direction: Guide architecture and engineering decisions across complex product environments, ensuring teams balance scalability, security, performance, and user needs.
Engineering Standards & Reliability: Champion industry-leading engineering practices across software design, code health, automated testing, continuous deployment, and system observability.
System Resilience: Ensure systems maintain high availability, security posture, and resilience in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Product Partnership & Execution
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work hand-in-hand with Product Management, Design, Operations, and Security leaders to translate company strategy into clear, executable technical roadmaps.
Execution & Velocity: Establish clear milestones, identify and resolve execution risks, and implement metrics to maintain predictable, high-cadence product releases.
What We Look For In You
Executive Leadership Experience: 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading multi-tiered engineering teams (50+ engineers) at the Director or VP level within high-scale product companies.
Technical Breadth: A strong background leading engineering in large-scale product environments, with the ability to engage with diverse technical disciplines, assess architectural trade-offs, and guide experienced engineering leaders.
Delivery Track Record: Demonstrated success driving complex, multi-team engineering programs to launch in fast-evolving, high-growth tech environments.
Domain Adaptability: Experience in high-availability, low-latency, or mission-critical domains (such as FinTech, SaaS, payments, consumer tech, or Web3).
Communication & Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build consensus across business, product, and deeply technical teams.

Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.text:
About Docker
Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.
We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.
_______________________________________________________________________
The Role
We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead the team behind existing and new products in the Docker portfolio, spanning our GUIs and the CLI. You'll manage the designers and raise the quality of what they ship, and you'll stay close enough to the work to build and critique it yourself, from the first prototype to the details of spacing, states, and copy.
You'll work alongside our principal designers, our Director of UX Research, design engineers, engineering leaders, and product leaders to turn technically complex systems into experiences that feel clear to the person using them.
You will report to the SVP of Design. This role is remote, with working hours that overlap US and Europe time zones.
_______________________________________________________________________
What you will do
Lead and grow the product design team.
Set the craft bar expected at each level and hold it through critique and your own work.
Partner with engineering and product from the start of a project, so design and engineering ship together.
Give designers ownership of important problems, with the context and trust to make good calls.
Shape how the team works with AI tools: human judgment leads, and the tools speed up the work.
Work with design engineering and the design system team so the shared system helps teams move faster without limiting new ideas.
_______________________________________________________________________
About you
You lead people:
You have led a product design team of comparable size through change, and you have grown designers from mid-level through senior and staff.
You have partnered closely with design engineers and engineering leaders, and you can engage with the technical decisions that shape the experience.
You state a clear point of view to engineering and product leaders and stay open to challenge and better ideas.
You build:
You still make things. You can prototype, critique a flow at the level of spacing, states, motion, and copy, and show us work from the last year. We will ask to see it.
You use AI tools in your daily work and can show how you use them, including when you step in because the output isn't good enough.
You have designed technically complex products and can turn underlying systems into experiences that feel clear and intuitive.
Bonus if you
Have led design for AI-powered or agent products, including experiences beyond a graphical interface.
Have designed for both developer-led adoption and complex enterprise customers.
Can prototype in front-end code, such as React or TypeScript.
Visa sponsorship: Not available for this role.
_______________________________________________________________________
Compensation & Equity
All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.
United States: $206,500 – $295,000 base
______________________________________________________________________
Posting Information
Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.
AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.
Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.
______________________________________________________________________
Perks & Benefits
Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.
Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.
Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.
Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.
Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.
Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.
Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.
Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.
Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.
Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.
Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.
#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Director, Product
jobs.company: Accelerated Digital Media - an OuterBox company
jobs.text:
Description
The Director of Product owns the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer: the internal applications, automation, and AI that help our staff deliver marketing services, and the direct-to-market products such as LOOP Analytics and future offerings. This role defines how our products work together as one consolidated, scalable system, makes sure each one delivers clear value to the people it was built for, and turns the capability of our development team into products that set OuterBox apart. The Director leads the Product Managers, sets product priorities and standards in partnership with the Director of Technology, holds the team to effective execution, and reports on how well our products perform for the service organization and our clients.
Job Responsibilities:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
Set the Product Vision: Define and own the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer, internal and external. Describe how our systems, applications, and AI work in concert, and keep that vision current as our services, our clients, and the technology change.
Own the Product Portfolio & Architecture: Keep the portfolio consolidated and coherent. Decide what we build, combine, retire, or buy so every product has a clear purpose, a defined user, and a place in the larger system. Partner with the Director of Technology so product architecture and technical architecture scale together.
Build Products for Our Delivery Teams: Direct the applications that help our staff deliver marketing services faster, more consistently, and more intelligently. Make sure each tool is designed around the people who use it and proves its value in their daily work.
Lead Direct-to-Market Products: Own product strategy for client-facing offerings such as LOOP Analytics and the products that follow. Identify market opportunities that grow out of our internal capability, shape them into offerings, and hold products that carry OuterBox's external reputation to the highest standard.
Lead the Product Management Team: Lead, coach, and develop the Product Managers. Set the operating cadence and hold a consistent standard of product thinking, user empathy, and design quality.
Turn Development Talent into Great Products: Give the development team clear direction, well-defined problems, and build-ready requirements. Own the PRD and acceptance-criteria standards, guide development and testing timelines, and keep the roadmap focused on the work with the most impact.
Drive Effective Execution: Direct the intake, feedback, prioritization, pilot, and rollout programs the Product Managers run. Set the criteria that move a product from pilot to production, and make sure what ships is adopted.
Measure & Report Product Effectiveness: Define the KPIs for each product and report on how well our products perform for the service organization, our clients, and the business. Translate adoption, usage, delivery improvement, and displaced-software-spend data into clear business impact.
Evaluate Emerging Technology: Track developments in AI, automation, and product practice. Run structured trials and recommend adoption or rejection with a clear rationale.
Additional duties, as assigned.
Requirements
6+ years in product management or product leadership, with 2+ years leading product managers or product teams.
A track record of setting product vision and strategy across a portfolio of related products, consolidating overlapping tools into a coherent, scalable platform, and taking new products to market.
Experience shipping both internal tools and external, client-facing software products, including AI, automation, and data-driven applications built in partnership with a development team.
Data orientation: able to define product KPIs, direct dashboards, and translate usage and adoption data into business impact.
Working knowledge of how digital marketing agencies deliver services
Fluency in product process, including PRDs and acceptance criteria, prioritization, and pilot and rollout programs, with credible participation in architecture and build decisions alongside technology leadership.
Hands-on experience with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or equivalent).
Strong product design and user-experience judgment, grounded in user research, feedback programs, and adoption measurement (interviews, NPS, surveys).
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, AI-accelerated environment, with working familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) and cloud-native platforms (Google Cloud Platform).
Benefits
Empowering your journey through every stage of growth—so you can do your best work and live your best life.
Boxer Benefits
Exceptional teams deserve exceptional support. Our employee benefits package includes generous paid time off, healthcare coverage, retirement savings options, professional development opportunities, and additional perks designed to help you stay healthy, productive, and fulfilled both at work and at home.
Health Insurance
401(k) & Retirement Savings
Generous Paid Time Off
Flexible Scheduling
Remote-First Culture
Professional Development
Employee Referral Program
And more!
Salary Description: $140,000 - $160,000
Our Company Values
Great results don’t happen by chance. They come from talented people working together with shared expectations, mutual respect, and a commitment to doing what’s right.
At OuterBox, our values guide how we approach our work, support our teammates, and serve our clients. They influence the decisions we make every day and help create a culture where people can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow throughout their careers.
Growth At OuterBox
We believe growth is oxygen—for our clients, our company, and our people. That’s why we’re committed to helping every teammate reach their next stage of growth.
Every person joins OuterBox with different experiences, ambitions, and career goals. We believe great leaders meet people where they are, providing the support, resources, and opportunities needed to grow professionally, develop new skills, and build a rewarding career.
Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or grow into leadership, you’ll find a team invested in helping you get there.
Physical Demands
Primarily involves sitting at a desk and using a computer for extended periods of time.
Light physical activity is also required, such as carrying equipment or setting up for presentations.
Requires a high level of mental focus and the ability to work under pressure.
Good manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and the ability to use a computer for extended periods are required.
Utilizes required organization-provided tools, such as project management systems, artificial intelligence (AI) applications, reporting and analytics programs, and other business software, as directed by management in the regular course of business. Use of such tools ensures accuracy, accountability, and continuity across projects, supports collaboration among team members, and allows the organization to maintain visibility into work product and progress.
Work Authorization/Requirements
Must be located in the USA.
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.
Affirmative Action/EEO Statement
Our company is an equal-opportunity employer committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.
OuterBox may use AI-assisted tools to support the hiring process. Human review is involved in all employment decisions.

jobs.title: Director, Product and Privacy
jobs.text:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.
In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.
Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.
Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.
Podium builds AI products that help local businesses engage customers, convert leads, book appointments, and manage customer relationships across Healthcare, Automotive, and Home Services. We are looking for an experienced product and privacy lawyer at the Director level to help shape how we build and deploy AI across our core verticals. Reporting to the General Counsel, you will work directly with the teams building our products, own practical privacy and AI governance programs, and be a critical member of a small legal team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, significant ownership, and direct influence on product decisions.
What you will be doing:
Regularly meet with internal teams (e.g. Product, Engineering and AI teams) to understand strategies, roadmaps, and initiatives, and advise throughout the product lifecycle, from early design and development through launch, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
Provide legal advice and counsel on a variety of product compliance matters, including AI, privacy, data rights, intellectual property, and consumer protection, and structure, negotiate, and advise on transactions with AI providers, data partners, and integration partners, including product terms, data processing agreements, and business associate agreements.
Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, Security, and the rest of the Legal team to ensure our products and services comply with applicable regulations in existing markets and industries and also help guide our expansion, with particular focus on AI products in Healthcare, Automotive, and Home Services.
Provide legal and regulatory guidance on the design and modification of products, proactively identify associated risks and recommend mitigation strategies, review product user experiences to ensure legal compliance and proper disclosures, and help translate guidance into product requirements that the Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Legal teams can implement.
Advise legal and business/product organizations on privacy issues and practical privacy considerations, and own the development and implementation of scalable product, privacy, and AI review process, including impact assessments, launch criteria, playbooks, and escalation paths.
Identify applicable regulatory or legal privacy and AI risks associated with existing and new laws, conduct gap assessments, and advise on appropriate controls, risk mitigation options, and compliance strategies. Translate evolving requirements into prioritized product and operational changes.
Manage cross-functional privacy-related projects, including but not limited to data mapping, permitted data uses, retention and deletion, and tracking technologies.
Partner with Security on incident response and privacy aspects of compliance and diligence reviews.
Build and operationalize AI governance for customer-facing agents and internal AI use. Advise on data sourcing and rights for model fine tuning, evaluation, and improvement; third-party model terms; output ownership; and safeguards against inaccurate outputs.
Counsel on AI agents, including permissions, customer configurations, AI disclosures, human oversight and escalation, auditability, and the allocation of responsibility among Podium, model providers, integration partners, and customers.
Guide healthcare product development, including HIPAA privacy and security, BAA obligations, sensitive health data, and EMR integrations. Advise on access controls, and patient communications.
Advise on automotive and home services workflows, including, as applicable, Field Services Management or CRM and dealer management integrations, lead sourcing and re-engagement, appointment booking, service scheduling, and representations about pricing, financing, and services. Assess GLBA, FCRA, payments and other sector requirements where relevant to the feature and data involved.
Advise on voice, messaging, and marketing compliance, including TCPA, telemarketing and do-not-call rules, consent and opt-out design, call recording and transcription, and AI-generated voice. Review product claims and customer guidance so they accurately describe capabilities, limitations, and customer responsibilities.
Provide fintech and payments counseling on Podium Payments, including consumer disclosures, fraud and chargebacks, applicable financial services and payment network requirements. Partner with Product and Finance to allocate compliance responsibilities among Podium, customers, and financial partners.
What you should have:
J.D. with strong academic credentials and demonstrated record of success as a lawyer and member of local State Bar or eligible to register as Registered In-House Counsel.
8+ years of experience, including at least 5+ years of in-house experience, preferably at a high-growth technology company.
Experience counseling product teams on compliance with regulatory frameworks applicable to the U.S. and global telecommunications.
Experience counseling product teams on compliance with regulations in other industries and markets, such as Healthcare, Automotive, or Home Services, is also highly desirable.
Experience advising clients on risk mitigation across technology product platforms, particularly with respect to AI, payments and messaging/telecommunications technologies.
Required privacy certification, such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT.
Specific experience working with, and knowledge of, privacy laws applicable to businesses, such as CCPA, CPRA, GDPR, TCPA, as well as other U.S. state and federal privacy and data security and global data protection laws.
Capacity to think strategically to identify issues and develop long-term solutions.
Ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously and manage major projects to successful completion.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a strong customer-focused orientation.
Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and facilitation skills, as well as the ability to navigate within a corporate environment and work with a variety of stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools thoughtfully in legal work, verify their outputs, protect confidential information, and improve the speed and quality of legal counseling.
BENEFITS
Open and transparent culture
Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
Paid parental leave
Fertility benefits
Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends
Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits
401k Plan
Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel
A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered
Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees
Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Tide Credit Services
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM
Tide Credit Services (TCS) puts credit in SMEs’ hands when they need it. We build Tide’s on demand lending products—including Credit Flex, Instant Loan, and Credit Score Insights—so members get fast, flexible funding inside the account they already run their business from.
We are scaling our flagship products globally across the UK, Europe, and India. This is high-velocity, high-impact work: you’ll architect and drive a fully automated, lightning-fast lending engine designed to deliver capital on demand, securely and seamlessly. Partnering with a brilliant and growing cross-functional team of 28 across engineering, product, design, data, and operations, you'll build a robust, scalable platform powering the future of SME credit.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Head of Engineering for Tide Credit Services (TCS, transactional credit), you’ll own the technology behind how Tide lends to SMEs. That covers Credit Flex, Instant Loan and the platform underneath them.
It’s a senior, hands-on leadership role with real say over architecture, engineering strategy and delivery. You’ll lead Engineering Managers and senior engineers, and set the bar for technical excellence.
As Head of Engineering you will:
Set the architectural direction for Tide’s credit platform: scalable, resilient, compliant, and built to launch in new markets quickly.
Lead the design and delivery of lending products that are fast, reliable and safe for members to use.
Work with Product, Risk, Compliance and the business to turn the credit roadmap into shipped outcomes.
Own integrations with third-party providers, including credit data, payments and funding partners, and make them seamless.
Stay close to the code. Get involved in architecture, design and the hard engineering calls.
Champion engineering fundamentals (system design, security, quality) and AI-native ways of working.
Mentor engineers and Engineering Managers, building a culture of ownership and learning.
Shape Tide’s wider technical strategy as we scale Tide Credit Services globally.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a highly technical, strategic engineering leader. Background in the credit domain (lending, credit decisioning, loan servicing or repayments) is preferable, and wider fintech experience is also valued. Neither is a prerequisite if you bring strong engineering leadership, breadth of technical knowledge and the ability to get up to speed fast.
10+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
Deep experience designing and running microservices, event-driven and distributed systems that are scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant and loosely coupled.
Track record of embedding AI tooling and LLMs into how engineering teams build, review and ship, with measurable gains in velocity and quality.
Experience building in regulated environments, where compliance is a design constraint rather than an afterthought.
Experience launching and scaling products across multiple jurisdictions, with differing regulation, partners and customer needs.
Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one stack. Experience with ours isn’t essential, but the ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
Ability to translate business goals into a clear technical roadmap and explain the rationale behind technical decisions.
Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.
OUR TECH STACK
Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €91,600 to €114,500 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
Remote first
25 days of paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Private Health Insurance
Mental Health Support Platform
FitPass
Family and friendly leave (according to statutory)
Personal L&D budget
Share Options
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM
Tide Credit Services (TCS) puts credit in SMEs’ hands when they need it. We build Tide’s on demand lending products—including Credit Flex, Instant Loan, and Credit Score Insights—so members get fast, flexible funding inside the account they already run their business from.
We are scaling our flagship products globally across the UK, Europe, and India. This is high-velocity, high-impact work: you’ll architect and drive a fully automated, lightning-fast lending engine designed to deliver capital on demand, securely and seamlessly. Partnering with a brilliant and growing cross-functional team of 28 across engineering, product, design, data, and operations, you'll build a robust, scalable platform powering the future of SME credit.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Head of Engineering for Tide Credit Services (TCS, transactional credit), you’ll own the technology behind how Tide lends to SMEs. That covers Credit Flex, Instant Loan and the platform underneath them.
It’s a senior, hands-on leadership role with real say over architecture, engineering strategy and delivery. You’ll lead Engineering Managers and senior engineers, and set the bar for technical excellence.
As Head of Engineering you will:
Set the architectural direction for Tide’s credit platform: scalable, resilient, compliant, and built to launch in new markets quickly.
Lead the design and delivery of lending products that are fast, reliable and safe for members to use.
Work with Product, Risk, Compliance and the business to turn the credit roadmap into shipped outcomes.
Own integrations with third-party providers, including credit data, payments and funding partners, and make them seamless.
Stay close to the code. Get involved in architecture, design and the hard engineering calls.
Champion engineering fundamentals (system design, security, quality) and AI-native ways of working.
Mentor engineers and Engineering Managers, building a culture of ownership and learning.
Shape Tide’s wider technical strategy as we scale Tide Credit Services globally.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a highly technical, strategic engineering leader. Background in the credit domain (lending, credit decisioning, loan servicing or repayments) is preferable, and wider fintech experience is also valued. Neither is a prerequisite if you bring strong engineering leadership, breadth of technical knowledge and the ability to get up to speed fast.
10+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
Deep experience designing and running microservices, event-driven and distributed systems that are scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant and loosely coupled.
Track record of embedding AI tooling and LLMs into how engineering teams build, review and ship, with measurable gains in velocity and quality.
Experience building in regulated environments, where compliance is a design constraint rather than an afterthought.
Experience launching and scaling products across multiple jurisdictions, with differing regulation, partners and customer needs.
Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one stack. Experience with ours isn’t essential, but the ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
Ability to translate business goals into a clear technical roadmap and explain the rationale behind technical decisions.
Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.
OUR TECH STACK
Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €92,000 to €115,000 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
25 days paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
Additional health & dental insurance
Mental wellbeing platform
Fully covered Multisports card
Food vouchers
Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
WFH equipment allowance
Flexible working from home
Sabbatical Leave
Share options
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

jobs.title: Technology - Enterprise Architecture - Senior Vice President
jobs.text:
Performance & Technology | Technology - Enterprise Architecture | Senior Vice President | London
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
Our Technology Advisory team provides independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and enhancing business performance. We leverage extensive expertise to deliver rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Defining and planning target architectures and roadmaps aligned to business objectives and plans including Data, Application/Integration and Technical/ Infrastructure architecture
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Platform/systems/infrastructure assessments, re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management, interim leadership roles, and project turnaround.
Central to our expertise is the technology strategy, organisation, applications and infrastructure which underpins any successful end-to-end transformation. We are looking for someone who has experience in Enterprise Architecture and how to define and design target state solutions, transition strategies and roadmaps, capability needs and the associated risks. jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Director, Site Reliability Engineering
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Okta authenticates, authorizes and provisions millions of users a day. The service is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) across multiple availability zones and geographically separated regions. The service is designed for high throughput, and 99.999 availability. We're looking for a technical leader to help us to continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective and efficient infrastructure, processes and tooling.
As the Director of Site Reliability Engineering you will oversee the SRE organization focused on various emerging products like Workflows, PAM/ASA and Inbox.
Job Duties and Responsibilities:
Build and lead a high-caliber SRE organization supporting Okta’s production fleet.
Partner with global engineering, product, and infrastructure leaders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure services.
Define and execute the SRE strategy in alignment with global reliability goals.
Lead post-incident reviews, drive root-cause analysis, and ensure long-term corrective actions. Participate in incident management, on-call rotations, and blameless RCAs.
Implement automation and observability to reduce manual toil and improve operational efficiency. Drive adoption of modern infrastructure practices: infrastructure as code (Terraform), Kubernetes, and AI within the SRE org.
Hire, mentor, and develop top SRE talent; build a strong engineering culture centered on reliability and innovation.
Foster collaboration across global teams.
Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and process improvement.
Maintain a deep knowledge of industry best practices, evolving trends, and technologies.
Manage service and business expectations and prioritize resource allocation.
Accelerate the velocity of SRE and product engineering by developing robust platforms, powerful tooling, and intuitive self-service capabilities.
Improve SDLC processes for Cloud infrastructure as a code, including the maturity of CI/CD pipelines, change and release management.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
15+ years of experience in site reliability, infrastructure, or production engineering roles.
8+ years of experience in technical leadership & people management including managing managers. Strong expertise in automation, observability, performance optimization, and incident response.
Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-cultural collaboration skills—particularly in a global matrixed setup.
Experience building and scaling offshore SRE teams that partner with global counterparts.
4+ years of experience running the SRE org supporting a SaaS/Cloud service in a public Cloud, preferably AWS. Experience supporting a multi-Cloud environment will be a plus.
Strong expertise in cloud-native architectures, containerization (Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage large-scale programs
Effective verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills
Education and Training:
Computer Science Degree or related degree or equivalent experience
Additional requirements:
There is no citizenship requirement. The Okta employee must be on US Soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101
Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
Okta is rethinking the traditional work environment, providing our employees with the flexibility to be their most creative and successful versions of themselves, no matter where they are located. We enable a flexible approach to work, meaning for roles where it makes sense, you can work from the office, or from home, regardless of where you live. Okta invests in the best technologies and provides flexible benefits and collaborative work environments/experiences, empowering employees to work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs. jobs.title: Head of Customer Engineering (x/f/m)
jobs.text:
Vos missions
Au sein de Doctolib, le Customer Engineering est au cœur du cycle de vie client. En tant que Head of Customer Engineering, vous pilotez une organisation de 50 personnes répartie en quatre équipes couvrant l'implémentation technique, la migration des données, le support engineering et le succès technique.
Votre rôle est de définir la direction stratégique de la fonction, de faire grandir vos managers et d'accompagner l'organisation dans une période de transformation ambitieuse. Vous créez les conditions pour que les équipes performent avec clarté et confiance, en connectant les enjeux techniques aux priorités client et business.
Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :
Définir et communiquer la vision, les priorités et le modèle opérationnel du Customer Engineering.
Piloter et développer les managers, clarifier les responsabilités et construire une culture managériale saine.
Accompagner l'organisation dans sa transformation en apportant stabilité, contexte et cap dans les périodes de changement.
Renforcer la collaboration entre le Customer Engineering et les équipes Sales, Account Management, Support, Tech et Produit.
Garantir que l'implémentation technique, la migration des données, le support engineering et le succès technique génèrent une valeur mesurable pour les clients et le business.
Améliorer la scalabilité via des modèles de service clairs, la planification des capacités, des standards de qualité, des outils, l'automatisation et une utilisation responsable de l'IA.
Les qualités attendues en tant que Head of Customer Engineering
Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.
Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :
Justifiez d'une expérience significative à la tête d'une organisation technique orientée client (customer facing) d'environ 40 personnes ou plus, avec management de managers.
Avez un solide bilan en matière de transformation organisationnelle et de conduite du changement.
Faites preuve d'un style de leadership calme, empathique et crédible, avec la capacité de rassurer les équipes et de construire la confiance dans les périodes de changement.
Disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication, notamment pour expliquer clairement des décisions complexes et influencer des parties prenantes senior.
Maîtrisez le français et l'anglais à un niveau professionnel (C1 minimum).
Ce serait fantastique si :
Vous disposez d'une profondeur technique suffisante pour challenger les hypothèses, comprendre les architectures clients et prendre des décisions éclairées sur les intégrations, les API et la gestion des données.
Vous avez déjà construit des modèles opérationnels scalables ou des organisations de services techniques orientées client.
Vous adoptez une approche fondée sur les données pour la priorisation, la planification des capacités et l'amélioration continue.
Notre offre
Une mutuelle avantageuse prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib (régime de base) pour les employés et leurs enfants
25 jours de congés payés et 12 à 14 jours de RTT par an
Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care
10 jours par an de télétravail à l'étranger possible
Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,50 € par jour, dont 4,50 € pris en charge par Doctolib
Adhésion au plan de partage de la valeur de Doctolib, appelé DoctoGrowth
Un programme d'intégration complet de 3 mois incluant la Doctolib Academy et diverses formations (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)
Une subvention du comité d'entreprise pour le remboursement partiel d'adhésions à des activités sportives ou de loisirs
Un remboursement à 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun
Programme ParentCare : bénéficiez d'un congé de naissance couvert par Doctolib à 100 % le premier mois et à 75 % le deuxième mois
Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien psychologique renforcé
Aide au déménagement en cas de mobilité internationale
Le processus de recrutement
Entretien avec un recruteur : Un échange pour découvrir votre parcours, vos motivations et évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences avec nos besoins.
Rencontre avec nos Senior managers / Business Case : Une étude de cas à préparer chez vous pour vous projeter sur le rôle avec restitution auprès de nos managers.
Échange avec notre Directeur de département : Un approfondissement de votre candidature et de vos compétences.
Prise de référence
Détails du poste
CDI
Temps plein
Nantes ou Levallois-Perret — Hybride (2 jours de télétravail par semaine)
Prise de poste : dès que possible
Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.
Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.
Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !
Toutes les informations fournies sont traitées par Doctolib pour la gestion des candidatures. Pour plus de détails sur le traitement des données, cliquez ici. Veuillez contacter hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com pour toute question ou pour exercer vos droits.
