jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
Join the Revolution in Car Finance 🚗💥
At Carmoola, we’re changing the way people get on the road – making it faster, fairer, and entirely built around the customer. We’ve started with car finance, reimagining it from the ground up with a seamless, digital experience that puts drivers in control.
Since launch, we’ve raised over £540m from top-tier investors (including QED), helped over 31,000 customers get behind the wheel – and we’re scaling fast.
To take things to the next level, we're looking for a technical, AI-native Head of Data Science to build and deploy the models that let us lend faster, safely, at scale.
Your Mission
You'll take the reins on building and owning Carmoola's data science strategy – from designing and deploying the AI to assess risk across our application flow, to using Open Banking to provide frictionless, accurate affordability assessments. You'll have a huge amount of autonomy and responsibility from day one, and the opportunity to define what AI-native risk and affordability at Carmoola really means.
This is a high-impact role for someone who is as comfortable writing and shipping production code as presenting to leadership, thinks commercially about the cost of friction, and knows how to build something from scratch. You won't hand requirements to another team – you'll set the strategy, build the models and agents yourself, deploy them into live decisioning and prove their impact on real losses.
What You'll Be Doing
Own our risk prediction strategy - Set the direction across data science methods, data sources and platforms. Decide what we build versus buy, and balance loss prevention against friction for customers and dealers.
Lead delivery across the business - Own the data science roadmap. Shape requirements with Product and Engineering, work with Credit, Ops and Collections to make models fit how the business really runs, and keep delivery moving from idea to live impact.
Develop the models underneath - Build Gradient Boosting Machines to predict risk, Open Banking categorisation models, plus look for other uses of data science techniques to meet our goals.
Ship it to production - Own deployment end to end, from tested, version-controlled code and CI/CD to safe releases and live monitoring for drift and performance, with clear governance and human oversight wherever customers are affected.
Turn data into decisions - Deliver analytics and MI that show how your models are winning, and report against risk appetite to senior leadership and the board.

jobs.title: Director of Instructional Media and Technology
jobs.text:
Overview
The Associate Director of Instructional Media and Technology leads strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of EIM’s educational technology ecosystem, ensuring that the tools and digital experiences supporting hybrid and online learning are modern, scalable, and aligned with institutional and programmatic needs. This role oversees an EdTech team and collaborates closely with LDT leadership, Learning Designers, and Academic and University Partner (UP) stakeholders to deliver solutions that enhance curriculum development efficiency and quality, elevate the user experience, and expand EIM’s innovation capacity.
Operating within the LDT division, this role evaluates instructional technologies, guides the development and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions, develops instructional media standards and templates, and ensures educational technology platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality. Through cross-functional leadership, technology stewardship, and continuous improvement, it strengthens EIM’s digital learning infrastructure and advances its mission to deliver high-quality hybrid healthcare education at scale.
Responsibilities
Strategy & Continuous Improvement
Lead the strategy, implementation, and continuous improvement of EIM’s educational technology ecosystem and roadmap, keeping tools modern, scalable, and aligned with institutional and programmatic needs.
Based on ongoing analysis of internal LDT needs and the innovation roadmap, set the EdTech vision and establish metrics that evaluate effectiveness and guide investment, development, or deprecation decisions.
Team Leadership
Build LDT team capability with respect to instructional media and technology.
Develop the EdTech team, fostering an innovative and solutions-oriented culture.
Work in a cross-matrixed environment to identify and serve the needs of the Learning Designers, University Partners, and other stakeholders.
Technology Evaluation & Management
Partner with Learning Designers and LDT leadership to identify instructional and operational needs and determine technology solutions that enable effective learning experiences and improve curriculum-development quality, efficiency, and scale.
Apply product-management principles to the EdTech portfolio, including discovery, prioritization, roadmap development, implementation, adoption, measurement, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement
Champion policies (such as AI and accessibility), supporting their translation into the edtech stack and training.
Oversee the administration of EdTech systems.
Course Templates, Media & Digital Experience
Lead the development and maintenance of master course templates, reusable instructional media, and design objects that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across UP and EIM programs. Balance standardization-for-scale and customize-for-partner dynamics.
Establish instructional media and design standards—including video, interactive, and multimedia components—and guide implementation in partnership with the LDT team.
Direct the development, adoption, and maintenance of internal tools and LMS-integrated solutions.
Ensure platforms meet standards for accessibility, performance, and instructional quality, refining them based on analytics and stakeholder feedback.
Innovation & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Expand EIM’s innovation capacity by exploring emerging technologies—including AI and automation—and recommending ROI-driven applications to implement.
Partner with EIM Business Enablement to ensure the LDT EdTech ecosystem aligns with enterprise technology architecture.
Develop adoption and change strategies for new technologies, tools, standards, and workflows, partnering with LDT leaders and managers to build awareness, capability, utilization, and sustained adoption.
Partner with Learning Designers and Academic/UP stakeholders to identify technology needs and systemic issues affecting course development, delivery, and user experience, driving cross-functional resolution and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
Master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or related field (or equivalent work experience), with 6–8 years of relevant experience (Associate Director) or 8-12 years (Director)
Minimum 5 years experience supporting online courses in an LMS (Canvas, Brightspace, Blackboard, or equivalent).
Knowledge of product development lifecycles and solution implementation in educational environments.
Strong analytical skills for evaluating technologies against organizational goals.
Demonstrated experience in two or more of the following: web development (HTML, CSS/SCSS); EdTech system administration; UI/UX design for educational platforms; multimedia development.
Proven strategic thinking with experience in road-mapping and implementation, plus strong project management across competing priorities.
Demonstrated experience evaluating and applying AI and emerging technologies in educational or content-development environments.
Exceptional communication skills including presentation to external partners (e.g., university partners).
Familiarity with learning theories, instructional theories, and instructional design best practices.
Ability to thrive in a diversified environment with varying levels of ambiguity.
About

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.
We're looking for a VP of Engineering to lead and scale Oddball's engineering practice across our federal digital modernization portfolio — someone who brings proven practices from commercial and product-focused organizations and knows how to adapt them to the realities of federal delivery.
What you'll be doing:
Set and drive technical standards, best practices, and engineering consistency across 100+ engineers spanning multiple federal programs — including how teams adopt and build with agentic AI tools
Own engineering talent decisions — identifying and promoting top performers, developing those with growth potential, and maintaining a high bar across the organization
Partner with Program Managers, Tech Leads and VPs to ensure programs are delivering high-quality, technically sound solutions
Roll up your sleeves when it matters — dig into architecture, solve a hard technical problem, or prototype an idea to move it forward
Build and own the engineering career ladder — defining skill levels, growth paths, mentorship structures, certifications, continuing education and promotion criteria
Coach and support Tech Leads in both technical and managerial dimensions
Drive technical strategy across the portfolio, identifying opportunities to improve performance, tooling, and delivery
Stay current on emerging technology including AI/ML, cloud platform engineering, and developer productivity — and turn it into practical advantages for our clients
Contribute to growth and capture efforts — solutioning, proposal reviews, and technical viability assessments
Provide thought leadership internally and externally, representing Oddball's engineering capabilities to clients and at industry events
What you’ll bring:
Deep experience leading engineering organizations with meaningful time in a federal contracting environment
Commercial, product, or industry experience outside government is strongly preferred — and a clear sense of how to bring those lessons into federal delivery
Hands-on technical credibility — you spend most of your time guiding and enabling, but you can still go deep when the situation calls for it
Track record of building technical culture, career development programs, and high-performing engineering teams
Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevSecOps, and cloud modernization in federal contexts
A collaborative leadership style — you build alignment and empower teams rather than dictate a single way of working
Experience building partnerships and driving technical change with government clients
Exceptional communication skills — you can translate complex technical concepts for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
Requirements:
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. In alignment with federal contract requirements, certain roles may also require U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and a security clearance.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree
Benefits:
Fully remote
Annual stipend
Comprehensive Benefits Package
Company Match 401(k) plan
Flexible PTO, Paid Holidays

jobs.title: Vice President Data and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.text:
Overview
At SCA Health, we believe healthcare is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.
As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.
What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:
Clinical quality
Integrity
Service excellence
Teamwork
Accountability
Continuous improvement
Inclusion
Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.
At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Click here to learn more about our benefits.
Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.
Responsibilities
SCA Health is building the data and AI foundation that will define its competitive position as the leading ambulatory surgery company in the United States. This is a greenfield executive leadership role — a chance to shape strategy, build a team, and establish the governance and technology platforms that will serve SCA's 300+ facilities and 12,000+ associates for the next decade. The VP, Data & AI reports directly to the CIO and is one of eight direct reports on the CIO's leadership team. You will own the enterprise data strategy, platform, and governance function, and will lead SCA's AI and machine learning capability — from foundational MLOps infrastructure through clinical decision support and operational AI at scale. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare's two most consequential technology shifts: the transition to data-driven clinical and operational decision-making, and the responsible deployment of AI in care delivery. You will work in direct partnership with SCA's CMO, CFO, COO, CGO, and clinical leaders — not just the technology organization.
Core Accountabilities:
Enterprise Data Strategy & Platform.Define and execute SCA Health's multi-year data platform roadmap — cloud data architecture, EHR/PAS data integration (HST, Athena, eCW, etc.), real-time pipelines, and the infrastructure that makes trusted data available to every decision-maker across the enterprise.
AI & Machine Learning Strategy.Lead SCA's AI roadmap — from MLOps infrastructure and model development through production deployment and monitoring. Prioritize use cases with rigorous business case analysis and establish clinical validation protocols.

Demonstrated experience building enterprise data platforms at scale (cloud-native, modern data stack: dbt, Spark, Databricks or Snowflake)

Track record of data product thinking — not just infrastructure, but data as a product consumed by business users

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Senior Engineering Director
College Board– Technology
Location:This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have theoptionof being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employeesare required tooccasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.
Type: This is a full-time position
AboutTechnologyat College Board
We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year,operatingatsignificantscale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways:blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery,operatingas an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.
About the Team
TheCore Assessment Platformis a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving shared platform capabilities that support assessment-related systems used by institutions at scale. The work spans a range of assessment contexts, from routine evaluation to more complex, high-stakes environments, where accuracy, consistency, and trust are essential. Teams collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and operations to build reliable capabilities that can be reused and adapted over time.What makes this group special is its focus oncontinuous learning, experimentation, and steady improvement, with success driven by thoughtful collaboration, iteration, and careful decision-making in environments where reliability and quality matter.
About the Opportunity
As the Senior Engineering Director, you will provide senior organizational and technical leadership within the Core Assessment Platforms group, with responsibility for multiple teams led by experienced engineering managers. This roleoperatesat the platform level, shaping multi-team roadmaps and aligning execution across highly interconnected systems. Working closely with peer directors, principal and staff engineers, and cross-functional partners, the Senior Engineering Director ensures teams deliver meaningful progress while keeping long-term platform goals front and center. The role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to guide complex decisions across teams with competing needs.You’llhelpidentifyand prioritize near-term improvements that unlock momentum or reduce risk, while ensuring those wins reinforce longer-term architectural and strategicobjectives. Success is measured by the coherence of the platform over time, the strength of collaboration across teams, and the durability of both the technical foundations and the leadership bench you help build.
In this role, you will:
Provide Technical Leadership to the Team(45%)
Provide senior technical leadership for a defined area of the Core Assessment Platforms, ensuring alignment across multiple highly interconnected systems.
GuideEngineeringManagers, Principal and Staff Engineers in evaluating solution options, making architectural tradeoffs, and managing technical risk and debt across teams.
Identifyand prioritize near-term technical improvements that unlock momentum or reduce risk, while reinforcing longer-term platform strategy and architectural coherence.
Establish and uphold shared engineering standards for system design, reliability, security, and operational excellence within your platform area.
Serve as an escalation point for complex, cross-team technicaldecisionsand platform-level risks, applying strong technical judgment.
Stay informed on relevant technologies and platform practices, using that insight to guide platform evolution.
Build ahighly engaged,and high-performing team(30%)
Lead multiple engineering teams through experienced Engineering Managers, building consistent leadership practices and strong collaboration across teams.
Partner with Engineering Managers to ensure teams are appropriately staffed, aligned, and able to deliver sustainably.
Foster a culture of trust, accountability, and continuous improvement across interdependent teams.
Actively support diversity, equity, and inclusion through hiring, talent development, and inclusive leadership practices.
Mentor Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, helping build a durable leadership bench and clear growth paths.
Interface with business partners and technology colleagues(25%)
Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, and peer Technology leaders to shape and align multi-team roadmaps.
Develop a strong understanding ofassessmentbusiness needs and platform consumers to inform technical priorities and sequencing.
Balance competing demands across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating tradeoffs whilemaintainingplatform cohesion.
Communicate complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations effectively to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
Ensure delivery progress across teams is coordinated, visible, and aligned with both near-term outcomes and long-term platform health.
Collaborate with peer Engineering Directors to ensure consistency and alignment across the broader Core Assessment Platforms group.
About you, youhave:
10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, includingsignificant experienceleading leaders (Engineering Managers, Senior Engineers, or equivalent).
Proven experience setting technical direction and overseeing the delivery of large-scale, cloud-based applications and platforms, preferably using AWS and modern web technologies.
A strong background in software architecture and system design, with the ability to guide teams toward scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions without being prescriptive.
Demonstrated success building, mentoring, andretainingdiverse, high-performing engineering teams at scale.
Experienceoperatingat the intersection of technology and business, with the ability to align engineering investments to organizational goals and customer impact.
Exceptional communication skills, witha track recordof influencing senior executives, product leaders, and cross-functional partners.
Strong operational mindset, including experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, delivery risk, and long-term technical health.
A leadership style grounded in trust, inclusion, and accountability, with a commitment to developing future engineering leaders.
Ability to travel 3–5 times per year to NYC or Reston, VA.
Authorization to work in the United States.
All roles at College Board require:
A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions anda comfortlearning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receivingtimely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.
About Our Process
Application review will beginimmediatelyand will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
Whilethehiring processmay vary, it generallyincludes:resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.
What We Offer
At College Board, we offer more than just apaycheck,we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive.We’rea self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.
A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation
The hiring range for this role is$170,000- $195,000
Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
We aim to make our best offerupfront—rootedin fairness, transparency, and market data.
We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.
You’llhave open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and whatit’slike to work atCollegeBoard throughout your hiring process. Check out ourcareerspage for more.

jobs.title: Director of Data Architect
jobs.text:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
Our Values
Best Life
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
Growth Mindset
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
One Team
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
What You’ll Do
Define and communicate ABC’s data architecture strategy, roadmap, and standards.
Lead the architectural evolution from batch and latency-driven processing toward real-time data.
Partner with executive, product, and engineering leaders to connect data architecture decisions to business and customer outcomes.
Identify practical opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity, data generation, quality, and decision-making.
Lead, coach, and develop a global team of four to five senior data architects.
Establish consistent design review practices across the Data and Reporting organization.
Guide architecture decisions related to data quality, governance, security, compliance, scalability, and reliability.
Partner with Product leaders early in the planning process to shape data and reporting capabilities.
Explain complex technical strategies clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
Build alignment across teams and influence decisions beyond your direct reporting relationships.
What You’ll Need
10+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or a related discipline, including experience leading senior technical professionals.
Demonstrated experience moving data platforms from batch processing toward real-time or near-real-time architectures.
Deep experience with modern cloud data platforms and lakehouse architecture.
Experience with AWS, Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog is highly valued.
Strong foundations in data modeling, data warehousing, data governance, and distributed data systems.
Working knowledge of SQL and Python sufficient to review designs and engage credibly with engineers.
Practical experience using AI in your own work, along with sound judgment about where AI creates meaningful value.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to make technical strategy clear to executive leaders and design decisions clear to engineers.
Demonstrated ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying solely on formal authority.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
And It’s Great to Have
Experience in fitness, wellness, SaaS, payments, or another subscription-based business.
Experience building customer-facing analytics or reporting products.
Experience with Databricks SQL, Power BI, or comparable analytics platforms.
Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
What Success Looks Like
ABC’s data architecture strategy is clear, credible, and supported by executive leadership.
The first real-time capabilities are live, with a practical roadmap for continued transformation.
Data and Reporting teams work against shared architecture, quality, governance, and design standards.
AI is embedded into the team’s everyday approach to building and improving data capabilities.
Product and engineering leaders involve the architecture team early in strategic decisions.
Your team is highly capable, well-developed, and trusted across the organization.
Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -
$173,000 - 198,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:
Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!
At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION:
ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com
About ABC Fitness
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. jobs.title: Head of Product - Cards
jobs.text:
Head of Product - Cards - Amsterdam
Build with us
Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.
We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.
If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.
Your impact
Cards is one of the most strategically important products at Mollie. It is the primary payment method operating at a global scale and the central enabler for Mollie to serve larger, more sophisticated merchants. As the accountable lead for online cards acceptance, you will own one of the highest net revenue-generating areas in the business, and your work will directly shape Mollie's ability to compete for and retain enterprise and mid-market merchants.
As the Head of Product for Cards Acquiring, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for one of the most critical payment methods. You will bridge the gap between heavy technical infrastructure and high-impact commercial enablement. Leading a cross-functional team of around 20 people that includes product delivery managers, a product partnership person, a dedicated data person, and a PMM, you will scale Mollie’s cards capabilities beyond Europe, unlock new merchant categories, and ensure our proposition wins the hearts of highly sophisticated merchants. You will also work directly with payment schemes and external partners, making decisions that influence both the product roadmap and Mollie's broader positioning in the market.
The cards domain is expected to become an increasingly primary driver of Mollie's growth over time, with the potential for the online and in-person card acceptance platforms to converge and expand the scope of this role significantly. If you want to own something that matters at a company that is moving fast in the right direction, this is it.
What you'll ship
End-to-end product ownership: own the full cards acceptance product lifecycle—from deep technical infrastructure and processing stability to commercial enablement.
Go-To-Market & commercial enablement: lead the GTM strategy for new card features in tight lockstep with Product Marketing (PMM) and Commercial teams. You'll translate complex technical capabilities into crystal-clear value propositions that our sales teams can run with.
Global scale: drive the geographic expansion of our cards product, building out capabilities beyond Europe to support Mollie’s international growth.
Portfolio optimisation: Identify untapped merchant vertical opportunities and make data-driven decisions to maximise net revenue across the entire cards portfolio.
Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing product team.
What You’ll Bring
Commercial & GTM Strategy: A proven track record of launching successful financial/payment products. You know how to price, position, and package features alongside PMM to win market share.
Partnership acumen: deep understanding of direct vs. indirect relationship strategies in the payments ecosystem and their respective commercial implications.
Technical depth: you aren't afraid of complexity. You can comfortably navigate the underlying technical architecture of cards acquiring, including the intricacies of the PCI compliance landscape.
Operational scale: experience managing operations-heavy environments and a proven ability to build scalable organisational structures that handle massive transaction volumes.
Customer obsession: this is non-negotiable at Mollie. You have a relentless drive to understand merchant pain points and build products that genuinely delight them.
Leadership: experience leading and developing cross-functional teams. You know how to cultivate a culture of high performance, accountability, and psychological safety.
Grow your way
At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.
You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.
No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy
If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.
Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.
AI at Mollie
We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.
AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Closing date: 6 November 2026
Salary scale: £71,595 - £90,000 per annum
Help Shape the Future of Britain's Railway
Rail Delivery Group (RDG) partners with Britain’s train operators to put customers at the heart of everything we do, delivering essential services and dedicated experts who keep the nation’s railway running efficiently.
From journey information, reservations and Railcards to improving performance, safety and accessibility, we drive the services and people that keep the railway moving. Anyone who has travelled by train or booked a journey for friends or family, will have used our services. We are integral to the running of the railway and play a crucial part at every stage of the customer journey – making sure we are delivering a better railway for all our customers, now and in the future.
As we embark on a new era for rail, we are now looking for a Head of Engineering to join us. If you are motivated by meaningful work and want to play a role in the future of Britain's railway, we'd love to hear from you!
What is the purpose of this job?
The post holder is accountable to the Director of Industry Operations and the Rolling Stock Strategy Director, DFTO.
The role:
· provides leadership to the RDG Engineering, ERTMS and Digital Systems Team
· works as part of the DFTO Rolling Stock team
· takes the lead on designing and establishing DFTO’s and GBR’s Fleet Engineering capability and structure.
In addition, the role acts as the Professional Head for RDG railway engineering support activities. The objective is to ensure effective centralised support for RDG, DFTO and industry partners and stakeholder businesses in support of their delivery of a safe, punctual and efficient railway.
This role will help to support the design of organisational rolling stock engineering capability ahead of the formation of Great British Railways (GBR).
What can I expect to do in this job?
1. To act as the Professional Head for the RDG engineering support activities.
2. To assist, advise, alert, advocate and act on behalf of the senior engineering community in GB rail.
3. Working as part of a matrix team between RDG Industry Operations and the DFTO Rolling Stock Strategy team, provide technical leadership and support to develop and promote RDG, DFTO and GBR policy for all Engineering matters, including GB Rail Interoperability, Safety, Standards, Performance, Digital Signalling & Communications, Rolling Stock Strategy & Related Supply Chain etc and to give support to GBR strategic initiatives in the same areas.
4. To influence the future strategic direction of technical leadership for the GB and European rail industry.
5. To ensure the efficient and cost-effective delivery of engineering support-related benefits to RDG/DFTO, GBR and industry partners and stakeholders.
6. To support the development and roll-out of digital signalling technology working closely with Network Rail, RoSCos and suppliers whilst ensuring operator views and experience shape and inform future plans.
7. To provide strategic direction and line management of the RDG Industry Operations Engineering and ERTMS & Digital Systems team and DFTO teams (where applicable) including, but not limited to, carrying out annual appraisals, objective setting and review, agreement of leave.
8. To act as the nominated partner in support of the senior Engineering leadership forum and other senior technical forums facilitated by RDG and DFTO.
9. To prepare and manage all elements of the RDG engineering budget and support DFTO budgeting arrangements as required.
10. To be accountable for the technical input and on-going development of the Railway Engineering Graduate Scheme (REGS) both today and in the context of wider GBR-related graduate/non-graduate engineering training programmes.
Who will my key contacts be?
Internal to the rail industry
· RDG & DFTO colleagues – exchanging information
· DFTO Rolling Stock Strategy Director
· Train Operator Engineering Directors
· GB passenger and freight operator and their trade associations executive and senior teams – exchanging information and networking
· Network Rail Senior Teams & Specialists – exchanging information and influencing
· Railway Safety and Standards Board (RSSB) Executives & senior personnel – exchanging information and influencing
· Rolling Stock Leasing Companies Executives and senior personnel – influencing
· Fleet & related supply chain MDs & Executives - influencing
· European TOC Personnel – influencing and exchanging information
· European Representative Bodies (CER and UIC) – influencing, negotiating and exchanging information
External to the rail industry
· Senior officials in government departments including the Department for Transport, Transport Scotland and Transport for Wales – influencing and exchanging information
· Office of Road and Rail Senior Personnel – influencing and exchanging information
· Rail Supply Group, Railway Industry Association, Rail Alliance and GB suppliers – networking
· Railway Consultancies – exchanging information
· Wider GB & European Suppliers - networking
· British Standards Institute, CEN/CENELEC, ISO/IEC Personnel – networking
· Professional Institutions - networking

jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Core Security & Security Operations
jobs.text:
About Us
At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.
We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.
At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.
Job Summary
Versa Networks is seeking a visionary, technically deep, and execution-oriented Senior Director of Product Management – Core Security & Security Operations to lead and scale our foundational threat prevention, data protection, endpoint/browser security, and SecOps capabilities.
In this role, you will define the multi-year security strategy, roadmap, and vision to ensure Versa outpaces modern adversary tactics and maintains market leadership across SASE, SSE, and core security products and technologies. You will directly steer core inspection engines, govern federal/public-sector compliance certifications, orchestrate 3rd-party technology ecosystems, oversee security incident response and research, and commercialize next-generation security innovations across Versa’s product portfolio.
Responsibilities
Strategic Vision & Product Leadership
Define, own, and execute the multi-year product strategy for core threat prevention, data security, secure browsing, and operational security across cloud-delivered and on-premises architectures.
Benchmark Versa against top-tier competitive solutions (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Fortinet) to maintain market-leading efficacy, low latency, and differentiation.
Act as an authoritative company spokesperson, representing Versa's core security architecture and vision at premier industry conferences (e.g., RSA, Black Hat), customer advisory boards (CABs), and executive briefings (EBCs).
Threat Prevention, Inspection & Secure Access
Drive product definition and roadmap evolution for Unified Threat Protection (UTP), including Next-Gen IPS, Network Antivirus/Anti-Malware (AV), and Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) / Sandboxing.
Scale and advance Versa's secure web and workspace ecosystem, including Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), Enterprise Browser posture/controls, and File Reputation & Filtering (FRM).
Lead email vector defense initiatives, encompassing ATP and DLP for SaaS email (M365, Google Workspace) alongside partnership with turn-key 3rd-Party Email Security Integrations (Proofpoint, Abnormal Security, Mimecast).
Data Protection & Endpoint Risk Posture
Direct the Inline DLP and Data Security roadmap across web, cloud, and edge endpoints, incorporating advanced classification, OCR, and clipboard/removable-media controls.
Own API-driven Data Protection (API DP) and lead technical integrations with leading 3rd-party Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platforms (e.g., Cyera, BigID).
Architect Versa’s native Device Risk Score (DRS) framework to drive dynamic Zero Trust policies; build deep bidirectional integrations with 3rd-Party DRS and EPP/EDR partners (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne).
Security Operations, Intelligence & Versa Security Portal
Lead the product roadmap for Versa Guardian and security operations tooling, streamlining incident workflows, remediation actions, and telemetry export into enterprise SIEM/SOAR/XDR platforms, including Versa’s own working together with colleagues owning respective products.
Help scale the customer-facing Versa Security Portal, delivering real-time visibility into threat trends, tenant security posture, attack surface metrics, and global threat landscape telemetry.
Direct Security Research priorities and weaponize 3rd-party threat intelligence (TI) feeds/APIs directly into Versa’s inspection pipeline to accelerate zero-day protection cycles.
Public Sector, Compliance & Product Security Assurance
Own the compliance and certification roadmap for regulated markets, including FedRAMP, FIPS 140-3, and Common Criteria (EAL4+).
Oversee product requirements for Code Hardening, secure software supply chain posture (SBOM), and platform vulnerability management.
Drive the operational product governance for the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), managing vulnerability disclosures, advisory bulletins, and customer remediation workflows.

Act as an authoritative company spokesperson, representing Versa's core security architecture and vision at premier industry conferences (e.g., RSA, Black Hat), customer advisory boards (CABs), and executive briefings (EBCs).

blocks.text: Threat Prevention, Inspection & Secure Access

items: Drive product definition and roadmap evolution for Unified Threat Protection (UTP), including Next-Gen IPS, Network Antivirus/Anti-Malware (AV), and Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) / Sandboxing.
Scale and advance Versa's secure web and workspace ecosystem, including Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), Enterprise Browser posture/controls, and File Reputation & Filtering (FRM).

Lead email vector defense initiatives, encompassing ATP and DLP for SaaS email (M365, Google Workspace) alongside partnership with turn-key 3rd-Party Email Security Integrations (Proofpoint, Abnormal Security, Mimecast).

blocks.text: Data Protection & Endpoint Risk Posture

items: Direct the Inline DLP and Data Security roadmap across web, cloud, and edge endpoints, incorporating advanced classification, OCR, and clipboard/removable-media controls.
Own API-driven Data Protection (API DP) and lead technical integrations with leading 3rd-party Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platforms (e.g., Cyera, BigID).

Architect Versa’s native Device Risk Score (DRS) framework to drive dynamic Zero Trust policies; build deep bidirectional integrations with 3rd-Party DRS and EPP/EDR partners (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne).

blocks.text: Security Operations, Intelligence & Versa Security Portal

items: Lead the product roadmap for Versa Guardian and security operations tooling, streamlining incident workflows, remediation actions, and telemetry export into enterprise SIEM/SOAR/XDR platforms, including Versa’s own working together with colleagues owning respective products.
Help scale the customer-facing Versa Security Portal, delivering real-time visibility into threat trends, tenant security posture, attack surface metrics, and global threat landscape telemetry.
Direct Security Research priorities and weaponize 3rd-party threat intelligence (TI) feeds/APIs directly into Versa’s inspection pipeline to accelerate zero-day protection cycles.

blocks.text: Public Sector, Compliance & Product Security Assurance

items: Own the compliance and certification roadmap for regulated markets, including FedRAMP, FIPS 140-3, and Common Criteria (EAL4+).
Oversee product requirements for Code Hardening, secure software supply chain posture (SBOM), and platform vulnerability management.
Drive the operational product governance for the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), managing vulnerability disclosures, advisory bulletins, and customer remediation workflows.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management - AI Security & AI Gateway
jobs.text:
About Us
At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.
We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.
At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.
Job Summary
We are seeking a visionary, technical, and execution-oriented Director of Product Management to lead Versa’s AI Security and AI Gateway product portfolio.
In this leadership role, you will define the vision, roadmap, architecture, and commercial strategy for how global enterprises discover, protect, optimize, and govern Generative AI models and Agentic AI workflows. You will own market-defining capabilities ranging from Gen-AI Firewalls and AI Gateways to AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM), Agentic Bill of Materials (ABOM), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server security.
As the face and champion of AI Security at Versa, you will also serve as a thought leader—representing the company at premier AI, cybersecurity, and networking conferences worldwide.
Responsibilities
Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap
Define and execute the multi-year vision, product roadmap, and strategy for Versa’s AI Security and AI Gateway portfolio.
Translate market shifts, emerging threats, and LLM/agent architectural evolutions into differentiated product capabilities integrated into Versa’s unified SASE/SSE architecture.
Drive end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation, requirements collection, use-cases definition, product experience definition working closely with the UX team, to leading new product launch process through to GA, customer adoption, and telemetry feedback loops.
Core Functional Ownership
Gen-AI Firewall & Runtime Defense:
Build next-generation inline defense against Prompt Injections, Jailbreaking, Data Poisoning, System Prompt Leakage, Denial of Service (DoS), and adversarial LLM threats.
Deliver robust Prompt Guard and Guardrail architectures that are integrated seamlessly into network traffic paths governed by Versa
Shadow AI Discovery, Control & Governance:
Deliver complete visibility into enterprise-wide AI adoption, detecting unsanctioned models, external web Gen-AI apps, and hidden API calls.
Build policy-driven governance frameworks enforcing corporate compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, HIPAA, GDPR).
Enterprise AI Gateway & Usage Management:
Lead the development of an enterprise-grade AI Gateway providing advanced traffic steering, rate-limiting, and routing based on application, data classification, geographic location, model choice (commercial vs. open-source), and cost efficiency.
Manage latency, fallback strategies, multi-model redundancy, and local vs. cloud inference routing.
AI-SPM (AI Security Posture Management)
Establish continuous auditing, vulnerability management, and misconfiguration detection across enterprise AI pipelines, model weights, data stores, and inference endpoints.
Agentic Security & Identity (ABOM, Agentic Verbo, MCP):
Pioneer security primitives for autonomous AI agents, including Agentic Identity, Agent Bill of Materials (ABOM).
Secure autonomous workflows, runtime permissions, inter-agent communications, and Agentic Verbo implementations.
Architect security and governance for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, securing the transport, tooling, and data access layers between LLMs and external systems.
Tokenomics & Cost Observability:
Deliver granular FinOps capabilities for AI: token consumption tracking, cost attribution by department/application/user, budget enforcement, cache optimization, and quota management.
Packaging, Pricing & Go-To-Market (GTM)
Own business modeling, SKU design, packaging, and monetization strategies for AI Security and AI Gateway add-ons and standalone offerings, working together with Product leadership
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Global Sales to build battlecards, technical collateral, white papers, demo environments, and sales enablement modules.
Act as an executive sponsor for key customer PoCs, design partner programs, and strategic beta rollouts.
Industry Evangelism & Thought Leadership
Serve as Versa’s external authority and public spokesperson for AI Security and Governance.
Represent Versa at leading industry conferences (e.g., RSA Conference, Black Hat, Gartner Security & Risk, AI summits, IEEE/OpenAI/developer forums).
Publish thought leadership articles, participate in standard bodies, and engage industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, IDC).

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT
jobs.text:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
Position Summary
The Senior Director, Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT will set direction for the Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT capability across GSK and lead the organisation that delivers it. This is a senior leadership role accountable for the capability across GSK. This role covers Global Supply Chain and Operational Technology, including manufacturing and laboratory systems.
About the team. The Technology Risk and Compliance Business Partners are the face of the Cyber Security Office to GSK's business and technology areas. Each partner owns the cyber risk and compliance relationship for an assigned area, translating central strategy into what that area actually needs to do, and bringing its risk back into the Cyber Security Office.
Key responsibilities:
This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
Set the multi-year strategy for Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT and secure the investment to deliver it.
Drive a risk-accountable leadership culture and a cyber- and risk-savvy workforce culture in Global Supply Chain and Operational Technology.
Lead the Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT organisation, including leaders of teams, and own its capability plan.
Own the budget, vendor portfolio and headcount plan for the capability.
Represent the capability to the CISO, GSK Tech leadership, auditors and regulators, including supporting risk and compliance for Sarbanes Oxley, Privacy regulations and Anti-Bribery and Corruption.
Own the cyber risk and compliance relationship for the assigned area, Global Supply Chain and Operational Technology, including manufacturing and laboratory systems.
Identify, analyse and influence the management of cyber security risk across the assigned area.
Hold operational areas, risk owners and suppliers to account against the Cyber Security Office strategy for the assigned area.
Build and maintain the cyber risk register for the area, including risk statements, ratings, owners and treatment plans.
Develop a deep understanding of Global Supply Chain business processes, including planning, manufacturing, distribution and quality, and supporting Information Technology and Operational Technology including ERP and integrated ecosystems, Manufacturing Execution Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, SCADA and industrial control systems.
Guide Global Supply Chain leadership on how the changing technology, threat and regulatory landscapes affect their risk posture and influence priorities, investments and roadmaps accordingly.
Own the Risk & Compliance governance forum (RMCB) for the assigned area, ensuring priority actions, findings and CAPAs are tracked with clear accountabilities.
Partner with Business Quality Assurance to ensure GxP validation of business-facing application systems and services within the assigned area.
Provide oversight and coaching to the team on audit and inspection readiness, including hosting of external inspections and regulator/auditor engagements, and on the reporting of CAPA status.
Provide oversight and coaching to the team on GxP software change management and system release governance for regulated applications within the assigned area.
Influence across the Cyber Security Office and broader Digital and Tech organisation to identify and shape solutions for effective and efficient risk and compliance management.
Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements
Why You?
Basic Qualification
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
Experience in cyber risk, technology risk or information security governance.
Experience with risk assessment and risk register management.
Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders.
Experience in cyber security, including leading a global capability at scale.
Experience leading leaders of teams across multiple geographies.
Experience owning a capability budget and vendor portfolio.
Experience influencing and communicating at executive and board level.
Experience with service definition and process improvement methodologies
Preferred Qualification
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
Experience acting as a business information security officer or embedded security partner.
Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001 and ISO 22301.
Experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow.
Experience in pharmaceutical or another regulated industry, including GxP and SOX contexts.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Relevant certification such as CISM, CRISC, CISA, CISSP.
Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
Understanding of Operational Technology (OT) security concepts, applied across manufacturing, distribution, quality laboratory and supply chain environments.
Typical tools and technologies: ServiceNow GRC, Power BI

#AGTech
#GSKcso
Skills
Cloud Security, Cybersecurity, Data Integrity, Executive Reports, Identity Access Management (IAM), Risk Assessments, Risk Management, Risk Management Framework, Security Architecture Design, Security Compliance, Security Policies, Security Risk, Third Party Risk Management, Vulnerability Management, Web Application SecurityThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $195,000 to $325,000. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process.
Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees.
Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

This capture of applicable transfers of value is necessary to ensure GSK’s compliance to all federal and state US Transparency requirements. jobs.title: Senior Director of Design, Search & Feeds
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.
We’re looking for a Senior Director of Design to lead the experience strategy for Reddit’s Search & Feeds experiences. Reporting to our Head of Design, you’ll lead a design team shaping how people find relevant conversations, discover communities, and build connections to the topics they care about. Your impact will extend across Reddit, connecting discovery to the experiences that turn initial interest into ongoing participation.
This role combines product vision, design leadership, and a high bar for craft. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science across Reddit to make discovery more useful, intuitive, and distinctly Reddit driving growth and retention by helping people connect with communities that matter to them.
What you’ll do
Set the design vision for Search & Feeds. Define a cohesive experience strategy across search, feed experiences, recommendations, and community discovery, connecting near-term improvements to a longer-term vision.
Lead and develop the team. Coach design leaders and individual contributors, build clear ownership, and create an environment where people can do ambitious work and grow.
Shape product direction. Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and guide investment decisions grounded in user needs and business goals.
Raise the bar for quality. Drive thoughtful interaction design, clear information architecture, accessible experiences, and strong execution from early concepts through launch.
Make relevance understandable. Help people understand and influence what they see, bringing clarity and user control to ranking, personalization, and recommendations.

jobs.text:
At DUAL North America, our core values dictate how we live and work. We are a group with independence and people at its heart and we are a home for talent with a unique culture: the biggest small company in the world.
The focus on being a People First business has always been at the very heart of the Group; Our vision was to create an independent business with a unique culture and one that would survive and thrive as a business controlled by the people working for it. And finding the most talented and entrepreneurial people to join the Group has been and will continue to be key.
DUAL North America, Inc. is seeking a
AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management
AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management
Location: Remote
Classification: Exempt
Reports to: SVP Service Strategy
Travel: 10-15%
Salary range: $160,000-$180,000
Role overview
DUAL North America is seeking an AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management to lead enterprise technology delivery, release governance, and strategic project execution across the organization. This role requires a strong leader who can drive the successful planning, coordination, communication, and delivery of technology initiatives while ensuring alignment with business objectives.
The AVP will oversee a team of product owners, analysts and project professionals, manage complex cross-functional technology programs, establish release management best practices, and partner closely with business and technology leaders to deliver scalable solutions that support operational excellence and business growth.
Role responsibilities
Leadership and Strategy
Lead, mentor, and develop a team responsible for requirements management, release management, and project execution.
Partner with senior business and technology leaders to prioritize initiatives, manage delivery portfolios, and align technology investments with business outcomes.
Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and execution excellence.
Release Management and Governance
Own and mature the enterprise release management function, including release planning, scheduling, governance, risk management, and deployment readiness.
Establish standardized release management processes, controls, and reporting to improve delivery predictability and quality.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of technology releases across applications, infrastructure, and business systems.
Drive release readiness reviews, dependency management, risk mitigation planning, and post-release assessments.
Ensure releases are delivered in accordance with organizational standards, compliance requirements, and business expectations.
Release Communications and Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating technical concepts into business-relevant information.
Develop and execute comprehensive release communication plans for business and technology stakeholders.
Provide timely updates regarding release schedules, impacts, milestones, risks, and deployment activities.
Present program status, release outcomes, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Technical Requirements Management
Lead the gathering, prioritization, and validation of technical and functional requirements for strategic technology initiatives.
Collaborate with architects, engineers and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are clearly defined and actionable.
Establish best practices for requirements management to improve solution quality, reduce rework, and accelerate delivery.
Ensure technical requirements align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and business objectives.
Project and Program Management
Lead complex technology projects and programs from initiation through implementation and operational transition.
Ensure delivery teams maintain alignment with scope, timelines, quality expectations, and business goals.
Drive cross-functional coordination to remove obstacles, resolve issues, and maintain project momentum.
Utilize SAFe Agile 6.0, and traditional project delivery methodologies as appropriate to maximize successful outcomes.
Data-Driven Delivery Excellence
Leverage reporting and analytics to monitor progress, identify risks, and support executive decision-making.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on performance trends and lessons learned.
Change Leadership and Organizational Readiness
Support organizational readiness activities that support successful adoption of new technology solutions and capabilities.
Partner with business stakeholders to ensure alignment between project delivery objectives and operational execution.
Promote best practices that improve delivery efficiency, team effectiveness, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Key requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology delivery, project/program management, release management, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.
PMP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), Release Train Engineer (RTE), or equivalent certifications preferred.
Experience implementing enterprise release management frameworks and governance models preferred.
Extensive experience leading large-scale technology programs, enterprise initiatives, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Demonstrated expertise in Release Management, Project Management, and Technical Requirements Management within complex enterprise environments.
Strong knowledge of Agile SAFe 6, and traditional project management methodologies.
Proven success managing technology portfolios, release governance processes, and organizational transformation initiatives.
Experience working closely with architecture, engineering, infrastructure and business teams to deliver enterprise technology solutions.
Strong understanding of IT operations, software delivery lifecycles, governance frameworks, and technology strategy.
Demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, and competing priorities across multiple initiatives.
Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a focus on delivering measurable business value through technology.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing strategic planning with operational execution.
What we offer:
A career that you define. Yes, we offer all the usual rewards and benefits - including medical, dental, vision, a wide variety of wellbeing offers, competitive salary, unlimited PTO, 401k with company match, paid volunteer days and more.
We provide an environment where new ideas are encouraged and celebrated, where people who want to have a real hand in our success thrive. We want people who want to make a difference - not just in the workplace, but in the industry and in the wider community.

We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect. DUAL North America provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. DUAL will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
