jobs.title: Director, Data & Standards
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.
Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.
Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.
At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.
If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!
Position Overview
The Director, Data & Standards leads API’s data analyst team and owns the standards, governance, and quality practices that make our data trustworthy and usable across the organization. The role also carries forward key parts of API’s AI Enablement program: running AI experiments and pilots, driving adoption of enterprise AI tools, and using AI to improve how the data team works and the insights it delivers. You will balance hands-on AI and analytics work with leadership of the team, setting direction, developing people, and raising the bar on how API defines, measures, and uses data. This is a remote position.
What You’ll Do
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Team leadership and analytics oversight
Lead, coach, and develop a team of data analysts, including hiring, goal setting, performance management, and career growth.
Set priorities and manage the team’s workload across Engineering, Client Delivery, and Corporate stakeholders.
Review analyst work for accuracy, clarity, and business relevance, and ensure reporting and analysis are timely and decision-ready.
Build a culture of curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning, including AI fluency across the team.
Data standards and governance
Define and maintain enterprise data standards, including metric definitions, naming conventions, documentation, and a shared data dictionary.
Establish data quality monitoring, validation processes, and issue-resolution workflows, and drive remediation with data owners.
Partner with IT, Engineering, and Security on data access, lifecycle management, and compliance requirements.
Serve as the authority on “one version of the truth” for key operational and commercial metrics.
AI experimentation and pilots
Run intake, hypothesis design, metric definition, and outcome documentation for data and AI experiments across the organization.
Lead go/no-go reviews and graduation-to-production decisions for AI pilots, owning validation evidence, vendor coordination, and integration readiness.
Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy and reliability, and set quality standards for AI-generated analysis.
AI adoption and enablement
Partner to drive training, communications, and enablement for Claude Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot, moving seat utilization from license to behavior.
Produce the monthly AI scorecard: experiments launched, seats utilized, automation rates, FTE-equivalent savings, and experiments graduated.
Co-lead AI Sandbox operations with Engineering, including use-case intake, prioritization, and graduation criteria.
Work with IT and internal stakeholders to identify gaps, surface high-value use cases, and improve return on AI spend.
Vendor and budget management
Manage relationships with data and AI tooling vendors and track spend against the approved plan, flagging variances.
What You'll Bring
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data governance, or a related field.
Working personal fluency with Claude (mandatory) and other enterprise AI tooling (Microsoft Copilot or equivalent), with demonstrated ability to design and document hypothesis-driven experiments.
Experience defining data standards, metrics, or governance practices in a cross-functional environment.
Strong SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce executive- and board-quality materials.
Comfort operating in ambiguity within a small, fast-moving team.
Preferred Qualifications
Technical background in computer science, engineering, data, or comparable hands-on experience with software, automation, or AI systems.
Experience with data warehousing, data modeling, and data quality tooling.
Exposure to voice AI, document automation, or contact-center modernization.
Prior experience in a PE-portfolio company or other high-growth, lean environment.
Experience in travel, transportation, or logistics.
Education
Bachelor’s degree required. Technical or quantitative field (computer science, engineering, economics, mathematics, data science) preferred. Advanced degree welcome but not required.
Compensation
The good faith compensation is $120,000 - $140,000, USD.
Compensation is determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, geographic location, as well as internal alignment and external benchmarks.
Other Duties
Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time according to business needs.
The performance of additional responsibilities if you are designated as a Data Protection Champion (DPC), Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) or Information Assurance Accounting Officer (IAAO).
Work Environment
This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
AAP/EEO Statement
Accommodations Plus International is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, arrest record, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.
Privacy Statement
API may use the contact information you provide to communicate about this role, including via text message. See our [Privacy Policy] for details. By clicking "Apply" you agree to Rippling's Terms of Service/User Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Community & Livestream
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
OKX is building a vibrant in-app social community — spanning content, livestream, and creator ecosystems — that connects users, creators, and partners while driving trading engagement across the platform. You'll own the end-to-end Community & Live product, and contribute to north star goals including DAU, high quality creator ratio, and trading conversion within the community, underpinned by a robust safety & moderation stack.
What You’ll Be Doing
Community & Livesteam Product
Own the community and livestream product roadmap: content strategy, content curation, and content recommendation to improve discovery, engagement, and retention.
Drive user segmentation and interest discovery — build the frameworks and tooling to understand user cohorts and personalize content and community experiences at scale.
Define and improve community content quality standards; own the content/community ecosystem governance roadmap.
Creator & Fan Ecosystem
Build the creator and fan economy: creator incentive programs, tasks/missions, creator leveling systems, and tiered benefits that deepen streamer-fan and creator-fan relationships.
Build up creator lifecycle product capability, including discovery, engagement, onboard, grow, retain, and off-board phases.
Drive community's user education, product adoption, and trading conversion via innovative ways including internal advertising, fan economy mechanics, and trader leaderboards to achieve strong content- and trader-driven growth.
Community Monetization & Partnerships
Design and run community growth campaigns that convert community engagement into platform value (acquisition, activation, trading conversion).
Partner with marketing and growth teams to develop content strategies to capture and amplify opportunities from trendy events in the industry.
What We Look For In You
5+ years of experience as a product manager, with solid experience shipping social media, community, livestreaming, creator platforms, growth campaigns, or social products.
Hands-on with Trust & Safety or content moderation tooling.
Adequate understanding of the crypto industry, trading funnels, and risk/compliance constraints.
Able to think and communicate logically, data-sensitive, and able to accurately grasp customer mindsets; strong ability to identify and break down problems quickly.
Strong in execution, with good communication and project management skills; able to mobilize cross-functional resources to solve problems and deliver projects on time.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering
jobs.text:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs, welcomed 1.2 million applicants, and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.
We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.
About the Role
Submittable is hiring a Vice President of Engineering who is deeply technical, works hands-on, and builds with AI every day. You will report to the CTO and run engineering day to day: delivery, quality, reliability, cost, and the people who make them happen.
We want a different VP than the old SaaS playbook produced. That playbook grew output by growing headcount and adding layers of management. We believe AI coding tools now let a small team of strong engineers ship what once took a team several times its size. We intend to run engineering that way. You will keep the organization lean, keep layers few, and raise output per engineer rather than the number of engineers.
You cannot lead that change from a slide deck. You need to know firsthand what it is like to ship production software with AI agents, including where they fail. We expect you to have done this yourself in the last 12 months and to keep doing it here. Plan on roughly a fifth of your week going to hands-on technical work: reading and writing code, reviewing pull requests, working incidents, and building the tools your teams use.
We are choosing depth over span. This is a hands-on leadership role for a small, senior team, not a role leading a large organization through layers of managers. If you want to make architecture calls, contribute and ship code, and help a lean team deliver well beyond its size, we want to talk.
What You'll Do
Run engineering day to day. Turn the CTO's technical strategy and the product roadmap into plans, priorities, and shipped software.
Stay hands-on. Review pull requests, prototype, debug production issues, and write tools. You should be able to pick up a ticket and ship it. Teams should trust your calls because of your technical judgment, not your title.
Make AI the default way we build. Expect every engineer to work with AI coding agents (tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for design, coding, testing, and review. Show people how by doing it yourself, and remove whatever stops them.
Measure what AI changes. Track the four DORA metrics (how often we deploy, how long a change takes to reach production, how often changes fail, and how fast we recover), plus defects that reach customers and engineering cost per release. Report plainly on where AI helps and where it creates new problems, such as oversized pull requests, thinner review, or code no one on the team understands.
Keep the organization lean. Grow output faster than headcount. Keep management layers thin, expect managers to stay technical, and favor small teams with clear ownership over large teams that need heavy coordination. Before adding a person, ask whether better tooling or automation solves the problem.
Automate the toil. Use AI and automation for test generation, CI/CD checks, code review assistance, release notes, incident triage, and alerting, so engineers spend their time on the product.
Raise the technical bar. Set standards for architecture, code review, testing, CI/CD, release management, and incident response. Shipping more code, faster, raises the stakes for review, testing, and observability. Make sure speed does not cost us quality.
Own platform reliability, security, and cost. Our products are multi-tenant SaaS running on AWS and Azure, with Kubernetes. Work with infrastructure and security partners to meet uptime targets, pass SOC 2 audits, and keep cloud spend growing slower than revenue. Simplify our architecture where consolidation pays for itself.
Build AI into the product. Work with the CTO and Product to add AI to Submittable so customers can set up programs, review applications, and make funding decisions in less time. Help decide what to build and how to test it for accuracy and fairness, because real applicants' outcomes depend on it.
Hire and grow a small, strong team. Recruit engineers and leaders who already build with AI. Coach managers to stay close to the work. Build career paths that reward impact and technical depth, not team size.
Partner across the company. Work with Product and Design on scope and trade-offs among new features, technical debt, and platform health. Work with Customer Experience and Support to resolve escalations and reduce customer-facing defects.
What We're Looking For
You have shipped software with AI in the last 12 months. You personally built and shipped production code using AI coding tools within the past year. You can tell us what you built, which tools you used, what broke, and how it changed the way you work. This is a requirement, not a preference.
Deep technical skill. 15+ years in software engineering, with real depth in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure, Kubernetes), and DevOps. You can hold your own in an architecture review with our strongest engineers and spot the flaw in a design or a pull request.
You have run lean, high-output teams. 7+ years in engineering leadership, including at least 3 years leading other managers. You have raised a team's output without matching growth in headcount, and you can show the numbers: delivery metrics, team size, and cost, before and after.
B2B SaaS at scale. Experience building and running multi-tenant, cloud-based B2B SaaS products. Experience consolidating platforms or integrating acquired products is a plus.
Predictable delivery. A record of shipping complex software on predictable timelines without trading away quality, security, or reliability.
Distributed teams. You have led teams across multiple countries and time zones, including offshore or nearshore partners. You write clearly, because much of this work happens in writing.
Comfort with fast change. The norms for building software now shift every few months. You form a view, test it, and change your mind when the evidence says so.
A clear storyteller. You can explain technical trade-offs to executives and non-technical colleagues in plain language. You tell people where engineering is going and why, often enough that they repeat it.
A builder of strong teams. A track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong engineers and building inclusive teams.
Nice to Have: Experience in a private equity-backed or high-growth SaaS company; familiarity with SOC 2 and GDPR; experience shipping LLM-based features to customers, including how to evaluate them.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Location: This is a remote, U.S.-based role — you must live and reside in the U.S. full-time.
Salary Details: The annual salary range for this position is $220,000 - $260,000. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. We also have a location-based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in other locations.
We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time. In addition, we are not able to consider applicants who reside in the following states: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming.
Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Submittable will NEVER request bank details, payment, or personal information during the hiring process, nor extend offers without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official email addresses. If you receive suspicious outreach, please report it to . (Please do not submit applications, resumes, cover letters, or other candidacy materials to this email address. Emails of this nature will not be reviewed or considered.)
Why Submittable?
Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.
At Submittable, you’ll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply!
Benefits: We are proud to offer highly competitive benefits to our full-time employees, including:
Comprehensive health and life insurance with optional HSA, FSA, and DCA accounts
401(k) plan with employer match starting day one
Equity stock options to share in our success
Flexible hours, remote work options, and generous vacation and sick leave
Paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents
Professional development stipends to support your career growth
Opportunities to participate in community outreach and volunteer programs
Monthly company-sponsored happy hours and gatherings to connect and unwind
Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging
At Submittable, we believe technology is a force for good, driving social impact and enabling corporate social responsibility on a global scale. To achieve this, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values inclusion and belonging as central pillars of our culture.
We embrace the strength of our diverse community by creating a safe space where employees feel empowered to share ideas, celebrate unique experiences, and learn from one another. By prioritizing inclusion, we aim to build an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and make innovative contributions that enable our customers to tackle complex challenges and spread more good.
As a globally used platform, we are dedicated to hiring and supporting employees who represent a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. This includes diversity in ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, religion, ability, culture, and socioeconomic background.
About Our Process
Our goal is a fair, efficient, and thorough evaluation process that benefits you and our team and respects your time. As you can imagine, we have received a high volume of applications. Your willingness to participate in I.D. Verification and answer a few questions early allows us to move through the process more quickly.
Let's Talk About AI:
Guidelines for using AI in our Hiring Process: At Submittable, we believe that Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a powerful tool for good. We are committed to leveraging AI technologies responsibly, ensuring their use is equitable, fair and safe. To ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during take home tests or interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, please let us know.
For additional information and guidance on using AI to prepare an interview at Submittable, please clickhere.
We believe our approach streamlines the hiring process and respects your time by ensuring that every conversation is substantive and focused on your unique qualifications. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to learning more about you.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Us
BTC Inc. is the parent company of Bitcoin Magazine, The Bitcoin Conference, and Bitcoin for Corporations. Our mission is Hyperbitcoinization, the global adoption of Bitcoin as the world's preferred monetary network. We believe Bitcoin opens the door to a global monetary network free from poor incentives, censorship, and government manipulation. Our journey to success involves decades of complex problem-solving, product development, and service creation in order to onboard billions of people into a future where money is more accessible, borderless, and inclusive. If you enjoy working on challenging problems, fast-paced sprints, and navigating ambiguity, you'll find our mission and type of work inspiring and rewarding.
The Role
We are seeking a product-minded Chief Technology Officer to architect and build the data platform that powers BTC Inc's next generation of products. You will lead the design and delivery of our core data infrastructure and consumer app architecture, own engineering standards across the company, and build the engineering organization behind them. You will report directly to the CEO and operate as a peer to product leadership, sharing one joint platform roadmap.
The ideal candidate has personally built, not just managed, a data platform that powers a revenue product. You are a senior IC at heart who has grown into leadership without losing your hands. You read an engineering plan and immediately want to redline it. You are wary of frameworks, transformation roadmaps, and any first-90-days plan that does not include shipping code. You have built or shepherded a modern data stack (BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, identity resolution, BI) and shipped data products that customers paid for. You are Bitcoin-literate or genuinely curious. You are comfortable being the first engineering hire and the last call on architecture.
The Work
Platform Architecture
Own the technical architecture of our data platform: warehouse, ingestion pipelines, identity resolution, and a unified data model across the business.
Make the early infrastructure calls: ETL tooling, dbt structure, BI layer, orchestration, and data governance posture.
Sequence the platform buildout to ship a working unified dataset within the first few months.
Consumer App & Data Connectivity
Define the technical relationship between our consumer app and our data platform: what gets captured, how identity flows, what gets enriched, and what flows back to the user.
Partner with the app engineering team (initially contractor, transitioning to FTE) on the consumer surface and event credentialing.
Ensure event credentialing is production-grade and survives tens of thousands of users on day one.
Engineering Leadership & Standards
Hire and develop the engineering team. Model constraint before headcount: automate, simplify, and ship before you hire.
Establish the engineering culture: code review, on-call, observability, technical writing, and a high IC bar.
Be the technical interviewer and bar-raiser on every engineering hire.
Set and enforce engineering standards company-wide, favoring shipped reference implementations over policy memos.
Own standards on day one; the broader technology portfolio consolidates under you as systems mature.
Surface technical constraints to the leadership team in plain language, and carry commercial constraints back into engineering planning.
Security, Compliance & Data Governance
Stand up SOC 2 readiness on a timeline that supports enterprise-grade commercial products.
Own GDPR, consent tiering, and right-to-erasure capability across the platform from day one.
Make vendor and tooling decisions that survive audit and scale.
Work with existing technology team to architect and enact future IT infrastructure and steward technical philosophies org wide.

10+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years as the senior-most technical leader at a startup, data-intelligence company, fintech, or media-intelligence business.
Personally architected and shipped a data platform that powered a revenue product.
Deep, current expertise in a modern data stack: BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran or Airbyte, an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster), and a BI layer (Looker, Hex, Metabase).
Track record hiring and growing senior ICs in a small, high-trust environment; no preference for command-and-control management styles.
Comfortable making product and commercial trade-offs, not just technical ones; able to push back on commercial leadership when the engineering reality requires it.
Bitcoin-literate, or genuinely curious about Bitcoin as a monetary network, the Bitcoin treasury thesis, and the Lightning/x402 stack.
Strongly preferred: AI native with experience building consumer mobile, agent-facing APIs (MCP, x402), or research/intelligence data products at production scale.

Company MacBook

jobs.title: Senior Director, Developer Relations
jobs.text:
Who we are
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.
Hiring and how we work
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.
See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Director of Developer Relations.
About the job
We’re hiring a Sr Director of Developer Relations to lead the global team building the strategies and programs that inspire and equip developers to win with Twilio. You’ll lead a unique, world-class org of hybrid engineer-marketers as you evolve the GTM motion that Twilio pioneered. This is a high-visibility, high-agency role reporting into Marketing, while working lockstep with Product and Go-To-Market.
The DevRel team at Twilio exists to make heroes of developers in their own organizations. You'll ensure we do this by showing up where developers live, both online and offline, while being humble, authentic and acting as a servant leader in the community. You are strategic yet deeply plugged into the Dev ecosystem, turning community engagement, technical contributions, and developer awareness into a steady drumb
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:
Serve as a figurehead, influencer, and key speaker on the global DevRel circuit, setting a high standard for how Twilio engages with builders online and offline.
Define the long-term global narrative for developer marketing. Build consensus and influence at the executive level to ensure cross-functional alignment with Product, Marketing, and GTM teams.
Recruit, mentor, and cultivate a unique global organization of Developer Evangelists, Advocates, and community specialists. Foster a culture of technical excellence that blends engineering rigor with world-class marketing storytelling.
Guide and scale Twilio's global Startups Program, help the team shape the strategic frameworks, partnerships, and early-stage developer initiatives that establish Twilio as the foundational tech stack for the next generation of high-growth companies.
Oversee a comprehensive technical content program (covering video, newsletters, and YouTube) to showcase the “art of the possible” with Twilio. Partner closely with the PR team to fuel our creator and influencer engine, leveraging both internal advocates and external partners to amplify developer-first storytelling.
Evolve our community and forums strategy into a modern, high-engagement motion. Build robust User-Generated Content (UGC) and ambassador programs that turn developers into long-term advocates across modern developer surfaces.
Spearhead Twilio’s Builder event strategy, ensuring our team is on the ground at major developer gatherings & meetups by showing, not just telling. Build strategic relationships with adjacent ecosystem partners to unlock high-impact co-marketing and launch activations.
Act as the ultimate steward of the developer experience. Navigate and facilitate complex, sensitive public community situations with high empathy, tact, and professional media coordination, while synthesizing community signals to directly inform the product roadmap.
Qualifications
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
*Required:
7+ years of leadership experience managing developer relations, technical evangelism, or community advocacy programs (and 10+ years total working in this technical field).
Proven track record of building, training, and scaling outstanding technical global teams to support local and global stakeholders.
Deep technical baseline with an understanding of software developer personas and workflows (e.g., former full-time developer or hands-on software development experience).
Strong data-driven execution skills with a demonstrated understanding of marketing motions and user growth metrics.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships with C-level executives, journalists, bloggers, and industry analysts.
Desired:
Experience leading a developer relations team that directly supports a bottom-up, Product-Led Growth (PLG) self-service GTM motion.
Firsthand experience contributing to or directing prominent open-source software communities or public engineering forums.
An established professional network spanning a diverse set of technical communities, platform ecosystems, and developer networks.
Location
This role will be remote and based in the USA.
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with developers, customers, and each other. For this role, approximately 30% travel is anticipated.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
Compensation
*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.
The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:
Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $275,840 - $344,800.
Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $292,080 - $365,100.
Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $324,480 - $405,600.
This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, 2026 but may change based on business needs.
Twilio thinks big. Do you?
We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.
Stay alert to recruitment fraud
We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.
Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.
We're looking for a VP of Engineering to lead and scale Oddball's engineering practice across our federal digital modernization portfolio — someone who brings proven practices from commercial and product-focused organizations and knows how to adapt them to the realities of federal delivery.
What you'll be doing:
Set and drive technical standards, best practices, and engineering consistency across 100+ engineers spanning multiple federal programs — including how teams adopt and build with agentic AI tools
Own engineering talent decisions — identifying and promoting top performers, developing those with growth potential, and maintaining a high bar across the organization
Partner with Program Managers, Tech Leads and VPs to ensure programs are delivering high-quality, technically sound solutions
Roll up your sleeves when it matters — dig into architecture, solve a hard technical problem, or prototype an idea to move it forward
Build and own the engineering career ladder — defining skill levels, growth paths, mentorship structures, certifications, continuing education and promotion criteria
Coach and support Tech Leads in both technical and managerial dimensions
Drive technical strategy across the portfolio, identifying opportunities to improve performance, tooling, and delivery
Stay current on emerging technology including AI/ML, cloud platform engineering, and developer productivity — and turn it into practical advantages for our clients
Contribute to growth and capture efforts — solutioning, proposal reviews, and technical viability assessments
Provide thought leadership internally and externally, representing Oddball's engineering capabilities to clients and at industry events
What you’ll bring:
Deep experience leading engineering organizations with meaningful time in a federal contracting environment
Commercial, product, or industry experience outside government is strongly preferred — and a clear sense of how to bring those lessons into federal delivery
Hands-on technical credibility — you spend most of your time guiding and enabling, but you can still go deep when the situation calls for it
Track record of building technical culture, career development programs, and high-performing engineering teams
Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevSecOps, and cloud modernization in federal contexts
A collaborative leadership style — you build alignment and empower teams rather than dictate a single way of working
Experience building partnerships and driving technical change with government clients
Exceptional communication skills — you can translate complex technical concepts for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
Requirements:
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. In alignment with federal contract requirements, certain roles may also require U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and a security clearance.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree
Benefits:
Fully remote
Annual stipend
Comprehensive Benefits Package
Company Match 401(k) plan
Flexible PTO, Paid Holidays
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities:
Oddball is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), age, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Any applicant with a mental or physical disability who requires an accommodation during the application process should contact an Oddball HR representative to request such an accommodation by emailing .
The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)
At Oddball, we may use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruitment process to help review applications, verify applicant information, and identify potentially fraudulent submissions. These tools support our recruiting team in maintaining a fair and secure hiring process. AI-generated findings are reviewed by our recruiting team and are not used as the sole basis for hiring decisions.
Compensation:
At Oddball, it’s important each employee is compensated competitively and fairly. In alignment with state legal requirements. A range for the included position is listed below. Be advised, actual offer details are determined by job category, job location, and candidate skill level.
United States Wage Range: $200,000 – $250,000

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Product — Transact is the business owner of Lone Wolf's Transact product line. Transact is our most-used product line and the transaction management platform agents, brokers, REALTOR® associations, and Multiple Listing Services rely on to get deals to the closing table. This role reports to the SVP, Product & Strategy and leads a team of Product Managers across the Transact modules.
This is a business-ownership role, not a feature-management role. Operating as the “Product CEO” for the line, the Senior Director owns the strategy, commercial results, and customer experience of the business, while driving the innovation required to remain the leader in an AI-enabled world.
The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Role and Responsibilities:
The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
What you will own:
Own the Transact P&L — revenue, bookings, retention, and margin — and report on it through a disciplined, no-surprises monthly Product Line Review.
Define and defend an outcome-based strategy and roadmap tied to Lone Wolf's financial goals, including clarity on what not to build.
Embed AI across the transaction workflow — replacing manual steps with conversational automation and digital workers that customers adopt.
Partner with peer Product leaders so handoffs between Transact and our other product lines are seamless and invisible to the customer.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of Product Managers who act as owners and innovators, not order-takers.
Maintain a real-time view of competitors and win/loss dynamics, and equip Sales and Marketing with field-ready battle cards and positioning.
Own key customer and partner relationships, turning feedback into prioritized action that protects and grows the base.
Requirments:
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of Product Managers in B2B or vertical SaaS.
Proven ownership of a product line's commercial results — P&L, bookings, or retention — with strong financial fluency.
Real estate technology, transaction management, or document and workflow software experience strongly preferred.
A track record of consolidating or modernizing products and migrating customers off legacy platforms while protecting retention.
Hands-on experience bringing AI and automation into production workflows with measurable adoption.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a single strategy.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director - Product Management
jobs.text:
Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence
EarthDaily | U.S. Remote | Washington Metropolitan Area preferred | Full-Time
Reports to: VP Product
About EarthDaily
EarthDaily is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company delivering daily, scientifically calibrated, AI-
ready imagery of the planet through the EarthDaily Constellation. Capturing 22 spectral bands across nearly
all of Earth's landmass and maritime regions at the same time every day, EarthDaily powers broad-area
change detection, advanced analytics, and mission applications for governments and industries worldwide.
About the Role
The Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence, is the senior product leader responsible for
defining and driving EarthDaily's product strategy for defense and intelligence markets. The Director will
identify high-value mission problems and translate them into differentiated, scalable products that combine
EarthDaily's Earth observation data, analytics, AI/ML, contextual data, and workflow capabilities. This role is
highly outward-facing and will spend substantial time with government users, commercial customers,
acquisition stakeholders, Sales & Business Development, and industry partners to understand the market and
translate those insights into clear product priorities and requirements.
The role is part of EarthDaily's Analytics Product organization and works in close partnership with EarthDaily
Federal, Analytics line of business, and Engineering to develop defense and intelligence products for U.S.
Government and international defense agencies and customers. The Director owns the product problem,
customer outcome, product strategy, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, packaging, and commercial
product case. EarthDaily Federal and EarthDaily Analytics market teams along with Sales lead customer
relationships, capture, opportunity strategy, contracting, and revenue execution, while Engineering owns
technical design, delivery planning, sprint management, and implementation. The Director is expected to
move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, develop evidence-driven roadmaps that drive
revenue, stay close to customers and technical teams, and maintain a high level of responsiveness and
accountability.
Minimum Requirements
Location preferred: Washington Metropolitan Area (WMA).
• Senior or Director-level product management experience with demonstrated ownership of product
strategy, discovery, prioritization, and commercialization.
• Must be a U.S. Citizen.
• Must hold a minimum active Secret clearance; active TS/SCI strongly preferred.
• Must have strong knowledge of U.S. Government mission needs, budgets, spending cycles, acquisition
pathways, and commercial GEOINT/EO adoption, with experience in one or more of imagery, geospatial
analytics, AI/ML, or mission workflow solutions.
• Must be able to engage credibly with mission users, program offices, acquisition stakeholders, senior
government leaders, and technical teams and translate among those audiences.
What You'll Own
Defense product strategy: Set and continuously refine the product strategy, roadmap, and investment
priorities for EarthDaily's defense and intelligence portfolio, including Earth observation data, analytics,
AI/ML, contextual data, workflow solutions, and mission applications.
EarthDaily | Director, Product Management - Defense & Intelligence | 2
Market and customer discovery: Maintain a continuous external discovery process with U.S. Government
users, buyers, mission owners, partners, and influencers to understand unmet needs, mission priorities,
buying behavior, competitive alternatives, and emerging demand.
• Mission-to-product translation: Translate customer problems and operational workflows into clear
product requirements, desired outcomes, priorities, and success measures that technical teams can act
on.
Productization and reuse: Identify common requirements across customers, programs, and mission areas
and translate them into scalable products, reusable capabilities, and configurable workflows. Distinguish
between strategic product investments, reusable customer-driven capabilities, and one-off custom
development.
• Prioritization and tradeoffs: Make clear recommendations on what EarthDaily should build, improve,
package, partner for, or explicitly not pursue based on customer value, market size, differentiation,
revenue potential, strategic fit, and technical feasibility.
• Commercialization and revenue enablement: Convert recurring customer and mission needs into
differentiated, scalable offerings that can be repeatedly sold and delivered. Work with EarthDaily Federal,
Growth, and Business Development to understand funded demand, inform opportunity shaping and
capture, and create product proof points that support commercialization and revenue growth.
• Pricing and packaging: Develop and evolve pricing, packaging, licensing, and value propositions for defense
and intelligence offerings based on customer willingness to pay, budget structures, acquisition pathways,
competitive dynamics, and product economics.
• Product positioning and external materials: Drive the product substance behind customer-facing
materials, product briefs, demos, presentations, proposal content, use cases, and sales enablement.
Ensure external claims accurately reflect current and planned capability.
• Customer validation: Establish disciplined feedback and validation loops with government end users and
buyers. Validate the problem, value proposition, workflow fit, usability, and willingness to pay before and
after major product investments.
• Cross-functional product leadership: Establish a working operating rhythm with Engineering in which
Product provides customer context, clear priorities, requirements, and desired outcomes while technical
teams own architecture, delivery planning, sprint execution, and implementation. Work closely with
Market and Sales leadership so customer and capture needs inform product decisions without turning
individual opportunities into one-off product direction.
• Competitive and market intelligence: Track relevant commercial EO, GEOINT, analytics, AI/ML, workflow,
and data-fusion competitors and substitutes. Translate market movement into implications for
EarthDaily's differentiation and product choices.
• Executive product leadership: Communicate product strategy, customer evidence, investment choices,
risks, and performance to senior leadership. Surface decisions early and drive alignment across Product,
Engineering, Analytics, Growth, Programs, Partnerships, and EarthDaily Federal leadership.
• Product performance: Define and track outcome-oriented product metrics, including customer validation,
adoption, usage, time-to-value, product reuse across customers and programs, pipeline influence,
revenue contribution, and other measures appropriate to the product lifecycle.
Leadership Expectations
Operate with urgency. Move fast without creating unnecessary process or waiting for perfect information.
• Be highly responsive to customers and internal teams. Product Management is an accountable,
collaborative leadership function, not a process gatekeeper.
EarthDaily | Director, Product Management - Defense & Intelligence | 3
Be proactive. Identify customer, market, product, and execution issues before they become leadership
escalations.
Own the outcome. Do not stop at documenting requirements; stay engaged through validation,
commercialization, and customer adoption.
• Lead through influence. Build alignment across teams with different priorities while maintaining clear
product accountability and decision-making.
• Use evidence, not volume. Bring customer data, market signals, economics, and mission impact into
prioritization discussions.
What You Bring
10+ years of product management, product strategy, or closely related product leadership experience,
with meaningful experience at the Senior Product Manager, Group Product Manager, Principal, or
Director level.
• Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive, analytics, geospatial, ISR, AI/ML, or workflow products
from discovery through commercialization and adoption.
• Strong knowledge of U.S. Government defense and intelligence mission environments, with the ability to
understand user and operator workflows as well as government buying behavior.
• Experience working directly with customers and users to conduct product discovery, validate problems,
test concepts, and translate findings into product decisions.
• Strong commercial judgment, including experience with pricing, packaging, market segmentation, product
positioning, and revenue-oriented product decisions.
• Ability to convert complex technical and mission concepts into concise, prioritized product requirements
and executive-level recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create customer-facing product content
and represent the product in external meetings.
• Comfort operating in a matrixed organization where Product owns the market solution, product strategy,
product priorities, requirements, and outcomes; Market leads market selection, capture and revenue
execution; and Engineering owns technical design and delivery execution.
Nice to Have
Direct experience with GEOINT, remote sensing, commercial Electro-Optical imagery, spectral data, SAR,
or multi-source geospatial analytics.
• Prior work with USG IC agencies, COCOMs, Military Services, NRO, NGA, or other civil, defense/intelligence
mission organizations.
• Prior work leading non-U.S. defense products (e.g., Canada, Europe, Australia).
• Understanding of federal acquisition, appropriations, PPBE/budget cycles, OTAs, CSOs, IDIQs, data buys,
software licensing, and other common pathways for commercial technology adoption.
• Experience with product-led capture, market shaping, or building customer advocacy for emerging
commercial capabilities.
• Prior military, IC, or federal service with firsthand exposure to analyst, operator, or mission workflows.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Company Overview
Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.
We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.
Job Summary
Orbis is hiring a Vice President of Engineering to lead our engineering organization through its most significant period of growth. You will lead our engineering directors and managers, hire and develop an exceptional technical workforce, and shape a culture where engineers do their best work while the organization triples in size over the next year.
You will report directly to the CTO and serve as the senior engineering leader accountable for how Orbis builds: the people, the leaders, the culture, the delivery engine, and the engineering standards. The CTO sets technical vision and architecture direction; you own the organization and operating model that turns that vision into reliable delivery at scale.
This role is built for a leader who has done it before in a small, fast-moving company, and who can bring structure without bureaucracy. You will be a visible, trusted voice with engineers, executives, and government customers alike. Our engineers work remotely across the United States and its territories, including Puerto Rico, so building ways of working that span time zones is central to this role.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop engineering leadership. Own the engineering leadership team, including directors and managers. Set clear expectations, coach with candor, and build a leadership bench that scales with the company.
Build and retain a high-caliber workforce. Own the engineering workforce plan, hiring strategy, and interview process, and apply our career ladder consistently, to triple the team without lowering the bar. Make timely, fair decisions on performance and staffing.
Shape the engineering culture. Define working norms, career paths, recognition, and feedback loops around how our engineers actually want to work, and protect that culture as we grow.
Communicate with clarity at every level. Set direction and context for the whole engineering organization, and represent engineering to the executive team, the board as needed, and customers. Translate technical trade-offs into business and mission terms.
Own delivery and accountability. Partner with product leadership to turn priorities into predictable delivery, balancing roadmap commitments, technical debt, architecture, and capacity across a growing portfolio. Establish the metrics and operating rhythm that show how engineering is performing.
Set technical direction and consolidate platforms. Working with the CTO, rationalize the toolchain, development environments, and shared infrastructure across our Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React codebases and our AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare environments to reduce duplication and speed delivery.
Scale skills and knowledge. Put documentation standards, shared engineering practices, onboarding, and training in place so knowledge lives in the organization rather than with individuals.
Hold the bar on security and quality. Ensure engineering practices meet the security, compliance, and reliability standards our government and allied customers require, including deployments onto small form factor computers in constrained and disconnected environments.
Lead a remote team across U.S. time zones and territories. Set core collaboration hours, meeting cadences, and on-call rotations that work across the continental U.S., Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and other territories, with written, asynchronous communication as the default.
Partner across the business. Work closely with the CTO, Product, Security, People, Business Operations, and IT on budget, headcount, vendor decisions, and company-level planning.
Travel up to 25% to our McLean, VA headquarters, team gatherings, and customer sites.
Required Qualifications
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations through other managers, with at least 3 years at the director level or above.
Prior experience as an engineering leader at a small or early-stage company (for example, under 200 employees), including operating with limited process and building structure as the company scales.
Demonstrated success as a people leader: developing managers, building diverse and high-performing teams, handling difficult performance and staffing decisions, and retaining top talent through rapid growth.
Proven success scaling an engineering organization through rapid growth, including building hiring pipelines and interview processes.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, with a record of setting direction, giving candid feedback, and explaining engineering trade-offs to executives, boards, and customers.
Proven experience leading a fully remote engineering organization across multiple time zones, including schedules, core hours, meeting cadences, and on-call coverage.
Hands-on technical background in modern software delivery (cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, CI/CD, and DevSecOps), including production experience with at least one of Rust, Go, or TypeScript and with AWS, GCP, or Cloudflare, deep enough to make sound architecture decisions and earn the trust of senior engineers.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Ability to travel up to 25%.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on experience across our stack: Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React, deployed on AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare (including Workers).
Experience shipping software to small form factor computers and other edge hardware, including resource-constrained or disconnected deployments.
Experience leading engineering for products delivered to the DoD, Intelligence Community, or allied governments, including accredited, air-gapped, or edge environments.
Active TS/SCI clearance.
Experience building or scaling data platforms, data integration, or AI/ML products in production.
Experience leading a toolchain consolidation, platform engineering, or developer-experience initiative across multiple teams.
Experience managing an engineering budget and contributing to company-level strategy.
Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
Physical Requirements
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the United States and U.S. territories
Orbis Benefits
Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.
Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.
Orbis Locations
Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.
Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.
Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.
Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,
qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.
Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.text:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.
About Magna
Magna Legal Services is a distributed business, and Microsoft 365 is how our people work: email, files, meetings, collaboration, and the security wrapped around all of it. When it works well, nobody notices. When it doesn't, work stops, and the people on the other end are professionals who need it fixed fast.
We're looking for a technology leader to take ownership of that platform — and the Azure cloud and infrastructure underneath it — and to lead and grow the people who keep it running.
Position overview
You'll be accountable for the availability, security, and usefulness of Magna's IT systems, with Microsoft 365 at the center. That means owning the platform's strategy and roadmap, making sure it's secure and well governed, and making sure our people actually get value from it — not just that it's switched on.
You'll partner with operations leadership to understand what the business needs, work with the VP of IT and Technology leadership to set priorities and policies, and coordinate with our Information Security Officer on data security and resiliency. You'll also oversee the Azure and infrastructure environments behind Microsoft 365 and our business-critical applications, and manage the vendors and partners we rely on.
You'll lead a geographically distributed IT team, and a big part of your job is raising the level of the whole organization — developing your people, standardizing how we work, and leading by example.
Primary Responsibilities
Own the strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day operation of Microsoft 365 — Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and other Applications — along with identity, security, and device management
Oversee the Azure cloud and core infrastructure that support Microsoft 365 and business-critical applications, working with our systems and cloud engineers
Partner with operations leadership to turn business needs into practical, cost-effective solutions
Work with the VP of IT and technology leadership to set priorities, policies, and standard operating procedures
Coordinate with the Information Security Officer to keep data secure and systems resilient
Manage relationships with IT vendors and partners, including Microsoft and managed service providers
Look for ways to add value, improve efficiency, and cut costs — including Microsoft 365 licensing and adoption
Develop and coach your team, and build standardized, documented, cross-trained ways of working
Keep end-user and technology support consistent across headquarters and our business units
Maintain accurate inventories of IT assets and licenses, and monitor compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements
Establish and maintain our disaster recovery and business continuity program for your areas of responsibility
Desired Background
Required qualifications
10+ years designing, supporting, deploying, and evolving technology platforms, infrastructure, and solutions
5+ years managing diverse and rapidly evolving IT platforms and services
5+ years of Microsoft platform management and administration, including Microsoft 365
5+ years managing technology teams in a diverse, geographically distributed business
Deep knowledge of the Microsoft stack — SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Power BI, and Office desktop and mobile applications
Experience supporting Microsoft 365 users in a distributed, highly mobile business
Experience building and maintaining secure, highly available cloud environments (Azure; AWS a plus)
A proven ability to translate business requirements into solution strategies in partnership with senior business leaders
Outstanding written and verbal communication, and a collaborative style with peer IT leaders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Sciences or a similar field, or equivalent experience
Preferred qualifications
Microsoft 365 or other Microsoft certifications
A deep understanding of the Azure / Microsoft 365 security model and group and policy structures
Experience with Intune/EMS, Purview information protection, Defender, and Entra ID
Experience moving on-premises systems to the cloud (Azure; AWS a plus)
Experience with data security standards and regulations relevant to the legal industry
Experience in a legal or regulated business environment, including handling highly secure and confidential client data
Key Characteristics
Ability to multitask using time management skills such as prioritizing, organizing, tracking details, and meeting deadlines on multiple projects with varying completion dates.
Mature and self-motivated professional able to work in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.
Collaborative problem solver and solution champion.
Strong sense of intellectual curiosity and interest in understanding business objectives and how technology can be leveraged.
Passionate about creative, cost-effective solutions to business problems and opportunities.
Active engagement in and understanding of the business — as a partner and collaborator with operational management.
Capability to work as an effective and collaborative member of a distributed IT leadership team.
A keen focus on customer satisfaction and high-quality service delivery, with strong interpersonal skills, responsiveness, and outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
The team
You'll report to the VP of IT. Your day-to-day partners:
The CTO and peer Technology leadership — for priorities, policies, and shared solutions
The Information Security Officer — for data security, resiliency, and compliance
Operations leadership and business units — for requirements and rollout
Your IT team and our vendors and partners — for delivery
Logistics
Full-time, exempt
Travel to company locations as needed — up to 20%
Specific title flexible based on profile and experience
Magna Legal Services provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY
321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.
Technology is central to how 321 competes and grows. From our CRM and automation programs to 321 AIM, our proprietary performance marketing platform, the systems we build are a core part of the value we deliver. The Chief Technology Officer is the executive who sets the vision for that technology and turns it into a lasting competitive advantage.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Chief Technology Officer at 321, you will own the agency's technology vision, strategy, and execution at the executive level. This is a C-suite role with company-wide authority — you'll shape how 321 builds, buys, secures, and monetizes technology, lead the technology organization, and help define the agency's direction as a member of the executive leadership team.
The right person for this role thinks in platforms and business models, not just systems. You understand that the right architecture decisions compound over years, that proprietary technology and data can become defensible products, and that AI is reshaping what an agency can deliver and how it should be priced. You're as comfortable advising on a High Level or Salesforce architecture as you are presenting a multi-year technology strategy to ownership, investors, or enterprise clients — and you build the organization that executes it.
You'll provide executive technology leadership in partnership with 321 AIM, guiding platform architecture, scalability, and roadmap decisions so that our proprietary technology and client service delivery grow together.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Executive Leadership & Technology Vision
Define and own the agency's multi-year technology vision and strategy, aligned with company growth goals, service offerings, and market positioning
Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, contributing to company strategy, annual planning, and major business decisions
Own the technology budget, including platform, licensing, infrastructure, and headcount investments, with clear return-on-investment expectations
Lead build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for major platforms and capabilities
Report on technology performance, risk, and investment outcomes to ownership and, where applicable, investors or a board
Technology Organization & Talent
Build, lead, and scale the technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration
Design the organizational structure, leadership roles, and hiring plan needed to support the agency's growth
Set the culture, engineering standards, and operating principles for how technology is built, shipped, and supported across the agency
Develop leaders within the technology organization through coaching, succession planning, and clear career paths
Proprietary Platforms & Product Strategy
Provide executive technology leadership for 321 AIM in partnership with its leadership, guiding platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and roadmap priorities
Identify opportunities to turn repeatable agency solutions, data assets, and automations into proprietary products, platforms, or productized services
Oversee product development practices, including requirements, release management, quality assurance, and technical documentation
Protect and grow the agency's technology intellectual property
AI Strategy & Innovation
Set the company-wide AI strategy, positioning 321 as a leader in AI-powered marketing, CRM, and performance services
Govern responsible AI use, including data privacy, model selection, accuracy standards, and client disclosure practices
Lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that create new service lines, improve margins, or strengthen client outcomes
Partner with department leaders to embed AI into creative, paid media, CRM, reporting, and agency operations
Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk
Own the agency's enterprise architecture across internal systems, client platforms, data infrastructure, and integrations
Lead the information security program, including policies, access management, vendor risk, incident response, and business continuity
Ensure agency and client technology meets regulatory and contractual requirements in healthcare, insurance, legal, and other regulated industries, including HIPAA, business associate agreements, TCPA, GDPR, and CCPA
Guide the agency toward formal security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 as client and growth needs require
Data Strategy & Measurement
Define the agency's data strategy, including how client, campaign, and performance data is collected, governed, stored, and used
Oversee the measurement and attribution infrastructure that connects marketing activity to closed revenue for clients
Build the data foundation needed to support performance-based pricing, benchmarking, and predictive insights across the client portfolio
Client, Partner & Agency Growth
Serve as the agency's senior technology executive with clients, partners, and prospects — including CMO, CIO, and ownership-level audiences
Lead the technology narrative in new business pitches, RFP responses, and strategic client relationships
Build and manage strategic technology partnerships with platforms such as High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, and Meta
Lead technical due diligence for partnerships, acquisitions, or major client engagements as the agency grows
WHAT YOU HAVE
