jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology & Business Services
jobs.text:
About G2
G2 Capital Advisors () is a multi-product, sector-focused investment bank and financial advisory firm serving middle-market companies. We advise clients on mergers & acquisitions, capital raising, and complex financial and operational situations.
G2 was founded on the belief that middle-market advisory firms can—and should—do more. We partner closely with management teams, private equity sponsors, and stakeholders to navigate growth opportunities, address operational and financial challenges, and execute high-impact transactions.
What differentiates G2 is the breadth of experience across our team. As part of GA Group (backed by Oaktree), G2 brings additional scale and resources to support middle-market companies. Our professionals bring a combination of operating, executive leadership, investing, and advisory backgrounds, enabling us to approach situations with both strategic perspective and execution discipline. This integrated approach allows us to deliver tailored, practical solutions aligned with our clients’ long-term objectives.
We operate in a highly collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where individuals are given meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to make an immediate impact. We seek driven, intellectually curious professionals who thrive in dynamic situations and are motivated to deliver exceptional outcomes for clients.
Location: Flexible, with preference for Boston, New York, Chicago, or Los Angeles
Job Description
As a Managing Director within the Technology & Business Services (TBS) Investment Banking group, you will be responsible for originating and leading client engagements, driving revenue growth, and supporting the strategic direction of the practice. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, private equity sponsors, and boards, while leading transaction teams through the execution of complex M&A and capital markets transactions. The Managing Director will be a hands-on leader deeply involved with deal teams in every aspect of mandates from sourcing though closing.
This role requires deep TBS sector expertise and a proven ability to build and maintain client relationships at the most senior levels, generate new business, and lead high-performing teams in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.
What You’ll Do
Originate and lead M&A, capital raising, and strategic advisory engagements within the TBS sector
Develop and maintain senior-level relationships with corporate clients, private equity sponsors, and key industry stakeholders
Drive business development efforts, including identifying opportunities, leading pitch processes, and converting mandates into revenue
Serve as senior advisor to clients on strategic, financial, and operational matters
Provide oversight and direction across all phases of transaction execution, ensuring quality and successful outcomes
Partner with Vice Presidents and deal teams to manage execution while maintaining strong client engagement throughout the process
Contribute to the growth and positioning of the TBS practice, including sector strategy, market presence, and thought leadership
Recruit, mentor, and develop junior and mid-level bankers, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture
Collaborate across product and industry teams to deliver integrated solutions to clients
Responsibilities include:
Sourcing and Origination (~40%)
Source and originate TBS investment banking opportunities, developing and maintaining senior-level industry relationships in partnership with G2 resources
Leverage your established network, prior transaction experience, and G2’s platform and track record to generate referrals and new client opportunities
Achieve and exceed defined revenue and origination targets, contributing meaningfully to firm growth
Partner with marketing to develop and execute sector-focused initiatives, including newsletters, campaigns, and thought leadership content
Represent G2 and your personal expertise in the market through speaking engagements, publications, conference participation, and other industry visibility efforts
Execution (~40%)
Serve as senior lead and overall owner of transaction execution from mandate through closing
Lead complex M&A, capital markets, and advisory engagements within a small, high-performing team environment
Ensure execution quality by identifying key risks early and developing proactive strategies to mitigate them
Manage all critical client, counterparty, and stakeholder communications with professionalism and judgment
Provide senior-level strategic and financial advice to clients within the TBS sector to support long-term value creation
Ensure transaction success by appropriately identifying risks and developing strategies and plans to proactively mitigate those risks
Maintain accountability for deal outcomes, ensuring successful delivery across all phases of the engagement lifecycle
Organization & Practice Development (~20%)
Support the continued growth and strategic development of the TBS practice
Recruit, mentor, develop, and retain high-performing investment banking professionals
Collaborate with other G2 senior leaders on cross-practice origination, live mandates, and firm-building initiatives
Contribute to shaping culture, standards, and excellence across the platform
Skills and Characteristics:
Managing Director-level experience leading sell-side, buy-side, capital raising, and advisory transactions within the TBS sector
Proven ability to originate and close complex transactions across varying market cycles, including growth, downturn, and distressed environments
Strong executive presence with the ability to lead high-stakes conversations across C-suite executives, boards, and investors
Demonstrated leadership in building, managing, and developing high-performing teams
Advanced financial, analytical, and strategic thinking skills
Deep and active professional network within the TBS ecosystem (IT services and/or business services experience strongly preferred; operating experience highly valued)
Strong reputation and track record that can be leveraged to expand G2’s market presence
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
Strong academic background; undergraduate degree from a leading institution required, advanced degree preferred
What we value
While our team members come from diverse professional backgrounds, we are united by a shared set of core principles. Explore our values here.
This role offers uncapped total compensation, with annual earnings typically ranging from $600,000–$3,000,000 or more, depending on sourcing, origination, and execution performance. Bonuses are paid upon transaction closing or throughout the year as revenue is collected.
G2 Capital Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
G2 is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Director Engineering SaaS & Framework (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
Our client is one of the leading software providers in the healthcare sector, operating internationally with several thousand employees. The company develops business-critical software solutions that help make healthcare processes more efficient, secure, and future-ready.
For a strategically important leadership role, we are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can take responsibility for a large SaaS product and platform environment in the ambulatory healthcare domain.
The role combines executive-level engineering leadership, SaaS transformation, regulatory responsibility, AI adoption, and platform strategy.
Your Impact
You take end-to-end responsibility for a large, distributed engineering organization that develops ambulatory SaaS solutions as well as shared framework modules used across multiple healthcare software products.
Together with executive leadership, product management, and technology stakeholders, you define and drive the strategic product and technology roadmap for a cloud-based ambulatory software portfolio.
You ensure that regulatory requirements in the healthcare environment — including medical device regulations, audits, certifications, and compliance standards — are embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.
You lead senior leaders and cross-functional engineering teams, continuously improving scalability, quality, delivery performance, AI maturity, and innovation speed across products and platforms.
You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, and help position the company as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.
Your Profile
You bring long-standing leadership experience at Director, VP, CTO, or comparable level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.
You have a strong academic background with a completed university degree, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.
You have deep expertise in cloud architectures, SaaS platforms, modern DevOps practices, reliability engineering, and scalable product development.
Experience with healthcare software, regulated environments, medical device requirements, audits, or certifications is a strong advantage.
You have a proven track record of driving AI adoption within engineering organizations — ideally with practical exposure to agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or comparable solutions, including AI agents, skills, workflows, engineering pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at scale.
You communicate confidently in English and German and combine strategic thinking with strong execution, entrepreneurial drive, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation.
Why this role is exciting
You will shape a strategically important SaaS and platform domain in the healthcare sector.
You will lead a large, distributed engineering organization with significant impact on product quality, scalability, regulatory readiness, and innovation.
You will work at the intersection of cloud transformation, AI-enabled engineering, healthcare software, and executive technology leadership.
You will have the opportunity to influence the future of digital healthcare and help build software that makes a real difference for users, patients, and healthcare professionals.
Interested?
If this sounds like the right next step for you, we look forward to hearing from you. Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile — we are happy to arrange a confidential first conversation.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology
jobs.text:
Vice President, Technology
Location: Remote-friendly — preferred locations are Singapore, Greater Shanghai, Seoul and vicinity, or Malaysia. This role works with R&D teams distributed across Singapore, Seoul, and Shanghai, and location flexibility reflects that operating reality.
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Curiox Biosystems is a pioneering life science technology company transforming sample preparation for cell analysis. Listed on the Korea Stock Exchange, Curiox operates globally with R&D and commercial teams across Singapore, Seoul, Shanghai, and Boston. Our breakthrough C-FREE™ Pluto automation platforms eliminate manual centrifugation, enabling faster, more reproducible, and scalable workflows for flow cytometry and single-cell applications. As Curiox scales globally across biopharma, CRO/CDMO, and platform partnerships, we are seeking a Vice President of Technology to institutionalize system-level architecture and lead Curiox's evolution from a product-led innovator to a software-enabled platform company.
Why This Role?
This is a senior leadership role with direct exposure to the CEO and broad influence across Curiox's technical strategy and product direction. You will own system-level architecture across hardware, software, workflow automation, and AI layers — ensuring that Curiox's platform scales coherently, not as a collection of disconnected products.
This role is accountable for architectural discipline, platform coherence, and the technical foundations that will carry Curiox to global scale.
What You'll Do
System-Level Architecture
Own and enforce architecture discipline across all product initiatives — hardware, firmware, software, cloud, and AI layers.
Define system boundaries and interface contracts before development begins.
Formalize the definition of "architecturally complete" across all product lines including Pluto Workstations, Pluto Code, Workflow Wizard, and Antibody Cocktailing Wizard.
Institutionalize failure-mode anticipation as a standard practice before implementation.
Implement AI-assisted requirement expansion and stress testing of system logic.
Eliminate patch-based development culture and replace it with architecture-first discipline.
Ensure no major initiative launches without an architecture review artifact.
AI-Driven Product Leadership
Lead the architecture and delivery of Curiox's next-generation software platform, integrating AI capabilities into unified, workflow-level user experiences.
Define execution models and interface standards that enable scalable, intelligent automation across Curiox's product portfolio.
Work with internal teams and external development partners to translate AI capability into coherent, productized outcomes.
Ensure software product direction is system-driven, not feature-accumulated.
Software-Driven Platform Expansion
Define modular API architecture for third-party robot integration, data pipelines, and partner connectivity.
Define and govern the development of reusable software components across the product portfolio, executed through internal teams and external development partners.
Integrate hardware, consumables, and software logic into a coherent platform.
Enable OEM-friendly architecture to support Curiox's partner-led growth model.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Work closely with R&D (including Engineering and BioApplications), Product, and Commercial teams to align architecture decisions with biological constraints and commercial priorities.
Contribute to leadership discussions on platform strategy, technical roadmap, and long-term scalability.
Operate effectively across globally distributed teams in Asia, the US, and Europe.
Who You Are
Must-Haves
Senior technical leader with 10+ years in systems architecture, platform engineering, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience designing and owning complex multi-layer systems — hardware, software, workflow, or equivalent.
Proven ability to define architecture under ambiguity — before all requirements are finalized.
AI-native operator: experienced using AI as a modeling and requirement-expansion tool, not just an execution aid.
Platform thinker with experience transitioning a product company toward scalable, modular platform architecture.
English proficiency at professional working level — able to lead technical discussions, produce architecture documents, and communicate with global stakeholders.
Experience leading cross-functional technical teams in complex, multi-disciplinary environments.
Background (one or more of the following)
Robotics, automation, or precision instrumentation systems
SaaS platforms with hardware dependencies
Semiconductor, MedTech, or industrial automation systems
Life science instrumentation (advantageous but not required)
Success Profile
Structured thinker who produces clear system models before others have finished defining the problem.
Low ego, high discipline — earns authority through clarity of output, not seniority.
Comfortable challenging the CEO and senior stakeholders constructively, with data and structured reasoning.
Raises architectural standards without destabilizing the existing team.
Documents by default — architecture artifacts, interface contracts, and decision logs are standard outputs, not follow-ups.
Adaptable to a globally distributed, multi-time-zone environment.
Why Join Curiox?
You'll join a team challenging legacy workflows and redefining how modern cell analysis is performed. Curiox values clarity of thinking, learning agility, and impact over hierarchy.
For the right person, this role offers something rare:
Architectural authority from day one. You are not inheriting a finished system. You are defining how a platform that is already in production at leading biopharma accounts gets built for global scale. Your decisions will be visible in the product for years.
Direct access to the CEO and Board. Curiox is a listed company at an inflection point. This role reports directly to the CEO and carries real strategic weight — not a layer removed from where decisions are made.
A physics-based moat worth protecting. C-FREE™ is not a software feature. It is a validated, patent-protected approach to cell handling that no competitor has replicated in 60 years of trying. You are architecting on top of a genuine scientific differentiator.
A platform that is not yet built. The convergence of hardware, software, AI, and cloud orchestration is defined in direction but open in execution. This is an architect's opportunity, not a maintenance role.
A globally distributed, high-caliber team. R&D spans Singapore, Seoul, and Shanghai. Commercial presence extends to the US and Europe. The team is lean, technically deep, and operating at a pace that rewards clarity over politics.

jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
ABOUT NOOKS
Nooks is pioneering Classified-Infrastructure-as-a-Service (CIaaS) — designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We’re growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.
About the Role
You will lead software engineering at Nooks and own the technical vision for everything we build. That covers three things: the software we deliver under government contract, the platform our site teams and internal functions run on, and the AI strategy that shapes both. AI is not a side initiative here. It is in the products that win us contracts, and Nooks intends to be an industry leader in how we leverage modern AI. You will report to the CEO, sit on the executive leadership team, and set direction rather than receive it. You will be building the function while running it. The team is small today, the operating model is yours to define, and the plan for how it scales is a deliverable rather than a given. Priorities will shift as contracts land and as the business grows into new sites and new lines. You will need to hold a durable technical direction while making short-term calls with incomplete information, and you will be expected to bring answers instead of waiting for them.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Organization and Delivery
Lead, develop, and scale a software engineering organization accountable for delivery, quality, security, reliability, and operational outcomes based on internal and external customers
Define the operating model that moves the team from project-based execution to outcome-based ownership, with clear intake, prioritization, and delivery cadence.
Build a strong team through deliberate hiring, training, and retention, developing the engineers you have while adding the capabilities you need.
Establish engineering metrics and reporting that give the executive team real visibility into velocity, quality, AI adoption, and business impact.
AI Strategy and Adoption
Own the AI strategy across Nooks, spanning the AI capabilities in our delivered products and the integration of AI into how the company works.
Drive measurable AI adoption across internal functions, accountable not just for shipping capability but for changing how teams actually operate.
Rebuild how Nooks captures, structures, and retrieves institutional knowledge so expertise scales beyond the people who hold it.
Own AI governance for the software portfolio, including data handling, model use, and evaluation, coordinating with IT/Cyber where network security apply.
Government Contract Delivery and Capture
Own delivery against awarded software contracts, including scope, schedule, technical quality, and customer confidence in our capabilities.
Run awarded work as a managed line with visible economics, owning cost, staffing, and utilization against the commitment (and EBITA expectations).
Represent Nooks engineering and AI capability directly to government customers, in delivery reviews and in pursuit conversations.
Support Growth on software pursuits by shaping technical approach, staffing models, and cost inputs, and by converting delivered work into past performance Nooks can compete on.
Internal Technology Strategy, Platform, and Investment
Set the technology strategy and architecture roadmap for everything the team builds, including systems that may deploy into customer environments.
Own the platform our site teams, Operations, and internal functions depend on to manage our spaces, our members, and our customer contracts.
Make and defend build-versus-buy decisions, integrating commercial systems where they fit and building only where Nooks gains real advantage.
Build the business case for engineering investment, including headcount, tooling, and vendor decisions, and manage the portfolio against it.
What Success Looks Like in This Role

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering - RWD
jobs.text:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments. We believe in our values, Patients First, Quality, Respect, Empowerment & Accountability.
This role will work within our innovative Data & Technology group that continues to evolve to meet business needs, fuel Parexel's growth and enable improved support for stakeholders, including customers and ultimately patients, who will benefit from Parexel's integrated processes and systems.
This role can be based in the UK, Poland or Romania and can be fully home based and remote working anywhere in any of these locations only.
As the Director of Data Engineering - RWD , you'll be a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for enabling Parexel's real-world data movement within the Enterprise Data Lake and delivering standardized operational data products across clinical, safety, and corporate domains. You'll partner with our Data and Technology teams, Data and Analytics Center of Excellence, and business stakeholders to ensure trusted, high-quality, well-governed data with consistent definitions and reliable movement across the enterprise.
What You'll Lead:
Data Lake Engineering & Strategy
Contribute to the strategy, design, and roadmap for our lakehouse architecture based on medallion principles that supports reporting and analytics aligned to operational, clinical, financial, and safety needs
Direct engineering activities across data ingestion, transformation, storage, and optimization within the Enterprise Data Lake
Oversee performance, quality, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of data in the lake environment
Ensure scalable engineering pipelines across data domains, that align with governance requirements
Delivery Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as a subject matter expert in data delivery, aligning data products and services with organizational priorities
Direct cross-functional prioritization and delivery processes to ensure cohesive, timely outcomes
Champion transparency and communication of data technology roadmaps across the organization
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Build, mentor, and direct global data engineering teams to deliver excellence
Champion capability development in cloud engineering, Databricks, CI/CD, SQL, and Python
Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer-focused delivery
What We're Looking For:
Experience & Track Record
Strong advanced level IT experience developing, implementing, and maintaining large-scale enterprise integration services and platforms across multiple hardware and software environments, with substantial expertise in emerging computing architectures
Exposure to Real World Data in the clinical/medical space
Experience with GxP regulations in a life sciences environment advantageous
Deep experience leading teams in data delivery management and execution, including major projects in data management, data integration, and analytics
Strong people and team management experience, including:
Successfully developing and implementing applications in new computing architecture environments using innovative technologies
Managing technical personnel across multiple project lifecycle phases with cross-functional experience
Managing financial resources to achieve goals across multiple projects
Developing efficient and effective solutions to complex business challenges
Technical Expertise
Extensive experience implementing and supporting enterprise data initiatives on cloud platforms
Demonstrated expertise in data and cloud platforms, particularly Azure Databricks
Significant experience with medallion architecture-based data lake implementations
Advanced proficiency in SQL querying and query tuning (mandatory)
Proficiency in modern data management and data-sharing tools, programming languages (especially Python), relational databases, data transformation, and development frameworks
Deep understanding of architectural best practices, application design, and estimation processes
Thorough knowledge of application architectures and enterprise application ecosystems
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (required)
In return we will be able to offer you a structured career pathway and encouragement to develop within the role including awareness and understanding of the industry. You will be well supported and in return for your hard work you will be rewarded with a competitive base salary, bonus, car allowance and holiday as well as other leading benefits you would expect with a top company in the CRO Industry.
Apply today to begin your Parexel journey!

jobs.title: Director of Product, AI (Remote Canada or US)
jobs.text:
Director of Product, AI
Toolbx · Product · Full-time · Remote (USA or Canada) · Reports to VP
About Toolbx
Toolbx is a vertical software platform for the lumber and building materials industry, offering dealers and distributors a suite of tools, from AR and payments to eCommerce and AI-powered ordering. We connect dealers, contractors and suppliers through a commerce layer that actually understands how the industry works, job-site deliveries, trade accounts, ERP-native pricing, mobile-first ordering. The industry is mid-transformation, and we’re the team building the rails it runs on.
Our platform is growing fast. 130+ dealers are live across USA and Canada. 1000s of daily transactions are flowing through our platform. The next chapter is about depth, smarter integrations, AI-driven ordering intelligence, and a product surface that earns contractor loyalty at scale.
The Role
We’re looking for a Director of Product who leads from the front. You’ll own the roadmap, the execution, and the outcomes. You’ll also be the person running discovery calls with dealers, prototyping solutions, and going deep on a thorny integration problem when the situation calls for it. But you won’t do it all manually, you’ll design the system that gets it done, using AI agents and automation alongside your team to maximize output. This is a player-coach role with a builder’s mindset. We have no need for a professional manager.
You’ll report directly to the VP, Strategy & Partnerships and manage a small product team, working alongside a tight-knit cross-functional group spanning engineering, customer success, design, and commercial. You’ll be measured on product velocity and outcomes, not headcount.
What You’ll Own
Product roadmap & platform strategy
Define and drive the roadmap across Toolbx’s core platform, ordering, payments, catalog, integrations, and AI capabilities. Translate market signals, dealer feedback, and internal data into a sequenced plan that balances near-term wins with durable platform value.
Hands-on execution
Lead discovery, prototype solutions, and ship features from concept to launch. You’re not above digging into an edge case in a supported ERP or jumping on a call with a dealer’s IT team. You also know which parts of the product development cycle can be automated and you build those systems. Your team looks to you to model what great product work looks like in an AI-native company. Travelling to meet customers face to face is expected.
AI product development
Own the product surface for Toolbx’s AI-powered ordering automation (AIOA). This is live, it’s differentiating, and it needs a product leader who can take it from early-stage to a core reason dealers choose Toolbx over anyone else.
Integration & ecosystem depth
You’ll own the platform to ERP integration strategy across our dealer ecosystem. Epicor BisTrack, Epicor Eagle, ECI Spruce, DMSI Agility are core supported ERPs. Knowing where to build, where to partner, and where to hold the line is a required skill here.
Team leadership
Manage and develop a team of 2-3 PMs, from near-peer senior level Group Product Managers to early career Associate Product Managers. Give them clarity, remove blockers, and create the conditions for excellent work. Hire well. Coach constantly. Raise the bar on craft without creating bureaucracy.
Cross-functional alignment
Partner closely with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Design to drive execution. Be the person who keeps commercial, technical, and customer perspectives in the same room — and makes a decision when they’re in tension.
Product operations & AI workflows
Design and maintain the operating system for how product work gets done. Build agent-assisted workflows for feature request triage, competitive monitoring, status reporting, and roadmap communication. Accelerate engineering development cycles by automating handoffs, specs, and coordination between product and engineering. Your goal is to run a product function that punches far above its headcount by combining human judgment with AI-driven execution.
What We’re Looking For
8+ years in product management, with meaningful time in complex B2B SaaS or vertical software platforms
3+ years managing PMs, you’ve grown people, not just shipped features
A track record of owning outcomes, not just outputs. You can point to metrics that moved because of decisions you made
Hands-on with AI product development, you know what’s real, what’s hype, and how to ship AI features that earn user trust over time
Experience building AI-assisted workflows for your own team’s operations not just shipping AI features for customers. You’ve used agents, automation, or AI tooling to multiply your team’s output and accelerate product-to-engineering handoffs.
Integration fluency, you’ve navigated ERP, payments, or similarly complex third-party ecosystems and know how to scope without blowing up delivery
Strong discovery instincts, you talk to customers regularly and your roadmap shows it
Exceptional written communicator, your specs are clear, your reasoning is traceable, and your executive updates don’t require a decoder ring
Bias for action; discomfort with ambiguity is disqualifying. You make calls with imperfect information and own the results
Systems thinker you see a product org as a set of workflows to be designed and optimized, not just a team to be managed. You look at how product and engineering collaborate and ask “what can I automate, accelerate, or eliminate?”
Flexibility to travel regularly to interface with our customers at their locations
Nice to Have
LBM or distribution familiarity, the industry has its own language. You’ll learn it either way, but fluency is a head start
Mobile-first product experience, a large share of our customer’s customers are ordering from job sites, not desks
Vertical SaaS or industry cloud background, you’ve built for a buyer who lived in spreadsheets and phone calls before using your product
Early-stage product leadership, you know how to build process that helps without slowing things down
Experience at a company undergoing AI transformation you’ve navigated the shift from traditional to AI-native product development and can bring that playbook to accelerate our engineering and product velocity.
About Us
Toolbx is a fully remote team building an AI-native platform for an industry most SaaS companies have ignored. We move fast and we’re deliberate about it, documentation matters, async is default, and we hire people who can own things without waiting to be told. If you want to build the product operating system for the next generation of LBM technology, we’d like to talk.
Salary: 200K+

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management  - India
jobs.text:
Everything we do is for our customers!
Featured on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 list and G2's leaderboard, Maropost offers a unified commerce experience that our customers need; transforming ecommerce, retail, marketing automation, merchandising, helpdesk and AI operations with one platform designed to scale for fast-growing businesses. With a relentless focus on our customers’ success, we are motivated by customer obsession, extreme urgency, excellence and resourcefulness to power 5,000+ global brands while we head to 100,000+.
Driven by the same customer-centric mentality as above, we empower businesses to achieve their goals and grow alongside us. If you're a driver and not passenger, and are ready to make a significant impact and be part of our transformative journey, Maropost is the place for you.
The Opportunity:
Maropost is looking for a senior Product Leader to own the vision, strategy, and growth of our Commerce Cloud platform.
Reporting to the Chief Product and Technology Officer,this is a high-impact leadership role with responsibility across the commerce experience—from storefront and checkout to catalog, order management, AI, and personalization. You’ll shape a 12–24 month product strategy, lead a talented product organization, and work closely with Engineering and executive leadership to turn customer and market needs into products that drive measurable growth.
This is a remote-first role, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere. To stay connected with the wider team and support strong collaboration, the incumbent will be expected to travel to Maropost’s office in Mohali approximately twice a month for in-person team and leadership sessions.
What You'll Do
Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Commerce Cloud, focused on customer and business outcomes.
Lead and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers and Product Owners.
Identify and deliver opportunities to use AI to transform commerce, including search, merchandising, personalization, and automation.
Partner with Engineering and leaders across Marketing, Merchandising, Service, Sales, and Customer Success to create a unified platform experience.
Stay close to merchants and the market to identify emerging needs, trends, and opportunities.
Define and drive key product metrics including adoption, activation, retention, and GMV impact.
Build a culture of ownership, speed, customer focus, and measurable impact.
What You'll Bring
12+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years leading product teams.
Proven experience building and scaling commerce, ecommerce infrastructure, retail technology, or B2B SaaS products.
Strong experience across areas such as checkout, storefront, catalog/PIM, order management, or related commerce platforms.
A track record of turning AI into real product capabilities and customer outcomes.
Experience hiring, coaching, and developing strong product teams.
Exceptional strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
A strong ownership mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; MBA or technical background is a plus.
Experience with PIM/merchandising, marketplace integrations, AI-powered search, or personalization is a plus.
You exemplify Maropost’s Values:
Customer Obsessed
Extreme Urgency
Excellence
Resourceful
Message from the Founders:Maropost is looking for builders - people who want to drive our business forward at all costs in order to achieve the goals we have both short and long term for the results and outcomes that that will bring to us all.
If that isn't for you that’s ok, for those of you that it is please get in touch with us!

jobs.title: Vice President of Product Management
jobs.text:
Job Overview
We are seeking a multi-skilled Product Marketing & UX Project Manager to lead product strategy and project execution. This individual will be responsible for market positioning, user experience design, Agile/Waterfall project management, and writing epics/user stories to drive product success.
This role requires deep expertise in SaaS product management, digital experience design, and cross-functional team collaboration to bring NexGen Virtual Workplace to market and enhance customer engagement.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Market Strategy & Positioning
Define go-to-market strategies for NexGen Virtual Workplace
Develop product positioning, messaging, and competitive analysis.
Work with marketing and sales teams to create value propositions and product launch plans.
Gather customer insights and market trends to refine the product roadmap.
2. UI/UX Design & User Research
Lead UX/UI strategy, ensuring seamless user experiences.
Conduct user research, usability testing, and feedback analysis.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and design specifications.
Collaborate with developers to ensure design feasibility and implementation.
3. Agile & Waterfall Project Management
Manage product development using Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
Write Epics, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria in Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
Work with engineering, design, and business teams to prioritize and execute sprints.
Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and risk management strategies.
Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, backlog grooming, and sprint planning.
4. Cross-Functional Team Collaboration
Work closely with developers, designers, QA, marketing, and leadership teams.
Drive alignment between business needs, user expectations, and technical feasibility.
Ensure smooth communication between stakeholders and development teams.
5. Data-Driven Decision Making & Continuous Improvement
Analyze customer engagement, conversion rates, and usability metrics.
Use A/B testing and iterative design to improve product experience.
Implement feedback loops to refine product strategy and UX.
Required Skills & Qualifications
5+ years in product management, UX/UI design, and project management (SaaS experience preferred).
Expertise in Agile & Waterfall methodologies, including writing Epics, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
Strong understanding of UX principles, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.
Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Figma, Adobe XD, or similar tools.
Experience launching SaaS products and conducting market research & positioning.
Ability to bridge the gap between business strategy, user needs, and technical development.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Analytical mindset with data-driven decision-making.
Nice-to-Have (Preferred Skills)
Experience with AI-driven UX/UI personalization.
Previous work in B2B SaaS or communication platforms.
Knowledge of customer journey mapping & behavioral analytics.
CcaaS/Contact Center experience a plus
Salary: $80,000 to $120,000

jobs.title: Director of Technology & AI
jobs.text:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY
321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.
Technology isn't a support function at 321 — it's the foundation everything else runs on. Our CRM builds, paid media measurement, AI workflows, and client reporting all depend on systems that are well-architected, secure, and connected. The Director of Technology is the leader who makes that foundation work as one.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Director of Technology at 321, you will lead the agency's technology function across internal systems, MarTech and CRM infrastructure, data and integrations, AI enablement, and information security. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the agency's technology roadmap, set standards for how our platforms are built and governed, and serve as the senior technical voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.
The right person for this role thinks in systems, not tools. You understand that a CRM workflow is only as reliable as the integration feeding it, that clean data is the difference between real attribution and guesswork, and that AI only creates leverage when it's built into the way a team actually works. You're as comfortable reviewing a webhook payload or a High Level workflow as you are presenting a technology roadmap to agency leadership — and you lead a team that delivers both.
You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, ensuring that its technology, data flows, and integrations stay aligned with the systems that power our client programs.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Technology Leadership & Team Development
Lead, manage, and grow the Technology department, including CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration
Own the agency's technology roadmap, aligning platform investments with client delivery needs, agency growth goals, and operational efficiency
Set the department's operating model: build standards, QA and testing practices, documentation requirements, change management, and support processes
Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide technical coaching and actively develop team capabilities
Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
Serve as the escalation point for system outages, integration failures, data issues, and complex technical questions across the client portfolio
Agency Systems, Infrastructure & Security
Own the agency's internal technology stack, including collaboration, project management, identity, file storage, and communication tools
Manage user access, single sign-on, device policies, and account provisioning and offboarding for a fully remote team
Establish and enforce information security policies, password and access standards, backup practices, and incident response procedures
Ensure agency and client systems meet applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Manage technology vendors, licenses, contracts, and costs; evaluate build-versus-buy decisions
MarTech, CRM & Integration Architecture
Set architecture and governance standards for client CRM and marketing automation programs built primarily on High Level, with additional work in Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot
Oversee integrations between CRMs, ad platforms, websites, call tracking, payment processors, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
Standardize snapshots, templates, naming conventions, tagging, and data hygiene practices across client accounts
Lead technical discovery for new client onboarding and CRM migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, and cutover planning
Review complex builds for scalability, reliability, and maintainability before launch
AI Enablement & Automation
Champion the integration of AI across the agency — from internal operations and reporting to CRM personalization, conversational AI, and workflow automation
Evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools and LLM-powered solutions, with clear standards for data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate use
Build and maintain internal automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery quality
Stay current on emerging AI and MarTech capabilities and proactively introduce relevant innovations to the agency and its clients
Data, Analytics & Measurement Infrastructure
Own the agency's data and measurement infrastructure, including conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
Partner with the Director of Digital Marketing to ensure lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting, and audience syndication between CRMs and ad platforms work reliably
Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting infrastructure that feed client dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
Establish data quality standards and monitoring across connected systems
Client Engagement & Agency Growth
Serve as the senior technology authority in client strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — translating technical solutions into clear, business-outcome terms
Contribute technology recommendations, solution architecture, and implementation estimates to agency proposals and RFP responses
Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients and platform needs to ensure technology, data flows, and lead infrastructure are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
Identify opportunities to productize repeatable technology solutions into new agency service offerings
WHAT YOU HAVE
8+ years of experience in technology, MarTech, or systems roles, with demonstrated depth in CRM architecture, integrations, and data infrastructure — agency experience strongly preferred
At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports
Hands-on experience architecting and governing CRM and marketing automation programs in High Level is strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and/or HubSpot experience also valued
Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and middleware (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), including troubleshooting integrations across multiple systems
Strong command of conversion tracking and measurement infrastructure: Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
Working knowledge of data pipelines, data warehousing, and reporting tools (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar)
Experience administering cloud-based business systems, identity and access management, and security for a remote team
Working knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements affecting marketing technology in regulated industries, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Practical experience deploying AI tools and LLM-powered workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and appropriate use
Scripting or development ability in JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar is a strong plus
Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to clients, agency leadership, and non-technical teammates
Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
Platform certifications (High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, cloud or security certifications) are a plus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience
REPORTING STRUCTURE
The Director of Technology reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team. This role directly manages the Technology department, encompassing CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration. The Director of Technology maintains a working relationship with 321 AIM leadership to align platform technology and data infrastructure, and collaborates closely with the Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director on integrated account delivery.
COMPENSATION
Salary Range: $100K+ annually, based on experience
321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, department impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated experience, leadership depth, and technical breadth across CRM, integrations, data, and AI. Performance bonus eligibility applies at the director level.
321 BENEFITS
100% remote work environment
Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
Paid time off + agency-observed holidays
Professional development and platform/tool access budget
Collaborative, AI-forward team culture that values innovation and continuous learning
Opportunity to build and lead the technology foundation of a high-growth agency operating at the intersection of performance marketing and marketing technology
Salary: $100,000+ based on experience

jobs.title: Vice President - Engineering
jobs.text:
R3 Lithium operates North America's first commercial-scale lithium carbonate recovery facility, located in Covington, Georgia. Using a lithium-first extraction process, the company recovers, refines, and returns lithium carbonate from recycled black mass into the battery supply chain for energy storage systems, defense applications, and electric vehicles. Founded in 2026 and privately held, R3 Lithium is headquartered at 9176 Industrial Drive NE, Covington, Georgia. For more information, visit
Position Overview:
The Vice President of Engineering is responsible for key value creation activities in the company. The candidate will have an opportunity to make a significant contribution to the future success of the company by providing outstanding managerial and technical leadership.
As the Vice President of Engineering, you will play a critical role in leading our engineering efforts, overseeing the design, development, and construction of our plants. You will ensure that our engineered materials meet the highest standards of quality and performance while driving strategic initiatives to facilitate our capacity expansion in North America. This role requires a leader with experience in materials and/or chemical engineering, has worked closely with R&D, with project management, with production management, and is a great cross-functional collaborator. This position will report directly to the CEO.
Key Responsibilities:
The Engineering VP will plan and direct all aspects of engineering activities and projects within the organization. The job entails establishing new policies and procedures, as well as ensuring all engineering projects, initiatives, and processes are in conformity with the organization and industry established policies and objectives.
The Engineering VP will utilize best practice engineering methods to provide expert technical guidance for engineering initiatives. The Engineering VP will incorporate all functions related to testing, repair, and maintenance of all equipment to be used in the organization.
Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the company’s goals, particularly focusing on production plant construction.
Project Management: Oversee all engineering projects, ensuring timely completion, adherence to budgets, and alignment with quality standards. Implement best practices in project management and engineering processes.
Team Development: Build and lead a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement. Mentor engineers and provide professional development opportunities.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including R&D, operations, and supply chain, to ensure alignment on project objectives and resource allocation.
Technical Oversight: Provide technical guidance in the development of engineered materials, ensuring they meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in battery materials. Develop appropriate engineering standards, the company’s bill of process and bill of design.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all engineering activities comply with relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations, particularly as we expand internationally.
Budget Management: Develop and manage the engineering budget, identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and performance.
Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership, investors, and regulatory bodies, to represent the engineering perspective and ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or professional engineering, a plus.
20+ years of experience in engineering management, with a focus on battery materials or related industries a plus.
Big company and small company experience, a plus.
Experience translating science level R&D ideas to engineering design packages.
Proven track record of leading large-scale engineering projects, particularly in the construction of manufacturing facilities or mega plants.
Strong knowledge of materials development and testing processes, particularly in the context of battery technologies.
New product introduction experience, a plus
Product certification experience, a plus
Experience in international expansion and understanding of European market dynamics is a plus.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.
What We Offer :
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Participation in the Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).
Opportunity to lead the engineering activities of a high growth company in a new high growth industry.
A collaborative and innovative work environment dedicated to sustainability.

Using a lithium-first extraction process, the company recovers, refines, and returns lithium carbonate from recycled black mass into the battery supply chain for energy storage systems, defense applications, and electric vehicles. Founded in 2026 and privately held, R3 Lithium is headquartered at 9176 Industrial Drive NE, Covington, Georgia. For more information, visit
Position Overview:

The Vice President of Engineering is responsible for key value creation activities in the company. The candidate will have an opportunity to make a significant contribution to the future success of the company by providing outstanding managerial and technical leadership.

As the Vice President of Engineering, you will play a critical role in leading our engineering efforts, overseeing the design, development, and construction of our plants. You will ensure that our engineered materials meet the highest standards of quality and performance while driving strategic initiatives to facilitate our capacity expansion in North America. This role requires a leader with experience in materials and/or chemical engineering, has worked closely with R&D, with project management, with production management, and is a great cross-functional collaborator. This position will report directly to the CEO.
Key Responsibilities:

items: The Engineering VP will plan and direct all aspects of engineering activities and projects within the organization. The job entails establishing new policies and procedures, as well as ensuring all engineering projects, initiatives, and processes are in conformity with the organization and industry established policies and objectives.

The Engineering VP will utilize best practice engineering methods to provide expert technical guidance for engineering initiatives. The Engineering VP will incorporate all functions related to testing, repair, and maintenance of all equipment to be used in the organization.
Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the company’s goals, particularly focusing on production plant construction.

Project Management: Oversee all engineering projects, ensuring timely completion, adherence to budgets, and alignment with quality standards. Implement best practices in project management and engineering processes.

Team Development: Build and lead a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement. Mentor engineers and provide professional development opportunities.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including R&D, operations, and supply chain, to ensure alignment on project objectives and resource allocation.

Technical Oversight: Provide technical guidance in the development of engineered materials, ensuring they meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in battery materials. Develop appropriate engineering standards, the company’s bill of process and bill of design.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all engineering activities comply with relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations, particularly as we expand internationally.
Budget Management: Develop and manage the engineering budget, identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and performance.

Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership, investors, and regulatory bodies, to represent the engineering perspective and ensure alignment with corporate objectives.

items: Bachelor’s degree in Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or professional engineering, a plus.

Experience in international expansion and understanding of European market dynamics is a plus.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Technology & Systems
jobs.text:
About Point Foundation
Point Foundation is the nation's largest scholarship-granting organization for LGBTQ+ and ally students, supporting 1,250 scholars in the 2026-27 academic year. Point provides scholars with financial support, leadership and career development, and a lifelong community of students, alumni, and leaders in every field and industry.
Point’s mission is to support the educational aspirations of LGBTQ+ and ally students to become impactful leaders in their lives, careers, and communities. Point is proud to be a top-rated nonprofit by watchdog groups including Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and the Better Business Bureau.
We pursue excellence in all we do and are building for scale - growing the number of scholars we serve, expanding leadership and career development opportunities, and innovating on the systems and technology that let a nimble team reach further every year.
Position Overview
Point Foundation seeks a visionary, innovative, and experienced Sr. Director, Technology & Systems to build the technology foundation that will carry Point into its next chapter of growth. This is a rare opportunity to own technology end-to-end at a prominent national organization. The Sr. Director will set the multi-year roadmap, serve as Point's internal authority on technology investment, and act as a trusted advisor and technical coach to leaders across Point’s Program and Development departments as they seek out the right technology to accelerate and streamline their work. This is also a chance to lead on AI: deciding where it genuinely creates capacity for a nimble team and bringing staff along, so new tools are actually adopted. For a leader who wants scope, real influence with the executive team, and a mission worth building for, this role offers all three.
Reports to: Chief Operating Officer - Kevin Wright
Status: Full-time, exempt
Supervises: Technology & Systems direct report(s); retained IT and technology vendors and consultants
Location: Remote position based in the greater Los Angeles area. Occasional in-person meetings and events require candidates to be located in, or willing to relocate to, the L.A. area. Relocation assistance available.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Technology Strategy & Roadmap:
Own Point's technology roadmap and strategy, developing a multi-year plan that translates organizational growth goals into a coherent systems and infrastructure strategy.
Serve as the internal authority on major technology decisions, investments, and implementations, bringing clear recommendations and trade-offs to the COO.
Evaluate the current tech stack end-to-end and sequence investments to systems scale with the organization rather than accumulating one at a time.
Manage the technology budget, allocating resources across vendors, licenses, staff, and projects with fiscal accountability.
Establish and maintain organization-wide standards for how technology is evaluated, procured, and implemented.
Report on technology performance, risk, and roadmap progress to senior leadership and the Board as needed.
Organizational Technology Strategy & Advisory:
Advise Program Operations and Development Operations on data governance, CRM strategy, and cybersecurity, partnering with those directors to identify and implement the right tools for their needs.
Establish organization-wide data standards, ensuring clean, consistent, and well-governed data across Program, Development, and Finance systems.
Set cybersecurity policy and hold departments and vendors accountable to it, including training, access management, and incident response.
IT Vendor Management & Infrastructure:
Own the relationship with Point's retained IT vendor(s) and additional technology vendors, setting KPIs and holding them accountable for support, security, and value delivered.
Lead RFP, selection, and contract negotiation processes for technology vendors, consultants, and platforms.
Oversee day-to-day IT infrastructure and support - cloud collaboration environments, hardware, access, and business continuity - so a nimble staff is well supported.
Continually evaluate the balance between in-house capability and external vendor support as the organization grows.
AI Adoption, Change Management & Team Leadership:
Lead AI integration across the organization, identifying where AI tools can meaningfully improve efficiency - and where they should not be used.
Lead the training and change management needed for staff to adopt AI tools effectively and responsibly, including usage policy and risk guardrails.
Lead organizational change management for new systems and processes, ensuring tools and workflows are genuinely adopted across departments, not just implemented.
Lead, coach, and develop direct report(s), building internal capacity so technology knowledge is not concentrated in a single person.
Translate technical decisions into terms non-technical department leaders can act on and rally around.
Requirements
8-10+ years in technology or systems leadership, including at least 3-5 years at a senior or director level owning technology strategy at a nonprofit or an organization going through significant growth or scaling.
Demonstrated project management experience, running multi-stakeholder initiatives with competing timelines through to completion.
Vendor and contract management experience, including running RFP processes for technology consultants and vendors.
Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce, Blackbaud, or equivalent) and cloud collaboration environments such as Microsoft 365.
Hands-on experience evaluating and deploying AI tools in an organizational setting, including adoption, training, and risk.
Proven ability to lead technology strategy cross-functionally, translating technical decisions into terms non-technical department leaders can act on and rally around.
Working knowledge of data governance and cybersecurity policy, standards, and practice.
Cross-functional leadership: able to manage up, down, and across a complex organization, and to manage internal staff and external vendors alike.
Intellectual curiosity and drive to stay current on best-in-class technology and systems practices.
Strong executive presence and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leadership and the Board.
Highly organized and deadline-driven, managing multiple high-priority projects in a fast-paced environment.
Discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive organizational and constituent data.
Passionate about Point's mission and enthusiasm about communicating the organization's philosophy, mission, and values.
Commitment to advancing equity and inclusion in all areas of responsibility and across the organization.
Preferred: experience with Claude or comparable AI platforms; experience managing and deploying enterprise-level software across an organization; and a security certification (such as CISSP) or project management certification (PMP).
Core Competencies - Our Ways of Working
Ownership: Owns outcomes, not just tasks. Follows through on commitments or proactively resets expectations, and raises issues early and directly.
Learn & Adapt: Stays curious and self-aware. Seeks feedback, reflects on impact, and applies learnings as conditions change.
Focus & Excellence: Prioritizes the highest-impact work, delivers consistent high-quality results, and makes tradeoffs visible and intentional.
Trust & Belonging: Builds relationships grounded in respect, honesty, and inclusion. Engages candidly, assumes good intent, and addresses issues constructively.
Collaborate for Scale & Growth: Clarifies roles and handoffs, shares information transparently, commits to decisions once made, and designs sustainable, repeatable systems over "boutique" solutions.
Compensation and Accommodations
Pay range: $165,000 - $190,000/year. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus based on performance. Our total compensation goes well beyond salary: Point pays 100% of employee health insurance premiums, with coverage for dependents available at additional cost. Our full benefits package also includes a 403(b) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 3%.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Accommodations: we want the process to work for you. If you need an accommodation at any stage - application, screen, interview, or work sample - tell your recruiter. Accommodations are offered proactively and are honored at every later stage.
The purpose of this job description is to provide an overview of the scope of the position. This is not a comprehensive list of duties and responsibilities.
Salary: $165,000 - $190,000/year

jobs.title: Director of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
About Modular Solutions
Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers enterprise-grade technology to the insurance industry. Our configurable platform helps insurers, mutuals, MGAs, and brokers manage core operations through a single system designed for flexibility, long-term growth, and complex regulated environments.
Position Summary
Modular Solutions is seeking a Director of Data & Analytics to own the architecture and governance of our data and analytics platform and how our data is turned into decisions, so that the data we collect becomes reporting and answers that clients and teams can trust as we continue to grow our platform, client base, and internal capabilities.
Reporting to the CTO, this role leads the Data function, including data engineering, data science, business intelligence, analytics, and migration, and owns the architecture of the data and analytics platform that connects them. While the data and analytics platform is the primary focus, the role also contributes to and collaborates on the data architecture and design of our core application alongside our Product and Development teams.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who sets direction and stays close to the work: designing the analytics data architecture, data models, and semantic layer alongside engineers rather than managing from a distance. You should bring deep experience in data architecture, data modelling, BI and analytics, and data governance, with a working knowledge of data migration and AI-enabled workflows, along with the ability to lead people, prioritize work, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
This role is well suited for someone who can build structure, develop teams, improve processes, and help Modular responsibly adopt data and AI practices that create real value for clients, employees, and the platform.
Key Responsibilities
Set the data strategy and long-term roadmap for the Data function, including platforms, vendors, budget, and cost, and build a high-performing team across data engineering, BI and analytics, and data migration.
Own the data and analytics platform architecture: the target-state design for how data flows out of our application into ingestion and pipelines, the data warehouse and data marts, the semantic layer, and the BI and AI tools that consume them, supported by reference architectures and documented architecture decisions.
Define and maintain the analytics data model for insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, bordereaux, brokers, and coverage, aligned with the application's data model, so that migration, reporting, and analytics map to it consistently.
Collaborate with Product and Development on the data architecture and design of our core application: bring a data perspective to schema and data model design, assess the downstream impact of changes, favour incremental improvements over large-scale redesign, and establish data contracts so that application changes do not break reporting, integrations, or client deliverables.
Own metric governance: a single set of business definitions and KPIs with clear owners, implemented once in the semantic layer and consumed consistently by BI, client reporting, and AI.
Design how clients access their reporting and analytics data, including governed data sharing and extracts, partnering with product engineering where access runs through application APIs, with appropriate tenant isolation, security, and performance.
Set standards for data quality, governance, privacy, security, and data residency, including PII classification, retention, lineage, and access control, in support of our security and compliance programs.
Establish a data quality and validation framework, including automated reconciliation, testing, and certification of trusted datasets and AI-generated outputs, so that our teams and clients can trust results at scale.
Define the reporting operating model for standard and client-specific reporting, including intake and prioritization, move clients toward governed self-service analytics, and deliver executive-level insights and advanced analytics, such as forecasting, where they create clear business value.
Build data migration and onboarding into a repeatable capability, with a reusable conversion framework, reconciliation, and post-migration validation, led by a dedicated migration lead.
Build AI-ready data foundations so that AI features call governed data and semantic models rather than calculating on their own, lead AI adoption within the Data team, and help define the product direction for self-service and AI-assisted analytics.
Partner with Product, Development, Implementation, Operations, and leadership to align priorities, and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to executives.
Perform other duties as required to support the Data function.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, or a related data field, including designing data platforms or data models at an organizational level.
3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams, while remaining hands-on in the work.
Proven experience designing enterprise data architecture, including data models, data warehouses and marts, ETL/ELT pipelines, semantic models, and the integration between operational systems and analytics platforms, with a track record of collaborating with application engineering teams on data design and improving existing systems incrementally.
Hands-on experience building and governing business definitions, metrics, or semantic models, and working directly with engineers to implement them.
Strong grounding in data governance, data quality, privacy, and security, including access control, PII handling, lineage, and validation of data and reporting outputs.
Experience leading data migration, data conversion, or reconciliation initiatives.
Strong technical knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and cloud data platforms, with experience in tools such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Python, or similar technologies. Familiarity with C# or TypeScript is an asset.
Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day work, and the ability to encourage and support their use across a team, with sound judgment on accuracy, privacy, and security.
Experience designing KPI frameworks and delivering executive-level reporting, with strong data visualization and storytelling skills.
Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technical direction and technical concepts into clear business language, and to set standards and repeatable operating models across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies.
Preferred Qualifications
Background in the insurance, InsurTech, SaaS, financial services, or other complex regulated environments.
Familiarity with insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, broker, customer, coverage, risk, transaction, or reporting data.
Previous involvement in AI adoption, AI enablement, or AI transformation initiatives within a software, data, or product organization.
Hands-on exposure to AI-powered internal tools, workflow automation, document analysis, reporting automation, data validation, or agentic systems.
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS data architectures, client data sharing, or data residency requirements.
Proven ability to partner with Product, Development, Implementation, and executive leadership teams to align data and AI initiatives with business priorities.
Familiarity with Agile delivery tools and practices, including Azure DevOps, Jira, Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.
Ability to scale teams, hire technical talent, and support career growth for data and AI professionals.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
A documented target-state analytics data architecture and data model, with a roadmap agreed with business and engineering leadership.
A governed semantic layer in production for our released data marts, serving as the single source of business definitions for reporting and AI.
Automated validation in place for key client reporting, including bordereaux, replacing manual checking.
A repeatable data migration framework, with a dedicated migration lead in place.
A clear reporting operating model and a plan for client self-service analytics.
Our Technology Stack and Architecture:
Our core platform uses C#/.NET, Entity Framework, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, and Azure, with Snowflake as our data warehouse. This role partners with product engineering teams on system logic, database structures, APIs, and platform requirements related to data architecture, migration, BI, the semantic layer, data quality, and automation workflows.
Why Join Modular Solutions?
We are building a long-term platform in a complex industry where customers depend on accurate data every day. You will shape how Modular architects its data and turns it into trusted reporting and answers for clients: designing the analytics data architecture, defining what the numbers mean, and building the semantic layer alongside a strong engineering team, while making migration and BI work cleaner, faster, and more AI-enabled as we grow. We value autonomy, accountability, strong technical judgment, and people who take pride in building production-grade systems the right way.
What We Offer
Be part of a growing company building a modern, enterprise-grade platform for the insurance industry.
Work alongside experienced insurance and technology professionals in a collaborative environment.
Flexible remote work environment, with a preference for Alberta-based team members, and periodic in-person planning sessions and team events.
Extended health, dental, and vision benefits.
Access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program.
Annual professional development allowance.
Additional paid time off beyond standard statutory holidays and vacation.
Recognition for meaningful contributions and career milestones.
Share Appreciation Rights program so you participate in the company’s long-term success.
To Apply:
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and what excites you about this opportunity. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
