jobs.title: Sr. Director, eDiscovery Technology & AI
jobs.text:
KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. The eDiscovery Technology practice is where those clients meet advanced analytics and AI: technology-assisted review, generative AI classification for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and the non-standard workflows that turn a hard matter into a defensible, efficient one. Clients across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia Pacific are asking how to use AI in discovery and how to defend it, each under their own rules. This practice answers them everywhere KLD operates.
The Senior Director, eDiscovery Technology leads that practice globally. You will lead a team of technologists and consultants across time zones, own the methodology and defensibility of every AI-assisted workflow we deliver, partner with Advisory to package and price the consulting offerings they sell, and sit at the table with Product and Engineering as we build AI review into our own platform. This is applied legal technology leadership rather than a software engineering role, and a legal background is preferred.
We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $156,000 to $195,000.
What you will do
Lead the eDiscovery Technology practice
Lead a team of eDiscovery technologists and consultants who design and run advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows on client matters, including technology-assisted review and continuous active learning, generative AI review for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and custom workflow design for non-standard tools and data.
Run the practice on a billable model: request intake, scoping, staffing, utilization, quality, and turnaround, against a demand curve that is growing fast.
Run it as one global practice, with one intake, one standard, and one set of playbooks across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Build follow-the-sun handoffs so a matter started in London or Hong Kong is picked up cleanly in the US, and partner with regional Operations leaders on staffing, skills, and coverage.
Grow the practice. Hire, onboard, and develop a manager, consultants, and technologists as demand expands, and build a career path from technologist to consultant to lead.
Build the operating rhythm: intake standards, capacity forecasting, coverage for second-shift, weekend, and deadline-driven work, quality standards, and playbooks so every matter gets the same standard regardless of who staffs it.
Own the methodology and its defensibility
Own how KLD applies analytics and AI to review: TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, generative AI classifiers for relevance and privilege, prompt design and iteration, validation statistics (recall, precision, elusion), and the documentation that makes the result defensible.
Serve as the senior subject matter expert for clients and counsel on AI-assisted review: scoping, protocol support, validation design, and explaining results in plain language to lawyers who have to sign their name to them.
Build reusable playbooks, prompt libraries, validation templates, and reporting so quality lives in the practice rather than in any one person.
Own AI governance for client matters with Legal and InfoSec: client data boundaries, client-specific AI restrictions, privilege protections, and audit trail, applied consistently across every tool the practice uses.
Adapt the methodology to the jurisdiction without lowering the standard: US TAR and GenAI case law and protocols, UK disclosure practice, GDPR and UK data protection, cross-border transfer and data residency limits, and APAC requirements, so the same playbook is defensible in every region where we run it.
Co-own the consulting offerings with Advisory
Partner with Advisory and Sales to define, package, and price the AI and analytics consulting offerings they sell: what we offer, how it is scoped, what it costs to deliver, and what margin it carries.
Supply the technical authority in pursuits Advisory leads across regions: pre-sales calls, RFP responses, pilots, and client education sessions for US, UK, European, and APAC clients and law firms.
Move the practice from reactive technical support toward productized consulting with clear deliverables, pricing, and outcomes.
Track offering revenue, attach rate, billable utilization, revenue per consultant per week, and margin, and report them into the weekly and monthly business reviews.
Partner with Product and Engineering
Serve as the practice’s voice into KLD’s own AI review capabilities: requirements, pilot design, operational readiness, adoption, and the feedback loop from client matters back to the roadmap.
Evaluate and adopt third-party analytics and AI tools, run structured comparisons, and own the practice’s vendor relationships and licensing.
Work with Process Engineering to encode repeatable workflows into automation and AI skills so the team’s time goes to judgment rather than mechanics.
Lead clients and cross-functional partners
Act as the senior technical voice for Client Success, Sales, and clients in every region on complex matters, escalations, and methodology questions, including cross-border matters that span more than one jurisdiction.
Represent the practice externally with a clear point of view on AI in discovery, thought leadership, and industry presence.
Lead with KLD’s values: Client is Always in the Room, Better Every Day, Own the Outcome, and Deliver Results Together.
What you bring
Required:
10+ years in eDiscovery or litigation technology, including 5+ years applying advanced analytics and AI-assisted review on client matters and 3+ years leading a team.
Deep hands-on expertise in TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, and generative AI review (Relativity aiR, eDiscovery AI, or equivalent), including prompt design, validation statistics, and defensibility documentation. Working command of Relativity and RelativityOne.
A client-facing record: you have scoped, defended, and explained AI-assisted review to counsel and clients, supported protocol negotiations, and handled the hard questions.
Multi-jurisdiction experience: you have delivered analytics or AI-assisted review on matters outside the US or for non-US clients, and you understand GDPR, cross-border data transfer constraints, and how disclosure practice in the UK, EU, or APAC differs from US discovery.
Commercial fluency: you have packaged or priced consulting work, partnered with sales on pursuits, and can explain utilization and margin to a CFO.
Product partnership experience as the operational or practitioner voice on AI feature design, pilots, or adoption.
A record of building and developing a technical consulting team, including growing leads into managers and leading people across time zones.
A direct, clear communication style. You can explain recall and elusion to a general counsel and to a first-year technologist in the same afternoon.
Experience in PE-backed or high-growth environments where pace and accountability are the norm.
Preferred:
Legal degree (JD or equivalent); bar admission a plus.
Structured analytics experience (Brainspace, Reveal, or similar).
Declaration or testimony experience on review methodology.
Relativity certifications, CEDS, or equivalent.
Our mission and core values:
We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.
Client is Always in the Room. We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.
Better Every Day. We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.
Own the Outcome. We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other.
Deliver Results Together. We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.
Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

jobs.title: Interim Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Who are we?
StoryToys, an independent subsidiary of Team17 Group plc, is a premier, award-winning developer and publisher of interactive educational apps designed to help children learn, play, and grow. We collaborate with the world’s most recognizable entertainment giants—including The LEGO Group, The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Entertainment, Mattel, and BBC Studios—to bring beloved characters like Bluey, Peppa Pig, and Barbie into engaging digital worlds.
Our global success spans all major distribution networks, amassing over 300 million app downloads and reaching millions of active families worldwide in up to 28 different languages. While headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, our internal team of over 130 professionals operates alongside a vast, highly agile global network of creators.
About the role
StoryToys is looking for an interim Head of Engineering to lead the engineering department behind our portfolio of award-winning children's mobile games.
This role is responsible for the performance and growth of our engineering function, ensuring teams can consistently deliver high-quality and engaging mobile experiences for children and families around the world. This is a product-focused role requiring deep experience in Unity, building and maintaining mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a senior engineering leader with a passion for mobile app development and an interest in children's play to join our dynamic and growing team.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Product
jobs.text:
Atria is a membership-based preventive health care practice delivering cutting-edge primary and specialty care in New York, South Florida, Los Angeles (2026), and through 24/7 telemedicine globally.
Our multi-specialty team of 60+ top in-house physicians provides proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. We aim to optimize lifespan and healthspan through meticulous screening, leading-edge therapeutics, and tailored interventions designed to prevent disease and detect it at the earliest possible stages.
Each member's care is led by a dedicated Chief Medical Officer who collaborates with specialists in cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, women's health, endocrinology, integrative health, performance and movement, nutrition, and more.
Through our nonprofit Atria Research Institute and Public Health Institute, we also work to accelerate the translation of medical breakthroughs and expand access to preventive care for as many people as possible.
About this role:
You will lead Product Engineering, the three teams that build everything our members, clinicians and care teams use:
Member Experience: registration, the member portal and the mobile app
Clinical Experience: the patient dashboard, results and clinical AI
Care Delivery: scheduling, the care calendar and clinician task management
The role is hands-on: you will work fluently in the AI-assisted workflows our engineers use every day to generate, review, and deploy code.
Tech Stack
Languages: TypeScript
Backend: Node, Express
Frontend: React, Honeypot SDK
Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform
Database: MySQL (migrating to Postgres)
Tooling & Integrations: Github, Sentry, Okta, Mixpanel, Omni, third-party APIs
Key Responsibilities
Product & Delivery
Lead the Member Experience, Clinical Experience and Care Delivery squads, and own their delivery: plans, priorities and predictable shipping at a high quality bar.
Work with Product, Design and clinical leaders to turn unclear problems into clear technical plans and roadmaps.
Drive system design for the core product areas that keep the platform reliable, HIPAA-compliant, and speed up future work.
Stay hands-on: write, review and ship code using the AI-assisted workflows the team uses every day.
Quality, Observability & Analytics
Set testing and code-review standards across Product Engineering, including how AI-generated code is reviewed and governed.
Make sure features ship with consistent observability (Mixpanel, Datadog, Sentry)

jobs.title: Technology and Operations Director
jobs.text:
ABOUT Resources Legacy Fund (RLF):
Resources Legacy Fund builds the architecture behind lasting environmental progress. From climate resilience to land and water conservation to community well-being, we help visionary ideas take shape—offering the steady support and strategic know-how to turn complex challenges into collective victories.
We deliver transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We also host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide.
Addressing three interconnected crises — climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental injustice — requires creativity, collaboration, and fast reflexes. With deep operational expertise and the confidence of donors and partners, we enable lasting solutions to rise.
Position Summary:
The Technology and Operations Director is responsible for ensuring RLF, FBF, and SAF have the technology, operations, and systems needed to support their missions.
Reporting to the Chief of Staff and Operations and serving as a member of the leadership team, the Technology and Operations Director provides strategic leadership over information technology and cybersecurity, with a particular focus on building a vision for and moving large-scale technology and systems projects from concept to completion. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to the organization and its fiscally sponsored projects, bringing an operational and technology lens to organizational decision-making. They balance innovation, flexibility, and speed with security, discipline, and care, helping RLF grow and deliver complex grantmaking and fiscal sponsorship services, support a “remote-first” staff, and achieve programmatic outcomes.
This is a full-time, exempt position that can be performed remotely within the U.S. Travel is required quarterly for meetings, conferences, and staff retreats.
Duties Include:
Technology & Systems Leadership
• Serve as the organization's lead on major technology and systems initiatives.
• Develop and align long-term technology and operational goals and projects with organizational objectives and strategy; build the roadmaps, timelines, and change-management plans needed to deliver them.
• Serve as a cross-functional partner to other directors and fiscally sponsored project staff in selecting and utilizing tech platforms.
• Manage technology to support evolving business needs; maintain knowledge of emerging trends and tools to enhance productivity.
• Identify new operational system needs, including systems and processes to support connectivity in a remote-first workplace.
• Manage information technology contractors and support services.
• Oversee CRM/database (Salesforce) design, maintenance, and management, in partnership with the Director of Grants Management and the Director of Development.
• Advance the technological fluency of staff.
Cybersecurity and Risk Management
• Devise security policies, procedures, hardware, and software solutions to mitigate cybersecurity and other enterprise risks.
• Drive data privacy compliance and business continuity/disaster recovery planning.
• Advise organizational leadership on technology strategy, operational risk, and resource allocation.
• In compliance with RLF policies and procedures, perform technological tasks necessary for the protection of data.
Facilities Oversight
• Oversee staff managing the RLF satellite office in Sacramento and approximately five additional leases.
• Oversee staff managing co-working locations.
• Play a supportive role on staff retreats and other in-person connections.
• In collaboration with Human Resources, oversee RLF's health and safety programs.
Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Provide oversight and management of RLF's technology and operations budget.
• Serve as a member of the organizational Leadership Team.
• Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure technology and operational solutions serve the varied needs of each team.
• Act as a trusted advisor and translator between technical/operational teams and non-technical staff and leadership.
Qualifications:
Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work and lived experiences that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.
• 10+ years leading and managing technology and/or operations teams, with at least 5 years in a director-level or above role; nonprofit or mission-driven sector experience preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to move complex technology and systems projects from planning through implementation and adoption (e.g., ERP, CRM/Salesforce, financial systems, infrastructure migrations) at organizations of comparable size (50–200 staff) or larger.
• Experience leading the development and implementation of an organization-wide cybersecurity/data protection policy, with direct experience managing security incidents, vendor risk assessments, and compliance with relevant data protection standards.
• Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing enterprise software platforms, including grants management systems or other CRMs; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
• 3+ years experience preferred working with a fiscal sponsor organization or comparable multi-entity structure, with direct exposure to how technology, operations, and facilities needs vary across sponsored projects with distinct programs, funding sources, and compliance requirements.
• Experience managing vendor relationships/contracts (IT, real estate, professional services) with demonstrated negotiation outcomes.
• Experience directly supervising staff and teams.
• Ability to handle sensitive personnel or organizational matters.
• Experience presenting to or advising senior leadership/board-level audiences.
• Experience operating in a remote-first or hybrid and growth-stage organization.
• A commitment to a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel welcomed, valued, and respected.
• Positive attitude and a commitment to being part of and building a positive work environment.
Commitment to Nondiscrimination:
We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.
Compensation and Benefits:
The anticipated salary range for the Technology and Operations Director is $180,000 - $210,000 annually. The final offer will depend on work location, experience, and job-related qualifications.
We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule and offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.
To Apply:
Please provide a resume and cover letter explaining how your skills fit this position.
Recruitment Schedule
October 19th – Recruitment launches
November 2nd – Priority application deadline (applications received after this date may still be considered)
November 9th – Screening Interviews
RLF participates in E-Verify, potential candidates can review the information here and here.

jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
About the role
We are currently hiring a Field CTO to join our Strategic Field Organization at a Principal Solutions Architect level to be based in Australia or Singapore. This role reports into our Global Head, Field CTOs. The Strategic Field Organization is a team of Principal Solutions Architects that supports global strategic prospects and customers. This team collaborates with the regional account teams to work together on large engagements that require a high degree of strategic planning - such as DevSecOps transformation, solution recommendations, and advisory for our customer's senior technical leadership.
Field Solutions Architects (SA) are the trusted advisors to GitLab prospects and customers during the presales motion. We demonstrate how the GitLab platform and GitLab Professional Services address common and unique business requirements. Our Solution Architect team adds value to GitLab's customers by providing subject matter expertise and industry experience throughout the sales process and collaborating internally with the product.
Our Field SA's also engage proactively with existing GitLab customers to provide thought-leadership, engage in innovative solutions, collaborate around evangelism activities around unique customer requirements (i.e. meetups and presentations) and continuously seek market feedback to improve the GitLab platform.
What you'll do
Create and maintain relationships with customer executives that contribute to large Net ARR deals and customer success
Provide executive-level, thought leadership on strategic opportunities (i.e., new logo and growth)
Curate and manage field feedback, while collaborating with the product team on roadmap and issue prioritization
Scale and grow regional-level expertise within the field (SAE/AE,SA,CSM) through contributions to enablement and content
Act as a prospect / customer advocate on DevSecOps transformation initiatives
Build and maintain select subject matter expertise related to GitLab targeted technology sectors through industry monitoring and participation in external working groups, committees and development projects
Keep up to date on GitLab-relevant emerging methodologies and technologies and leverage that knowledge to drive solution strategy and influence product strategy
What you'll bring
Significant experience as a CTO/ Principal Solution Architect with architecture of enterprise software development workflow
Experience delivering information/Cyber Security and compliance related solutions and assessments
Experience with software development tools, practices, and methodologies
Strong verbal and written skills with a strong ability to articulate and communicate strategies to all levels in an organization (i.e., executive to staff engineer)
Ability and willingness to learn and use GitLab as an integral part of the role
Ability to travel and comply with the company’s travel policy

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave
Home office support

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product
jobs.text:
About Tekmetric
Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.
Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.
Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.
But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.
Working the Tekmetric Way
At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.
We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.
We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.
Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.
What You’ll Do
The Senior Director of Product Management will be a thought leader who can drive strategy, innovation, and execution.We’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit, a creative problem-solver, and a strategic thinker who can take a bold approach to product development
Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision
Define and communicate a compelling product vision and multi-year strategy aligned to company goals.
Identify new opportunities across customer segments, markets, and workflows—balancing innovation with strong business fundamentals.
Lead annual and semi-annual product planning cycles, ensuring clear prioritization and resource alignment.
Leadership & Team Development
Directly lead multiple Directors/Group PMs and indirectly oversee the entire PM organization.
Recruit, coach, and mentor a high-performing PM team with a strong emphasis on accountability, customer insight, and product excellence.
Establish consistent product management standards, operating rhythms, rituals, and evaluation frameworks across teams.
Execution & Delivery

blocks.text: About Tekmetric
Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.
Working the Tekmetric Way
At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
VP, Product
Role Overview
Ad Results Media (ARM) is building the next-generation operating platform that powers how the agency plans, buys, measures, and reports across audio and emerging channels. Internally known as the ARM Suite, this platform unifies order management, finance connectivity, and — over time — planning, buying, communications, and measurement into a single environment used by ARM, our clients, and our network partners.
We are seeking a Vice President, Product to serve as the internal product owner of the ARM Suite. This role is responsible for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and governance. The VP, Product will partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Client Services to translate agency and client needs into a durable, scalable product.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. The VP, Product will set long-term product direction while operating in the day-to-day decisions that shape how ARM Suite is built, governed, and adopted.
Platform Ownership & Impact
ARM Suite is transitioning from a vendor-led build to an internally owned product. This role mitigates vendor dependency risk, restores institutional knowledge, and ensures the platform evolves in alignment with how ARM actually wins, retains, and grows business.
The VP, Product will be accountable for ARM Suite as a product — not as a collection of features, dashboards, or vendor deliverables. That means owning the charter, defining what the platform is (and is not), establishing a prioritization framework, and making the trade-offs required to ship a durable system rather than a set of bespoke responses to internal requests.
ARM Suite is, at its core, an API-driven platform. It depends on durable pipelines to media buying systems, measurement partners, finance, network partners, and client-side data sources to keep users in ARM’s environment rather than dependent on parallel tools. The VP, Product owns the API and integration strategy that makes this possible.
Key Responsibilities
Product Vision & Roadmap
Be accountable for the end-to-end product vision and multi-year roadmap for the ARM Suite, including order management, finance connectivity, planning, buying, communications, and measurement workflows.
Translate ARM’s commercial strategy, client needs, and partner relationships into a clear product narrative and sequenced roadmap.
Define what ARM Suite is, what it is not, and what “done” looks like at each phase, with explicit trade-offs documented for leadership.
Own ARM Suite’s API and integration strategy, including API pipelines into media platforms, measurement partners, finance and billing systems, network partners, and third-party enrichment sources that keep users inside ARM Suite.
Vendor Reduction & Internal Capability Building
Lead the structured reduction of third-party dependency by extracting institutional knowledge, documenting business rules, and transitioning ownership of roadmap and prioritization in-house.
Review and approve product designs, scope, and delivery plans proposed by vendors; ensure work aligns to ARM’s long-term roadmap
Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure clean separation between platform design (Product) and data correctness and pipeline ownership (Engineering / Analytics).
Governance, Prioritization & Intake
Establish and operate a product-governed intake and prioritization framework that replaces ad hoc requests with a defensible, transparent process — while preserving fast paths for revenue-critical work.
Define and enforce the authority split between Product (system design and prioritization) and Analytics (metric definitions, QA, and interpretation).
Document and socialize standards for product decisions, business rules, and platform constraints so they persist beyond individual contributors.
Partner with Analytics to operationalize a formal QA delegation model within ARM Suite intake and delivery workflows.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as a trusted partner to Analytics & Insights, Reporting, Data Science, Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Client Services.
Bridge the gap between platform capability and agency workflows, ensuring product decisions reflect how ARM teams actually plan, buy, and report.
Influence and align senior leaders on roadmap sequencing, trade-offs, and investment cases without relying on positional authority alone.
Build a product practice over time — starting solo, with a clear path to scale through hires and contributors as the platform matures.
Client & Partner Orientation
Ground product decisions in real client and network-partner needs through structured exposure to top-revenue accounts, partner conversations, and pitch motions.
Ensure ARM Suite produces standardized, credible artifacts for sales, planning, and renewal motions rather than bespoke, one-off deliverables.
Position ARM Suite as a durable differentiator that creates switching costs and supports long-term client retention and expansion.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Required Experience
10+ years of product management experience, including senior product leadership (Director, Sr. Director, or VP) at a SaaS, agency-tech, ad-tech, mar-tech, or analytics platform company.
Demonstrated experience owning a B2B platform or product line end-to-end — vision, roadmap, prioritization, governance, and stakeholder management.
Track record of leading internal product ownership through transitions away from third-party engineering vendors, contractors, or outsourced build partners.
Experience operating in environments that combine internal teams with external engineering partners, with a clear philosophy on what should be owned in-house vs. outsourced.
Deep, hands-on capability with API-driven product design — including standing up API pipelines, integrating third-party data sources for user-facing enrichment, and shipping products built on APIs from scratch.
Preferred Experience
Prior experience in media, advertising, agency, ad-tech, or mar-tech environments, with an understanding of planning, buying, measurement, and client reporting.
Familiarity with order management, finance/billing connectivity, and workflow tools that span multiple internal stakeholders.
Broad working knowledge of APIs across the advertising, media, and ad-tech ecosystem (e.g., DSPs, programmatic platforms, measurement and attribution partners, audio and CTV systems), with a track record of using them to extend product capability.
Comfort working closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Data Science functions; able to engage substantively on data models, BI tooling, and measurement frameworks without owning them.
Experience standing up product governance, intake frameworks, and prioritization processes in organizations transitioning from ad hoc to durable operating models.
Personal Attributes
Strong communicator and executive-level storyteller; can move comfortably between vendor architecture reviews, leadership strategy discussions, and client-facing conversations.
Pragmatic and business-oriented, with an appreciation for balancing ideal product strategy with real-world commercial and operational constraints.
High ownership mindset; comfortable being the only product leader in the room and building the function from the ground up.
Collaborative, curious, and motivated by building durable systems that compound the value of every team they touch.
Ad Results Media is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe strong product organizations are built at the intersection of operational excellence, business judgment, and a deep understanding of how teams and clients actually work.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
About DemandBridge
DemandBridge builds the ERP and e-commerce software that print, promotional products, and marketing-services distributors run their businesses on, from order entry and inventory to procurement and online storefronts. Hundreds of distributors across North America rely on our platform to serve their clients faster, keep costs under control, and grow.
DemandBridge is part of Fluent Software Group (a Valsoft Corporation operating group), a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. We focus on specialized industries where expertise creates lasting advantages.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to take our team through its most important chapter in years: building our next-generation ERP. This is a player-coach role — you'll manage and develop the team, raise the bar on how we build and ship software, and still get into the code and architecture yourself. You'll work hand-in-hand with a newly strengthened Product team to turn the roadmap into reliable, predictable delivery.
Location: Canada or US (remote)
The salary range for this role is $170,000 CAD– $200,000 CAD per year. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.
What You'll Own
Lead and Grow the Team
Manage, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and consistent feedback
Assess the current team's strengths and gaps, and make recommendations on hiring, development, and structure
Hire and onboard engineers, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
Build the Next-Generation ERP
Set technical direction and lead architecture decisions for the new ERP, including finalizing the technology stack (Java-based direction)
Stay hands-on: code reviews, design, prototyping, and contributing directly to critical components
Balance modernization with supporting existing product lines and current customers, and manage technical debt proactively
Raise the Bar on Engineering Practices and Delivery
Own the software development lifecycle: a shared sprint cadence, daily standups, retrospectives, and release schedules across all teams
Shorten and stabilize release cycles by strengthening automated testing, CI/CD, and Engineering's ownership of release quality
Set clear standards for code review, testing, and observability
Drive team adoption of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent)
Partner with Product
Engage early in epic kickoffs and discovery to provide sizing estimates and technical feasibility input
Own engineering capacity planning by quarter and sprint so roadmap commitments are realistic — and met
Communicate trade-offs, risks, and progress clearly to Product, Support, and leadership
Own Infrastructure, Reliability, and Compliance
Oversee IT/Infrastructure and Site Reliability Engineering alongside the software engineering team
Own production incidents and the on-call model, and act as the escalation point for outages and critical issues
Own the PCI compliance process end to end, from controls and audits through remediation
Own Azure cost optimization: track spend, right-size environments, and hold the team accountable for cloud costs
Keep the legacy platform (Linux, Perl, Spring Boot, Oracle, SQL) stable and secure while the next-generation ERP is built
What We're Looking For
8+ years in software development, including 3+ years managing engineering teams
Strong hands-on Java experience (back-end, enterprise applications) and genuine comfort still working in the code
Experience building or modernizing an ERP or complex transactional B2B systems (order management, inventory, accounting)
A track record of implementing agile practices, CI/CD, and test automation that made releases faster and more reliable
Strong relational database design and performance optimization skills
The ability to assess talent, give direct feedback, and make tough people decisions
Hands-on experience with Azure (AWS or GCP also considered), including managing and optimizing cloud spend
Experience building or leading a QA function and a test automation strategy
Experience owning production operations: on-call rotations, incident management, and Site Reliability Engineering practices
Experience with PCI DSS compliance, or a comparable security and compliance framework, in a production environment
Comfort supporting and modernizing legacy systems, including Linux, Perl, Spring Boot, Oracle, and SQL
Active, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into business impact
Strongly Preferred
Experience in distribution or supply chain software, or in the print and promotional products industry
Experience in an acquisitive, growth-stage vertical software business
Experience managing teams distributed across Canada and the U.S.
Join Us
Your next big build starts here. Join us to lead the team behind DemandBridge’s next-generation ERP.
We use AI-powered tools (including transcription and automated note-taking) during portions of our interview process to support a consistent and thorough candidate experience. Candidates who require alternative accommodation may request it at any stage of the recruitment process.
Fluent Software Group is committed to building diverse, equitable, and inclusive teams. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and all qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Energy Engineering Management
jobs.text:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Moss is a national privately held construction firm providing innovative solutions resulting in award-winning projects. With regional offices across the United States, Moss focuses on construction management, PV Solar & BESS EPC, design-build, and public-private partnerships. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses a wide range of sectors, including luxury high-rise residential, landmark mixed-use developments, hospitality, K-12 and higher education, justice, solar energy and battery storage, and sports. Moss is ranked by Engineering News-Record as one of the nation's top 65 general contractors, and the 3rd ranked solar EPC nationwide. Moss prides itself on a strong entrepreneurial culture that honors safety, quality, client engagement, and employee development.
POSITION SCOPE AND ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT
The Senior Director, Engineering Management is a strategic leader responsible for aligning departmental execution with the broader business objectives of Moss'sEnergy Division. This role provides leadership and direction for the Engineering Management team within Moss's solar and renewable energy EPC business, translating organizational goals into portfolio strategy, resource planning, and partner engagement frameworks.
The Senior Director is accountable for the engineering portfolio's overall success, including client satisfaction, Engineer of Record (EOR) strategy, talent planning, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment. Serving as a key partner to executive leadership, this individual drives portfolio performance, delivery predictability, and commercial outcomes while ensuring the organization is positioned to scale effectively.
Working through Directors and Senior Managers, the Senior Director empowers leaders to oversee day-to-day portfolio execution, EOR performance, and the standardization of engineering processes and best practices. While operational responsibilities are delegated, this role retains ultimate accountability for departmental performance and serves as a trusted advisor to the Vice President on strategic priorities, organizational effectiveness, and portfolio health.
ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Define team portfolios, regional assignments, and resource strategy.
Coordinate with Preconstruction Management and Business Development on future project pipeline strategy.
Own hiring strategy and execution, including 6-month and 1-year workforce plans.
Define and track OKRs and 90/180-day plans for the organization.
Own the EOR strategic relationship, including MSA review and contract standardization.
Define roles, responsibilities, and governance frameworks across the Engineering Management organization.
Drive stakeholder services strategy and build trust with Owners, Trade Partners, EORs, and internal teams.
Resolve major commercial, multi-stakeholder, and project-level escalations with sound judgment and a bias for action.
Perform other duties as assigned.
EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field required.
Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration is preferred.
Professional Engineer (PE) license or comparable technical credential is preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, design management, or construction, including significant experience in the solar or renewable energy EPC sector.
10+ years leading engineering or project teams, with proven accountability for portfolio-level commercial and delivery outcomes.
Demonstrated experience managing external design partners or Engineers of Record, including contract negotiation, MSA governance, and performance management.
Track record of building and scaling teams to match pipeline growth across multiple regions and owners.
Strategic leadership: ability to set direction, define governance frameworks, and translate enterprise goals into executable portfolio strategy.
Commercial acumen: manages contracts, budgets, and value engineering with discipline and price competitiveness in view.
Stakeholder alignment: builds trust with Owners, Trade Partners, EORs, and internal teams across Preconstruction, Procurement, and Construction.
Talent development: owns hiring strategy, coaches Directors and Senior Managers, and builds bench strength for the function.
Decision quality: resolves complex, multi-stakeholder escalations with sound judgment and a bias for action.
Fort Lauderdale-based: Willingness to travel as required to support portfolio oversight and stakeholder engagement.
Remote-based: Ability to travel 50% to Fort Lauderdale to visit the office for team building, company and client meetings, and to support portfolio oversight and stakeholder engagement.

JOB LOCATION: FORT LAUDERDALE, FL OR REMOTE with 50% TRAVEL
CLASSIFICATION: FULL-TIME – EXEMPT – SALARIED
REPORTS TO: VICE PRESIDENT, ENGINEERING
Moss is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Details
Kemper is one of the nation’s leading specialized insurers. Our success is a direct reflection of the talented and diverse people who make a positive difference in the lives of our customers every day. We believe a high-performing culture, valuable opportunities for personal development and professional challenge, and a healthy work-life balance can be highly motivating and productive. Kemper’s products and services are making a real difference to our customers, who have unique and evolving needs. By joining our team, you are helping to provide an experience to our stakeholders that delivers on our promises.
Position Summary
Responsible for leading the enterprise strategy, development, and delivery of data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and intelligent automation solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Oversee enterprise data engineering, data products, governance, analytics enablement, and AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency, decision-making, customer experience, and business growth.
Position Responsibilities
Enterprise Data & AI Strategy: Develop and execute enterprise data, analytics, and AI strategies aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology priorities. Establish strategic roadmaps, investment priorities, and performance measures that deliver measurable business value.
Data Engineering & Data Products: Lead enterprise data engineering, modern cloud data platforms, data architecture, and reusable data products. Drive scalable, secure, and integrated data solutions that support business operations, analytics, digital capabilities, and AI adoption.
Data Governance & Quality: Establish enterprise data governance frameworks, standards, and accountability for data quality, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, and master data management. Partner with business and risk leaders to ensure regulatory compliance and trusted enterprise data.
Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation: Partner with application teams on the development, implementation, and adoption of enterprise AI, machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions. Establish responsible AI practices, governance, and operational controls while driving measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, and business performance.
Analytics & Business Enablement: Partner with business leaders to advance enterprise analytics, self-service reporting, predictive insights, and data-driven decision-making. Promote consistent performance measures, reusable analytics capabilities, and solutions that improve business outcomes.
Position Qualifications
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field required.
Master's degree, MBA, or advanced technical degree preferred.
Experience
At least 10 years’ experience in technology, data, analytics, or artificial intelligence, including significant executive leadership experience
At least 8 years’ experience leading and developing teams
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise data engineering, cloud data platforms, data architecture, governance, and data product development.
Proven success developing and implementing enterprise AI strategies, including generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and responsible AI governance.
Extensive experience translating data and AI investments into scalable business solutions, production adoption, and measurable operational or financial outcomes.
Strong understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management, preferably within insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.
Demonstrated ability to develop enterprise technology strategies, manage complex portfolios and budgets, and lead cross-functional transformation initiatives
This position is a remote role and can work from a US based home. The qualified candidate will need to be able to travel occasionally.
The range for this position is $225,000 to $275,000. When determining candidate offers, we consider experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location among other factors. This job is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, equity and Kemper benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, 401k, etc.).
Kemper is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, disability status or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We are committed to supporting diversity and equality across our organization and we work diligently to maintain a workplace free from discrimination. Kemper is focused on expanding our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion efforts to align with our vision, mission, and guiding principles.
Kemper does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Kemper and Kemper will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.
Kemper will never request personal information, such as your social security number or banking information, via text or email. Additionally, Kemper does not use external messaging applications like WireApp or Skype to communicate with candidates. If you receive such a message, delete it.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
Job Description
The Opportunity
FIS is one of the world’s largest financial technology companies, a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company serving banks, financial institutions, and businesses across six continents. We manage approximately 190 million deposit and wealth management accounts, power 1.1 billion payments accounts, and process more than 70 billion transactions annually. Our fraud and financial crimes capabilities sit at the foundation of that infrastructure, protecting consumers, institutions, and the financial system at a scale that few companies in the world can match.
The fraud and financial crimes product role drives the protection of millions of customer accounts world- wide every day. Preventing fraud here means protecting generational wealth, life savings, company assets as well as preventing financial crime, identity theft, and regulatory exposure globally.
We are in the middle of a significant transformation. FIS is investing heavily in building proprietary fraud signals, next-generation machine learning models, and AI-driven detection capabilities — not simply integrating third-party tools, but constructing a differentiated, data-rich fraud intelligence platform from the ground up. This role is central to that work, and the person who fills it will have an outsized impact on how FIS competes and serves its clients for years to come.
The Role
The VP, Product will own the product roadmap and strategy for FIS’s Enterprise Fraud & Financial Crimes portfolio. The position will report to the SVP of Fraud & Financial Crimes and lead a team of product managers, each leading their own PM teams across the portfolio.
This is a role for someone who has built and run product at a fraud or financial crimes company — someone who knows what a modern, technically differentiated fraud roadmap looks like, has shipped it, and is ready to bring that standard to one of the largest financial technology platforms in the world.
What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end product roadmap for the Enterprise Fraud & Financial Crimes portfolio
Set product strategy that reflects the full breadth of the portfolio. Your depth in transaction monitoring will raise the bar across the platform, but this role is not transaction monitoring alone, it spans the entire fraud and financial crimes stack.
Partner directly with FIS’s Data & AI product leads to define and drive the roadmap for proprietary fraud models, signals, and intelligence capabilities — a central pillar of FIS’s platform transformation.
Lead a senior product management organization spanning multiple product lines, providing clear ownership, strategic direction, and career development across the team.
Drive enterprise architecture and product strategy to ensure the platform scales to support financial institutions of every size, configurable to diverse client needs while maintaining a coherent long-term vision.
Engage directly with clients — from the largest global banks to community institutions — to validate priorities, understand needs, and surface outside-in perspective into the roadmap.
Align cross-functional teams across engineering, data science, compliance, operations, and commercial to deliver coordinated product outcomes.
Connect product decisions to business results — client adoption, revenue growth, fraud detection effectiveness, false-positive reduction, and measurable client outcomes.
What We’re Looking For
A product leader who has built fraud products. You have owned a roadmap at a fraud technology company, a fintech, or a financial institution where product was the core discipline. You know what modern fraud product looks like because you have shipped it. A background leading fraud product strategy at a cutting-edge fraud or financial crimes company is highly valued, as is experience leading fraud product at a financial institution or payments company — provided you owned the roadmap, not solely operations.
Deep transaction monitoring expertise. You understand the mechanics of rules engines, behavioral signals, and ML-based detection across cards and money movement. This is your strongest domain, and it shows — but you think in terms of the full portfolio, not just one capability.
Experience building proprietary fraud models and signals. You have led the product side of building proprietary fraud detection models and signals: defining which data and signals matter, partnering with data science to develop and productionize models, and turning them into differentiated capabilities clients rely on. You treat models and signals as products, with their own roadmaps, performance metrics, and feedback loops.
Breadth across the fraud and financial crimes stack. You understand end-customer authentication, identity, AML and financial crimes, and how these capabilities fit together into a coherent, enterprise-grade platform.
Technical fluency. You do not need to write code, but you need to be the kind of product leader who gets into architecture conversations, challenges technical tradeoffs, and drives roadmaps alongside engineering and data science. You have managed technical teams and held them accountable to delivery.
Commercial and enterprise orientation. You understand how to build products that serve large, complex enterprise clients and how product decisions translate to revenue, adoption, and client value.
Executive presence and stakeholder credibility. You can operate at the client C-suite level and internally across a large, matrixed organization.
Nice to Have
Experience as a head of product or equivalent at a fraud technology company or fraud-focused fintech.
Background leading fraud product at a financial institution or large payments company, with direct ownership of the product roadmap.
Familiarity with integrated fraud and AML transaction monitoring platforms.
Experience building or scaling AI, ML, or rules-based fraud detection products.
FIS is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive compensation. The pay range for this full-time position is $202,260.00 - $343,840.00 and reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for this position based on the posted role, level, and location. Within the range, actual individual starting pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Any changes in work location will also impact actual individual starting pay. Please consult with your recruiter about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
Privacy Statement
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
EEOC Statement
FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here supplement document available here
For positions located in the US, the following conditions apply. If you are made a conditional offer of employment, you will be required to undergo a drug test. ADA Disclaimer: In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Sourcing Model
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

Breadth across the fraud and financial crimes stack. You understand end-customer authentication, identity, AML and financial crimes, and how these capabilities fit together into a coherent, enterprise-grade platform.

Technical fluency. You do not need to write code, but you need to be the kind of product leader who gets into architecture conversations, challenges technical tradeoffs, and drives roadmaps alongside engineering and data science. You have managed technical teams and held them accountable to delivery.
Commercial and enterprise orientation. You understand how to build products that serve large, complex enterprise clients and how product decisions translate to revenue, adoption, and client value.
Executive presence and stakeholder credibility. You can operate at the client C-suite level and internally across a large, matrixed organization.

items: Experience as a head of product or equivalent at a fraud technology company or fraud-focused fintech.
Background leading fraud product at a financial institution or large payments company, with direct ownership of the product roadmap.
Familiarity with integrated fraud and AML transaction monitoring platforms.
Experience building or scaling AI, ML, or rules-based fraud detection products.

jobs.title: Head of Technology, Digital Health Services (USA - Remote, US)
jobs.text:
Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.
Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.
Position Overview
Digital Health Services is a newly formed business unit with a mandate to build a layer of AI-driven tools that improve how patients navigate their care journey, from first diagnosis through treatment and beyond. We are starting with a focused, high-value problem in pre-operative patient education and building from there; our goal is to serve patients and physicians across the full eye care continuum.
The Head of Technology, Digital Health Services is a founding role, reporting to the President, Digital Health Services. You will be the first technical hire, and work alongside the Head of Product who is being recruited in parallel. You will set the architecture, help select the technology partners, and build the engineering culture from day one. You will also be expected to get your hands dirty; this is not a role for someone who wants to come in a manage a team on day one; that will come later. Right now, our job is to build.
The commercial backing of B+L — its distribution, its clinical relationships, its reach across the eye care ecosystem — gives this product a head start that a standalone startup cannot replicate. The charter of the BU gives it the speed and decision-making autonomy to operate like one.
What You Will Do
Architecture and Technical Leadership
Own the end-to-end technical architecture — cloud infrastructure, AI/ML systems, data platform, security, and scalability — and make decisions that balance speed to ship with long-term defensibility
Lead build vs. buy vs. partner evaluations for every core technology component, making clear-eyed decisions about where to invest engineering effort and where to leverage existing solutions
Select and manage the initial development partner — you will play a central role in evaluating, choosing, and structuring the relationship with the firm that executes the first build while the internal team grows; this is a thought-partnership decision, not a solo call
Architect for EHR interoperability and HL7 FHIR compliance from day one, even where active integration is not in the initial scope — the data model and API design must not create future blockers
Design the patient-facing architecture with scalability across the eye care continuum in mind — the initial product is pre-operative, but the platform will expand and the foundations should support it
Compliance and Regulatory Readiness
Own data governance and HIPAA compliance infrastructure from the start, including BAA frameworks, audit logging, and access controls
Build the compliance architecture with regulated software pathways in mind — the right data capture, audit trails, and quality infrastructure from day one, even ahead of formal regulatory requirements
Ensure the platform is instrumented to generate the real-world evidence and performance data that will matter as the product evolves
Partner with B+L’s regulatory and legal resources to stay ahead of the compliance requirements that come with operating in a clinical environment
Own the post-market surveillance architecture — define the technical systems and processes for ongoing safety monitoring, adverse event capture, and real-world performance tracking that a cleared SaMD will require
Product and Clinical
Partner with the Head of Product on roadmap prioritization, ensuring every technical trade-off is grounded in clinical realities and commercial outcomes
Ensure the product ships reliably and performs in real clinical environments from day one — uptime, latency, and incident response all sit with you
Instrument the platform with the right telemetry and data capture to support continuous improvement and future product decisions
Represent technical credibility externally — with pilot clinicians, with B+L leadership, and with prospective technology and data partners
AI and Data
Lead AI model selection, evaluation, fine-tuning, and deployment — with a clear-eyed view of where foundation models serve the use case and where custom development is required
Build AI governance infrastructure from the start — model explainability, bias evaluation, and audit trails for AI-assisted clinical interactions
Own the data platform strategy, ensuring patient data is handled with the rigor that a clinical environment demands and the architecture supports future analytics and evidence generation
Team and Culture
Set the engineering culture from day one — hiring practices, technical standards, and ways of working that will define the team as it scales
Build the engineering team over time as the organization grows — you are the first technical hire, not the last; the team grows around you and your standards
What We Are Looking For
Required
10+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time in a senior technical leadership role — CTO, VP Engineering, or Staff/Principal Engineer who has owned architecture end-to-end; first-time CTOs with the right foundation are strongly encouraged to apply
Proven track record of taking a product from early-stage architecture to live, scaling production — you have done this before, not just planned it
Genuine builder mentality — you are comfortable being the only engineer in the room for a period, writing code and making architecture decisions hands-on before the team exists beneath you
Deep experience with AI/ML systems in production — model selection, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and governance
Strong command of modern cloud architecture (AWS, GCP, or Azure), data infrastructure, and API design at scale
Experience building in regulated or compliance-adjacent environments — you understand what it means to ship software that has to be right, and you build accordingly
Comfortable with ambiguity and concentrated technical risk — you make confident architectural decisions before all the information is in, and you own the outcome
Strong communicator and genuine thought partner — able to operate credibly with a GM, a development partner, and clinical stakeholders who are not engineers
Strongly Preferred
Background in healthcare technology — digital health, medtech, EHR/HIS, or clinical decision support
Familiarity with HIPAA compliance, BAA frameworks, and healthcare data governance — in practice, not just in theory
Hands-on experience with EHR interoperability and HL7 FHIR standards — you have built against or alongside real EHR systems and understand the practical complexity, not just the specification
Understanding of regulated software pathways and what it takes to build toward them, including quality management systems and software lifecycle standards
Experience with patient-facing digital health products — consumer-grade UX expectations in a clinical context
Experience selecting, structuring, and managing external development partners or engineering firms
Experience at a company in the digital health or eye care space such as Phreesia, Modernizing Medicine, Abridge, Suki, Klara, or similar
Prior experience working alongside a product-led founding team in a startup or independent operating unit within a larger company
This position may be available in the following location(s): US - Remote
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
For U.S. locations that require disclosure of compensation, the starting pay for this role is between $275,000.00 and $300,000.00. The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors.
U.S. based employees may be eligible for short-term and/or long-term incentives. They may also be eligible to participate in medical, dental, vision insurance, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, a tuition reimbursement program (select degrees), company holidays, and well-being benefits, among others. U.S. based employees are also eligible to receive sick time, floating holidays and paid vacation.
Job Applicants should be aware of job offer scams perpetrated through the use of the Internet and social media platforms.
To learn more please read Bausch + Lomb's Job Offer Fraud Statement.
Our Benefit Programs: Employee Benefits: Bausch + Lomb
Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.
