jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Platform/Services
jobs.text:
About Life360
Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .
Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed withI mean or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
Our Services engineering teams, part of our Quality and Scale Pillar, build and run the systems every Life360 member relies on but never sees. We carry location data between members’ phones and our servers, deliver the push and SMS notifications that families depend on, verify who members are and what they can access, build and scale our business critical services and give partners a safe way to build on Life360. When we do our jobs well, product teams ship faster and families trust the app in the moments that matter most.
We are a group of backend, cloud, and mobile engineers who care about reliability, security, and scale, and who treat member trust as the foundation of everything we build.
About the Job
As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams building and operating Life360’s critical platforms, including location and messaging, cloud infrastructure and identity, and partner ecosystems. These systems are the foundation of the experiences millions of families rely on every day. You are a player coach who will set technical direction, develop strong engineering managers and technical leaders, and ensure our platforms are reliable, secure, and built to scale as Life360 grows to hundreds of millions of members worldwide.
This is a leadership role that combines deep technical judgment with business impact. You will anticipate scaling challenges before they become problems, modernize critical systems, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across reliability, performance, cost, and speed. You will partner closely with Product, Security, Data, and engineering leaders to connect technology investments to business outcomes, accelerate product innovation, and build an engineering organization that can deliver at scale.
For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $216,500 to $318,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 251,000 to 295,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.
Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.
What You’ll Do
Build the foundation for scale. Lead the engineering teams behind Life360’s critical services, including location and messaging, cloud and identity, and partner platforms. Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems that can support hundreds of millions of members around the world.
See around corners. Anticipate architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and scaling challenges before they impact members. Set technical direction, modernize legacy systems, and balance near-term business needs with long-term platform investments.
Make reliability a competitive advantage. Establish high standards for availability, performance, observability, security, and incident response. Build resilient systems that proactively detect and prevent failures, ensuring members can trust Life360 in the moments that matter most.
Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Create an engineering organization where teams proactively identify problems, take responsibility for outcomes, and drive solutions without waiting for direction. Empower leaders to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the bar for engineering excellence across organizational boundaries.
Make the invisible visible. Establish meaningful engineering metrics across reliability, performance, cost, security, and developer productivity. Use data to identify risks, prioritize investments, and communicate platform health and business impact to senior leadership.
Grow leaders who grow teams. Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers, staff engineers, and technical leaders. Build a high-performing organization with clear accountability, strong technical judgment, and leaders who can make decisions and deliver outcomes independently.
Accelerate the entire engineering organization. Build reusable services, APIs, and platforms that reduce duplication and enable product teams to ship faster. Expand our partner ecosystem through secure, scalable integrations that make it easier to build on Life360.
Turn engineering investments into business outcomes. Connect technical strategy to member experience, product velocity, and business performance. Make deliberate tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, cost, and speed, and use meaningful metrics to demonstrate impact and inform investment decisions.
Lead through influence. Partner across Product, Security, Data, and Engineering to align priorities, resolve ambiguity, and drive cross-functional decisions. Translate company strategy into actionable engineering roadmaps while bringing technical risks and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
Stay close to the technology and embrace what’s next. Engage in architectural reviews and critical technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and empower teams to make pragmatic tradeoffs. Champion AI-assisted development, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and speed.
What We’re Looking For
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with experience managing managers.
Track record of leading backend or platform engineering at high scale, with distributed systems serving millions of users. B2B or B2C platform experience is welcome.
Demonstrated success developing and coaching managers, including former individual contributors who grew into leadership.
Experience translating company strategy into technical plans, and representing your teams’ needs back to senior leaders.
Experience modernizing legacy systems with respect for the history behind them, and the judgment to change what needs changing rather than everything.
Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with a record of resolving ownership and priority conflicts directly.
Hands-on technical credibility in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems (AWS experience preferred).
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Our Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave.
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
Learning & Development programs.
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.
Life360 Values
Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference
Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Our Commitment to Diversity
We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.
We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.
What You’ll Do

items: Build the foundation for scale. Lead the engineering teams behind Life360’s critical services, including location and messaging, cloud and identity, and partner platforms. Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems that can support hundreds of millions of members around the world.

See around corners. Anticipate architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and scaling challenges before they impact members. Set technical direction, modernize legacy systems, and balance near-term business needs with long-term platform investments.

Make reliability a competitive advantage. Establish high standards for availability, performance, observability, security, and incident response. Build resilient systems that proactively detect and prevent failures, ensuring members can trust Life360 in the moments that matter most.

Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Create an engineering organization where teams proactively identify problems, take responsibility for outcomes, and drive solutions without waiting for direction. Empower leaders to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the bar for engineering excellence across organizational boundaries.

Make the invisible visible. Establish meaningful engineering metrics across reliability, performance, cost, security, and developer productivity. Use data to identify risks, prioritize investments, and communicate platform health and business impact to senior leadership.

Grow leaders who grow teams. Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers, staff engineers, and technical leaders. Build a high-performing organization with clear accountability, strong technical judgment, and leaders who can make decisions and deliver outcomes independently.

Accelerate the entire engineering organization. Build reusable services, APIs, and platforms that reduce duplication and enable product teams to ship faster. Expand our partner ecosystem through secure, scalable integrations that make it easier to build on Life360.

Turn engineering investments into business outcomes. Connect technical strategy to member experience, product velocity, and business performance. Make deliberate tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, cost, and speed, and use meaningful metrics to demonstrate impact and inform investment decisions.

Lead through influence. Partner across Product, Security, Data, and Engineering to align priorities, resolve ambiguity, and drive cross-functional decisions. Translate company strategy into actionable engineering roadmaps while bringing technical risks and tradeoffs to senior leadership.

Stay close to the technology and embrace what’s next. Engage in architectural reviews and critical technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and empower teams to make pragmatic tradeoffs. Champion AI-assisted development, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and speed.

blocks.text: What We’re Looking For

items: 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with experience managing managers.
Track record of leading backend or platform engineering at high scale, with distributed systems serving millions of users. B2B or B2C platform experience is welcome.
Demonstrated success developing and coaching managers, including former individual contributors who grew into leadership.
Experience translating company strategy into technical plans, and representing your teams’ needs back to senior leaders.
Experience modernizing legacy systems with respect for the history behind them, and the judgment to change what needs changing rather than everything.
Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with a record of resolving ownership and priority conflicts directly.
Hands-on technical credibility in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems (AWS experience preferred).
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

blocks.text: Our Benefits

items: Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave.
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
Learning & Development programs.
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

blocks.text: Life360 Values
Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

items: Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

blocks.text: Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
Role: Own Radity's technology direction and engineering organization, from delivery quality on client projects to how Radity adopts AI in building software.
Stack: TypeScript, Python, Java or similar modern languages; Azure or AWS; AI-assisted development tools
Experience: You have led engineering teams and senior engineers through complex enterprise software delivery, typically with about 10+ years in software engineering.
English: B2 or higher, C1 ideal
Contract: Full-time, indefinite B2B contract with Radity; you invoice Radity monthly in USD.
Location: Remote
Core hours: 09:00–18:00 CET, with evening overlap with US clients
The company
Radity is a Swiss-based software engineering company of 70+ people, fully remote and working mostly with US clients, many in insurance. It is founder-managed, with direct access to the CEO.
Its teams build and run complex client platforms, and the engineering organization is growing. The next step is consistent engineering standards and AI-assisted practices across every team and project.
You lead engineers and their leads, join the leadership team and report to the CEO. This is not a hands-off executive role: you stay close to architecture and the major technical decisions.
What you'll do
Lead and develop engineering teams across several complex client projects.
Own engineering quality, delivery standards and technical direction.
Guide architecture, system design and major technical decisions.
Coach engineering leads and developers in their professional growth.
Turn client and stakeholder needs into practical technical plans, estimates and delivery risk control.
Drive AI-assisted engineering practices across teams and projects.
Shape hiring, team structure and engineering capabilities.
What you bring
Proven leadership of engineering teams as a CTO, Head of Engineering, Engineering Manager or similar.
Complex enterprise software projects you led to delivery.
Strong judgment in software architecture, system design and modern engineering practices.
Senior engineers and technical leads you have managed and developed.
Ownership of quality and technical decisions, with the trade-offs you can explain.
Daily use of AI tools and a plan for spreading them across teams.
Clear communication with clients, stakeholders and leadership.
Nice to have: insurance or insurtech experience.
Not for you if you want to step away from technical decisions, or prefer managing one team over leading several.
What Radity offers
Indefinite contract: not tied to the end date of one project.
Full equipment, paid AI tools and learning budget.
Global team events.
Startup-style projects for established clients, with real influence on direction.
A seat on the leadership team, shaping Radity's technology strategy, engineering organization and AI adoption.
Hiring process
About 2–3 weeks in total, with no take-home task. After each step, you hear from us within 2 business days, with feedback.
Intro call with Radity HR,
Interview with the CEO,
Panel with 2 of our engineers,
Offer.
If we choose another candidate after you have passed our steps, you stay in our pool for other Radity roles.
How to apply
Send your CV or LinkedIn profile; no cover letter needed, and it takes about 5 minutes.
Data privacy:
We assess every applicant on the same job-related criteria.

jobs.title: Director - Transmission Engineering (Overhead) - Remote
jobs.text:
Position Summary
Director, Transmission Engineering (Overhead) –– (Remote)
We have an opportunity for a talented & ambitious Engineer with Transmission Engineering experience with background and working experience of transmission and distribution lines Project Management, and P&L Leadership experience to join us as a Director of (OH) Transmission Engineering
At NV5, our Transmission Line teams play a critical role in delivering safe, reliable, and efficient power to communities and regions. We provide engineering solutions for the design, construction, maintenance, and modernization of high-voltage transmission infrastructure—the backbone of the electric grid. From new line development and system upgrades to critical maintenance projects, our teams apply rigorous standards of safety, quality, and performance while leveraging proven practices and innovative technologies to deliver sustainable, cost-effective solutions for our clients.
The Director of Transmission Engineering is a senior leadership position responsible for directing the planning, design, and execution of transmission line projects. This role leads multidisciplinary engineering and technical teams, ensures compliance with applicable safety, regulatory, and quality requirements, and aligns project delivery with NV5’s strategic objectives. The Director collaborates across business groups and with clients, stakeholders, and industry partners to advance innovation, improve efficiency, and promote operational excellence.
Why NV5?
At NV5, we understand the aging electrical grid faces significant challenges. The need for resiliency to withstand harsher weather while meeting increasing demands for power and power delivery are challenges, we face every day.
Navigating through permitting and regulation has increased design complexity and time to design and build desperately needed new and revitalized transmission assets.
By harnessing our expertise and providing cutting-edge solutions, NV5 steps in as a leader, to enhance transmission system capacity, fortify against fire and storm risks, and elevate the reliability of electrical service for utility customers. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, and conduct inspections on construction projects.
NV5’s integrated service capabilities deliver efficiency, consistency, attention to detail, and safe project execution. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in engineering, safety, quality, procurement, QA/QC, right-of-way, scheduling, environmental planning, permitting, and land management to achieve successful outcomes for our clients.
Responsibilities
Act as the engineer of record and client point of contact for power delivery projects.
Lead a team of 6-10 direct reports and an extended team of 30-40 resources which include engineers, designers, and drafters.
Assist in marketing, promotion and business development efforts retain and add new national clients.
Prepare, review, and P.E. seal technical calculation reports and construction documents meeting client and NV5 requirements.
Assist in the routing and design of transmission lines using industry-standard tools.
Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project success.
Manage multiple projects and provide engineering QA/QC
Travel to client sites as needed.
Assist with development of construction packages.
Oversee the planning, design, and execution of transmission projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and regulatory requirements.
Develop project budgets, schedules, and resource plans, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Manage risks and resolve issues that may impact project scope, quality, and delivery.
Provide technical guidance and expertise in the design and optimization of transmission systems.
Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and regulatory changes, and integrate best practices into the engineering processes.
Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards in all engineering activities.
Contribute to the development of the company's strategic plans and objectives, particularly in the areas of transmission infrastructure.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, and technologies that can enhance the company's competitive position.
Collaborate with other departments within Power Delivery and also Operations, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs, to align engineering initiatives with broader business goals.
Represent the company at industry forums, conferences, and regulatory meetings, advocating for the company's interests and promoting its capabilities.
Requirements
Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) or Graduate degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited university.
Experience with understanding and managing project financials and overall P&L of the team
Experience leading a team to produce quality transmission construction ready designs.
Knowledge and Proficiency with PLS CADD, PLS Pole, MFAD, PLS-Tower a plus
12+ years’ experience in the electric utility industry performing engineering related duties and/or management for high voltage electrical projects.
PE license is a must. PE license in CA is a plus.
Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, including ANSI, ASTM, ACI, AISC, NEC, NESC, and others.
#INDHP
Benefits
NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.
Competitive Salary
Medical, dental, and supplemental insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Company paid Life & AD&D
Company paid Disability
401K Plan
Paid Holidays
Paid Time Off
Company Overview
NV5 delivers technology-enabled engineering, consulting, and geospatial solutions that help clients plan, design, and optimize infrastructure, buildings, utilities, and environmental systems. We bring together technical expertise, data, and innovative thinking to create resilient, high-performance assets. As part of TiC Solutions, alongside Acuren, we share a purpose: to shape and strengthen the physical world.
Our work starts with our people. We invest in their growth and never compromise on safety. We work as one team across disciplines and geographies, bringing diverse perspectives and a shared purpose to complex challenges.
At NV5, we take pride in high-quality work that creates lasting value for our clients. We challenge the status quo, continuously improve, and turn insight into smarter designs, plans, and solutions. Join us to contribute your expertise and collaborate with our teams to help shape the infrastructure and systems the world relies on.

jobs.title: Vice President of Information Technology
jobs.text:
Established in 1956, Jacuzzi® Group operates through two distinct divisions: Jacuzzi® Spa, a global leader in premium hot tubs, swim spas, and saunas—and Jacuzzi® Bath, which provides specialized bathing solutions and national remodeling expertise. Jacuzzi Bath is the fastest growing division focusing on the highest standard of customer satisfaction.
We are seeking a visionary Vice President of Information Technology to join our leadership team during an exciting period of growth. This newly created leadership role will be instrumental in defining and executing an IT strategy that drives operational efficiency. The Vice President of Information Technology will be responsible for building and scaling our IT organization from the ground up, delivering technology solutions that drive growth and providing an exceptional customer experience. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing large-scale IT projects, implementing cutting-edge technologies, and leading teams in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities for the Vice President of Information Technology:
Strategic Leadership
Develop and execute an IT strategy aligned with company objectives.
Build a shared-services IT model that effectively supports multiple business units.
Collaborate with leaders across Operations, Manufacturing, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Supply Chain, and Customer Service.
Translate business needs into technology solutions and communicate technical concepts in clear business terms.
Provide regular updates to executive leadership on IT performance, projects, risks, and strategic initiatives.
IT Leadership & Team Development
Design the IT organization for Jacuzzi Bath: define the roles, structure, and reporting lines needed to support both manufacturing and remodeling.
Create a phased hiring plan that matches the growth of the business, so the team scales as the division does.
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing IT team.
Establish IT key performance indicators.
Determine the right balance between internal resources and outsourced services.
Promote a customer-focused approach where IT is viewed as a trusted business partner.
Process Improvement Initiatives
Oversee IT service management processes, including incident, change, and problem management.
Standardize systems and processes while reducing manual work and inefficiencies.
Partner with business leaders to improve and automate key operational workflows.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.
Systems, Data & Technology
Manage enterprise applications, including ERP, CRM, financial, HRIS, manufacturing, and project management systems.
Lead system implementations, upgrades, and integrations.
Establish strong data governance, reporting, and analytics capabilities to support business decision-making.
Ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and aligned with organizational needs.
Financial & Vendor Management
Develop and manage the IT budget and long-term technology investment plans.
Negotiate and manage vendor contracts, service agreements, and strategic partnerships.
Monitor IT spending and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiency.
Other duties as assigned.
Compensation for Vice President of Information Technology:
$200,000 + (Based on experience) + potential bonus
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. Master's degree or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience at lease 5 years in an executive position.
Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma.
Experience supporting manufacturing, construction, building products, home services, distribution, or related industries preferred.
Experience in private-equity-backed organizations preferred.
Strong experience leading ERP and CRM implementations and optimization efforts.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, risk management, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
Proven success delivering process improvements and measurable business results.
Experience managing vendors, contracts, and technology budgets.
Must be willing to travel as needed.
Benefits
401(k) with matching
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off and Holidays
Vision insurance

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
jobs.text:
Career Category
Information Systems
Job Description
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will advance Enterprise Data Governance, FAIR data practices, and a data product operating model that makes trusted, reusable, and responsibly accessible data available for analytics, automation, and AI innovation.
The successful candidate will lead cross-functional data strategy and delivery across data domains, translating scientific and business priorities into scalable governance, metadata, quality, semantic interoperability, and data product capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the enterprise Data Governance, FAIR, and data product strategy and roadmap, aligning investments to scientific and business priorities.
Establish a value-realization framework to measure business outcomes, adoption, and return on investment from data initiatives.
Execute the Enterprise Data Strategy, including data ownership, reusable data products, lifecycle management, data contracts, and adoption measures.
Evolve a federated governance operating model with clear decision rights, data ownership, stewardship accountabilities, data councils, data standards, and escalation paths.
Evolve FAIR maturity across the enterprise, including embedding FAIR practices in the data lifecycle, metadata standards, persistent identifiers, controlled vocabularies, and access patterns.
Advance active metadata, data catalog, lineage, business glossary, semantic and knowledge graph capabilities to improve discovery, context, interoperability, and trust.
Set governance policies and controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, retention, and responsible use; ensure fit-for-purpose data for regulated and AI-enabled use cases.
Partner with Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Digital, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to operationalize governed data products across platforms and domains.
Enable responsible AI by defining and enforcing data readiness criteria.
Serve as the data engagement lead for an assigned business function, driving adoption of data management practices, including FAIR, to deliver measurable data improvements and business value.
Manage large-scale data programs, cross-functional initiatives, and external partners; communicate outcomes, risks, dependencies, and value realization to senior leadership.
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is adata management leader with biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience with these qualifications.
Basic Qualifications
Doctorate degree and 2 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Master’s degree and 6 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Associate degree and 10 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
Mandatory Skills and Qualifications
Experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, with an understanding of regulated data, business processes, and compliance requirements.
Demonstrated leadership of enterprise data governance, data management, active metadata, data quality, or data product initiatives across business and technology teams.
Hands-on understanding of FAIR data principles and their practical application through active metadata, standards, semantics, interoperability, and access controls.
Experience establishing data governance operating models, including data ownership, stewardship, policy, standards, controls, and issue management.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex data topics into business value and decisions.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
Experience implementing enterprise data strategy, scaling FAIR, data products operating model, and data contracts.
Knowledge of modern data management capabilities, including active metadata, data observability, lineage, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and policy-as-code.
Experience with master data, data catalog, governance, quality, active metadata, and semantic technologies: Collibra, Databricks Unity Catalog, Reltio, SciBite, or TopQuadrant.
Experience enabling responsible AI, including data readiness for machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI agent use cases.
Ability to define measurable outcomes for data investments, including data product adoption, quality, time-to-discovery, reuse, compliance, and AI readiness.
Experience managing external partners and geographically distributed delivery teams in complex stakeholder environments.
What you can expect of us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:
A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
Stock-based long-term incentives
Award-winning time-off plans
Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.
Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.
careers.amgen.com
In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
Application deadline
Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.
Sponsorship
Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - Remote (Americas time zones)
jobs.text:
This is a remote position.
Why this role exists
Sell2Rent is a fast-growing residential real estate platform specializing in sale-leaseback transactions. We help homeowners unlock their home equity without moving, while connecting properties with single-family rental investors. We operate in 30+ states and have closed 200+ transactions.
Technology is a key driver of our growth. We’ve built a proprietary operating platform, AI agents for lead qualification and outreach, an investor-matching layer, and a lead engine that supports our sales process.
We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who sees technology as a growth and revenue engine — not just an engineering function. You’ll work closely with Sales, and Marketing, to use AI, automation, data, and product to generate more qualified leads, improve conversion, accelerate the sales cycle, and close more transactions.
You’ll inherit real, revenue-generating technology, a talented team, and the opportunity to create the technology strategy that will help Sell2Rent scale faster and sell more.
If you’re excited about using technology to drive measurable business results, this is your opportunity to make a major impact.
What you'll own
Technology strategy.You set the direction: architecture, build-vs-buy, which platforms we standardize on, where AI is a genuine advantage and where it's a distraction. You'll be the person in the room who knows what's actually possible and what it costs.
The engineering organization.You lead a distributed team of roughly ten across engineering and data, all of them in Latin America. You'll grow it, structure it, and set the bar.
Scaling the platform.Our twelve-month mandate is to ship the roadmap and scale what we've built — completing the migration off legacy systems, hardening the platform, and getting to a place where the business can grow transaction volume without engineering becoming the bottleneck.
The AI layer.Agents handle a meaningful share of our qualification, outreach, and internal operations today. Deciding how far that goes — and building it so it's a durable advantage rather than a demo — is one of the most interesting problems here.
Resilience and continuity.Security, access governance, vendor management, monitoring, documentation, and the discipline that ensures no single person is ever again the only one who knows how something works. We've learned this lesson the expensive way and we're not repeating it.
Executive partnership.You sit on the Executive Committee. You'll work directly with the CEO and the sales, marketing, and operations leaders — translating what the business needs into what gets built, and telling us honestly when what we're asking for is a bad idea.
Requirements
Who we're looking for
15+ years in technology, with progressive leadership responsibility and time as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or Head of Technology.
You've scaled a team and a system before.Not just managed one — took something from working-but-fragile to reliable-at-volume, and grew the org that did it.
You are technical enough to be trusted, but your job is not to write the code.You should be able to read our architecture, challenge a design decision, and evaluate a vendor on the merits. We have engineers to build. We need someone who can direct them and know when the answer is wrong.
Real depth in AI-driven architecture, cloud infrastructure (we run on GCP), APIs, integrations, and data. Depth, not enthusiasm — you can tell us what LLM-based agents actually break on in production.
You find blind spots.Much of the value in your first six months is telling us what we don't know we're missing — in our architecture, our tooling, our security posture, and our process.
You lead people well.Our team is remote, distributed, and international. Keeping engineers motivated, growing, and clear on what matters is a large part of this job.
Startup-fluent.You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and making decisions before all the information arrives.
Business-minded.You can connect a technical investment to revenue and defend it to a CEO who will ask.
Helpful, not required:real estate, proptech, or fintech experience; running a US-based company with a LatAm engineering team; Spanish.
How this role fits with product
Our CEO owns product direction and will continue to for the foreseeable future, working closely with the commercial leadership team. You own technology, architecture, and execution. You'll have real influence on what we build and strong input on sequencing — but the product roadmap is not yours to set, and we're not planning to hand it over.
We're stating this plainly because the previous version of this role blended both, and the wrong expectation here makes an otherwise great partnership fail. If owning a product is what you're looking for in your next role, this isn't it.
What success looks like
By 90 days— you know where every system, credential, vendor, and dependency lives, and so does someone besides you. You've told us the three things about our architecture that worry you most. The team knows who they report to, what they're building, and why it matters.
By 6 months— the platform migration is on a credible path, engineering has a real operating cadence, and technology decisions are being made deliberately rather than reactively. You've made at least one hire that raises the bar.
By 12 months— we've shipped the roadmap, the platform handles significantly more volume without more people, and our AI capability is a genuine competitive advantage rather than a set of internal tools. Nothing critical depends on any single individual, including you.
Benefits
Details
Location:Remote, with meaningful overlap with US Eastern and Latin America.
Compensation:Competitive base plus meaningful equity. We'll be direct about the range early in the process.
Team:~10 in technology and data; company-wide, a lean and fast-moving organization.
Our process
Intro call with the CEO — 45 minutes, mutual fit.
Technical and architectural conversation — we'll walk you through what we've actually built and get your honest read on it.
Meet the engineering team and two executive peers.
A working session on a real problem we're facing. Paid, if it requires meaningful preparation.
References and offer.
We move quickly and we'll tell you where you stand at every step.
Sell2Rent is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Fractional Director of Technology (Advisor Network)
jobs.text:
Opportunity Overview
Arootah engages a curated network of senior operators to support clients across the alternative investment industry, including hedge funds, private equity firms, and family offices. Advisors are deployed on project-based engagements when client needs match their expertise. Joining the network does not guarantee placement; it provides access to opportunities as they arise.
Why Join the Arootah Network
Alt-industry-only engagements with hedge funds, private equity firms, and family offices
Project-based work that fits around existing commitments
Client origination and engagement management handled by Arootah; advisors focus on delivery
About Arootah
Arootah is a talent solutions firm purpose-built for the alternative investment industry. We advise and we execute, covering the full talent spectrum from entry to exit across five services: Talent Acquisition, Fractional Leadership, Talent Development, Retention & Compensation, and Transition.
Most talent firms solve one problem. Because we cover the full spectrum, we can help clients identify and solve the right one. We start with diagnosis, then deliver.
Our team has run alternative investment firms at the highest levels as COOs, CFOs, and CCOs. That operator experience, combined with 15+ years of alternatives-specific recruiting and a network of 700+ vetted advisors across 18 functional disciplines, is what makes the advice credible and the execution reliable. We also draw on a network of 600+ coaches, deploying those with specific experience guiding senior executives in the alternatives industry.
One industry. One talent partner. Entry to exit.
Learn more:
Who We’re Looking For
Arootah is searching for experienced Directors of Technology to consult to our highly prestigious client base. As a consultant, you will work with our Alternative Asset Firm and Family Office clients to provide expert advice. Having previously served in this leadership role, you have specific, hands-on experience strategically supporting the efforts of the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in building, maintaining, and overseeing the full technology (hardware and software) infrastructure and operations of a leading Alternative Asset Firm or Family Office.
Core Areas of Expertise
Best practice reviews.
Developing realistic and effective action plans.
Breaking apart goals into actionable steps.
Advising on vendor selection and oversight.
Creating and implementing policies, procedures, and control measures.
Evaluating each client’s advancement toward goal actualization through key performance indicators (KPIs) and scoring matrices.
Special projects or other areas of need.
Assist and support the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in managing all aspects of the day-to-day management and oversight of the full tech stack across the organization: software (full stack, mobile/web apps, AR/VR, metaverse), hardware (IT, IoT, connected devices), cybersecurity, operations (internal, external), policies, etc.
Lead and manage the design, development, and deployment of new applications, systems software, and/or enhancements to existing applications.
Ensure application optimization and transformation to enable corporate partners continued business growth and expansion.
Supervise and implement a proactive cybersecurity, disaster recovery and business continuity planning mindset across the firm to maintain industry-leading uptime on critical technology infrastructure through successful monitoring, testing processes, and system redundancy.
Provide resource management and communication across multiple product and engagement teams that rely on and are impacted by technology. Support and influence user adoption and user understanding, such as through training and demos.
Optimize and supervise IT infrastructure to ensure integrity, security, and optimal performance of an office-based and remote, distributed, and growing team of employees and contractors to the standards of leading financial service organizations.
Oversee and provide technical direction, management support and daily guidance to IT staff, ensuring adherence to technology policies, security controls, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
Working with the CTO, establish and monitor KPIs to continuously track, measure, and drive productivity.
Generate new ideas and creative solutions to complex business problems; support the development of technology roadmaps that align with business current and future needs.
Advise CTO and senior leadership on issues affecting the operations and/or strategic direction of the Technology team.
What You Bring
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
MBA or other relevant graduate degree is a plus.
6+ years of proven experience as a Director of Technology at an Alternative Asset Firm or family office.
Strong technical knowledge and expertise in all facets of IT, including Application Teams, Information Security, Business Process Management, Program and Portfolio Management, IT Partner and Supplier Management, IT Architecture Management, Digital Platforms, and IT Infrastructure and Operations.
Strong experience with Investment Technology vendors for both hosted and on-prem platforms. This could include derivatives platforms (e.g. Calypso, Murex), investment accounting platforms (e.g. Eagle, ePam), OMS vendors (e.g. Aladdin, CRD) and others (e.g. Bloomberg, FactSet).
Expertise in budget & resource planning/monitoring to ensure budget optimization.
Strong understanding of the business processes in the regulated environment of investment management and financial services firms.
Ability to collaborate and succeed in a fast-paced environment while maintaining focus on on-time delivery, customer satisfaction (both internal and external) and team morale.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product and Technology
jobs.text:
Senior Director, Product and Technology
Location: Remote,
Application Submission Deadline: November 1, 2026
About Us
Propel America addresses a broken workforce system that fails both young adults and healthcare employers, sidelining talented individuals from entering healthcare careers and contributing to critical workforce shortages that threaten community health. Propel’s work centers on bridging this gap by creating alternative, debt-free career pathways into healthcare for young adults ages 18–26, particularly those from underrepresented and low-income backgrounds, while helping employers access the trained, diverse talent they urgently need. Today, over 13 million young adults in the U.S. are either not in school, not working, or stuck in low-wage jobs with little room for growth. Traditional college remains financially and logistically out of reach for many, especially young people from low-income communities, forcing them into a false choice: sacrifice income to pursue an expensive degree or remain in low-wage work without upward mobility. At the same time, systemic barriers, such as limited exposure to healthcare roles, low visibility of alternative pathways, and a lack of representative mentors, prevent many high school graduates from entering the healthcare field.
Meanwhile, healthcare employers face compounding workforce shortages. The Bureau of Labor Statistics projects a 13% growth in healthcare jobs from 2021 to 2031, translating to nearly 2 million openings annually. Many of these are middle-skill roles, which represent over half the U.S. labor market but remain unfilled due to a lack of training infrastructure. Employers often contend with high turnover in entry-level positions yet underinvest in structured career advancement pathways or innovative strategies to retain talent.
Propel America aims to solve both sides of the equation, by equipping young adults with the skills and support to launch healthcare careers and by helping employers build stronger, more diverse, and more stable workforces. In our portfolio, we offer a suite of Propel Paths and Propel Products to place young adults in critical talent gaps in healthcare
To learn more about Propel America, please visit .
The Opportunity
Propel America is undergoing an exciting phase of growth and technological transformation, marked by the development of our signature Fellow Portal and the integration of cutting-edge AI technologies into our program delivery. To lead this effort, we are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Director, Product and Technology.
This role sits within our newly formed Solutions Team and reports directly to the Vice President of Solutions.
The Director will serve as our core technology lead, managing the technical implementation of our product roadmap, maintaining the integrity of our overall technology stack, and directly supervising our technical staff (Salesforce Administrator and Junior Product Developer).
Key Responsibilities
The ideal candidate is a product developer who can set a vision and design the technology roadmap while also architecting integrations, managing developers and salesforce administration as well as overseeing outsourced Managed Service Providers (MSPs). The Direct will act as the critical link between Propel’s strategic vision and our day-to-day software execution, ensuring that our infrastructure is secure, scalable, and built to support our fellows' journey
Key Responsibilities include
Product leadership 40%
Technology stack management and development 40%
Cross Functional Collaboration (20%)
Product Leadership
Develop technology roadmap and set vision for Propel’s technology products including the Applicant and Fellow Portal to ensure they are responsive to fellows and employer needs
Directly manage the Junior Product Developer in building and iterating on the Fellow Portal, ensuring coding standards, version control, and security practices are rigorously maintained.
Guide the technical implementation of AI-integrated tools within the Fellow Portal to accelerate development, improve portal functionality, and enhance the user experience.
Establish and enforce development workflows (e.g., Agile Scrum/Kanban, code reviews, deployment pipelines) to minimize technical debt and streamline release cycles.
Work collaboratively with the VP of Solutions and key stakeholders to translate strategic product requirements into clear, prioritized technical backlogs.
Work closely with Director, Content Solutions and Product Director, Apprenticeship to develop technology requirements for Propel suite of products including PropelRecruit, Apprenticeship, TTE and Hire Ready Content.
Define and track success measures for the Fellow Portal and other products, such as adoption, engagement, completion and time-to-placement.
Run discovery with fellows, applicants and employers (interviews, usability testing, feedback loops).
Oversee QA, testing, release management and technical documentation.
2. Tech Stack Management & Architecture
Own the strategic and operational direction of IT infrastructure, software development, and data systems
Ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of core enterprise systems (Salesforce, Google Cloud, Forms software, virtual private servers, website hosting, code management workflows).
Lead architecture and platform decisions in partnership with VP, Solutions.
Evaluate and select software and vendors, and negotiate contracts and renewals
Directly manage the Salesforce Administrator to ensure Propel's CRM is optimized to support programmatic operations, student tracking, and data-driven decision-making
Conduct regular audits of the organizational tech stack to eliminate overlaps, consolidate licenses, and ensure optimal data flow across departments.
Define and implement standards for cybersecurity, information security, and data privacy, safeguarding fellow, staff, and donor data, including oversight of all data flows between systems (e.g. FERPA, health information and funder requirements)
Act as the primary technical point of contact and relationship manager for Propel’s outsourced Managed IT Service Provider
Ensure the MSP successfully resolves Level 1 help desk tickets, user account maintenance, and daily IT support requests, completely offloading this burden from Propel’s executive leadership
Collaborate with the MSP to maintain healthy network infrastructure, ensure data backups and disaster recovery plans are active, and manage device lifecycles
Identify budgetary needs for technology and work closely VP, Solutions to develop the annual budget
Set responsible-AI guidelines, covering acceptable use, data handling, bias review and human oversight.
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with the entire solutions team to support the integration of technology into the development of products and solutions
Work closely with the Senior Director of Evaluation and Learning to ensure that Salesforce is the source of truth for all data
Work closely with with the Partnerships team to ensure that employer and fellow feedback is incorporated into the technology priorities and solutions development
Lead technology team to support cross functional and organization priorities by modeling Propel’s core values
Train staff on systems and lead change management when tools are rolled out.
Required Qualifications
Product Development: 6-8 years in product or technology, including 3+ years managing people; experience in discovery, writing and developing technology requirements and bringing products to market
People Management: Demonstrated experience directly managing technical staff (developers, database admins, or system engineers) and fostering a collaborative, high-performance team culture
Platform & CRM Familiarity: Deep understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, database schemas, and cloud-based integrations
Vendor Coordination: Proven track record of managing technology vendors, software developers, and external IT consultants or MSPs
Modern Workflows: Strong familiarity with Agile software development methodologies (Scrum/Kanban)
APIs: Experience leveraging AI, APIs or machine learning integration in customer-facing products
Data security: Experience with managing PII and other secure data
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience working in the nonprofit, workforce development, or education technology (EdTech) sectors
Product engineering experience or knowledge of coding
Salesforce certification (Admin, Platform App Builder), or Nonprofit/Education Cloud experience
Experience designing products for young adults or mobile-first users
Experience with low-code/no-code tools
Success Profile
Strategic Translator: Exceptional ability to translate education and business requirements into pragmatic, scalable technology plans
Security & Risk-Minded: Practical understanding of cybersecurity protocols, access control frameworks, and compliance auditing
Clear Communicator: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on simplicity, clarity, and active listening, and effective collaboration across functional teams.
Mission-Driven: Strong alignment with Propel America’s values of innovation, courage, joy, team, equity, and impact
Compensation
The salary for this position is between $113,000-$153,200 annually. We consider candidate experience and location when determining where a candidate may fall within that range. Propel America offers a competitive total rewards package including coverage of 90% of health insurance premiums, unlimited PTO, and a flexible work environment.
Interested in applying?
Please submit your application here.The application deadline to apply for this position is November 1, 2026. After this date we do not guarantee review of submissions.
Propel America is an equal-opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
We encourage candidates from historically underrepresented backgrounds to apply.
Salary: $113,000 – $153,200 / year

jobs.title: Director of Data Strategy & Performance
jobs.text:
Harlem Children’s Zone (HCZ) — a world-renowned education and poverty-fighting organization based in New York — seeks an enthusiastic, dedicated, and mission-aligned Director of Data for our After-School, Community, and Early Childhood programs.
The Director of Data Strategy & Performance provides strategic leadership for data governance, performance management, analytics, reporting, and data-informed decision-making across the Deputy Program Officer’s portfolio. Reporting directly to the Deputy Program Officer, the Director establishes the vision, standards, systems, and management routines that enable program leaders to use reliable data to assess performance, identify risks and opportunities, strengthen execution, and improve outcomes for scholars and families.
The Director serves as the senior program-side leader for cross-portfolio data strategy and directly supervises the Assistant Directors of Data. The Director provides formal supervision, performance management, coaching, role expectations, and technical leadership for the Assistant Directors of Data, while Managing Directors maintain a dotted-line relationship to support portfolio alignment, responsiveness, and day-to-day partnership. The Director will partner with organizational teams in IT Evaluation, HR, and other functions to strengthen Salesforce (Zora) usage, data quality and governance, dashboards and scorecards, OKR and core-metric monitoring, and the integration of data into ongoing performance management and strategic planning routines.
The ideal candidate is a strategic and systems-oriented data leader who can set direction, build organizational capacity, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, develop staff, and translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
For more information, check out Want to Work at Harlem Children’s Zone? Here’s 7 Things You Need to Know.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Head of Product
Location: Remote
About This Opportunity
Purple Squirrel Enterprises has been supporting startups and global firms through growth, change, and expansion for 19+ years. We provide flexible HR and recruiting solutions that allow leaders to focus on strategy while we handle people operations — and this search is no exception.
We are exclusively engaged by a high-growth health technology company to help them identify and hire exceptional product leadership talent for this role. We are embedded directly with their leadership team, have deep knowledge of the company, the culture, and what it takes to succeed here — and we will be your dedicated recruiting partner from first conversation through offer.
This is not a blind submission. When you apply, you are working with a team that knows this opportunity inside and out and will advocate for you every step of the way.
💜 If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. We will be in touch promptly.
Applications submitted directly to our client will be redirected back to Purple Squirrel Enterprises. To be considered for this role, all candidates must apply through this posting.
About Our Client
Our client builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.
Their platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. They support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.
Their results so far:
48% reduction in medication errors
39% increase in compliance
69% improvement in audit-ready documentation
💜 This company was built around a cause that is both personal and urgent. That authenticity shows in how they operate, who they hire, and what they build. If you are looking for work that matters — this is it.
A Note on Title, Reporting Line & Scope
Our client is posting this role as Head of Product, but the final title, reporting structure, and scope will be shaped by the experience and leadership level of the person they hire. Depending on your background, this could ultimately be structured as VP of Product or other. Reporting line will most likely be directly to the CEO, though for a more foundational-level hire it could sit under Engineering leadership instead. These specifics — along with compensation — will be part of the conversation as we get to know your experience and how it maps to what they need.
This is intentional flexibility, not indecision: our client is committed to bringing in the right level of leadership for where they are today and where they're headed.
About the Role
Our client is looking for a Head of Product to own product strategy and execution and to build the Product function from the ground up. You will lead a team of two today — a Product Lead and a Product Specialist — with real influence over the type, number, and pace of hires as the team grows.
This is a startup, and this function is being built rather than maintained. You will have real ownership, very little inherited process, and a direct line to executive leadership. Product has been driven by the leadership team to date, and they are committed to a deliberate, unhurried handoff of that ownership to you — including knowledge transfer, context on customers and commitments, and hands-on support while you take the reins. You will not be handed a backlog and left to guess.
They are building toward empowered product teams, where leadership sets priorities and outcomes and teams have real autonomy to discover how to achieve them. You and engineering leadership will define how Product and Engineering work together — engineers here are product-minded and deeply involved in how the product takes shape, and the handoff model is intentionally not prescriptive.
Their product operates in a regulated, high-stakes environment. A missed dose is a patient safety event, not a support ticket, and their customers are audited by state agencies whose requirements differ state by state. Product judgment here means understanding what actually happens in a group home at 7am during a shift change, not what looks good in a spec.
As with all leaders at this company, you'll need to be both hands-on and strategic — that combination is core to their culture. Priorities, travel, and schedules shift with the pace of a growing company and its leadership team, so you'll need to bring your own ideas, act autonomously when needed, and stay a strong team player at the same time. Communication — proactive, reactive, and yes, sometimes over-communication — is essential in an environment like this.
What You'll Do
Own the Roadmap
Own product strategy and the roadmap across the full surface area: software, connected hardware, and pharmacy/EHR integrations. Publish it so the company can see what is coming and why
Bring a point of view on where the platform should go over the next 12–24 months, and make the case for it
Weigh patient safety, HIPAA, and state-by-state regulatory requirements from the start rather than retrofitting them
Treat reporting, audit trails, and business intelligence as first-class product — audit-ready documentation is a primary reason customers choose this platform
Lead Discovery
Spend real time with caregivers, house managers, administrators, nurses, and state agency stakeholders — observing workflows rather than consuming feedback secondhand
Distinguish recurring needs from individual feature requests, and explain the difference to Sales and Customer Success
Design for three very different users: administrators (oversight/audit), caregivers (speed/clarity mid-shift), and the individuals receiving care
Design into existing routines rather than around them — usability is a safety requirement here, not a preference
Set the bar for product definition: clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case thinking Engineering can build from without guesswork
Build the Function
Establish how product gets practiced: how problems get framed, how discovery happens, how decisions get made, how outcomes get measured
Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, and shape the hiring plan — including roles that don't exist yet — as scope expands
Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations aligned on priorities and support strategic accounts and state-level opportunities where product credibility matters
Work With AI
Set the standard on AI rather than delegate it — use tools like Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic environments to explore the codebase, work with data, and build functional prototypes
Establish these practices across the Product team and coach your people into them
The goal is better-informed decisions about scope and value — not handing engineering a flashy prototype to productionize
You do not need to be a software engineer, and you will have strong engineering partnership. You do need to be willing and able to build.
What This Role Is Not
This is not a purely strategic or advisory position, and it is not a roadmap-maintenance or backlog-management role. You will be the most senior product person in the company, with no layer between you and the problem. blocks.text: Head of Product
Location: Remote
About This Opportunity

Purple Squirrel Enterprises has been supporting startups and global firms through growth, change, and expansion for 19+ years. We provide flexible HR and recruiting solutions that allow leaders to focus on strategy while we handle people operations — and this search is no exception.

We are exclusively engaged by a high-growth health technology company to help them identify and hire exceptional product leadership talent for this role. We are embedded directly with their leadership team, have deep knowledge of the company, the culture, and what it takes to succeed here — and we will be your dedicated recruiting partner from first conversation through offer.
This is not a blind submission. When you apply, you are working with a team that knows this opportunity inside and out and will advocate for you every step of the way.
💜 If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. We will be in touch promptly.
Applications submitted directly to our client will be redirected back to Purple Squirrel Enterprises. To be considered for this role, all candidates must apply through this posting.
About Our Client

Our client builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.

Their platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. They support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.
Their results so far:

items: 48% reduction in medication errors
39% increase in compliance
69% improvement in audit-ready documentation

blocks.text: 💜 This company was built around a cause that is both personal and urgent. That authenticity shows in how they operate, who they hire, and what they build. If you are looking for work that matters — this is it.
A Note on Title, Reporting Line & Scope

Our client is posting this role as Head of Product, but the final title, reporting structure, and scope will be shaped by the experience and leadership level of the person they hire. Depending on your background, this could ultimately be structured as VP of Product or other. Reporting line will most likely be directly to the CEO, though for a more foundational-level hire it could sit under Engineering leadership instead. These specifics — along with compensation — will be part of the conversation as we get to know your experience and how it maps to what they need.
This is intentional flexibility, not indecision: our client is committed to bringing in the right level of leadership for where they are today and where they're headed.
About the Role

Our client is looking for a Head of Product to own product strategy and execution and to build the Product function from the ground up. You will lead a team of two today — a Product Lead and a Product Specialist — with real influence over the type, number, and pace of hires as the team grows.

This is a startup, and this function is being built rather than maintained. You will have real ownership, very little inherited process, and a direct line to executive leadership. Product has been driven by the leadership team to date, and they are committed to a deliberate, unhurried handoff of that ownership to you — including knowledge transfer, context on customers and commitments, and hands-on support while you take the reins. You will not be handed a backlog and left to guess.

They are building toward empowered product teams, where leadership sets priorities and outcomes and teams have real autonomy to discover how to achieve them. You and engineering leadership will define how Product and Engineering work together — engineers here are product-minded and deeply involved in how the product takes shape, and the handoff model is intentionally not prescriptive.

Their product operates in a regulated, high-stakes environment. A missed dose is a patient safety event, not a support ticket, and their customers are audited by state agencies whose requirements differ state by state. Product judgment here means understanding what actually happens in a group home at 7am during a shift change, not what looks good in a spec.

As with all leaders at this company, you'll need to be both hands-on and strategic — that combination is core to their culture. Priorities, travel, and schedules shift with the pace of a growing company and its leadership team, so you'll need to bring your own ideas, act autonomously when needed, and stay a strong team player at the same time. Communication — proactive, reactive, and yes, sometimes over-communication — is essential in an environment like this.
What You'll Do
Own the Roadmap

items: Own product strategy and the roadmap across the full surface area: software, connected hardware, and pharmacy/EHR integrations. Publish it so the company can see what is coming and why
Bring a point of view on where the platform should go over the next 12–24 months, and make the case for it
Weigh patient safety, HIPAA, and state-by-state regulatory requirements from the start rather than retrofitting them
Treat reporting, audit trails, and business intelligence as first-class product — audit-ready documentation is a primary reason customers choose this platform

blocks.text: Lead Discovery

items: Spend real time with caregivers, house managers, administrators, nurses, and state agency stakeholders — observing workflows rather than consuming feedback secondhand
Distinguish recurring needs from individual feature requests, and explain the difference to Sales and Customer Success
Design for three very different users: administrators (oversight/audit), caregivers (speed/clarity mid-shift), and the individuals receiving care
Design into existing routines rather than around them — usability is a safety requirement here, not a preference
Set the bar for product definition: clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case thinking Engineering can build from without guesswork

blocks.text: Build the Function

items: Establish how product gets practiced: how problems get framed, how discovery happens, how decisions get made, how outcomes get measured
Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, and shape the hiring plan — including roles that don't exist yet — as scope expands
Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations aligned on priorities and support strategic accounts and state-level opportunities where product credibility matters

blocks.text: Work With AI

items: Set the standard on AI rather than delegate it — use tools like Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic environments to explore the codebase, work with data, and build functional prototypes
Establish these practices across the Product team and coach your people into them
The goal is better-informed decisions about scope and value — not handing engineering a flashy prototype to productionize
