jobs.title: Global Head of Product, T&S Mandarin Required
jobs.text:
Global Head of Product, Trust & Safety (Mandarin Required)
Location:
- Singapore / NYC / Palo Alto
Industry:
- Consumer Internet / Technology
Function:
- Product Management
- Trust & Safety
Language:
- Mandarin & English (Mandatory)
The Company:
Our client is a leading global consumer technology company with a significant international presence and a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem. As the business continues to strengthen its international operations, it is investing in advanced Trust & Safety, risk management, and platform governance capabilities to support a safe, trusted, and scalable user experience. We are seeking an experienced Head of Product, Trust & Safety to lead the product strategy, development, and execution of critical safety and risk-management capabilities across international markets.
The Role:
This is a senior product leadership position combining Product Strategy, Trust & Safety, Risk Technology, and People Management. You will lead a team of Product Managers responsible for building and scaling solutions across content safety, platform integrity, risk prevention, policy enforcement, and governance infrastructure. The role requires someone who can translate complex platform risks and operational challenges into scalable product solutions, while balancing user safety, operational efficiency, regulatory considerations, and business objectives. You will work closely with Engineering, Algorithms, Data Science, Policy, Legal, and Trust & Safety Operations teams across international markets.
Key Responsibilities:
- Define and execute the international Trust & Safety product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers, establishing clear priorities and execution standards.
- Drive product initiatives across content safety, platform integrity, abuse prevention, risk detection, and policy enforcement.
- Develop and optimise moderation platforms, risk-control systems, policy enforcement workflows, and other Trust & Safety infrastructure.
- Partner with Engineering and Algorithm teams to improve automated risk detection, content classification, decisioning, and enforcement capabilities.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and large language models to improve Trust & Safety effectiveness and scalability.
- Translate complex policy, operational, and regulatory requirements into practical product capabilities.
- Establish product success metrics covering risk reduction, enforcement effectiveness, operational efficiency, and user experience.
- Ensure product capabilities can support different international markets, languages, cultural contexts, and regulatory environments.
- Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Data Science, Policy, Legal, and Operations.
- Collaborate closely with senior stakeholders and technical teams based in China to align international product priorities with global platform capabilities.
The Ideal Candidate:
We are looking for a senior Product leader with strong experience developing and scaling complex technology products, ideally within Trust & Safety, platform governance, risk control, or related areas. The strongest candidates will have:
- Significant Product Management experience, including leadership responsibility within a technology or consumer internet environment.
- Proven experience directly managing a team of at least 5 Product Managers (mandatory requirement).
- Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, owning complex roadmaps, and delivering products at scale.
- Strong understanding of Trust & Safety, content moderation, risk detection, policy enforcement, or platform integrity systems.
- Experience developing complex internal platforms, risk-control products, or operational technology systems.
- Strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Algorithms, and Data Science teams.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience defining product metrics and driving data-informed decisions.
- Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
- Strong people leadership, organisational development, and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Experience within a large-scale consumer internet, social media, UGC, marketplace, or technology platform would be highly advantageous.
- Comfortable operating within a fast-paced, international environment.
Language Requirements:
- Professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is mandatory.
- Candidates must be comfortable conducting senior-level product strategy discussions, technical discussions, and stakeholder alignment in Mandarin.
- Frequent collaboration with China-based Product, Engineering, and leadership stakeholders is a core requirement.
- Conversational Mandarin alone will not be sufficient.
Particularly Relevant Backgrounds:
Candidates with experience across the following areas will be particularly relevant:
- Trust & Safety Product Management
- Content Safety / Content Moderation Platforms
- Platform Integrity / Abuse Prevention
- Risk Control / Fraud Prevention Products
- Policy Enforcement Systems
- Platform Governance Infrastructure
- AI / ML-Enabled Safety Systems
- Large-Scale Internal Product Platforms
- Experience within major global consumer internet, technology, social media, or marketplace organisations would be highly valuable.
The Opportunity:
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important product function within a large-scale international consumer technology business. You will have:
- Leadership of an established Product Management team
- Significant ownership of international Trust & Safety product strategy
- The opportunity to build and scale advanced AI-enabled safety and risk-control capabilities
- Close collaboration with senior Product, Engineering, Policy, and Algorithm stakeholders
- Exposure to complex product challenges across multiple international markets
- The opportunity to shape how platform safety, integrity, and governance technologies evolve at scale
- Meaningful influence over the company's international product and technology direction
For an experienced Product leader who combines strong people leadership, technical product depth, and Trust & Safety expertise, this represents an opportunity to build and scale critical platform capabilities within a growing international technology organisation.
*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
EA Licence No.: 25S3232
EA Personnel Reg. No.: R1874604
EA Personnel Name: Kenneth Ho

jobs.title: VP Product Management
jobs.text:
Our client is a leader in AP Payments as a Service, specializing in embedded B2B payments. They streamline the payment process by integrating electronic payment and cash flow solutions into accounts payable and procurement software.
Their vision is for finance leaders to decide only "what" to pay, while their software manages the "how" and "when."
The company is a major disruptor in B2B Payments and Fintech, growing revenue by over 100% annually. They've raised over $65M from investors like JP Morgan, Discover, NBH Bank, Mendon Venture Partners, and Valley Bankwho are also customers and partners.
Role Overview:
As the Vice President of Product Management, you will shape and drive our software roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and delivering top-notch results. You will lead a dynamic team, defining product vision, strategy, and execution to achieve market leadership.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, engineering, or related field; MBA preferred.
8-10 years in product management with a proven track record.
Strong leadership and communication skills.
Expertise in product development processes and methodologies.
Experience in B2B, technology, software, or SaaS industries.
Success in product innovation and revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities:
Act as the primary liaison between business P&L owners and the product development team.
Drive product vision, strategy, and execution to achieve market leadership.
Ensure leadership alignment and support for product management methodologies.
Define and manage internal and external product roadmaps.
Develop processes for customer feedback management and prioritize needs.
Install project plan methodology for efficient product commercialization.
Create C-suite/board-ready presentation materials on product strategy.
Develop external materials communicating product strategy and value.
Collaborate with P&L owners to develop business cases for product initiatives.
Execute product commercialization, planning, and go-to-market strategies.
Foster strong relationships with internal customers and support their needs.
Conduct market analysis to understand current and future needs.
Establish and track KPIs to measure and optimize product performance.
Lead and delegate product management and commercialization activities.
Benefits:
Fast-paced start-up environment with experienced leaders.
Opportunities to engage with the latest technologies and make a measurable impact.
Quarterly virtual team-building activities and monthly team lunches.
Competitive salary ($150,000 - $175,000) plus equity.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Unlimited vacation policy.
This is a remote position.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Lead Engineer / Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
The Role
Navable is hiring a senior, hands-on Lead Engineer / Head of Engineering to own the technical foundation of the company.
This is a foundational leadership role for an experienced full-stack engineer who wants real ownership across architecture, execution, AI strategy, and team building — with a clear path to leading Navable’s long-term engineering organization.
You will work directly with the Founder & CEO to:
Scale and harden our core platform
Architect systems built for financial accuracy, auditability, and security
Execute on a roadmap of AI-powered products embedded directly into fund operations workflows
Establish engineering standards and hire our early in-house team
In the near term, this role is deeply hands-on. You will write production code, own architectural decisions, manage external engineering resources, and establish engineering standards. Over time, you will hire and lead a growing in-house team.
While this is a remote role, candidates must be based in the U.S., with a strong preference for someone in the greater New York area.
What You’ll Own
Architecture & Platform
Own system architecture and technical roadmap
Evolve our carry and compensation engine to support increasingly complex firm structures
Ensure scalability, performance, and enterprise-grade reliability
AI Product Execution
Lead development of AI-based features that enhance workflows, automation, and decision support
Translate real customer pain points into practical, production-ready AI solutions
Establish the foundation for applied AI across the Navable platform
Hands-On Development
Write high-quality production code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure
Lead technical refactors and improve developer velocity
Security & Compliance
Design secure systems appropriate for institutional financial clients
Support SOC 2 and enterprise security requirements
Engineering Leadership
Manage current external engineering resources
Define hiring needs and build Navable’s in-house engineering team
Establish strong engineering culture and standards
Who You Are
Senior full-stack engineer with early-stage startup experience
Have owned architecture through periods of growth
Comfortable across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure
Experienced building systems that handle sensitive financial or regulated data
Excited about applying AI in structured, high-value enterprise workflows
Thrive in high-ownership, ambiguous environments
Want to build and lead an enduring engineering organization
Compensation
Competitive base salary
Meaningful equity ownership
Flexible PTO

jobs.title: Director, Developer Relations
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As Director, Developer Relations – Europe, you will lead Roblox’s developer ecosystem strategy and growth across Europe. You will be accountable for defining the regional strategy, establishing the partnerships and programs required to execute it, and delivering measurable outcomes for the Roblox developer ecosystem.
You will build deep relationships with leading developers, studios, publishers, technology partners, and emerging creators while identifying the next generation of high-potential partners for Roblox. You will serve as a senior representative of Roblox within the regional games and technology industries and as an executive-level advocate for the needs and opportunities of developers within Roblox.
This role requires both strategic vision and operational leadership. You will translate Roblox’s global priorities into a regional strategy, identify opportunities and barriers to ecosystem growth, and mobilize teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Creator, and International to deliver against those opportunities.
Note: This is a 1-year contract position, with the potential to convert to a full-time role, subject to business needs and mutual agreement.
You Have
Tack record of building trusted relationships with game developers, studios, or publishers. Developer relations, partner or account management, business development, licensing or partnerships experience preferred
Experienced leading regional or ecosystem strategy with measurable business impact.
Deeply knowledgeable about the games and developer landscape in Europe.
Able to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
Data-driven, strategic, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
Familiar with Roblox Studio, Unity, Unreal, or similar development tools.
Proficiency in one or more of the following European languages is a plus: Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Swedish, or Finnish.
Based in the Netherlands or willing to relocate.
You Will
Own the multi-year developer ecosystem strategy for Europe.
Drive developer acquisition, engagement, and long-term success.
Build executive relationships with key studios, publishers, and ecosystem partners.
Identify regional developer needs and influence Roblox product priorities.
Set goals, metrics, and operating rhythms for regional ecosystem growth.
Partner cross-functionally to turn strategy into execution.
Represent Roblox at major industry and developer events.
Surface market trends, opportunities, and risks to senior leadership.
Build and lead the regional Developer Relations organization as the opportunity grows.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means that Roblox has a clear and durable developer ecosystem strategy for Europe, stronger relationships with the region’s most important developers and studios, a growing pipeline of high-potential developers building on Roblox, and a measurable increase in the quality and success of experiences emerging from the region.
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: VP Data Management
jobs.text:
Vice President Data Management
Department: Data Management
Location: Remote (USA-based, with travel as required)
Job Summary
The Vice President of Data Management is an executive leader responsible for overseeing client engagement strategy, delivery success, account growth, and financial performance across a diverse set of industry verticals (e.g., Sports & Entertainment, Media, CPG, Manufacturing, Energy, CPG etc).
This role combines hands-on leadership in data management with a consultative approach to solving complex enterprise data challenges. The ideal candidate will have prior experience in a global consulting firm, a strong background in enterprise data management (EDM), and a track record of owning P&L, building high-performing teams, and delivering measurable client outcomes across varied sectors.
Key Responsibilities
40% Vertical Expansion & Strategic Growth
Drive $10M+ in annual revenue through the growth of client accounts across diversified industries.
Build industry-specific go-to-market strategies and consultative solutions in EDM, data governance, data platforms, and analytics.
Lead client portfolio strategy and collaborate with business unit leaders to shape offerings and account pursuits.
Act as a strategic advisor to client executives across industries, identifying opportunities to expand data and analytics services.
30% Client Relationship Leadership
Serve as the executive sponsor for client engagements, ensuring business value delivery and client satisfaction.
Cultivate long-term C-level relationships and identify opportunities for cross-sell and upsell into data, digital, analytics, cloud, and AI/ML.
Conduct executive business reviews, ROI demonstrations, and client feedback sessions to ensure alignment with client goals.
Lead strategic solutioning and proposal development for complex data transformation programs.
15% Engagement Oversight & Operations
Oversee delivery excellence through structured engagement metrics, governance, and financial tracking (revenue, margins, utilization).
Manage SOW execution, change orders, and project escalations to ensure delivery success.
Coordinate with finance, delivery, and resourcing to forecast, provision, and optimize account profitability.
10% Leadership & Talent Development
Mentor project leaders, solution architects, and client partners; build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and skills development initiatives across the data management practice.
Serve as an executive presence in internal forums and industry events to elevate brand and talent attraction.
5% Cross-BU Collaboration & Other Duties
Partner with leaders from analytics, digital, and AI/ML to develop joint offerings.
Contribute to IP development, industry playbooks, and reusable accelerators in EDM and cloud data solutions.
Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
15+ years of experience in enterprise data management and transformation (EDM, data warehousing, MDM, data quality, governance).
10+ years in a consulting or professional services environment, with delivery, practice, and business development responsibilities.
Prior P&L ownership and demonstrated success in growing multi-million-dollar accounts across different industries.
Experience leading pre-sales, proposals, and solution shaping with cross-functional delivery and sales teams.
Nice to Have
Domain expertise in at least 2 - 3 industries such as CPG, Retail, Manufacturing, Sports & Entertainment.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, GCP, AWS, Azure), MDM tools, and governance frameworks.
Certifications in Agile, PMP, or industry-standard data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).
Exposure to emerging technologies like AI/ML, GenAI, and real-time data integration tools.
Key Skills & Competencies
Expertise in leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery teams (onshore/offshore).
Strong executive communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Deep understanding of SDLC, agile methodologies, and data modernization strategies.
Proven consultative approach to client problems and solution selling.
Analytical and financial acumen in managing forecasts, staffing, and revenue targets.
Supervisory Responsibilities
Direct oversight of account leads, project managers, and solution architects across engagements.
Provides regular feedback, performance evaluations, and growth path development for team members.
Collaborates with HR and competency leads to manage hiring and team health.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, TradingView (Growth & Trading Experience)
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.
Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.
What You’ll Be Doing
Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity —
Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.
Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey —
Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.
Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention —
Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.
Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships —
Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.
Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration —
Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.
Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment —
Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.
What We Look For In You
Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.
A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.
Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.
Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.
An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.
Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.
Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.
Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.
Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.
Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.
What Success Looks Like
An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.
Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.
Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.
Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration —

Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.
Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment —

Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.
What We Look For In You

Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.

A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.

Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.

Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.

An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.

Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.

Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.
Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.
Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.

Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.
What Success Looks Like
An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.
Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.
Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.

Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.

Competitive total compensation package

jobs.title: VP, Information Technology
jobs.text:
At Adaptive, we’re Powering the Age of Immune Medicine. Our goal is to harness the power of the adaptive immune system to transform the way diseases are diagnosed and treated.
As an Adapter, you’ll have the opportunity to make a difference in people’s lives. With Adaptive, you’ll create a career highlight through collaboration with bright, curious colleagues working at the apex of innovation and application.
It’s time for your next chapter. Discover your story with Adaptive.
Position Overview
The Vice President, Information Technology is the senior leader responsible for defining and executing the enterprise IT strategy and ensuring the delivery of reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective technology capabilities that support Adaptive’s business objectives and long-term growth.
In partnership with the Senior Vice President, Technology and the executive leadership team, the Vice President establishes the vision, priorities, operating model, and multi-year roadmap for enterprise IT. This role has executive accountability for corporate infrastructure, enterprise applications, the Enterprise Data Warehouse and related data platforms, Modern Workplace, identity and access management, Service Desk operations, Business Relationship Management, IT governance, and business continuity.
The Vice President serves as a strategic advisor to business and functional leaders, anticipating organizational needs and translating business priorities into enterprise technology investments and capabilities. This leader is accountable for IT organizational performance, financial stewardship, operational resilience, risk management, regulatory readiness, employee technology experience, and measurable business outcomes.
Leaders at Adaptive demonstrate behaviors consistent with Adaptive’s Core Values and Leadership Principles. Critical functions of your role include helping establish individual team member goals, aligning those individual goals with broader team objectives, and ensuring those objectives drive the achievement of company goals. Providing thoughtful coaching and consistent feedback to your team members will drive performance excellence and accountability, as well as support your team members’ growth and development. Leaders at Adaptive create an environment of belonging, respect, and open and honest communication every day.
Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions
Enterprise IT Strategy and Executive Leadership
Define and own Adaptive’s enterprise IT strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap in alignment with company and Technology priorities.
Partner with the SVP, Technology, executive leadership team, and functional leaders to identify business needs, evaluate technology opportunities, and prioritize enterprise investments.
Serve as the company’s principal advisor on enterprise IT capabilities, operational resilience, technology lifecycle management, data platforms, and the employee technology experience.
Translate business strategy into scalable technology capabilities, transformation initiatives, investment plans, and measurable outcomes.
Establish enterprise IT priorities and communicate strategy, performance, risks, and investment needs to executive stakeholders.
Monitor emerging technologies, industry trends, and evolving business requirements to identify opportunities and manage enterprise technology risk.
Organizational Leadership and Operating Model
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing enterprise IT organization capable of supporting Adaptive’s current operations and future growth.
Establish an effective organizational structure with clear roles, decision rights, accountability, succession plans, and career development opportunities.
Lead and develop IT leaders and teams through clear expectations, regular coaching, performance management, and workforce planning.
Foster a culture of customer focus, operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Define and maintain IT governance, policies, standards, controls, and operating procedures across the enterprise.
Establish appropriate sourcing and service-delivery models across internal teams, managed service providers, consultants, and technology vendors.
Infrastructure, Enterprise Systems, and Data Platforms
Own the strategy, architecture, implementation, operation, and lifecycle management of Adaptive’s corporate technology environment.
Provide executive oversight for networks, cloud platforms, identity and access management, endpoints, telecommunications, collaboration platforms, and workplace technology.
Establish the enterprise applications strategy and oversee platforms supporting functions such as Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Operations, and employee productivity.
Own the strategy, architecture, operation, and lifecycle management of the Enterprise Data Warehouse and related enterprise data platforms.
Ensure enterprise systems and data platforms are resilient, scalable, secure, supportable, integrated, and aligned with business requirements and enterprise architecture standards.
Partner with Data, Engineering, Security, and business leaders to establish standards for data architecture, integration, governance, quality, access, retention, lineage, and security.
Oversee the integration of enterprise applications and source systems into the Enterprise Data Warehouse, including data pipelines, monitoring, service levels, and operational support.
Ensure enterprise data platforms effectively support reporting, analytics, regulatory requirements, and strategic decision-making.
Guide technology selection, modernization, consolidation, and retirement decisions to reduce complexity and improve business value.
Establish lifecycle, capacity, availability, performance, and resilience plans for critical enterprise systems and data services.
Modern Workplace, Service Delivery, and Employee Experience
Own the Modern Workplace strategy, including endpoints, collaboration platforms, productivity tools, mobility, workplace technology, and employee technology adoption.
Establish the vision and service model for enterprise IT support and the end-to-end employee technology experience.
Provide executive oversight of Service Desk operations, including incident and request fulfillment, knowledge management, escalation, service performance, and continuous improvement.
Ensure consistent, responsive, and high-quality IT services across office-based, remote, and distributed teams.
Define service-level objectives, key performance indicators, experience measures, operational metrics, and executive reporting mechanisms.
Use performance data and employee feedback to improve service quality, reliability, productivity, adoption, and satisfaction.
Provide executive oversight of incident, problem, request, asset, knowledge, configuration, and change-management practices.
Ensure technology onboarding, offboarding, and other employee lifecycle services are secure, consistent, efficient, and scalable.
Business Relationship Management
Establish and lead a Business Relationship Management capability that connects business priorities with IT strategy, services, capabilities, and investments.
Develop trusted relationships with functional leaders to understand their objectives, demand, pain points, risks, and future capability needs.
Maintain business technology roadmaps and facilitate demand intake, prioritization, portfolio planning, and value realization.
Translate business needs into clear technology requirements, service improvements, and investment proposals.
Ensure business stakeholders receive clear communication regarding service performance, initiative status, technology risks, dependencies, and investment decisions.
Measure stakeholder satisfaction and the business value delivered through IT services and initiatives.
Promote adoption of enterprise technology capabilities and ensure business areas are prepared for technology-driven change.
Security, Risk, Compliance, and Business Continuity
Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance leaders to maintain secure IT operations and support regulatory and contractual obligations.
Ensure the effective implementation and operation of IT controls related to identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, patching, configuration, backups, and disaster recovery.
Establish clear accountability for technology risks and ensure material risks, control gaps, and remediation plans are communicated to appropriate executive stakeholders.
Oversee IT’s participation in audits, risk assessments, regulatory reviews, and customer assurance activities.
Maintain and regularly test IT business-continuity and disaster-recovery capabilities.
Provide executive leadership during significant technology incidents, coordinating response, communication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
Portfolio, Financial, and Vendor Leadership
Own enterprise IT portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and delivery.
Develop and manage the IT operating and capital budgets, multi-year investment plans, forecasts, and resource-allocation decisions.
Establish business cases and value measures for significant technology investments and ensure initiatives deliver intended outcomes.
Provide executive oversight of strategic vendors, managed service providers, contracts, renewals, licensing, and commercial negotiations.
Evaluate vendor performance, concentration risk, service quality, security posture, and long-term strategic fit.
Drive cost optimization, platform rationalization, and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate service, security, resilience, and compliance standards.
Cross-Functional Partnership and Transformation
Build trusted partnerships with Engineering, Data, Security, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and other business functions.
Lead the IT components of enterprise transformations, organizational changes, office expansions, and major business initiatives.
Partner with business leaders to improve processes, increase automation, strengthen data flows, and support effective technology adoption.
Provide leadership for the IT aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and integrations, including diligence, planning, execution, and stabilization.
Establish effective change-management and communication practices for enterprise technology initiatives.
Represent enterprise IT in executive planning, governance, and decision-making forums.
Other Responsibilities
All other duties as assigned.
Position Requirements (Education, Experience, Other)
Required
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with at least 20 years of related experience,
OR
Master’s degree in a related field with at least 18 years of related experience,
OR
D. in a related field with at least 12 years of related experience
Significant senior leadership experience within enterprise IT, including leadership of managers, multidisciplinary teams, and complex technology portfolios.
Demonstrated success defining and executing an enterprise IT strategy aligned with business objectives and organizational growth.
Proven experience leading enterprise IT operations in a complex, distributed, or rapidly evolving organization.
Deep understanding of cloud platforms, enterprise SaaS, identity and access management, endpoint technologies, networking, collaboration platforms, Modern Workplace capabilities, and IT service management.
Demonstrated experience overseeing enterprise applications and data platforms, including an Enterprise Data Warehouse.
Experience leading Service Desk operations and establishing measurable service-management and employee-experience practices.
Experience establishing effective relationships between IT and business functions, including demand management, prioritization, roadmap development, and value realization.
Proven ability to lead large-scale technology transformations and complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience developing and managing significant budgets, investment portfolios, strategic vendors, and outsourced service providers.
Strong knowledge of IT governance, data governance, operational risk, business continuity, disaster recovery, and security-control practices.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, communicate complex technology matters clearly, and make sound decisions with incomplete or evolving information.
Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect technology investments to measurable business value.
Preferred
Experience in a regulated or compliance-driven environment.
Working knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or other applicable standards.
Experience supporting global or geographically distributed organizations.
Experience leading IT integrations for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or significant organizational transformations.
Experience presenting technology strategy, performance, investment priorities, and risk considerations to executive leadership or board-level audiences.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, Certified Business Relationship Manager, or cloud-platform certifications.
Working Conditions
May require periodic travel, up to three times per quarter, to support business operations, team collaboration, or strategic initiatives.
May require intermittent work outside normal business hours, including evenings or weekends, to provide executive oversight for critical incidents, system upgrades, or major initiatives.
Participation in executive escalation and major-incident response processes is required to ensure continuity of critical IT services.
Compensation
Salary Range: $261,000 - $391,600
Possible “other compensation” elements to include:
equity grant
bonus eligible

jobs.title: Head of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Hey, mabuhay! 👋
Thanks for dropping by. We know looking for the right job can feel like being stuck in EDSA traffic, so we’ll keep it moving and get straight to the point.
With over 8 million downloads and a powerful network of thousand of dedicated biker-partners, we are a leading ride-hailing platform operating across the Philippines. Our vision is to end poverty in the Philippines through revolutionary transportation solutions. We aim to provide our customers with convenient, reliable, and safe rides, impacting millions of lives positively every single day.
Now, we're looking for a Head of Engineering. You will lead our multi-team engineering organization across our customer and driver apps, backend platforms, and operations tools, while spearheading our transition to an AI-native organization.
Responsibilities:
Keep mission-critical services reliable. Build robust, highly available systems at scale, designed to self-heal and backed by tested failover and disaster recovery for critical workflows.
Lead incidents end to end. Take command when things break, coordinate across engineering, SRE, and Ops, drive rigorous RCAs, and put preventive measures in place so issues don't recur.
Build a healthy, high-performing org. Grow the engineering organization through hiring as well as career and skill development. Set a culture of ownership and align teams around clear goals and metrics.
Deliver the roadmap predictably. Work with Product to shape features and sharpen scope, ensuring solutions are scalable, well architected, and built as reusable platforms. Keep commitments predictable, rescue projects that drift, and make releases safe.
Set the technical bar. Quality-gate architecture and designs for scalability, security, and cost before they reach the CTO, and provide senior technical direction across squads.
Raise the bar on velocity and stability. Establish meaningful delivery and reliability metrics for our systems and teams, use them to spot bottlenecks, and remove what slows engineers down.
Lead the shift to AI-native engineering. Use AI to improve developer experience: remove friction and toil from how engineers build, review, ship, and operate, and drive measurable gains in speed, quality, and system health.
At Angkas, we believe in giving our people the trust and flexibility to work in a way that helps them and their teams perform at their best. Whether you’re working onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid setup, we provide the flexibility, you bring the drive. ⚡
Let’s get this show on the road!🚦

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.
About Evo
For more than 20 years, the Evolution Championship Series (Evo) has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are gathering points where players, fans, publishers, developers, creators, and brands come together to celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them.
Beyond our flagship live events, Evo continues to expand how we create, celebrate, and grow fighting game fandom around the world.
Role Overview
We’re looking for a Director of Product, Evo to lead the vision, development, and continued evolution of Evo’s live event and consumer products.
This person will define what we build, why we build it, and how Evo brings its tournaments, programming, and fan experiences to life around the world. You will own the end-to-end development of select Evo products, from tournament formats and on-site attractions to new events, specialty programming, and other major initiatives that will help shape Evo’s future.
You will take products from initial concept through launch, defining the audience, goals, scope, requirements, budget, and measures of success. You will work closely with Event Operations, Production, Broadcast, Marketing, Partnerships, and Business Development to ensure each product can be delivered successfully and remains true to Evo’s community and brand.
This is a senior leadership role within Evo. In addition to leading individual products, you will help shape Evo’s broader product portfolio, support decisions about global expansion and future growth, develop strong leaders and teams, and take on broader leadership responsibilities across the business when needed.
The right person combines product strategy, live event experience, audience empathy, and strong business judgment. They understand how to translate fighting game culture and broader gaming fandom into competitive and entertainment products that can grow without losing what makes Evo special.
At our size, this is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable moving between long-term product planning, experience design, documentation, budget decisions, team leadership, cross-functional coordination, and on-site execution.
Reporting Structure
You will report to Evo’s General Manager.
Key Responsibilities
Evo Product Strategy
Own the vision, priorities, plans, and measures of success for major Evo products, including live events, tournament experiences, on-site attractions, and specialty programming.
Write clear product and event briefs that define experience goals, spatial concepts, stage requirements, tournament parameters, and what each team is expected to deliver.
Make product tradeoffs across features, formats, and investments using audience data, player sentiment, endemic impact, business value, timing, complexity, and cost.
Define ticket types, experience packages, benefits, and attendee value in partnership with Event Operations, Marketing, Finance, and other relevant teams.
Work with the General Manager and company leadership to set product priorities and evaluate new formats, events, and markets.
Event & Consumer Experience Development
Lead the development of flagship event features and experiential zones, including museum exhibits, indie developer showcases, vendor villages, artist alleys, community meetups, and other on-site attractions.
Define tournament formats, exhibition formats, rulesets, and competition structures in partnership with tournament and event teams.
Lead the ideation and development of new events and specialty products, including exhibition programming and publisher partnered showcases, creating repeatable, scalable formats that can be adapted for Evo events in different markets.
Consider the full attendee and viewer journey, including how an experience works on-site, on broadcast, and across Evo’s content channels.
Publisher & Partner Experiences
Partner with Partnerships, Marketing, and Business Development to design industry leading experiences for Evo’s partners that fit within Evo’s broader product and consumer plans, including activations, show features, developer panels, content presentations, commercial segments, circuit qualifier integrations, and official circuit finals.
Define the structural guidelines for tournament activations, publisher-supported side events, and programming
Ensure partner integrations add something meaningful to the player, attendee, or viewer experience and feel right for Evo.
Join major publisher and partner conversations when product direction, tournament formats, or fan experiences are a central part of the opportunity.
Product Management & Processes
Create consistent ways of evaluating, prioritizing, planning, and documenting Evo products and experiences across our global events.
Monitor attendance, participation, capacity, show pacing, fan feedback, and other relevant measures during live events to assess product performance and identify changes that should be made during the event or in the future.
Lead post-event product reviews and turn community feedback, viewership data, surveys, and internal feedback into clear improvements for future events.
On-Site Creative Stewardship & Execution Support
Manage the creative integrity of the event on-site, ensuring all stage presentations, experiential feature builds, and brand moments match documented expectations and creative standards.
Partner closely with Event Production to resolve issues that affect the player, attendee, broadcast, or partner experience.
Support the selection and management of specialized experiential vendors, contractors, and other outside partners when needed.
Provide hands-on product direction during events and work with Event Operations, Production, and Broadcast to make changes when circumstances shift.
Participate on-site at major Evo events and other product launches as needed.
Budget Management
Develop and manage approved budgets for assigned products and programs, including prize pools, experiential builds, specialty programming, and early product development.
Review product costs, audience engagement, and results to help decide where Evo should invest in the future.
Evaluate the audience, cost, revenue potential, and operational needs of proposed products and experiences.
Leadership & Team Development
Serve as a senior member of Evo’s leadership team and help make decisions across Evo’s products, events, teams, and future plans.
Build strong working relationships across Evo and RTS and help teams align around shared priorities.
Lead, manage, and develop product team members as the function grows.
Set clear roles, goals, and expectations for team members and outside partners supporting assigned products.
Step in to lead major events, new products, and cross-functional projects when needed.
Qualifications
10+ years of experience across product management, live event development, experience design, or creative leadership, or related roles.
Experience taking complex live events, gaming, entertainment, or consumer products from initial concept through launch and continued improvement.
Experience developing tournaments, attendee experiences, programming, activations, or other large-scale fan-facing products.
Strong experience defining product goals, scope, requirements, budgets, and measures of success.
Ability to turn broad creative ideas into clear and practical briefs that production and operations teams can execute.
Experience working across Event Operations, Production, Broadcast, Marketing, Partnerships, Business Development, and other teams to deliver complex initiatives and resolve competing priorities.
Experience managing budgets, evaluating product performance, and making decisions based on audience, operational, and business results.
Experience leading teams and developing other leaders.
Strong communication, judgment, organization, and prioritization skills, with the ability to move between long-term planning and hands-on event execution.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for Evo events, planning meetings, and other major milestones.
Bonus Points
Background developing products or experiences across a global event portfolio.
Familiarity with designing products for players, attendees, viewers, publishers, and commercial partners.
Deep understanding of competitive gaming ecosystems, live event dynamics, and familiarity with the Fighting Game Community (FGC).
Ability to create repeatable event formats that can be adapted for different markets.
Established relationships with experiential agencies, creative vendors, production partners, or other specialized contractors.
Previous leadership within a growing entertainment, events, gaming, or consumer business.
Compensation
The salary for this role is $140,000 to $200,000, based on experience and qualifications.
Benefits
Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
401k plan available for employee contributions
Flexible work schedule
Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
Remote-first culture

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics
jobs.text:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.
If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.
At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics
The Senior Director, Enterprise Data leads Vetsource's enterprise data organization and is accountable for making data a trusted, high-value business asset to drive product innovation and business performance. This role brings together data engineering, analytics, MLOps, AI engineering, and data services under a common strategy and operating model.
Working closely with business leaders, product, security, and technology teams, the Senior Director, Enterprise Data translates business priorities into governed data products, scalable platforms, meaningful insights, and AI capabilities. The role is responsible for measurable improvements in data quality, adoption, and business value for associates, customers, and industry partners.
This is a full-time, remote position.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Enterprise Data Strategy and Leadership
Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Data Engineering Platforms and Integration
Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Analytics and Data Products
Lead analytics and business intelligence teams that develop trusted metrics, analytical models, dashboards, and decision-support products for internal stakeholders and external customers.
Adopt a data product approach for priority business domains, with defined customers, accountable business and technology owners, quality expectations, service levels, documentation, and adoption measures.
Partner with business teams to define critical data domains and common metrics so teams can make decisions using consistent, well-understood information.
Ensure analytical work addresses a clear business decision or workflow and produces measurable value, not simply reports or dashboards.
AI Enablement and Adoption
Develop the data and platform foundations required for AI-powered products, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and generative AI use cases.
Partner with product, engineering, security, privacy, legal, and business leaders to evaluate and deliver AI use cases with appropriate controls for data access, quality, privacy, safety, traceability, and monitoring.
Enable associates and customers to access approved data and insights through governed conversational interfaces and AI assistants, while preserving metric consistency, permissions, and source traceability.
Establish practical standards for model and prompt lifecycle management, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, and MLOps or LLMOps where applicable.
Build data and AI literacy across the organization through education, reusable patterns, and close partnership with business teams.
Data Governance Trust and Risk
Create a federated governance model that assigns business and technology ownership for critical data and establishes clear decision rights and stewardship responsibilities.
Oversee the enterprise data catalog, business glossary, lineage, quality rules, access policies, retention practices, and issue-management processes.
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, and legal teams to ensure data and AI capabilities meet contractual, regulatory, ethical, and company requirements.
Build trust by making data quality and ownership transparent and by ensuring material data issues are prioritized, communicated, and resolved.
Business Partnership and Delivery
Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across the company, helping them frame business questions, understand data limitations, and use evidence to make better decisions.
Create a transparent intake and prioritization process that balances strategic initiatives, customer commitments, platform health, regulatory needs, and operational support.
Manage divisional objectives, service metrics, budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity plans; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to executive stakeholders.
Promote strong product management and engineering practices that improve delivery speed, quality, accountability, and customer experience.
Supervisory Responsibilities
Lead a multidisciplinary organization that may include managers and individual contributors across data engineering, integration, analytics, business intelligence, AI engineering, MLOps, and data product development.
Set clear goals and decision rights, manage performance, and hold leaders accountable for business outcomes, platform reliability, and delivery commitments.
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing teams; build succession plans and strengthen technical, product, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
Create an inclusive culture of ownership, curiosity, constructive challenge, continuous learning, and responsible innovation.
Delegate effectively, remove organizational blockers, and help teams make sound decisions close to the work.
WHAT YOU BRING
12+ years of progressive experience across data engineering, analytics, and data platforms
8+ years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams and leaders.
Proven track record in delivering production AI/ML capabilities, including assessing data readiness, enforcing AI governance (access controls, audit trails), and managing MLOps/LLMOps.
Demonstrated experience defining and executing an enterprise data strategy or broad data transformation with measurable business outcomes.
Strong and prior hands on data engineering background, including experience with modern cloud data platforms, data modeling, batch and near real time streaming platforms like Kafka, schema registries, APIs and integration patterns, testing, observability, and production operations.
Experience leading analytics and business intelligence capabilities, including governed metrics, semantic models, dashboards, experimentation, or advanced analytics.
Experience establishing data governance, catalog, lineage, quality, access, ownership, and stewardship practices in partnership with business leaders.
Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, vendors, investment tradeoffs, and capacity planning.
Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to executive, business, customer, and technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, build alignment across functions, and convert ambiguous opportunities into focused plans and delivered results.
Preferred Experience and Qualifications:
Experience with cloud data and AI services, modern data warehouses or lakehouses, transformation and orchestration tools, event platforms, BI tools, and data catalogs.
Experience building data products or commercial data services for external customers and partners.
Experience in veterinary health, animal health, pharmacy, healthcare, ecommerce, or another regulated, data-intensive industry.
Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, statistics, information management, economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
WORKING CONDITIONS
Remote work environment with reliable internet access.
Extended periods working at a computer, with the ability to alternate between sitting and standing.
Travel up to 30 percent, including occasional international travel, based on business needs.
WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM VETSOURCE
In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:
Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care
PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day
Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program
Paid parental leave
Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible
The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!
For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*
OUR VALUES
Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.
Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.
Pay Range (US based applicants): $190,265 - $240,000 USD + Annual Bonus Plan Eligible
Pay Range (CAN based applicants): $185,000 - $240,000 CAD + Annual Bonus Plan Eligible
Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, certifications, relevant education and training, while also considering internal equity.
The statements in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed for this role, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Our pre-employment process includes a background check as a part of the hiring process, and will include a drug screen for pharmacy related roles. The background check will only be initiated after a conditional offer of employment has been made and will be subject to an individualized assessment, as required by law. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please email , or if you have general questions relating to this process. No agencies please. We are an equal opportunity employer.
Vetsource is an E-verify employer.

Partner with business teams to define critical data domains and common metrics so teams can make decisions using consistent, well-understood information.

Enable associates and customers to access approved data and insights through governed conversational interfaces and AI assistants, while preserving metric consistency, permissions, and source traceability.
Establish practical standards for model and prompt lifecycle management, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, and MLOps or LLMOps where applicable.
Build data and AI literacy across the organization through education, reusable patterns, and close partnership with business teams.

blocks.text: Data Governance Trust and Risk

blocks.text: Business Partnership and Delivery

Create a transparent intake and prioritization process that balances strategic initiatives, customer commitments, platform health, regulatory needs, and operational support.
Manage divisional objectives, service metrics, budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity plans; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to executive stakeholders.

Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing teams; build succession plans and strengthen technical, product, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
