jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.text:
The VP, Product Management role will lead the product strategy for several of eMoney's foundational platform capabilities, including data aggregation, APIs, strategic integrations and the evolution of our platform for an AI-native future. This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of product, technology, data and AI. This role will lead a team responsible for products and capabilities that enable eMoney's platform to connect to financial data sources, enterprise customers, strategic partners and increasingly to AI applications and agents. A key priority will be helping eMoney determine how our platform should safely and strategically expose data and planning capabilities to AI agents, including emerging technologies such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), while protecting eMoney's differentiated planning intelligence and intellectual property. This role is an opportunity to shape a foundational component of eMoney's AI strategy and help establish the platform as a trusted source of financial data and planning intelligence within the emerging AI ecosystem.
Job Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Leadership
Bring deep product leadership experience across enterprise platforms, APIs, data products and integrations, combined with a strong understanding of emerging AI technologies and agentic architectures.
• Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for eMoney's Platform, Data, APIs and AI capabilities.
• Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing team of Product Managers and product leaders.
• Partner closely with executive leadership to identify opportunities to strengthen eMoney's platform differentiation and competitive position.
• Establish clear product metrics and accountability for business, customer and platform outcomes.
• This role will work with Technology Leadership to determine how these requirements are technically implemented, while maintaining Product accountability for what capabilities should be exposed and under what conditions.
Data Aggregation & Data Products
Lead product strategy for eMoney's data aggregation capabilities and related customer experiences.
• Partner with Technology and Data leadership to ensure the platform is increasingly prepared for AI-driven use cases.
• Identify opportunities to leverage eMoney's data foundation as a strategic differentiator.
AI Platform & Agentic AI
Define eMoney's product strategy for AI platform connectivity and agentic experiences.
• Establish the product strategy and requirements for MCP and other emerging AI connectivity standards.
• Ensure APIs evolve from traditional application integrations toward an architecture capable of supporting AI applications and agent integrations.
• Establish clear product requirements for authentication, authorization, entitlements, data access, auditability and enterprise governance.
• Define appropriate boundaries between customer-accessible data and eMoney's proprietary planning intelligence.
• Ensure AI connectivity supports eMoney's broader Always-On Planning strategy.
• Partner with AI Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal and Compliance leaders to establish appropriate AI governance.
Requirements
12+ years of progressive Product Management experience, with significant experience leading enterprise fintech products.
• Proven experience leading product organizations at the VP or equivalent senior leadership level.
• Deep experience with platform products, APIs, data products, and enterprise integrations.
• Experience defining product strategy for complex technology platforms used by large enterprise customers.
• Strong understanding of modern cloud architectures, APIs, data platforms and enterprise
integration patterns.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with CTO, Engineering and Architecture leaders.
• Experience translating complex technology capabilities into clear customer and business value.
AI / Emerging Technology Experience
Strong understanding of generative AI, AI platforms and emerging agentic architectures.
• Experience defining products or platforms that incorporate AI, intelligent workflows or AI agents.
• Understanding of AI tool/function calling, agent orchestration, APIs and emerging AI connectivity standards such as MCP.
• Ability to assess emerging technologies and translate them into practical product strategies.
• Understanding of the data, security, governance and intellectual-property implications of exposing enterprise capabilities to AI systems.
Skills
The role will be expected to operate effectively at both the strategic executive level and the detailed product-definition level.
• Strong executive communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
• Experience managing and developing senior Product leaders and building high-performing product organizations.
The salary range for this position is $227,000 - $282,000; commensurate salary to be determined based on skills, professional background and expertise. This position is also eligible, pursuant to applicable eMoney policies, for the annual bonus program, retirement contributions, health insurance, sick leave, parental leave and paid time off.
At eMoney, we’re powering what’s possible in financial planning. Our mission is to help people talk about money and make more informed financial decisions. Through our comprehensive financial planning solutions, we help advisors bring clarity to complex decisions and deliver more personalized guidance.
Today, eMoney supports more than 138,000 financial professionals who guide the financial lives of over 7 million end clients. That reach gives every member of our team the opportunity to contribute to work that makes a meaningful, lasting impact.
We’re equally committed to powering what’s possible for our people. We foster an inclusive, people-first culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and employees are supported in doing their best work.
eMoney is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management, Growth & Commercialization
jobs.text:
About Us:
insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.
Job Description:
This senior leadership role will drive new revenue growth and commercialization across insightsoftware's product portfolio for the Office of the CFO. You will own the strategy and execution for launching new products and new revenue streams, including the monetization of AI-enabled capabilities, and drive them from concept to material annual recurring revenue. As the portfolio undergoes a major brand and platform transformation toward a unified, AI-native experience, this leader ensures that new capabilities convert to durable, profitable revenue.
This leader pairs deep product judgment with commercial rigor across pricing and packaging, go-to-market design, and disciplined launch execution. The ideal candidate is fluent in applying AI both to the products we ship and to the way the team works, has a track record of standing up new revenue streams, and reports performance to executive leadership and the board. They must exude an unrelenting passion for our customer experience, strong financial acumen, and an entrepreneurial spirit.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Ownership and accountability for the strategy, P&L, and commercialization plan for new products and new revenue streams across the portfolio.
Define monetization models, pricing, and packaging for new and AI-enabled capabilities, with explicit measures for genuinely monetized revenue.
Own the launch Go/No-Go gate and pricing validation, and the post-launch growth plan that scales adoption into revenue.
Build the business cases for new products, features, and inorganic opportunities, and lead build, buy, and partner decisions.
Set the standard for AI fluency across the team, using AI to compress cycle time across discovery, delivery, and go-to-market.
Work closely and collaboratively with marketing, sales, customer success, and services to execute acquisition, retention, and expansion strategies and meet revenue targets.
Maintain a competitive market overview to identify white spaces, pricing opportunities, and strategic threats.
Report new-revenue and commercialization performance to executive leadership and the board, including ARR, win rates, attach, and adoption.
Assess risks and dependencies across product, engineering, and go-to-market functions and provide guidance to Business Unit leadership.
KEY AREAS OF FOCUS:
NEW REVENUE STREAM LAUNCH
Identifies, validates, and launches new revenue streams, owning the offer, pricing, packaging, and the path from first dollar to scaled ARR.
Designs and runs the commercialization motion, including offer and SKU design, sales enablement, and adoption tracking, so new capabilities reliably convert to revenue.
Establishes the measures that separate genuinely monetized revenue from bundled or attributed revenue, and reports against them.
AI MONETIZATION AND AI-NATIVE PRODUCT
Builds the business case and operating model for monetizing AI-enabled capabilities, balancing customer value, willingness to pay, and cost to serve.
Shapes an AI-native product strategy, partnering with engineering and platform leaders on the data, evaluation, and governance foundations required to ship trustworthy AI.
Defines how AI value is measured and connects AI investment to adoption and revenue.
PRODUCT COMMERCIALIZATION AND GO-TO-MARKET
Owns pricing and packaging validation at launch and the cross-functional readiness required for a successful release.
Manages across channels to define and deliver product performance goals (for example revenue, attach, and customer experience).
Leverages enterprise platforms and capabilities to improve speed to market and drive development and ongoing support cost efficiencies.
PRODUCT STRATEGY, VISION, AND PLANNING
Pulls from market and competitive insights, customer needs, and business priorities to shape the portfolio's growth strategy and investment areas.
Aligns the strategy with cross-functional stakeholders to shape the roadmap and success measures.
Understands the product technical architecture and the economics of technical investments, for example buy vs. build and total cost of ownership.
TEAM LEADERSHIP
Build and lead a high-performing team across product management and product marketing, providing mentorship, guidance, and support.
Foster a culture of commercial rigor, innovation, and disciplined use of AI in everyday work.
Identify and develop talent, ensuring the team has the skills and resources needed to hit revenue objectives.
STAKEHOLDER COLLABORATION
Collaborate closely with executive leadership, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success to ensure alignment on revenue objectives.
Act as a trusted advisor to Business Unit leadership and the board on commercialization and new revenue.
Qualifications
Experience owning direct P&L responsibility for a product line, business unit, or division within a B2B software company.
10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role focused on growth, monetization, or commercialization.
Demonstrated success launching new products and new revenue streams and scaling them to material ARR, including subscription and usage-based or AI-enabled monetization.
Strong pricing and packaging expertise, with a track record of pricing decisions that improved attach, conversion, or margin.
Demonstrated AI fluency: has used AI to improve product and team outcomes, and has shipped or monetized AI-enabled capabilities.
Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or a related field. An MBA or similar advanced degree is preferred.
Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills in a complex, matrixed, global software environment.
Analytical, data-driven mindset with strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and prioritization skills.
The salary range in United States of America for this position is 212,000.00 to 265,000.00 USD Annual.
For sales roles, this range includes the commission target. For non-sales roles, this is a base salary only range; additional bonus eligibility may apply.
Your specific offer within this range will be determined by your skills, experience, and qualifications.
We are committed to pay transparency and fair compensation practices. If you have questions about our compensation approach, please don't hesitate to ask during the interview process.
Additional Information
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - FuzeRx
jobs.text:
Job Summary
About Fuze Health
At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.
Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.
Job Description
We are seeking a dynamic Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead and scale our Rx engineering organization in the next chapter of innovation and growth. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of building and mentoring high-performing teams, delivering innovative products and services, and driving operational excellence. Deep experience with AI and machine learning is essential, including a passion for leveraging large language models (LLMs) to accelerate product innovation, enhance efficiency, and unlock new capabilities across the business. As a key member of the executive team, the CTO will provide strategic thought leadership, partnering with the CEO and C-suite to shape the company’s technology roadmap. This leader must set a high bar for accountability and inspire a culture of excellence, execution, and continuous improvement within the engineering organization. In addition, the CTO will be responsible for identifying and addressing technical debt, evolving our infrastructure, and implementing scalable systems and processes to improve engineering productivity and enable sustained velocity.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Define and Champion FuzeRx's Technology Vision and Strategy: Take the lead in shaping FuzeRx's future, leveraging your deep expertise in AI, machine learning, and large language models (LLMs) to drive innovation, efficiency, and new capabilities across the business.
Ensure Scalability, Reliability, and Security: Oversee FuzeRx's technology infrastructure to ensure it scales effectively, operates seamlessly, and maintains high standards of security as the company grows and evolves.
Drive Strategic Alignment: Collaborate closely with the CEO and C-suite to define company strategy, shaping FuzeRx's technology roadmap to align with overarching business goals and driving key performance metrics.
Own the Tech Development Lifecycle: Lead the engineering organization through the end-to-end product development lifecycle, consistently delivering innovative products that meet or exceed customer expectations and create meaningful impact.
Inspire a World-Class Technology Organization: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team, setting a high bar for accountability and execution, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Establish and Execute Product Roadmaps: Set priorities and drive product roadmaps that enable exponential growth and transform the patient experience, ensuring alignment with both short-term and long-term business objectives.
Champion User-Centric Design: Drive solutions that directly address critical challenges for patients and healthcare professionals, using innovative technology to improve healthcare delivery.
Establish and Evangelize Best Practices: Lead the charge in establishing best practices across the technology organization, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence in execution.
Evolve FuzeRx's Platform Architecture: Oversee the continuous evolution of FuzeRx's platform, anticipating market needs and implementing scalable systems and processes that drive sustained productivity and velocity.
Identify and Integrate Cutting-Edge Technologies: Stay at the forefront of technological advancements, identifying and integrating cutting-edge technologies that enhance FuzeRx's offerings and strengthen its competitive edge.
Cultivate an Inclusive, High-Performing Engineering Culture: Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where teams are empowered to innovate, thrive, and contribute to FuzeRx’s vision and mission.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product, science, and business teams to ensure technology initiatives are aligned with company goals, ensuring seamless execution of strategic priorities across the organization.
Develop and Mentor the Next Generation of Leaders: Invest in developing high-potential leaders and technical talent, building a strong leadership pipeline and nurturing the next generation of technology leaders at FuzeRx.
Drive Communication and Collaboration: Ensure effective communication and collaboration across all teams to facilitate flawless execution of strategic priorities, ensuring alignment and synergy throughout the organization.
Required Experience & Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or closely-related technical field.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience across product, engineering, and data science functions, with at least seven years in executive roles at a high-growth startup or a large, complex technology organization.
Demonstrated ability to build and scale high-performing, cross-functional global teams of 100+ across engineering, data science and product, including experience managing remote or distributed teams.
Proven track record of scaling customer-facing digital products or platforms from early stages to significant user base, with quantifiable impact on key business metrics (e.g., revenue, market share, customer acquisition cost, retention).
Deep understanding of modern software development methodologies, data analytics, and AI/ML frameworks and their application in a business context.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), modern front-end frameworks (React and React Native), and API-first design principles.
Demonstrated ability to drive product and technology innovation that has resulted in significant improvements in business outcomes (e.g., increased customer satisfaction, market share, revenue, or operational efficiency).
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences, including board members and investors.
Proven experience leading Agile teams and driving cross-functional collaboration to deliver on complex product and technology roadmaps. Experience with OKRs or other performance management frameworks is a plus.
Thrive in a highly regulated healthcare technology environment
Ability to travel up to 20% of the time
Preferred Qualifications:
MBA or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Deep and demonstrable experience in healthcare technology, specifically within the pharmacy industry or related healthcare systems. A proven track record of navigating complex regulatory landscapes (e.g., HIPAA, FDA) is a significant advantage.
Extensive experience with SaaS platforms, subscription-based models, and ideally, B2B2C business models within a regulated industry. Experience scaling a B2B2C platform is highly desirable.
Proven success in leading and scaling technology organizations through periods of hypergrowth and significant transformation, including experience with mergers and acquisitions or other major strategic events. Demonstrated ability to anticipate and adapt to rapidly changing market dynamics is essential.
Exceptional product sense, with a demonstrated ability to translate business needs into innovative technology solutions that delight users and drive business growth. Experience with product-led growth strategies is a plus.
Additional Information
Additional Physical Job Requirements
Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.
Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and similar applicable state laws, it is Fuze Health’s policy to provide reasonable accommodation to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship.
Salary and Benefits
Salary Range: $375,000 - $400,000
Commission Eligible: No
Travel: Yes up to 20% of the time
Location Requirement:
Fuze Health is limited to individuals residing in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia, Wisconsin.
Employment Authorization Requirement: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. Alto Pharmacy, Fuze Health, LetsGetChecked, and Fuze Care Services can not take over, transfer, or sponsor any visa type at this time.
Benefits - Fuze Health
Full-time employee benefits include: dental, vision, and multiple group medical plans to choose from, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, group life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, flexible spending account (FSA) and health savings account (HSA), commuter benefits, employer-paid short-term (STD) and long-term disability (LTD) insurance, and additional supplemental insurance plans (spouse life insurance, legal insurance, an employee assistance program, home health testing kits, and a fertility medication discount program). Employees are also provided flexible vacation time, accrued paid sick time, 10 paid holidays, (2 floating holidays for full time non-exempt employees) , and eight weeks of paid parental leave for eligible employees, additional paid weeks for the birthing parent, 4 weeks paid caregiver leave, and a Lifestyle Spending Account allowance each month.
More Benefits Information Here: Fuze Health Benefits Site
The application deadline is Oct. 31st 2026. This application deadline may be extended based on business needs.
Equal Opportunity Employer
Fuze Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, please contact us at .
Fuze Health considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. We are an E-Verify participating company.
Use of Automated Decision Tools
Fuze Health recruiters and hiring managers may use automated decision tools to help identify candidates who match the stated job requirements, and to what extent. These tools are designed to help ensure fairness in all aspects of the hiring process by providing recruiters and hiring managers with data-backed insights based on information provided in your resume, including work experience, education, and other skills. Fuze Health does not use automated decision tools to make hiring decisions; hiring decisions always involve human review and input. If you have any questions or would like to request an alternative process, please contact us at .
Privacy Notice
To learn about Fuze Health’s privacy practices, including compliance with applicable privacy laws, please read our Privacy Notice for Job Applicants.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.text:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US
We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.
About Foundant
At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.
We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.
Where You’ll Work:
As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
Own the product management function across Foundant's portfolio of SaaS products, serving customers across the US, Canada, the EU, Australia, and the UK.
Lead the Product Managers, Product Owners, and Product Designers aligned to each product line, setting direction and raising the bar for how the portfolio is built and run.
Build out the organizational competency, process maturity and tooling.
Instrument active listening, structured data and signals, and operational metrics across the portfolio.
Partner with the CTO, CEO, and Chief Strategy Officer to shape portfolio-level strategy and investment prioritie, across both organic and inorganic initiatives.
Partner closely with engineering leadership on execution of product initiatives and roadmap objectives.
Partner with leaders in the Sales and Marketing and Customer Success organizations to ensure downstream GTM execution that drives product releases to realization of value.
Other duties as assigned.
WhatYou’llNeed:
10+ years of experience in product management, including experience building and leading product management organizations at scale.
Proven experience leading Product Management, Product Ownership, and Product Design functions together within SaaS organizations.
Experience operating a multi-product, multi-region SaaS portfolio, ideally spanning international markets such as the US, Canada, the UK, the EU, and/or Australia.
Demonstrated experience selecting, implementing, and scaling product management process/methodology, tooling and infrastructure to support organizational maturity.
MBA preferred
Must be legally eligible to work in the United States.
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:
Strategic Thinking
Translates Foundant's North Star into a coherent portfolio strategy across five SaaS products and five global markets, partnering with the CTO, CEO, and Chief Strategy Officer to shape organic and inorganic investment decisions that move the whole portfolio forward together.
Performance Advancement
Builds the operating backbone of the product management function — active listening, structured signals, and portfolio-level metrics — creating the visibility needed to catch problems early and double down on what's actually working for the people we serve.
Decision-Making
Weighs data, market signals, and cross-functional input to make and defend prioritization and investment calls across a five-product portfolio, staying transparent with executive peers about trade-offs rather than papering over them.
Staff Development
Builds bench strength across the Product Management, Product Ownership, and Product Design leaders at each product line, coaching them to raise both craft and business impact.
Change Management
Leads the organization through the process, tooling, and operating-model changes required to mature the product management function, bringing teams along with clear reasoning rather than top-down mandates.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!
Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.
Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Having built a strong lending business serving SMEs across multiple markets, the company is now expanding its product portfolio while embedding AI across the organization to improve how financial services are delivered.
This role exists because Product has become a strategic priority. Today, product ownership sits between Engineering and a junior Product Owner focused on execution — there's no dedicated leader driving strategy, prioritization, or long-term innovation. jobs.title: Global Head of Technology & Product
jobs.text:
About GP Strategies
GP Strategies is a global leader in talent transformation. We help organizations unlock the full potential of their people through innovative learning, leadership, technology, and workforce transformation solutions.
Our clients partner with us to improve workforce performance, accelerate change, and develop the skills needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving world. As technology and AI continue to reshape the future of work, we're investing in the next generation of products, platforms, and technology-enabled services that help our clients achieve lasting impact.
That's where you come in.
About the Role
We are seeking an exceptional Global Head of Technology & Product to define and lead GP Strategies' technology and product vision.
Reporting to the Chief People & Technology Officer, this is a highly visible leadership role with responsibility for Product Management, Solution Architecture, Engineering, and Support Services globally.
You will shape how we bring together technology, AI, product innovation, and client needs to create scalable solutions that drive growth, improve client outcomes, and strengthen our market position.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, technology, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with leaders across Innovation, Growth, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success to identify opportunities, set priorities, and deliver solutions that create measurable value for both our clients and our business.
What You'll Be Doing
Technology & Product Strategy
Define and communicate a clear vision for GP Strategies' technology and product portfolio.
Develop and own a global roadmap aligned to client needs, market trends, and business priorities.
Drive decisions on when to build, buy, partner, or integrate technology solutions.
Product & Portfolio Leadership
Lead the development of technology-enabled products and services that support business growth.
Prioritize initiatives based on client impact, commercial value, strategic fit, and delivery feasibility.
Establish portfolio governance and investment frameworks that support sustainable growth.
AI & Emerging Technology
Shape GP Strategies' approach to AI-enabled products, services, and internal capabilities.
Identify opportunities where automation, data, and AI can improve efficiency, client outcomes, and competitive differentiation.
Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
Leadership & Delivery
Lead global teams across Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, and Support Services.
Build a high-performing culture focused on innovation, accountability, agility, and continuous improvement.
Partner with stakeholders across the organization to drive successful delivery and adoption of strategic initiatives.
Commercial Impact
Work closely with Growth, Sales, and Operations leaders to develop technology-enabled solutions that create competitive advantage.
Support proposition development, client engagement, and revenue growth through technology innovation.
Measure success through business outcomes, client value, adoption, and commercial performance.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for a strategic technology and product leader who combines commercial thinking with a strong understanding of how technology can solve business challenges.
You'll bring:
Significant leadership experience in Product, Technology, Engineering, Digital, or Innovation functions.
Experience leading global teams and operating in complex matrix organizations.
A successful track record of developing and scaling technology-enabled products, platforms, or services.
Experience translating market opportunities and customer needs into clear product and technology strategies.
Strong understanding of AI, SaaS platforms, enterprise technology, and digital transformation.
Commercial acumen and experience influencing growth, revenue, or investment decisions.
Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
We'd Love to Hear From You If You Have Experience In:
Learning technology
Talent or HR technology
Professional services
Consulting
Digital transformation
Enterprise software
Workforce transformation
Technology-enabled services
Why Join GP Strategies?
This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of technology within a global organization dedicated to transforming workforce performance.
You'll have the freedom to influence enterprise strategy, drive meaningful innovation, build world-class teams, and help define how AI and technology create value for clients around the world.
If you're excited by the opportunity to combine product leadership, technology strategy, commercial impact, and innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Director of Data Engineering to lead our enterprise data engineering strategy, platform modernization, and operational excellence initiatives. This role will drive the design, governance, reliability, and scalability of our data ecosystem while enabling analytics, AI, and business intelligence capabilities across the organization. The Director will partner with technology and business leaders to deliver secure, trusted, and business-ready data solutions that support organizational growth and innovation.
Define and execute the enterprise data engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
Lead and develop high-performing teams of managers, architects, and data engineers.
Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise data platforms, including data warehouses, lakes, lakehouses, and analytical data products.
Establish standards for data architecture, integration, governance, quality, security, observability, and DataOps.
Drive modernization initiatives that improve scalability, reduce technical debt, and enhance operational efficiency.
Enable AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and self-service reporting through trusted data foundations.
Partner with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to align data initiatives with business objectives.
Manage technology investments, vendor relationships, budgets, and resource planning.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, architecture, analytics engineering, or enterprise data platform leadership.
7+ years leading technical teams in complex enterprise environments.
Experience developing enterprise data strategies, governance programs, and modernization roadmaps.
Strong expertise with cloud data platforms, ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing, data integration, and production operations.
Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational and analytical databases.
Experience with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or hybrid cloud environments.
Experience with Informatica or similar enterprise integration platforms.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in a related discipline.
Experience with Informatica IDMC, Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Power BI, and related technologies.
Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics initiatives.
Experience leading large-scale data modernization programs in regulated or data-driven industries.
Technical Skills
Enterprise data integration and data management platforms
Cloud-based data architecture and engineering
Data warehousing, lakehouse, and analytical platforms
DataOps, observability, and operational excellence
Data governance, metadata management, and lineage
Modern orchestration and transformation frameworks
Business intelligence and analytics technologies, including Power BI
Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and source control platforms such as GitHub and GitLab
Project collaboration tools including Jira and Confluence
What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance bonus program
Fully remote work environment
Comprehensive benefits package including 401k match
19 days of PTO per year; 10 holidays per year
Opportunity to work in a mission-driven organization where your work directly shapes clarity, confidence, and better outcomes across healthcare
Travel
Up to 10% travel, based on business needs. While our roles are 100% remote, we do get together a few times a year for up to one week. Employees are given ample notice and attendance is expected.
Work Environment
This position operates primarily in a remote work environment and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing work at a desk or workstation. The employee must be able to operate standard office equipment, including a computer, keyboard, mouse, webcam, and telephone.
The role also requires the ability to occasionally move throughout a workspace to access files, office equipment, and work-related materials. Effective communication, both written and verbal, is essential for interacting with employees, clients, and stakeholders.
Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Statement
Staritas is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status.
As a federal contractor, Staritas complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding nondiscrimination and affirmative action. We are committed to creating a workplace that is fair, inclusive, and grounded in merit-based decision-making.
Accommodation Statement
If you need reasonable accommodation to apply for this position, please contact the recruiter.
Pay Transparency Statement
Staritas posts compensation ranges and benefits for all open roles. The base compensation range for this position is $165,000 - $175,000annually, plus a comprehensive benefits package. Compensation offered will depend on factors including experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity. Staritas does not retaliate against employees or applicants for discussing compensation.
Benefits Statement
Staritas offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our employees. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings plans with company contributions; paid time off and company holidays; paid parental and family leave; and access to employee assistance and wellness resources. Additional benefits include life and disability insurance, professional development opportunities, and flexible work arrangements.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
About Onfleet
Onfleet is the last-mile delivery platform behind millions of deliveries every month for thousands of businesses around the world. We enable shippers to manage deliveries across their private fleet, carriers, and couriers. We make it easy for dispatchers to plan and run their operations, drivers to execute deliveries, and recipients to get real-time tracking and notifications. Our customers span grocery, prepared meals, pharmacy, flowers, furniture, and more.
The Role
We're looking for a Vice President of Product to lead Product at Onfleet, owning how our strategy gets translated into roadmaps and how roadmaps turn into shipped, adopted products. Your job is to sharpen our strategy where needed and define how the Onfleet product suite evolves as we scale up in a fast-growing market. This is a hands-on leadership seat where you'll stay close to the details and roll up your sleeves when the team needs it.
You'll report to our CEO and lead Product Management, Design, and User Research. You’ll also work closely with Engineering, QA, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience. As our senior-most product leader, you'll sit on our Strategic Leadership Team and represent Product in company planning.
What You'll Do
Own the product roadmap that delivers on our strategy, and update both as our market and target customers change.
Prioritize aggressively by committing to a few well-scoped bets per quarter and saying no to other competing initiatives.
Build deep knowledge of the last-mile delivery industry and our core users: shippers, carriers and couriers, dispatchers, drivers, and recipients.
Lead quarterly and annual planning with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and partner with them to set company goals that tie product work to business outcomes.
Own how we gather, prioritize, and close the loop on product feedback from customers, Sales, CX, and other internal teams.
Coordinate work across squads so dependencies and risks surface early, and keep one roadmap view the whole company can see.
Connect product success metrics to company metrics, and build a team habit of defining success before launch and acting on what adoption data shows.
Represent Product internally and with our board of directors, customer advisory boards, and key customers.
Foster a collaborative team culture and think ahead about team structure, process, and tooling.
Coach the team and define clear growth paths for each member.
What You'll Bring
You have 10+ years in B2B SaaS product roles, including 5+ years leading product teams and 3+ years as Director of Product or above.
You've run Product at a Series B+ company generating tens of millions of dollars in ARR.
You've led a product through a move upmarket into enterprise.
You've directly hired, managed, and developed Product Managers, Designers, and User Researchers.
You have significant UX and design experience, and you champion it across the company. You've overseen teams that run usability tests, user interviews, and experiments.
You've partnered with Engineering as equals: scoping work together before committing, keeping scope stable once work starts, and shipping in small iterations.
You've run market research to size opportunities in a customer base and adjacent markets.
You make roadmap calls by weighing customer evidence, usage data, strategy, and business impact, and you explain the trade-offs clearly.
You're analytical, using data to make decisions and hold yourself and your team to the numbers.
You've built or managed a Product Operations function, with working fluency in tools like Jira, Productboard, and Amplitude.
You communicate clearly in writing and in person.
You're highly organized and focused on outcomes.
Nice To Have
Experience in last-mile logistics or delivery.
What We Offer
Remote-first work environment with quarterly domestic travel
Generous employee stock options
Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
401(k)
Flexible PTO
Onfleet Is an Equal Opportunity Employer
Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.
We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.
We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.text:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
Job Description
Not on a global job description.
Job Description
Vice President, Enterprise Data Strategy & Governance (Solventum)
3M Health Care is now Solventum
At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.
We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.
The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As a Vice President, Enterprise Data Strategy & Governance, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:
Defining and evolving the enterprise data strategy aligned to business priorities, digital transformation goals, and the operating model
Driving the design and adoption of enterprise data governance frameworks, including data ownership, stewardship, quality, and standards
Partnering with IT and business leaders to shape scalable data platforms, including cloud, MDM, metadata, and analytics capabilities
Establishing governance forums and executive steering committees to align priorities, manage risk, and ensure value realization
Leading cross-functional change management to embed data-driven decision-making, trusted data usage, and enterprise-wide adoption
Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND fifteen (15) years of experience in enterprise data strategy, governance, analytics, or digital transformation
OR
High School Diploma/GED AND nineteen (19) years of experience in enterprise data strategy, governance, analytics, or digital transformation
AND
In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:
Proven success implementing or maturing enterprise data governance frameworks in complex, multi-business unit organizations
Deep expertise in data architecture, MDM, metadata, data quality, lineage, and modern cloud data platforms
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across business and technology functions
Experience leading large-scale transformation, operating model design, and cross-functional change initiatives
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics into actionable insights
Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
Master’s degree in Data, Information Systems, Business, or a related field from an accredited institution
Experience building and leading enterprise data governance organizations and data domain models
Strong strategic thinking with a focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and enterprise value creation
Work location: Remote
Travel: May include up to 20%
Relocation Assistance: May be authorized
Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).
Supporting Your Well-being
Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other comparable organizations.
Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County.

jobs.title: Vice President, Information Technology
jobs.text:
For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes.
JOB SUMMARY & SCOPE
Responsible for the strategic direction, management, and performance of the Company's global technology organization, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, enterprise applications, data management, and IT operations. This position ensures a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology environment that supports a multi-site, acquisition-driven business while leading technology modernization, enterprise integration, IT governance, cybersecurity, vendor management, and M&A integration initiatives. The role serves as the Company's senior authority on information security and IT risk and partners closely with business and technology leaders to align technology platforms, data, and processes with operational and growth objectives.
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Develop and execute the enterprise IT strategy, roadmap, and operating model aligned with business objectives.
Provide leadership and oversight for all IT functions, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, business applications, data management, and technical support operations.
Manage the global technology infrastructure environment, including cloud platforms, networks, telecommunications, endpoints, and site connectivity.
Establish standards for system availability, performance, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Lead service desk and technology operations functions, including service management processes, service levels, and operational performance metrics.
Direct the enterprise cybersecurity program, including security strategy, governance, monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and identity and access management.
Serve as the executive leader responsible for information security, technology risk management, and security-related stakeholder communications.
Oversee third-party technology risk management, vendor security assessments, and customer security compliance requirements.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, privacy, and security frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and related standards.
Maintain the organization's IT risk management framework, audit readiness, internal controls, and compliance reporting processes.
Oversee enterprise business applications, including ERP, CRM, productivity, collaboration, cloud, analytics, and workflow management platforms.
Drive application integration, process automation, and technology modernization initiatives that improve operational efficiency and data integrity.
Partner with executive leadership to establish enterprise data governance, reporting, analytics, and business intelligence strategies.
Develop and execute plans to rationalize technology platforms, reduce application redundancy, improve user adoption, and optimize technology investments.
Lead IT due diligence, integration planning, and post-acquisition technology integration activities for mergers and acquisitions.
Manage the IT operating and capital budgets, ensuring effective financial stewardship, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
Direct vendor relationships, contract negotiations, software licensing, and strategic sourcing initiatives.
Lead, develop, and mentor IT leaders and teams while communicating technology strategy, risks, priorities, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
EDUCATION + EXPERIENCE + KEY TRAITS
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of 12 years of progressive enterprise IT experience, including at least 5 years leading multi-functional IT organizations at the Director level or above.
Demonstrated expertise leading enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, business applications, and IT operations within complex, multi-site organizations.
Hands-on experience managing enterprise-scale Microsoft and Azure environments, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies.
Experience overseeing enterprise ERP, CRM, data, analytics, and business intelligence platforms, preferably including NetSuite, Salesforce, Azure Data Lake, and Power BI.
Proven success developing, implementing, and maintaining cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management programs, including frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR.
Demonstrated ownership of significant IT operating and capital budgets, vendor management, contract negotiations, and technology investment strategies.
Experience supporting global and multi-country business operations, with strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Preferred experience within private equity-backed, acquisition-oriented, or rapidly growing organizations, including technology due diligence and post-acquisition integration.
Experience supporting distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or field service operations and familiarity with enterprise customer security, compliance, and procurement requirements.
Knowledge of AI, machine learning, data governance, and advanced analytics environments.
Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or similar credentials are preferred.
TYPICAL PERFORMANCE TARGETS
SERVICE DELIVERY: Sustained, measured excellence in project & process delivery
COST TO SERVE: Sustained, measured excellence in delivery efficiency with expected continuous improvement
INNOVATION: Step changed delivery in safety, quality, and/or cost
LANGUAGE SKILLS
Primary language used in daily operations is English. Additional primary company languages include Spanish, French, and Dutch.
Read and interpret documents, procedure manuals and various correspondence from both internal and external.
Speak effectively, both individually and before groups of both external customers and/or various levels of employees within the organization.
SUPERVISION
Responsible for direct and/or indirect reports.
DECISION MAKING + REASONING
Able to take accountability and responsibility for business target delivery and decision making.
WORKING RELATIONSHIPS
Peak Executive Team
Peak Management Team
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Activity Amount of Time None Under 1/3 1/3 to 2/3 Over 2/3 Stand X Walk X Sit X Use hands to finger, handle, or feel X Reach with hands and arms X Climb or balance X Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl X Talk or hear X Lift Up to 25lbs X Travel X

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer / VP of Technology
jobs.text:
This is a remote position.
Our client is a global advisory business in the energy industry, operating across North America and Europe. They are looking for a single technology leader accountable for everything technical in the business: the systems the company runs on and the platforms their clients use directly.
This is a broad role in a company of roughly 300 people. The technology estate is small enough that the leader stays hands on, and significant enough that the decisions matter commercially.
What you will own
Enterprise IT and operations across multiple countries: network, cybersecurity, endpoints, service desk, identity and access.
Internal business systems, including Dynamics 365 CRM and Finance & Operations, and the reporting stack.
A portfolio of client-facing platforms across two regions, covering maintenance, roadmap and the connectivity between them.
AI and automation adoption, working directly with business teams to map processes and introduce tooling that supports growth without proportional headcount increase.
Technology cost, vendor relationships and managed-service arrangements.
A distributed technology team across several countries.
What we are looking for
Experience leading technology in a mid-sized organisation, covering both internal corporate systems and client-facing products.
Strong Microsoft estate background: Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, M365.
Genuinely hands on. Builds and uses modern tooling personally rather than only sponsoring it.
Demonstrable experience managing vendors, licensing and technology cost.
Comfortable operating across multiple countries and time zones.
A practical, business-first approach. This is not an environment for heavy process or top-down IT governance.
Useful but not required
Exposure to data platform work: Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Fabric, Power BI.
Experience in a business that has recently changed ownership or become standalone.
Energy sector experience is preferred not required.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: SVP, Technology
jobs.text:
Lead the Future of Financial Technology
We are seeking an experienced and transformational Senior Vice President of Technology to lead a diverse portfolio of cloud-based fintech products serving customers across accounts payable automation, source-to-pay, supplier networks, electronic invoicing, and payments. This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a technology leader who thrives in complex environments and has a passion for modernizing platforms, scaling global teams, and building an AI-first culture and delivery model that redefines how software is created and delivered.
As the SVP, Technology - you will oversee Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, Customer Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Security. You'll lead a global organization while shaping the technology strategy that will accelerate growth, improve operational excellence, and unify a portfolio of products into a modern, scalable ecosystem.
What You'll Do
Define and Execute Technology Strategy
Execute the technology vision, roadmap, and investment strategy across a portfolio of SaaS products.
Lead platform modernization initiatives, including architecture simplification, cloud optimization, and AI-enabled product capabilities.
Partner with executive leadership to evaluate technology investments, product consolidation opportunities, and strategic initiatives, supported by clear, well-constructed business cases.
Champion a service-pack based strategy for delivering key platform enhancements and features, including agentic plug-ins, APIs, and reporting, on a predictable cadence.
Drive Engineering Excellence
Lead high-performing engineering, quality assurance, and DevOps organizations responsible for building, securing, and operating mission-critical SaaS solutions.
Establish best practices across software development, CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and engineering operations.
Create and lead an AI-focused culture and development delivery model that drives order-of-magnitude productivity gains, more reliable release cycles, and continuous improvements in quality and efficiency.
Scale Global Teams and Delivery
Lead and develop a globally distributed organization of employees and strategic technology partners.
Build a culture focused on accountability, execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Manage outsourced engineering and operations partnerships to ensure high-quality outcomes and cost-effective delivery.
Elevate Customer Experience
Lead Customer Engineering teams responsible for onboarding, implementation, integrations, and application support.
Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Operations leaders to improve customer adoption, retention, and satisfaction.
Standardize implementation and support processes to accelerate time-to-value.
Ensure product delivery remains aligned to customer needs and business strategy, translating customer insight into platform priorities and measurable outcomes.
Ensure Security, Reliability, and Compliance
Own cloud operations, infrastructure performance, security, compliance, and business continuity.
Lead programs supporting PCI DSS, SOC compliance, data protection, vulnerability management, and regulatory requirements.
Drive cloud modernization through automation, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and cost optimization.
Build Organizational Capability
Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional technology leaders.
Lead workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational transformation initiatives.
Own technology budgets, vendor relationships, and technology investment planning.
What Success Looks Like
Within your first year, you will:
Establish clear technical ownership and accountability across every product.
Improve release predictability, software quality, and operational performance.
Reduce key-person and vendor dependency through stronger documentation, processes, and organizational design.
Strengthen security, compliance, and operational maturity across the portfolio.
Develop a technology roadmap that positions the organization for long-term growth and innovation.
Embed AI-assisted development practices across the organization, demonstrating order-of-magnitude productivity gains and more reliable release cycles.
Launch a service-pack delivery model for key platform enhancements, including agentic plug-ins, APIs, and reporting.
Requirements
Required Qualifications
15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including executive-level responsibility across multiple technology functions.
Proven experience leading software engineering, QA, cloud operations, and customer-facing technical organizations for SaaS products.
Experience in customer-facing roles, with demonstrated success aligning product delivery to customer needs and business strategy.
Experience managing complex, multi-product environments, including acquired or legacy platforms.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, software quality, and modern engineering practices.
Experience leading AI adoption across the software development lifecycle, with measurable gains in engineering productivity and release reliability.
Experience in fintech, payments, or another highly regulated industry.
Demonstrated success leading global, distributed teams and third-party technology partners.
Strong financial and business acumen, including budgeting, business case development, vendor management, and technology investment decisions.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Business Administration.
Experience in private equity-backed organizations and transformation environments.
Experience applying AI and automation to both customer-facing products and engineering operations, including AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
Background in accounts payable automation, procure-to-pay, electronic invoicing, or payments platforms.
Relevant cloud, security, or technology leadership certifications.
Why Join Us?
This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of a growing fintech platform portfolio while leading large-scale technology transformation initiatives. You'll have executive visibility, significant influence over strategy, and the ability to build a modern technology organization that delivers measurable business impact.
If you're a transformational technology executive who combines strategic vision with operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Vice President, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Career-defining. Life-changing.
At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career
About This Role:
iRhythm is seeking a Vice President of Software Engineering to provide technical and organizational leadership across our regulated software platforms. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Systems Development, this leader is accountable for ensuring the successful delivery, performance, and scalability of software products and platforms. These solutions enable clinician workflows, enhance patient experiences, integrate connected medical devices, and provide the data infrastructure necessary to support innovation, operational excellence, and growth. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution at scale, requiring executive leadership and offering exceptional visibility across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Software Delivery & Operational Execution
Lead end-to-end software engineering execution across clinical, patient-facing, platform, and device-integrated software systems within a highly regulated Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) environment.
Establish and continuously evolve the engineering operating systems, governance frameworks, and development practices that enable disciplined planning, transparent execution, effective risk management, and predictable delivery across a complex software portfolio.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives that measurably enhance engineering velocity, product quality, release confidence, system reliability, and customer outcomes.
Ensure software development lifecycle processes consistently meet regulatory, compliance, and quality standards, including FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, cybersecurity, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
Translate complex technical concepts, delivery risks, and strategic tradeoffs into clear, actionable insights for executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Advance software engineering capabilities through scalable CI/CD frameworks, development platforms, automation, and engineering enablement tools appropriate for regulated medical technology environments.
Lead the responsible adoption and governance of AI-assisted software development practices to accelerate innovation, enhance productivity, improve quality, and reduce delivery risk.
Establish a metrics-driven engineering culture by leveraging meaningful operational and quality indicators to increase transparency, predictability, accountability, and data-informed decision making.
Team Development & Leadership
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of software engineering directors, managers, and senior technical leaders, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and execution excellence.
Serve as a thought leader, trusted advisor and mentor to engineering leaders, cultivating leadership capability, organizational resilience, and a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technical excellence across the company.
Cross-Functional & Strategic Contributions
Partner closely with executive and functional leaders across Product Security, Software Quality, Research & Systems Engineering, Machine Learning, and IT to ensure seamless execution, architectural alignment, and delivery excellence across the product portfolio.
Drive alignment and shared accountability across Product Management, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and other cross-functional teams to successfully deliver innovative solutions from concept through commercialization.
Lead software engineering diligence, technical assessments, and post-acquisition integration activities in support of the company's mergers and acquisitions strategy.
Contribute to the development and execution of the long-term software platform, architecture, and technology strategy, ensuring scalability, innovation, and competitive differentiation.
Qualifications
Required Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive software engineering leadership experience, including leadership of large-scale engineering organizations and senior technology leaders.
Demonstrated success leading the development and delivery of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) solutions within highly regulated medical device environments.
Proven track record bringing complex regulated software products from concept and development through verification, validation, regulatory approval, commercialization, and post-market support.
Deep expertise in FDA software regulations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and medical device quality systems, with a strong understanding of applying these requirements within modern software development environments.
Experience leading complex, matrixed software engineering organizations through periods of growth, transformation, organizational change, and technology modernization.
Preferred Experience
Experience spanning both high-growth and established healthcare, medical device, digital health, or regulated technology organizations.
Experience scaling software organizations supporting connected products, cloud platforms, data ecosystems, and customer-facing applications.
Exposure to technical diligence, integration planning, or software leadership support for mergers and acquisitions.
Demonstrated success modernizing software delivery capabilities, including CI/CD frameworks, automation, and engineering productivity tools within regulated environments.
Practical experience evaluating, implementing, and governing AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering effectiveness, product quality, and delivery outcomes.
Leadership Profile
Strategic and execution-oriented leader with the ability to translate business priorities into operational excellence and measurable outcomes.
Equally comfortable shaping long-term technology strategy and engaging directly in delivery execution, organizational design, and engineering operations.
Proven builder of high-performing teams and leadership talent, with a strong track record of developing leaders and creating a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Exceptional cross-functional collaborator capable of influencing executive stakeholders and aligning diverse teams around shared objectives.
Data-driven, pragmatic, and decisive, with the ability to balance speed, quality, regulatory compliance, and business impact.
Resilient and adaptable leader who thrives in complex environments and successfully leads organizations through change, growth, and transformation.
Location:
Remote - US
Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.
Estimated Pay Range
$278,000.00 - $361,000.00

iRhythm is a leading digital healthcare company that creates trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease. Through a relentless focus on patient care, iRhythm’s vision is to deliver better data, better insights, and better health for all.
