jobs.title: Vice President, Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Experian Software Solutions (ESS), is the global product and engineering function delivering world-class software solutions and data through the Ascend Platform. Ascend brings together data, analytics, AI, decisioning, and fraud capabilities to help our clients accelerate digital transformation, improve risk management, detect and prevent fraud, and make faster, more informed customer and business decisions.
The Vice President, Platform Engineering is responsible for leading technology for Identity, Access & SSO, Portal & Design System, Observability, Metrics & Monitoring, and Billing & Metering. This executive oversees the development and evolution of shared platform architecture and horizontal services that Product Engineering and AI & Agentic Platform build on top of, ensuring platform capabilities are built once and consumed as a service across the business.
Reporting to the CTO, this VP will lead a global team of 100+ employees and will work across Experian's global business units to embed scalable, secure platform capabilities that accelerate product innovation, improve operational efficiency, and reduce duplicated engineering effort. The VP serves as the senior technology voice for shared platform capability, shaping enterprise platform strategy, and delivering measurable outcomes across one of the world's leading data and technology companies.
Develop and execute the technology strategy for Identity, Access & SSO, Portal & Design System, Observability, Metrics & Monitoring, and Billing & Metering, scaling platform adoption globally through cloud migration, workload modernization, and platform standardization to enable growth, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
Lead the identity and access strategy underpinning ESS Technology's customer-facing Identity Management capability, driving the development and governance of SSO, RBAC, and authentication infrastructure across products and platforms.
Partner with product, engineering, and regional leaders to prioritize technology investments and drive innovation, applying disciplined engineering standards to ensure platform investments are aligned to strategic business outcomes and deliver measurable ROI.
Lead enterprise platform modernization initiatives, evolving legacy environments into secure, scalable, cloud-native architectures that support long-term business growth, resilience, and cost optimization.
Establish enterprise platform engineering standards, design system and portal strategy, and developer-facing tooling that accelerate engineering productivity and enable scalable, reusable technology capabilities across the business.
Build and evolve the observability and billing infrastructure that other teams instrument against and rely on, including monitoring, tracing, metering, and monetization plumbing, while evaluating and scaling emerging platform technologies across the organization.
Partner with executive leaders across Technology, Product, Security, and regional organizations to align platform investments with growth priorities.
Shape enterprise platform strategy and technology governance by actively contributing to key leadership forums. Act as an ambassador for Experian's platform engineering capability, enhancing the company's profile and influence within the broader technology ecosystem.
Engage regularly with Operating Committee level leaders across the business, including regional Product senior leaders and regional CTOs across the US, UK, EMEA, APAC, and Latin America, requiring sustained senior stakeholder management across geographies and reporting lines.
10+ years leadership experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, identity and access management, or technology product management, including leading large-scale global technology organizations.
Proven track record building and scaling cloud platforms and shared technology capabilities at enterprise scale (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Strong ability to influence senior executives and secure stakeholder commitment, translating complex technical strategies into compelling business outcomes.
Demonstrated success mobilizing multiple business units, engineering teams, and P&L owners to drive adoption of shared platform capabilities and enterprise-wide transformation without direct authority.
Deep understanding of identity, access, observability, and platform technologies, with the strategic judgment to determine capabilities to build, buy, scale, or retire.
Experience operating in regulated industries, with governance accountability for platform engineering standards, identity and access architecture, and design system frameworks across regions and business units.
Location
This is a US based, Remote position with periodic travel.
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why.
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay range for this position is listed above. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity.
Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
Benefits/Perks:
Comprehensive executive level total rewards package
Flexible time off including unlimited vacation, volunteer time off, and 12 paid holidays

jobs.title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
jobs.text:
Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
The opportunity
Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.
More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.
For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.
This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.
We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.
What you will build and lead
As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.
Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:
access to care, search and booking;
patient messaging and teleconsultation;
the Patient Health Record and patient context;
the app homepage and daily health experience;
health content and prevention;
recommendations, reminders and care plans;
new patient services and subscription experiences;
conversational and AI-powered experiences.
The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.
Your mandate
You will:
Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.
Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.
Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.
Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.
Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.
Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.
Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.
Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.
Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.
Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.
What success looks like
In your first year, you will have:
established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;
raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;
helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;
strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;
developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;
helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.
What we are looking for
You are likely to bring:
Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..
Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.
A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.
Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.
Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.
Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.
A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.
Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.
The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.
A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.
Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.
Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.
A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.
Why Doctolib, why now?
Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.
The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.
You will join at a defining moment:
Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.
AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.
The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.
The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.
The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.
This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.
Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.
Information submitted through this application is processed by Doctolib for recruitment purposes. For more information about data processing and your rights, please refer to our privacy policies:
France
Germany
Italy
The Netherlands
For questions about data privacy, please contact hr.dataprivacy@doctolib.com.

jobs.title: Head of Finance Business Partnering, Operations & Technology
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As Tide continues to grow across multiple markets, strong financial management is essential to helping us scale responsibly, profitably and sustainably. As our Head of FP&A, you will serve as a core strategic Finance Business Partner to multiple leadership teams.
In this high-impact, multi-faceted leadership role, you will shape workforce strategies, lead complex investment cases, and oversee key operational expense drivers—from fraud loss P&L and vendor contract structures to AI token costs and cross-functional capacity modeling.
You will bring data-backed financial discipline and strategic oversight to ensure Tide continues gaining operational leverage as we launch new products and expand internationally.
This is a highly visible global leadership role where you will partner closely with Directors, Product & Engineering leads, and the Finance SLT to tell the story behind our numbers and ensure Tide balances ambitious growth with sharp operational and financial discipline.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
This is a global role in which you will:
Partner with Leadership: Act as the key finance business partner to Product & Engineering, Member Ops, Risk & Fraud, and Enablement area leaders, shaping strategic, workforce, procurement, and investment decisions.
Drive Business Cases & Investment Funding: Design and build business cases for Member Ops investments and fraud/risk prevention tooling, managing them through the Finance SLT to sign-off and bridging BizOps to the CFO office.
Lead Capacity & Workforce Planning: Lead capacity modeling and workforce strategies, balancing trade-offs across stakeholders while aligning to finance and SLA targets.
Set Budgets & Target Efficiency: Set budget parameters and efficiency targets across operational teams, connecting Product & Engineering roadmaps directly with operational delivery.
Manage Commercials & Vendors: Execute the commercial review framework for Member Ops vendors alongside procurement, managing contract structures, renegotiations, and make-vs-buy decisions.
Own Fraud Loss P&L & Exposure: Own the fraud loss P&L across forecasting, actuals tracking, and variance analysis, while leading multi-region fraud exposure scenario modeling.
Align Cross-Functional Loss Assumptions: Connect the financial impact of Risk & Fraud to Collections and Treasury, keeping loss, recovery, and provisioning assumptions aligned across teams.
Own Narratives & Reporting: Partner with operational directors to control the financial narrative on vendor outcomes and fraud performance reported to the CFO office, while reporting cost-to-serve and ROI to the SLT.
Optimize Data Availability: Work closely with Data Engineering, BizOps, and Financial Reporting teams to ensure robust data availability for Risk reporting.
Manage Enablement & Operational Costs: Direct cost management across software consolidation, contractor spending, real estate/CAPEX, P&E, and AI token usage.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
You'll likely have:
10+ years of Commercial Finance & FP&A Leadership: Senior Finance Business Partner experience within high-growth fintech, digital banking, or tech environments.
Operations & Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience partnering with Member Ops and Risk/Fraud leaders on capacity modeling, SLAs, and multi-region fraud exposure.
P&L & Loss Ownership: Experience owning fraud loss P&Ls (forecasting, variance analysis) and aligning loss assumptions across Treasury and Collections.
Opex Control: Proven track record in vendor contract renegotiations, make-vs-buy decisions, software consolidation, and managing AI/token costs.
Investment & Portfolio Strategy: Ability to build CFO-level business cases, model multi-horizon ROI, and manage pod/incubation funding models.
Executive Influence: Clear communication skills to bridge operational metrics with financial narratives for the CFO and Senior Leadership Team.
MBA or CA qualification
Most importantly, you'll enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, thrive on unlocking operational leverage as we scale, and care deeply about building sustainable financial foundations to support Tide's global growth.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide
Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement
Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent)
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Vice President, Earned Media, Technology - Burson
jobs.text:
Who we are:
Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
More about the role:
Technology is reshaping how we live, work and do business. For the companies driving that change, earning attention requires a clear point of view, credible proof and stories that connect innovation to what matters to people and stakeholders.
We’re looking for a Vice President, Earned Media — Technology who combines deep technology sector expertise, strong editorial judgment and creative thinking in order to help clients tell stories that shape their reputation and advance their business priorities.
Working across Burson’s U.S. Earned Media Practice and Technology teams, you’ll lead earned strategy and execution for leading technology clients. You’ll partner with client leads to help clients define what they want to be known for and determine what they need to do, say, create or demonstrate to earn that coverage and recognition.
You’ll bring Earned into the work from the beginning, partnering with account and client leaders, strategists, creatives and other specialists to shape ideas that breakthrough in the news cycle, develop narratives and identify opportunities to create news.
This role calls for someone who can translate complex technology into coverage that supports business and human impact, confidently.
What you'll do:
Lead earned media strategy. Translate clients’ business priorities and reputation goals into clear narratives, proactive storytelling opportunities and actionable earned programs. Define the audiences we need to reach, what we want them to understand, how to break through with the right earned outlets that can influence those perceptions.
Find and create the story. Work with clients to uncover the ideas, data, customer experiences and proof points that make their businesses newsworthy. Recommend what clients can do, say or create to give media a compelling reason to pay attention.
Make technology relevant. Connect technical capabilities and product innovation to broader stories about business transformation, competition, work and everyday life. Develop newsworthy narratives that resonate with business, technology and industry audiences.
Provide confident client counsel. Serve as a trusted day-to-day earned advisor, helping clients assess newsworthiness, sharpen their point of view and make informed decision. Help clients understand the evolving media ecosystem and bring sound judgment to sensitive issues, partnering with senior leaders and specialists as needed.
Drive hands-on media engagement. Develop and maintain relationships with national business and technology journalists, trade reporters, newsletter writers, podcasters and independent news creators. Lead pitching and substantive media conversations, securing coverage that advances the client’s narrative.
Integrate Earned from the start. Partner with account leads and colleagues across Strategy, Intelligence, Creative, Social and Digital to shape programs with a compelling earned story at their core.
Use intelligence to sharpen the work. Apply audience insights, media analysis, data and AI-powered tools to identify emerging conversations, narrative opportunities, white space, and timely opportunities. Bring editorial judgment to interpret those findings and translating them into recommendations.
Own Execution. Lead earned workstreams across launches, ongoing storytelling, company events and major industry moments. Set clear priorities, manage timelines and resources, and evaluate results against agreed audience, narrative and reputation objectives.
Develop people and grow the business. Coach junior colleagues on strategy, storytelling, pitching and client counsel. Contribute to new business proposals and presentations, identify opportunities to expand existing relationships, and partner with account leaders on scopes, staffing and budgets.
You’re our ideal candidate if you
Start with the business challenge. You ask what the client wants to achieve and what they want to be known for, then build an earned strategy that connects the two.
Think like an editor. You recognize a compelling story, understand why it matters now and know what evidence will make it credible. You can challenge an idea constructively and help make it stronger.
Understand technology deeply. You’re curious about how technology works, how companies compete and what innovation means for customers, industries and society. You can translate complexity into clear, accessible language.
Combine strategy with execution. You’re comfortable presenting a recommendation to a senior client, writing the pitch and speaking with a reporter.
Understand the modern media ecosystem. You understand the modern media ecosystem and the evolution across established newsrooms, trade media, newsletters, podcasts and news creators—and how to choose the right targets for a particular story to reach an audience.
Bring clarity and ownership. You offer a point of view, direct strategy, set realistic expectations and take responsibility for the quality of your team’s work.
Make the team better. You collaborate generously, give useful feedback and help colleagues build their judgment and confidence. You stay curious and open to learning.
Experience that contributes to success:
Approximately 10–12 years of relevant experience in technology earned media, media relations or communications, with substantial responsibility for earned strategy and execution. Agency experience is preferred.
Direct, hands-on experience in at least two of the following: AI, enterprise/B2B software, or early-stage companies.
A demonstrated ability to turn business objectives and complex technology topics into distinctive narratives and sustained earned media programs.
Strong relationships with business and technology media, alongside an understanding of relevant trade outlets, independent journalists, newsletter writers and news creators.
A track record of securing meaningful coverage through proactive story development, executive positioning, customer storytelling and data-driven ideas.
Experience leading earned workstreams within integrated B2B campaigns, including product launches, company-owned events and major technology industry events.
Experience counseling senior clients and preparing executives for media interviews and other high-visibility opportunities.
Exceptional writing, editing and presentation skills, with the ability to develop clear strategies, compelling pitches, executive messaging and briefing materials.
Experience managing teams and multiple client workstreams, contributing to new business and organic growth, and working within agreed scopes and budgets.
Experience using research, analytics and measurement to inform strategy, improve programs and demonstrate the contribution of earned media.
#LI-FB1
Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.
The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:
$75,000—$180,000 USD
You belong at Burson:
Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Director, Management & Technology (DACH) - CPG/Retail
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
About Celonis
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.
The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.
Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.
About the Role
Based at our global headquarters in Munich, as a Management & Technology Consulting Manager / Director (internal title: Value Engineering Manager / Director) for CPG & Retail, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.
In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.
Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.
What Sets Our Patch Apart
The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.
As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth: Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
People Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
Executive Advisory & Player-Coach: Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
Enterprise AI Champion: Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
Ecosystem & Partner Strategy: Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
Thought Leadership: Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.
Leadership Behaviors We Value
Deliver Business Outcomes: Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent: Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
Lead by Example: Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
Think BIG, Be BOLD: Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.
Qualifications & Scope
Language Skills: Native or business-fluent German (spoken and written) and fluent English are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.
Location Presence: Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
Proven Leadership Experience: Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
Domain Expertise: Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.
People Management: Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
Executive Presence: Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.
About Us:
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Your Privacy:
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
About Celonis
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.

The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.

Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.
About the Role

Based at our global headquarters in Munich, as a Management & Technology Consulting Manager / Director (internal title: Value Engineering Manager / Director) for CPG & Retail, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.

In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.
Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.
What Sets Our Patch Apart
The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.

As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.
Key Responsibilities

items: Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth: Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.

People Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.

Executive Advisory & Player-Coach: Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.

Enterprise AI Champion: Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.

Ecosystem & Partner Strategy: Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
Thought Leadership: Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.

blocks.text: Leadership Behaviors We Value

items: Deliver Business Outcomes: Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.

Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent: Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
Lead by Example: Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.

Think BIG, Be BOLD: Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.

blocks.text: Qualifications & Scope

items: Language Skills: Native or business-fluent German (spoken and written) and fluent English are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.
Location Presence: Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
Proven Leadership Experience: Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
Domain Expertise: Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.
People Management: Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
Executive Presence: Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.

blocks.text: What Celonis can offer you:

items: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.

Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

blocks.text: About Us:

Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
What Celonis can offer you:

items: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

jobs.title: Data Director, EU
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available
About our Data Discipline
We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.
Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.
Our EU team ⭐
Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo.
Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.
You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.
🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.
Shaping product and commercial strategy:
You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.
Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:
You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.
Changing how decisions get made:
You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.
Building and leading a high-performing team:
You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!
You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.
You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.
You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.
You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.
You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.
You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.
🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
30 minute recruiter call
60 minute call with the hiring manager
4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Payments
A meet and greet with a member of EU Executive Committee
Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.
🙌 What’s in it for you...
💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options and benefits
✅ We can sponsor visas
📍This role can be based in our London or Barcelona office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team
📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.
➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.
#LI-JH1 #LI-Remote
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Head of AI Engineering
jobs.text:
Head of AI Engineering – Bilingual English C1
Full-Time | Remote | Colombia
About the Company
We are an AI strategy and integration firm that builds production AI systems for B2B companies in private equity, wholesale lending, real estate, and SaaS.
We work with high-growth businesses globally, helping them move revenue, compress costs, and automate the work that used to take entire teams — through AI systems that are built to last and designed to perform.
About the Role
We are seeking a Head of AI Engineering to own all engineering delivery at our Colombia engineering hub.
This is the senior-most technical leadership role in the organization. You will lead a high-performing team of AI, ML, MLOps, and Data Engineers while setting the technical bar personally. You'll translate ambitious client goals into scalable, production-ready AI systems — and build the processes, platforms, and culture needed to operate at scale.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of deploying AI systems that moved real business KPIs, is comfortable being client-facing, and knows what it means to own the whole problem — not just manage a piece of it.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Delivery & Leadership
Own all engineering deliverables — quality, scalability, and on-time execution
Lead and manage the full engineering organization: AI Engineers, ML Engineers, MLOps, and Data Engineers
Establish and run Agile/Scrum processes: sprints, backlog grooming, ticketing, and release planning
Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement
AI/ML Strategy & Architecture
Define and standardize best practices across the full AI/ML lifecycle — from experimentation through deployment and monitoring
Architect and oversee a full ML platform: infrastructure, scalability, reliability, and rapid iteration
Design and build scalable, end-to-end ML solutions for predictions, recommendations, search, and growth systems
Evaluate experiments, document findings, select winning approaches, and roll them out team-wide
Technical Execution
Contribute directly to system architecture and key technical decisions
Oversee model training, optimization, deployment, and performance monitoring
Drive data excellence: clean pipelines, strong governance, and actionable insights
Establish frameworks that integrate generative AI into engineering workflows
Client Engagement
Join client calls as a senior technical voice, shaping solutions and building stakeholder trust
Partner with product managers and business leaders to translate business objectives into technical roadmaps
Present trade-offs clearly so clients understand what's being built and why it will move their business
Team Development
Hire, coach, and mentor top-tier AI-first engineers and engineering leaders
Establish clear career paths, feedback loops, and performance standards
Scale the AI function across MLE, MLOps, and Data Engineering as the company grows
Requirements
10+ years of engineering experience with significant and proven leadership responsibility
Track record managing large engineering teams in fast-moving, high-accountability environments
Deep expertise in AI/ML systems — generative AI, model training, and production deployment
Strong command of Agile/Scrum and the operational discipline to run a high-output engineering org
Experience architecting and scaling ML platforms and data infrastructure
Comfortable being client-facing and translating complex technical concepts into business value
English proficiency at C1 level or above
Nice to Have
Former founder or early engineering leader who has operated with full ownership of a technical function
Experience in consulting, professional services, or client-facing technical leadership
Track record of deploying AI systems that moved a business KPI — revenue gained, cost saved, or time eliminated
Active in the AI community — writing, speaking, or building in public
Skills
Machine Learning, Generative AI, and model optimization
MLOps, CI/CD, and ML lifecycle management
Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Data engineering, pipelines, and analytics
Scalable system design and architecture
Exceptional communication across engineering, client, and executive audiences
At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they are born in.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
Why Tenna?
We take pride that our roots are in the construction industry. With this experience and knowledge, we have built a platform revolutionizing construction equipment fleet operations. We provide innovative solutions to customers looking for competitive ways to better manage and track their assets, such as heavy and light equipment, large fleets, tools, and materials.
At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible.
When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets on one comprehensive platform anytime, anywhere.
Position Description
Tenna is searching for a Vice President of Product to partner with our Executive Team to define and execute the product strategy for our B2B SaaS, mobile, and hardware-enabled platform. This leader will translate Tenna’s product vision into practical, actionable plans and ensure our product teams deliver solutions that create measurable value for customers.
The VP of Product will lead multiple teams, establish clear priorities, and bring structure and accountability to product execution. This is not a strategy-only position. We are looking for a hands-on, outcomes-oriented leader who stays close to the work, regularly checks progress, removes obstacles, and ensures our commitments are met.
The right candidate is an analytical, low-ego leader who listens well, communicates clearly, and is equally comfortable with engaging executives, product and engineering teams, and prospective and existing customers. They will bring experience developing complex, high-value B2B products within industrial markets and supporting solutions deployed across thousands of users.
Your Responsibilities
Partner with the Executive Team to define and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy aligned with Tenna’s business goals, market opportunities, and customer needs.
Translate long-term product strategy into clear roadmaps, priorities, timelines, and executable plans for product, design, engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
Lead, and develop multiple and distributed product teams.
Maintain close visibility into product development, regularly reviewing progress, identifying risks, removing blockers, and ensuring teams deliver against commitments.
Oversee the development and evolution of Tenna’s web, native mobile, SaaS, and hardware-enabled product offerings.
Ensure products are designed to support large-scale deployment across thousands of users and complex customer environments.
Establish and monitor meaningful product metrics, using data to evaluate performance, prioritize investments, and communicate progress.
Present product plans, performance data, tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to executive leadership and other key stakeholders.
Promote disciplined product development best practices while adapting processes to meet the needs of the business.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations.
Develop and improve the tools, systems, and operating rhythms used to manage product work and communicate progress.
Cultivate a practical, customer-focused product culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and execution.
Qualifications
12+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proventrack record of success in launching and scaling B2B technology products in a fast-paced environment.
2+ years of experience in senior leadership roles
Significant product management and product leadership experience within a B2B SaaS organization.
Demonstrated success leading multiple product teams, including teams or stakeholders operating across different regions or countries.
Experience developing and delivering complex B2B products within industrial verticals.
Strong record of moving beyond strategy to drive execution, monitor progress, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Experience with web applications and native mobile application development, including products deployed at scale to thousands of users.
Experience working with hardware-enabled products and connected software ecosystems.
Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud-based platforms, multi-tenant systems, and product development.
Sufficient technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and understand how technologies and programming languages such as JavaScript, Java, Python, Swift, and Kotlin support product development. This role is not expected to read or write production code.
Experience reporting to and communicating directly with senior executives, including C-suite leaders.
Ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into clear recommendations, priorities, and decisions.
Experience using sophisticated product and project management tools to manage work, analyze data, and communicate plans and timelines.
Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Figma, Zeplin, or comparable platforms.
Experience directly engaging prospective and existing customers about current products, future offerings, and unmet needs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and persuasively.
Strong people-management skills and a demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and align high-performing teams.
Analytical, practical, and execution-oriented approach to leadership.
Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information
Full-time opportunity.
Opportunity is remote – nationwide.
Competitive compensation package.
Travel is required, up to 25%.
Robust, low-cost benefit packages.
Benefit coverage begins the first date of employment.
Dependent Care.
401k match.
Employee referral bonuses.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Tenna is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome different perspectives and opinions to foster innovation, authenticity, and excellence across all parts of our company, and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: Director of Product & Technology, ACCC Subsidiary
jobs.text:
The Director of Product & Technology leads the end-to-end build and ongoing evolution of the digital platform for ACCC's subsidiary. This is a hands-on, builder role: the Director is accountable for the technical architecture, UI/UX, API integrations, infrastructure, and AI-based data solutions that bring the platform to life, while also setting the strategic technology roadmap needed to support the subsidiary's growth and scale.
This role owns the platform roadmap and provides leadership across the full build lifecycle — from architecture and vendor selection through design, development, integration, testing, launch, and continuous improvement. The Director acts as the subsidiary's hands-on technology lead: scouting and managing IT partners and consultants, coordinating UI/UX and website development, and translating the subsidiary's business and growth needs into well-built, scalable, and measurable technology solutions.
Operating within the subsidiary's build phase, the Director owns the Product & Technology function and is responsible for establishing clear priorities, build milestones, scorecard measures, operating rhythms, and team or vendor accountabilities.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
This job description does not limit management’s ability to assign or adjust duties and responsibilities at any time.
Develop and maintain ACCC’s digital product vision, strategy, multiyear roadmap, translating organizational priorities, client needs, and operational needs into actionable initiatives.
Establish product goals, business outcomes, success measures, and value propositions in partnership with business leaders.
Lead a structured process for evaluating, prioritizing and managing digital product requests based on strategic alignment, user impact, risk, effort, and expected value.
Balance new product development with enhancements, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies, platform maintenance, and defect resolution.
Identify opportunities to improve digital client experiences, employee tools, self-service capabilities, and operational workflows.
Own end-to-end technical architecture and infrastructure decisions (hosting, security, scalability) for the subsidiary's platform.
Coordinate UI/UX design and the overall user experience across the platform, working with designers and consultants as needed.
Scope, evaluate, and manage API integrations with third-party data, marketing, and financial-wellness platforms.
Lead website development and ongoing technical build-out of the ConsumerCredit.com platform.
Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-based data solutions to support personalization, lead qualification, and intelligent routing.
Own technical feasibility assessment, architecture decisions, and solution design — directly or in partnership with outsourced development and infrastructure partners — translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Oversee user acceptance testing, launch readiness, communications, training coordination, implementation, and post-launch support.
Monitor product performance, adoption, user feedback, and business impact, using results to drive continuous improvement.
Maintain visibility into product priorities, active initiatives, risks, dependencies, and progress, and communicate recommendations to senior leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop the Product & Technology team, and manage outsourced development and consulting partners.
Scout, evaluate, and manage relationships with IT vendors, development agencies, and technology consultants supporting the platform build.
Ensure digital products incorporate accessibility, privacy, security, compliance, and operational considerations.
