jobs.title: Director, Engineering - Cloud Detection Platform
jobs.text:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
About the Role
CrowdStrike stops breaches, and detection content is how we do it. The Cloud Detection Platform team builds the engines that execute detection logic in the cloud at massive scale, along with the infrastructure that lets detection engineers author, test, deploy, and manage that content safely across the entire Falcon fleet.
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this platform. You will manage multiple teams responsible for our cloud detection engines (scheduled, real-time, and retrospective execution across first- and third-party data) and the supporting infrastructure: content management and deployment pipelines, rule lifecycle and exception management, testing and validation environments, and the observability, quotas, and SLOs that keep rule execution reliable and cost-effective for customers.
This is a high-leverage role at the center of CrowdStrike's detection strategy. Your platform serves detection engineers across endpoint, cloud, identity, and next-gen SIEM, and every improvement you ship translates directly into faster, higher-quality protection for thousands of customers.
What You'll Do
Own the multi-year strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the Cloud Detection Platform, from detection engines to the content delivery infrastructure that supports them
Lead and grow an organization of managers and senior engineers across multiple teams, owning the full talent lifecycle: hiring, coaching, performance, and succession
Be accountable for the reliability, latency, and cost of detection rule execution at fleet scale, including SLO definition, capacity and quota management, and COGS
Drive the evolution toward a unified multi-engine detection architecture, balancing scheduled search, real-time, and retrospective execution across engines
Partner closely with detection engineering, content, product management, and data platform teams to prioritize and deliver against roadmap commitments
Build the guardrails that make shipping detection content safe: pre-release validation, staged deployment, rollback, exclusion management, and end-to-end testing
Anticipate and manage escalations and cross-team dependencies, and represent the platform in architecture and planning forums across the product organization
Drive annual operating plan and organizational planning for your area, and reflect CrowdStrike's culture in how your teams operate
What You'll Need

blocks.text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
About the Role

CrowdStrike stops breaches, and detection content is how we do it. The Cloud Detection Platform team builds the engines that execute detection logic in the cloud at massive scale, along with the infrastructure that lets detection engineers author, test, deploy, and manage that content safely across the entire Falcon fleet.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this platform. You will manage multiple teams responsible for our cloud detection engines (scheduled, real-time, and retrospective execution across first- and third-party data) and the supporting infrastructure: content management and deployment pipelines, rule lifecycle and exception management, testing and validation environments, and the observability, quotas, and SLOs that keep rule execution reliable and cost-effective for customers.

This is a high-leverage role at the center of CrowdStrike's detection strategy. Your platform serves detection engineers across endpoint, cloud, identity, and next-gen SIEM, and every improvement you ship translates directly into faster, higher-quality protection for thousands of customers.
What You'll Do

items: Own the multi-year strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the Cloud Detection Platform, from detection engines to the content delivery infrastructure that supports them
Lead and grow an organization of managers and senior engineers across multiple teams, owning the full talent lifecycle: hiring, coaching, performance, and succession
Be accountable for the reliability, latency, and cost of detection rule execution at fleet scale, including SLO definition, capacity and quota management, and COGS
Drive the evolution toward a unified multi-engine detection architecture, balancing scheduled search, real-time, and retrospective execution across engines
Partner closely with detection engineering, content, product management, and data platform teams to prioritize and deliver against roadmap commitments
Build the guardrails that make shipping detection content safe: pre-release validation, staged deployment, rollback, exclusion management, and end-to-end testing
Anticipate and manage escalations and cross-team dependencies, and represent the platform in architecture and planning forums across the product organization
Drive annual operating plan and organizational planning for your area, and reflect CrowdStrike's culture in how your teams operate

jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
Pinterest is a visual discovery platform where hundreds of millions of people come to find inspiration and decide what to try, buy, or do next. Our Ads Quality organization builds the machine-learning systems that make ads relevant and valuable to Pinners while delivering meaningful outcomes for advertisers.
We are seeking a Director of Machine Learning Engineering to lead a broad portfolio of Ads Quality modeling teams focused on engagement, conversion, ROAS optimization, ranking, representation learning, and ML-powered experimentation.
In this role, you will shape and drive a unified technical strategy across Ads Quality, leading teams responsible for engagement ranking, oCPM and conversion modeling, ROAS optimization, lightweight ranking and retrieval models, foundation model adoption, sequence and multimodal modeling, and the quality and efficiency of production machine learning systems.
What you’ll do:
Set the technical vision and multi-year strategy for Ads Quality machine learning, connecting model innovation to Pinner value, advertiser performance, revenue, and marketplace health.
Lead and develop a group of engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and machine-learning engineers across multiple modeling domains.
Establish a coherent modeling roadmap across engagement, conversion, ROAS, relevance, ranking, and foundation-model initiatives.
Drive improvements in model quality, calibration, generalization, cold-start performance, attribution, and robustness across Pinterest surfaces.
Guide the evolution of Ads models toward larger, more generalizable architectures, including foundation models, distillation, long-context sequence modeling, multimodal representations, and cross-domain learning.
Ensure that modeling investments translate into reliable production outcomes through strong offline evaluation, online experimentation, launch discipline, and post-launch monitoring.
Partner closely with Ads Product, Ads Data Science, Ads Signals, Ads Retrieval, Ads Delivery, Measurement, Core, ATG, and ML Infrastructure.
Set expectations for training-serving parity, data quality, privacy, reliability, latency, capacity, and cost efficiency.
Improve engineering velocity through better experimentation workflows, reusable modeling infrastructure, automation, and agentic development tools.
Build a culture of technical excellence, candid collaboration, inclusion, ownership, and continuous learning.
Represent Ads Quality ML in senior leadership forums and communicate strategy, tradeoffs, risks, and results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
What we’re looking for:
Minimum 12 years of experience building and deploying machine-learning systems, including significant experience leading managers and multi-team organizations.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale recommendation, ranking, advertising, search, marketplace, or personalization ML teams.
Strong understanding of modern deep-learning and recommender-system techniques, including sequence models, embeddings, multimodal models, multi-task learning, foundation models, distillation, and reinforcement learning.
Experience with conversion, value, ROAS, bidding, or other lower-funnel optimization problems is strongly preferred.
Proven ability to connect modeling objectives and offline metrics to online experiments and business outcomes.
Experience operating production ML systems with demanding requirements for latency, availability, calibration, privacy, reliability, and cost.
Strong judgment in balancing near-term product delivery with foundational technical investments.
Track record of building high-performing organizations, developing senior leaders, and creating effective operating mechanisms.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
In-Office Requirement Statement:
We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2x per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from one of the following offices: Palo Alto, San Francisco.

jobs.text:
Job Title: Executive Director, Global Technology Service Management
Job Location: Remote (US), United States of America
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer. The Executive Director, Global Technology Service Management executes BeOne’s enterprise service management strategy and leads the governance and operational performance needed to improve service reliability, employee productivity, business continuity, and technology-enabled business outcomes. This role oversees the ServiceNow platform, global service desk operations, executive support, ITSM processes, service governance, automation, experience management, and performance accountability as an integrated service management ecosystem designed to deliver consistent, scalable, and high-quality technology services worldwide. In partnership with regional delivery, workplace technology, infrastructure, enterprise platform, and business leaders, the Executive Director standardizes services, strengthens operational excellence, and improves employee experience through data-driven, AI-enabled service delivery. Essential Functions of the Role: Enterprise Service Management & Governance Define and execute the enterprise service management framework, including standards, governance, service ownership, support models, escalation paths, and lifecycle practices. Maintain service catalog governance, service taxonomy, service data quality, and consistent onboarding practices for technology services. Extend enterprise service management practices beyond IT where appropriate to enable consistent, controlled, and measurable business services. Drive continual service improvement across the technology service portfolio. Service Performance & Accountability Partner with service owners across infrastructure, collaboration, workplace technologies, enterprise platforms, and regional delivery to define KPIs, SLAs, XLAs, scorecards, service reviews, and reporting standards that clearly measure and communicate service health, performance, experience, and business impact. Use service analytics, trend data, employee sentiment, and operational insights to identify friction, reduce recurring issues, and improve service reliability. Translate performance insights into prioritized improvement actions that strengthen employee experience, business stakeholder satisfaction, and service outcomes. ServiceNow, ITSM & Automation Own ServiceNow platform governance, adoption, data quality, roadmap execution, and business outcomes as the enterprise system of record and system of action for technology service management. Lead maturity of Incident, Request, Change, Problem, Knowledge, Asset, Configuration, Service Catalog, and related ITSM disciplines. Advance workflow standardization, orchestration, self-service, virtual agent, knowledge management, predictive routing, agent assist, and AI-enabled service capabilities. Establish guardrails for responsible automation and AI-enabled workflows, including human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, risk management, and measurable value realization. Global Service Desk & Executive Support Lead global service desk and executive support operations with consistent standards, regional alignment, and strong customer experience. Drive operational excellence, workforce performance, quality management, and support model effectiveness. Ensure support capabilities align with enterprise service management governance and operational requirements. Compliance, Risk & Controls Ensure service management processes and platforms meet applicable GxP, privacy, cybersecurity, audit, validation, and regulatory requirements. Partner with Quality, Compliance, Validation, Cybersecurity, and Risk teams to maintain controls, procedures, and auditable records. Support audits, inspections, assessments, and remediation of service management control deficiencies. Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement Build and lead a high-performing global service management organization. Partner with regional delivery, platform, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and business leaders to align priorities and execution. Foster accountability, service excellence, continuous improvement, customer-centric delivery, talent development, and succession planning. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree and 14+ years of technology operations, service management, or service delivery leadership experience, including 8+ years leading within complex global organizations. Demonstrated success leading enterprise service management functions at scale, including service governance, ownership models, operating models, service data quality, and performance programs. Deep experience with ServiceNow as an enterprise workflow platform, including platform governance, adoption, roadmap execution, data quality, and business outcome accountability. Strong command of ITSM disciplines including Incident, Request, Change, Problem, Knowledge, Asset, Configuration, and Service Catalog Management. Experience leading global service desk, executive support, and service performance management capabilities, including KPIs, SLAs, XLAs, scorecards, service reviews, employee sentiment, and stakeholder experience measures. Experience operating in regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or similarly controlled environments with strong understanding of GxP, audit readiness, validation, privacy, cybersecurity, and operational controls. Strong understanding of automation, workflow orchestration, self-service, virtual agents, knowledge management, predictive analytics, agent assist, and responsible AI-enabled service management capabilities. Exceptional executive leadership, communication, stakeholder management, vendor management, talent development, and change leadership skills. ITIL certification or equivalent service management expertise strongly preferred; ServiceNow leadership experience preferred Global Competencies When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world. Fosters Teamwork Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback Self-Awareness Acts Inclusively Demonstrates Initiative Entrepreneurial Mindset Continuous Learning Embraces Change Results-Oriented Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis Financial Excellence Communicates with Clarity Salary Range: $278,200.00 - $358,200.00 annually BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, and any other applicable federal, state or local laws, applicants who require reasonable accommodation in the job application process may contact . BeOne is a global oncology company that is discovering and developing innovative treatments that are more affordable and accessible to cancer patients worldwide. With a broad portfolio, we are expediting development of our diverse pipeline of novel therapeutics through our internal capabilities and collaborations. We are committed to radically improving access to medicines for far more patients who need them. Our growing global team of more than 11,000 colleagues spans six continents. To learn more about BeOne, please visit www.beonemedicines.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X (formerly known as Twitter), Facebook and Instagram. jobs.title: TECH000: Head of Technology/CIO
jobs.text:
About JerseySTEM
JerseySTEM is a mission-driven network of professionals dedicated to closing the gender gap in STEM by expanding access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.
Role Details & Commitment:
Type: Pro-bono (unpaid volunteer)
Time Commitment: ~6 flexible hours per week for a minimum of 6 months
Member Deposit: Requires a $100 refundable deposit (fully returned after 6 months of active service). Exemptions apply for K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students.
Overview
JerseySTEM is seeking an experienced Head of Technology / Chief Information Officer (CIO) to provide leadership, strategic oversight, and team management for our technology department. Taking the reins from our Interim CIO, you will lead a team of 6–8 technical leads (and their respective associates) who maintain our core operational platforms, including Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Jira.
Note: This is fundamentally a people leadership and operational management role rather than a hands-on technical coding position.
Responsibilities
Culture & Collaboration: Cultivate an open, feedback-driven environment focused on mission impact over ego to ensure all technology decisions directly serve the youth we empower.
Executive Leadership: Serve on the Executive Committee as the primary liaison and advocate for the Tech team.
Team Operations: Facilitate weekly Tech meetings to align goals, resolve roadblocks, and advance both technical capabilities and organizational mission objectives.
Performance Management: Establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across the organization to deliver responsive, high-quality technical support.
Knowledge Management & Succession: Champion best practices in technical documentation and build a sustainable succession pipeline for key technical roles.
Qualifications
Service Mindset: View internal teams and stakeholders as primary clients, prioritizing responsive, high-quality technical support.
Team Leadership & Strategy: Proven ability to articulate technology strategy, gain team buy-in, and foster collaboration among technical leads and associates.
Non-Profit Experience & Adaptability: Prior experience working with non-profits or community organizations, with a demonstrated ability to thrive and innovate within resource-constrained operating environments.
Strong Communication: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to convey strategy clearly and build alignment across teams.
Drive & Initiative: A strong sense of urgency focused on decisive execution and timely problem-solving.
Team Advocacy: Serve as an enthusiastic champion and advocate for the Tech team and its contributions.
Technical Familiarity: General exposure to or familiarity with core platforms, including Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Jira.
Documentation Focus: Strong commitment to clear, thorough documentation to ensure operational continuity and seamless succession.
Availability & Commitment: Ability to dedicate 8–10 hours per week for a 12+ month commitment.

jobs.title: Director, Value Engineering (DACH) - CPG/Retail
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
About Celonis
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.
The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.
Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.
About the Role
Based at our global headquarters in Munich, as a Value Engineering Manager / Director for CPG & Retail, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.
In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.
Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.
What Sets Our Patch Apart
The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.
As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth: Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
People Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
Executive Advisory & Player-Coach: Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
Enterprise AI Champion: Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
Ecosystem & Partner Strategy: Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
Thought Leadership: Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.
Leadership Behaviors We Value
Deliver Business Outcomes: Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent: Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
Lead by Example: Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
Think BIG, Be BOLD: Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.
Qualifications & Scope
Language Skills: Native or business-fluent German (spoken and written) and fluent English are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.
Location Presence: Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
Proven Leadership Experience: Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
Domain Expertise: Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.
People Management: Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
Executive Presence: Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.
About Us:
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Your Privacy:
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

jobs.title: Director, Product Development & Commercialization
jobs.text:
About US
Shameless Snacks makes low-sugar gummy candy that tastes like the real thing. Every bag has 3g of sugar, is packed with fiber, and is vegan and gluten-free. Our sour and fruit gummies are sold on Amazon, DTC, TikTok, and at major retailers across the country.
We’re not a startup hoping something works. We’ve taken better-for-you candy from an idea to retail shelves nationwide and built a brand that consumers love. We move with the speed of a startup: small teams with real ownership and accountability.
This is the place where you’ll see the entire machine: flavor development, formulation, packaging, co-manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail, all in one team. If you want to build and ship a food brand at scale, there is no better place than this.
About the role
You are in charge of commercializing every Shameless Snacks product: taking an approved brief and delivering a formula, spec, supplier and stable first commercial production run, on the roadmap date and at the target cost. You own the technical answer to “can we make this, where, and at what COGS,” and the go/no-go at each step from bench to first run.
Shameless is an omnichannel better-for-you confectionery brand. We do not own plants. Product is made by co-manufacturers across several confectionery platforms, and the company owns its formulas. This role is the technical center of that model.
What you own:
The commercialization timeline for every product, brief to first production run, and the go/no-go at each step
Feasibility and cost reads on every brief before it is approved: can we make it, where, and at what COGS.
Formulation across all platforms, with every formula owned by Shameless in writing.
Benchtop samples, hands-on — you make them yourself and through flavor-house and co-manufacturer labs (there is no in-house lab today), and deliver them to Brand 3–4 weeks before flavor lock.
Regulatory and label data: nutrition panel, sugar grams, allergens, claims substantiation.
Technical specs and acceptance criteria: sensory, texture, shelf life, stability. You own technical sensory; Brand owns consumer acceptance.
Structural packaging spec (bag, master case, display) with Brand on artwork.
Supplier and co-manufacturer technical qualification: technical fit, trials, site audits. You recommend which co-manufacturer makes what.
Pilot runs, stability, scale-up and first commercial run, ending in a released spec, BOM and test plan handed to Quality and Procurement
Post-launch improvement: sensory consistency, cost-down and reformulation, driven by market feedback and quality signals
How you work with the rest of the company:
Brand decides what and when. You decide how, and whether it can be done at cost. Each function holds the final call on its own piece:
Brand owns the brief, the roadmap, consumer acceptance, artwork and go-to-market
Quality (under the Director of Supply Chain, Procurement and Sourcing) approves the spec and test plan and releases lots at the co-manufacturer
Procurement and Sourcing owns commercial terms, MOQs and purchase orders
The executive team owns co-manufacturer contracts, IP, recall terms, and which co-manufacturer gets volume
Operations owns inbound logistics, tariffs and 3PL
FP&A owns COGS targets, the margin model, and S&OP
The Retail team owns retail spec sheets, pallet patterns and OTIF
Your job is to give each of them what they need from the product: the spec, the cost inputs, the lead times, the recommendation on where it should be made.
What success looks like in year one:
The co-manufacturer transition is complete for the core portfolio.
Every active SKU has a written, Shameless-owned formula and spec
Written acceptance criteria exist for every platform, and every incoming sample is evaluated against them before it reaches Brand.
Every launch on the roadmap ships on its date, with formulation freeze and benchtop samples delivered ahead of flavor lock
Landed COGS on transitioned SKUs is down against the prior baseline, quantified with FP&A.
Every project is visible in the pipeline system with a stage, owner and next gate, and nothing depends on one person’s inbox.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) iGaming Crypto - Estonia or Remote
jobs.text:
We are seeking an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the technology strategy of a fast-growing international crypto iGaming group. Reporting directly to the COO and Board, you will define the company's technical vision, oversee engineering, infrastructure, blockchain, security, and product delivery, and play a key role in driving innovation and scalability across multiple brands.
This is a unique opportunity to shape the technology roadmap of a high-growth business operating at the forefront of crypto, blockchain, and online gaming.
Key Responsibilities
Define and execute the group's technology strategy and long-term roadmap.
Lead engineering, platform architecture, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and security functions.
Oversee blockchain infrastructure, crypto wallets, payment systems, and digital asset integrations.
Ensure highly scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms with excellent uptime and reliability.
Drive engineering best practices, CI/CD, automation, QA, and continuous improvement.
Manage third-party technology providers, integrations, and strategic partnerships.
Lead enterprise IT, internal systems, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Build, mentor, and develop high-performing global engineering teams.
Collaborate closely with Product, Payments, Risk, Operations, and senior leadership to align technology with business objectives.
Report regularly to the Board on technology performance, investment, risks, and future initiatives.
Requirements
Proven experience as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or senior technology leader within iGaming, betting, fintech, payments, or a similar high-scale environment.
Strong background in modern software architecture, microservices, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and distributed systems.
Hands-on experience with blockchain technologies, crypto payments, wallet infrastructure, and security best practices.
Strong commercial mindset with experience evaluating build vs. buy decisions and managing technology vendors.
Experience leading large engineering organisations through periods of growth, transformation, or restructuring.
Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
What's on Offer
Opportunity to lead technology for a rapidly growing international crypto iGaming group.
Highly strategic executive position with direct Board exposure.
Influence over the company's long-term technology vision and innovation strategy.
Competitive executive remuneration package and long-term career opportunity.

jobs.title: Director of AI Developer Experience - Platform Engineering (x/f/m)
jobs.text:
The opportunity
Founded in 2013, Doctolib is Europe's leading AI and digital health company, serving 580,000 health professionals and 100 million people. We are building a new way to build software: agents doing the grunt work of writing, testing, reviewing and merging code, with engineers moving into a control-tower role to monitor and intervene.
Your mission: build the tooling and workflows that let AI agents and the engineers who work alongside them test, review, ship and monitor code reliably, so Doctolib can multiply its engineering output while keeping quality and control.
The role
We're looking for a Director of AI Developer Experience to lead our new AI Developer Experience team, reporting to the VP Platform Engineering. You will also own the existing CI and Developer Experience scope.
Doctolib is moving AI adoption from a temporary SWAT team to a permanent capability. The current team includes two Product Managers and two engineers, with more people joining through internal transfers and hiring.
Your team will own:
The agent-native testing and feedback infrastructure that lets agents know, within their own workflow, whether what they built is correct.
CI/CD and build systems for the monolith and satellite services, elevated from a CI-run team into an efficient agent-testing capability.
Developer productivity measurement in the AI era DORA, autonomous change rate and complementary indicators.
The inner-loop experience: local and remote environments, onboarding, editor integration and sandboxing.
Your impact
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Build the tools and workflows that allow agents to write, test, review and merge code, including evaluation, security checks and controls giving agents a fast, reliable feedback loop on whether what they build is correct.
Own testing and feedback for the monolith and satellite services, elevating the current CI setup from a CI-run team into an efficient agent-testing capability.
Own developer productivity measurement in the context of AI DORA, autonomous change rate and complementary indicators and make it visible and actionable to feature teams.
Lead the inner-loop experience: local and remote environments, onboarding, editor integration and sandboxing.
Build and organise the team, developing agentic skills internally where needed, as AI adoption shifts from a temporary SWAT team to a permanent one.
Partner with Product Engineering and Product Management to understand internal users and drive adoption.
Your team
Reporting to the VP Platform Engineering, Mike Aidane, you'll join the Platform Engineering leadership team alongside directors and senior EMs for Application Platform, Data Services and Platform Services.
You will lead the new AI Developer Experience team, which includes Automation Platform (CI team), ILOT (Internal LLMs Ops & Training team) and TestingOps.
You'll partner closely with Product Engineering, Product Management, Release Engineering, Quality Engineering, Infrastructure Platform, SRE, FinOps, Security, Privacy and Compliance, and engineering teams across France and Germany.
Your profile
You have led engineering organisations through large-scale Developer Experience transformations and know what it takes to ship great tooling fast, durably, and without sacrificing quality. You think in systems technical and organisational and are as comfortable setting architecture direction as you are making a hard technical call.
Core qualifications:
You have led Developer Experience, Developer Productivity, Developer Infrastructure or Build/CI organisations serving 300+ engineers. You have demonstrated measurable change in how engineers work, with evidence of adoption, productivity outcomes and organisational or operating-model change.
You have deep technical credibility across CI/CD, build and test infrastructure, monorepo build graphs, test selection, caching, merge queues and flake management. You can guide architecture and trade-offs while remaining credible with Staff Engineers and strong EMs.
You have 5+ years of experience as a manager of managers: hiring, growing and levelling engineering managers and staff-plus ICs.
You are comfortable setting your own success metrics and being held to them, with strong written communication and structured thinking.
You are fluent in English.
Bonus points for:
Recent exposure to AI-assisted or agentic engineering transformation, including evaluation, security, guardrails, adoption and productivity measurement. Several years of AI Developer Experience leadership are not expected — the relevant signal is strong large-scale DevEx experience combined with recent AI transformation exposure.
Experience with large legacy codebases or monoliths, or in a regulated or high-trust environment such as healthcare. You treat constraints as design inputs, not blockers.
Having led multi-country, distributed engineering organisations.
Life at Doctolib Tech
Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.
Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.
What we offer
Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
Relocation support in case of international mobility
Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training
Our interview process
Intro with the VP Platform Engineering
Deep dive on your large-scale Developer Experience transformation
Business case presentation
Cross-functional panel with Product Engineering and Product Management leaders
Executive conversation
At least one reference check
We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.
Job details
Permanent position
Full-time
Paris
Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)
Start date: as soon as possible
We welcome everyone
At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.
The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.
To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.
Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!
Your data privacy
All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: France. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

jobs.title: Head of Analytics - Global Multi-Product Broker
jobs.text:
Job Description (JD)
Job Title
Head of Analytics – Global Multi-Product Broker
Location
Limassol, Cyprus (Hybrid) or Remote (UTC−1 to UTC+4)
Reporting To
Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Head of Analytics to establish and lead our analytics function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to define the company's data strategy, build the analytics architecture, and create the foundations for data-driven decision-making across a rapidly growing multi-product brokerage business.
Operating across CFDs, cryptocurrency, proprietary trading, and prediction markets, the business has reached significant scale without a centralized analytics function. As the first Head of Analytics, you will have full ownership of building the data ecosystem, defining business metrics, implementing attribution models, and establishing analytics best practices that will shape the organization for years to come.
Key Responsibilities
Analytics Strategy & Leadership
Build and lead the company's first centralized analytics function.
Define the long-term analytics vision, roadmap, and operating model.

jobs.title: VP, Global Technology Services
jobs.text:
About SH/FT
Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.
The Role
SH/FT is seeking a VP of Global Technology Services to lead and scale our technology delivery practice across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, develops processes with clarity, works cross-functionally by default, and is energized by building client relationships. You will own the quality, margin, and strategic direction of our technology services engagements from pre-sale through delivery, while unifying a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, and platform experts into a single, scalable practice.
This is not a role for someone who needs a fully defined playbook. It requires a leader who can move between executive strategy and hands-on execution when it counts, drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority, and bring clarity and momentum to complex, evolving client engagements spanning martech platform configuration to web and email engineering. You'll have real latitude to shape how this practice is structured, staffed, and grown.
What You’ll Lead
Client Delivery and Technical Strategy
Own technology services delivery across active engagements, ensuring technical quality, on-time delivery, and alignment to scope
Serve as a senior technical and strategic advisor to clients, translating complex architecture, engineering, and platform capabilities into clear business outcomes
Step in directly on client work where needed to protect delivery integrity - particularly on the most complex or highest-stakes engagements
Provide thought leadership in RFP and RFI responses, ensuring technical feasibility, clarity, and alignment with best practices
Establish and enforce architectural standards, delivery governance, and quality frameworks across the practice
Practice and Team Leadership
Lead, develop, and retain a team of Directors, senior architects, and engineers across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning
Set standards and best practices for system integrations and email engineering, including responsive design, rendering compatibility, templating architecture, and deployment workflows
Identify opportunities for practice innovation, including accelerators, reusable frameworks, and AI and ML enablement
Partner with Sales and leadership on pipeline development, partnership co-selling, and capability positioning
Cross-Functional Process and Growth
Drive process and operating rhythm across a matrixed, cross-functional team where formal structure is still being built
Partner closely with Sales, Alliances, Business Operations, and Delivery Management to ensure seamless handoffs from pre-sale through execution
Build scalable delivery frameworks, scoping standards, and technical governance models that reduce variability and protect margin across platform and email work
Identify and close operational gaps before they become client or financial issues
What You Bring
Leadership and Delivery
10 or more years in marketing technology, solution architecture, software engineering, or digital consulting, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role (Director or equivalent)
Proven track record leading delivery across multiple complex engagements simultaneously in a consulting or agency environment
Highly comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where process must be built alongside execution
Strong cross-functional influencer who drives alignment without relying on formal authority
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to lead client conversations at the VP and C-Suite level
Technical Expertise
Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of the Adobe ecosystem (AEP, AEM, CDP, Marketo, AJO, CJA) or the Salesforce ecosystem (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Account Engage, Agentforce, Sales Cloud), with working fluency across the other-
Strong background in email development, including HTML/CSS email engineering, responsive design, rendering across clients and devices, ESP integrations, and templating frameworks
Broad understanding of enterprise data architecture, identity resolution, and customer 360 strategy
Experience integrating martech platforms with data warehouses, CRMs, CMS platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience with AI and ML enablement across marketing and data platforms
About SH/FT
SH/FT is a client services business that focuses on implementing and activating technology and data to make sales and marketing work. Our people bring combined experience across technology, data and analytics, business strategy, and campaign operations to accelerate our clients' businesses. We keep pace with change in modern marketing and technology in order to create effective, scalable, and future-proof solutions for clients that span both the Fortune 500 and emerging industry leaders. We have built strong relationships with the world's most influential martech platforms and are key partners to them and their clients.
Why SH/FT
SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. As VP of Technology Services, you will shape how our clients connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable delivery, and data-driven strategy - and you'll have significant influence over how the practice's structure, standards, and team are shaped and scaled. You will lead a team doing some of the most complex and interesting work in martech today, with a direct line to executive leadership and real influence over where the practice goes next.
We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
Candidates must have current U.S. or Canada work authorization. For U.S. candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be located in North America.
As required by law, SH/FT provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in California, Colorado, Hawaii, New York, New Jersey, or Washington. The salary range for these residents is $185,000.00 to $210,000.00 + annual performance based bonus. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to scope of responsibilities, skillset, relevant experience, certifications, and more. In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.
No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.
All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

jobs.title: Head of software Engineering
jobs.text:
Ultimate Peaks is seeking a strategic and dynamic Head of Software Engineering to lead our software development teams and drive the successful delivery of innovative technology solutions. The Head of Software Engineering will oversee the full software development lifecycle, foster a culture of technical excellence, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with product management, design, and operations teams to deliver scalable, high-quality software products that meet the evolving needs of our clients.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, mentor, and grow a talented team of software engineers across multiple projects.
Define and implement software engineering best practices, development methodologies, and quality standards.
Drive architectural decisions and ensure the scalability, reliability, and security of software solutions.
Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and delivery milestones to ensure on-time project completion.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing within the engineering team.
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to maintain competitive advantage.
Qualifications & Experience
Proven experience (typically 10+ years) in software engineering with at least 3-5 years in a leadership role.
Strong expertise in modern software development technologies, programming languages, and frameworks.
Experience leading Agile teams and implementing Agile/Scrum processes.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate across teams and with stakeholders.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Operations
jobs.text:
OEC provides software solutions to those who work in the automotive parts and repair industry. Our solutions make it easier for automotive industry professionals to buy and sell parts, conduct repair research & planning, optimize estimates, improve the parts supply chain, and more. OEC partners with many of the world’s largest manufacturers, dealers and suppliers, shops and repairers, and service providers, giving our customers access to a comprehensive network and a streamlined workflow.
Job Summary Provides guidance to assigned product leaders and their direct reports, and ensures work is distributed across the team in a manner that optimizes throughput and builds skills and capabilities. Monitors evolution in the industry, innovation in parallel industries, competitor products, market, and consumer trends, to drive product portfolio decisions. Establishes, directs, and maintains the overall policies and strategies for product operations.
Key Responsibilities
Leads, guides, evaluates and monitors deliverables of assigned product team(s). Ensures clarity around priorities and provides performance feedback and coaching. Motivates and empowers department leaders to manage day-to-day execution of team operations and removes obstacles to improve team productivity & effectiveness. Encourages leadership development and growth and implements professional development plans for high-potential employees. Ensures performance issues are addressed timely and appropriately.
Works in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and execute engagement, recognition, promotion, and retention strategies, focused on making sure the organization has the right talent to drive product strategy and initiatives forward.
Guides and assists the creation of the product roadmap, success criteria, and product launch plans to drive clear prioritization, organizational alignment, customer satisfaction, and sales.
Partners regularly with senior management and leadership teams to develop OEC and product line strategies and delivers on team and OEC’s goals.
Models adaptability by encouraging continuous evolution to product portfolio considering industry trends, emerging solutions, new insights, and changing customer and business needs.
Develops and builds business cases reflecting all necessary commercial and technical considerations required to secure product development funding. Ensures teams are creating detailed plans and executing them to meet financial commitments of projects.
Partners with Technology leaders to refine and deploy effective collaboration techniques between product and engineering.
Owns organizational approach to product lifecycle management, including clear and consistent frameworks for how investment decisions are made across the portfolio.
Designs product packaging, pricing, and name to distinguish product line(s) from other OEC and competitive products in line with the product’s value proposition and refines the approach to voice of customer (VoC) and market research so that customer and market insight consistently informs product decisions.
10. Defines core services across the portfolio that are customer-focused, revenue-generating, strategically sound, and operationally central. 11. Recruits, hires and onboards new product leaders and staff. Ensures newly hired employees have the tools, resources, and knowledge needed to be successful at OEC. 12. Supports the legal team and subsequent agreement needs, business development strategy, and related work. 13. Assists in developing annual department budget(s). Identifies, manages, and allocates company resources (budget and staffing) to ensure business goals can be accomplished, while ensuring fiscal responsibility. 14. Continuously innovates on best practices for how AI is leveraged, both internally and within the products themselves.
Education A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus in Business, Marketing, or related discipline. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.
Experience, Skills and Key Competencies At least 14 years of progressively responsible experience in a product development environment managing large scale projects and implementations, plus at least 10 years of people management experience with responsibility for leading a team of direct reports.
Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:
Ability to lead diverse teams and create an engaging and positive culture that motivates and empowers others to do their best work; can unlock the full potential of product teams.
Background as both a hands-on product manager and a senior people leader with a genuine passion for product operations.
Applied AI experience, ideally including designing and building AI agents.
Experience in a private equity-backed business, with software as a service (SaaS) background.
Experience with Profit & Loss (P&L) management and department budgeting.
Excellent at coaching and developing people, building strong leaders and a deep bench of talent.
Able to lead without authority, influencing and aligning stakeholders across product, engineering, and the broader business.
A proven change agent who drives adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working.
Monetization and pricing experience, including pricing strategy.
Strong interpersonal skills with executive presence, and able to collaborate across all levels of the organization.
Flexible and adaptable approach to work and can effectively support product leaders and their staff through change management and with adjusting to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.
Travel
Travel for this position is required and anticipated to be approximately 10-20% of the time.
What makes working at OEC awesome? It varies from employee to employee. For some, it's the flexibility - whether it's remote work or a hybrid or in-person role, OEC takes our teams across multiple time zones and international communities. For others, it's the strong sense of camaraderie and community that celebrates both individuals and team-driven contributions. Or it could be the empowerment and how the team is encouraged to take risks, learn, and grow within a dynamic and supportive environment. But no matter what gets us out of bed in the morning, our whole global community is inspired to be forward thinking and drive innovative solutions for the automotive parts and repair industry.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.
You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.
Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.
DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).
Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.
