jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.
You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.

jobs.title: Director, Applications Engineering
jobs.text:
About Us
Founded in 2015 to develop the world’s first industrially scalable laser metal additive manufacturing solution, VulcanForms is reshaping how the world manufactures critical products. We build and operate advanced digital infrastructure that enables innovation, accelerates growth, and supports sustainability across aerospace, defense, medical, and other essential industries. Through our vertically integrated capabilities, including scalable additive manufacturing and precision machining, we deliver true end-to-end production at scale by combining cutting-edge technology with a foundation of proven industrial craftsmanship. Our team brings deep expertise in manufacturing, materials science, software, automation, and operations, united by a shared commitment to quality, curiosity, and accountability. We foster an inclusive culture where people take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and continuously learn, because we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes.
Job Purpose
The Director, Applications Engineering builds and leads the technical function that connects customer product requirements to VulcanForms' manufacturing capability. You will own how VulcanForms evaluates technical fit early in the sales cycle, scoping out opportunities before they reach our product development teams, and build trust and value-based technical relationships with key customers from first conversation through onboarding & product development. We are looking for a player/coach who will be a senior technical voice alongside sales while building a team of applications engineers and evolving how we deliver value to external and internal customers.
Key Responsibilities
Build, hire, and develop an Applications Engineering team, moving to vertical specialization as the portfolio matures.
Set team standards for feasibility assessment, concept design, and requirements documentation, and track metrics that show the function's impact
Own the technical qualification process of inbound opportunities, filtering out poor-fit parts and programs before they reach BU technical teams.
Produce or oversee first-cut design concepts and feasibility assessments that highlight risks, constraints, and tradeoffs early, with credibility and customers' trust.
Design and execute a process to capture “no-go” part data and technical capability requirements to support our product development process
Serve as the senior technical partner to Commercial leadership on proposals, strategic pursuits, and executive-level customer conversations.
Ensure customer requirements are fully captured and turned into documentation NPI and BU engineering teams can act on, so nothing is lost between customer intent and internal execution.
Qualifications
12+ years in applications engineering, sales engineering, or technical product roles in a manufacturing environment, including 3+ years leading technical customer-facing teams.
6+ years in additive manufacturing part engineering
Track record of building or scaling a technical sales function, including hiring, setting standards, and defining processes across functions.
Able to assess technical feasibility quickly and explain constraints and tradeoffs to technical, commercial, and executive audiences, both internally and with senior customer stakeholders.
Comfortable working as a player/coach, carrying key pursuits personally while developing a team.
Experience working with product or manufacturing cost structures and giving technical input to pricing decisions.
Strong written communication; able to set documentation standards a team can follow and engineering teams can build from.
A strong relationship-builder who is credible with sophisticated industrial buyers and trusted by internal engineering peers.
Preferred Qualifications
Adjacent metal manufacturing experience (precision machining, casting, forging) will be considered if additive-specific background isn't available. Metal vs. Polymer is preferred
Aerospace & Defense customer experience, including familiarity with qualification and certification requirements.
Experience in an engineered-to-order or highly customized manufacturing environment with long, technical sales cycles.
VulcanForms offers a competitive salary and equity package. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, VulcanForms provides comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; generous paid time off; and a 401(k) plan with company match.
The annual base salary range for this position is $203,980 to $280,470 and is eligible for additional variable compensation.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: IT Director, Payroll and Time & Attendance Technology
jobs.text:
IT Director, Payroll and Time & Attendance Technology – Remote
Remote, United States
Come build something that matters.
It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.
The Job:
As a IT Director, Payroll and Time & Attendance Technology, you’ll be part of our IT team working as a remote employee. You’ll get to:
Responsible partnering with HR & Payroll for the strategy, delivery, integration, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise platforms that enable payroll, workforce management, timekeeping, and attendance tracking across a global manufacturing organization. This role leads the technology capabilities supporting UKG Workforce Manager and ADP Payroll, and a breadth of technologies globally – ensuring reliable, compliant, and scalable operations for both hourly and salaried employee populations.
Partner closely with HR, Payroll, Operations, and external vendors to deliver solutions that support complex manufacturing environments. The role requires a strong blend of strategic leadership, operational discipline, systems integration expertise, and deep understanding of workforce management and payroll processes in a manufacturing setting.
Strategy and Leadership
Define and lead the technology roadmap for Payroll and Time & Attendance capabilities, aligned with enterprise HR, Payroll, and Global Supply Chain strategies – prioritizing initiatives that improve workforce productivity, compliance, and employee experience.
Serve as the senior IT leader for Payroll & Workforce Management solutions.
Lead and develop a team of IT professionals, including technical leads, analysts, architects, and support resources, across global and regional operations.
Establish governance, standards, and operating models for enhancements, releases, integrations, vendor management, and service delivery.
Delivery and Transformation
Oversee end-to-end delivery of lifecycle management of Payroll & Workforce Management capabilities, including implementations, upgrades, integrations, and process transformation initiatives.
Lead cross-functional efforts to improve time capture, attendance tracking, payroll accuracy, and workforce data flow across enterprise systems.
Ensure seamless integration between Workday, UKG, ADP, ERP, and connected systems, and reporting tools.
Drive standardization of global processes where appropriate while enabling plant-, country-, and region-specific requirements.
Manufacturing Operations Support
Ensure technology solutions effectively support manufacturing workforce needs.
Partner with operations and plant stakeholders to minimize payroll and timekeeping disruptions that could impact production or employee pay.
Support workforce processes that require high reliability during payroll close, shift changes, and period-end processing.
Operations and Service Management
Own production support and operational stability for payroll and time-related applications, with a strong focus on payroll-critical service windows.
Establish and monitor service levels, incident response, problem management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement practices.
Ensure timely resolution of issues affecting employee pay, time capture, attendance exceptions, interfaces, and downstream reporting.
Oversee system health, interface monitoring, batch processing, reconciliation processes, and data quality controls.
Compliance, Controls, and Risk Management
Ensure systems support compliance with wage and hour laws, payroll tax and reporting requirements, labor regulations, collective bargaining considerations, and data privacy obligations across relevant jurisdictions.
Maintain strong controls over payroll and employee data, including access management, segregation of duties, audit logging, change control, and data retention.
Partner with HR, Payroll, Legal, and Cybersecurity teams to support audits and strengthen control environments.
Identify and mitigate operational, technology, compliance, and vendor risks related to payroll and timekeeping systems.
Architecture and Continuous Improvement
Provide leadership on solution architecture and integration design across the HR, timekeeping, and payroll technology landscape.
Drive automation, simplification, and process harmonization across system workflows.
Improve reporting and analytics capabilities related to labor, attendance, payroll accuracy, and workforce trends.
Evaluate new capabilities from platform vendors and recommend enhancements that improve scalability, compliance, and user experience..
The Person:
You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field.
12+ years of experience in IT, with at least 8+ years of direct experience supporting and delivering Payroll, Time & Attendance, workforce management, and related HR technology capabilities.
5+ years of people management experience leading employees, including direct management analysts, architects, or application support professionals.
Demonstrated experience supporting manufacturing or industrial operations with large hourly employee populations.
Hands-on leadership experience with UKG Workforce Manager and ADP Payroll platforms.
Strong understanding of integrations across HCM, timekeeping, payroll, ERP, identity, and reporting ecosystems.

jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering
jobs.text:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
About the role
Every board number, retail report, and marketing decision at Grüns runs through our data platform. As Director of Data Engineering, you will own that platform and lead the team that builds it. We moved fast to get here, and now we're building the foundation for an enterprise-level data function: cleaner models, less tech debt, and numbers everyone trusts.
This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.
In this role, you will:
Own the data roadmap and company data model, with a single source of truth for core business data
Refactor legacy jobs and tech debt so the platform scales with the business
Keep pipelines resilient so data stays available, accurate, and trusted across the company
Manage warehouse and infrastructure cost as data volume grows
Run our intake process and sprint cadence, prioritizing requests by business impact and staying flexible when priorities shift
Lead and coach a small team through code reviews, feedback, and clear growth paths, and get hands-on when the work needs it
Connect new enterprise systems, such as ERP, into the warehouse
Make the team AI-native, using AI agents for development, incident investigation, and data quality
We're looking for someone who:
Has 8+ years in data architecture or data engineering, including 3+ years leading teams
Has built and scaled cloud data platforms (BigQuery or similar)
Is strong in SQL, Python, and dbt or a similar modeling framework
Has deep data modeling experience and starts from business concepts before tables
Has built data quality, governance, and monitoring practices that teams trust
Has run sprint-based intake and prioritization for a team serving many stakeholders
Is comfortable with ELT tools like Fivetran, Orbitrail and enterprise systems (ERP experience is a plus)
Comes from DTC or CPG (preferred)
Approach to the role:
Starts with the business question, then picks the simplest technology that answers it
Gets fundamentals right first: integrity, governance, observability
Treats a trust problem in the data as urgent
Prioritizes ruthlessly against their own time and everyone else's
Stays in the weeds when needed while leading the team
Coaches engineers to grow into senior contributors and managers
Uses AI agents daily and teaches the team to do the same
Compensation & Benefits:
At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $200,000 plus bonus + incentive compensation depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.
A bit about us...
At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.
Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.
So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.
What we care about...
Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.
Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.
Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.
Compensation & Perks:
For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.
Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Privacy & Data Governance Director
jobs.text:
Company Overview
One Park Financial (OPF) is a leading Financial Technology company dedicated to empowering small businesses by connecting them with flexible financing and funding options. Our mission is to provide entrepreneurs with the working capital they need to elevate their businesses. At OPF, we believe in working with high-performing individuals who are ready to play an integral part in our company's expansion — because our success hinges on our people.
Why Join Us?
At OPF, we foster a dynamic and inclusive company culture that emphasizes collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. Our team is composed of passionate, driven individuals who are committed to making a difference. Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:
Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge technology and be part of a team that is constantly pushing the boundaries of fintech.
Professional Growth: We invest in our employees’ growth with continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and career advancement paths.
Supportive Culture: Enjoy a supportive and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your contributions make a real impact.
Community Focus: Be part of a company that understands the importance of small and mid-sized businesses to their communities and the nation’s financial health.
High-Performing Team: Join a team of badasses who are committed to excellence and are integral to our company's expansion and success.
About the Role
As our data, systems, and partner relationships grow, we're in need of a Privacy & Data Governance Director to strengthen and run our privacy and data governance program.
This person will turn written policy into enhanced controls that actually operate across our platforms, including Salesforce, AWS, and other collaboration tools. They'll set the rules for how we classify, retain, anonymize, and delete data. They'll also set guardrails for new data risks, including AI tools. The role will work closely with Legal, Risk, Operations, Engineering, and IT/Security.
Responsibilities
Own the data classification policy and establish governance over the inventory of confidential and restricted data across systems, vendors, and data flows.
Maintain privacy policies, procedures, and standards that match applicable law, partner requirements, and our own risk appetite.
Run privacy impact assessments for new products, systems, vendors, and major changes.
Support successful completion of SOC 2 audits.
Assist with third-party reviews to ensure proper alignment with privacy and data governance requirements.
Lead the retention program, including retention schedules, legal holds, and secure disposal and media sanitization.
Partner with Engineering to specify retention and deletion controls inside production systems, and confirm they work as designed.
Write and maintain governance standards for generative AI tools, covering acceptable use, what data may go into prompts, and vendor review.
Help set requirements for data loss prevention (DLP) and data discovery tools.
Test privacy and data controls in key systems.
Track gaps and remediation and report status and risk trends to senior leadership.
Serve as the privacy point of contact for audits, bank partner reviews, and regulatory exams.
Assist in building privacy and data-handling training for employees and new hires.

jobs.text:
Are you passionate about building cloud infrastructure that powers millions of customers? Do you enjoy leading high-performing engineering organizations that design and operate mission-critical distributed systems at massive scale? Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the strategy, development, and operations of our Tier-0 Virtual Networking and Identity services.

jobs.title: Vice President, Health Information and Technology
jobs.text:
Texas Health Action (THA) is a community-informed non-profit organization dedicated to providing access to culturally affirming, quality health services in a safe and supportive environment, with expertise in serving LGBTQIA+ people and those impacted by HIV. Kind Clinic proudly serves Texas with four vibrant locations: two in Austin, one in San Antonio, and another in Dallas plus virtual care services available to all residents across Texas. Bolstered by Waterloo Counseling Center and a passionate team of over 250 dedicated employees and volunteers, THA is at the forefront of promoting healthcare equity and accessibility throughout the state. Read more about THA here: http://texashealthaction.org.
The Vice President, Health Information & Technology provides senior level leadership for the organization’s Information Technology (IT) and Health Information Management (HIM) functions, including clinical applications, data systems, interoperability, security, and information/data governance. This role is responsible for the technology and information system infrastructure of the organization and its future direction.
This role serves as a strategic partner to the CEO, translating organizational goals into a cohesive technology and data strategy and ensuring disciplined execution across infrastructure, clinical systems, analytics, and compliance. The VP is accountable for aligning technology investments with patient care and experience, operational excellence, regulatory requirements, and long-term organizational growth.
Core Functions
Senior Leadership & Strategy
Serve as the senior most leader for IT, clinical applications, data, and information management and security functions.
Partner with the CEO and executive team to develop and maintain a multi-year technology and data strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
Translate organization strategy into clear roadmaps, budgets, and operational plans for technology and information systems.
Advise executive leadership on emerging technology, digital health trends, and data capabilities relevant to healthcare delivery.
Develop budgets in collaboration with IT and HIM leaders, advise on technology investments to support technology and information system strategy and organization growth.
Ensure the security, reliability, capability, and scalability of our information systems and technology to execute our mission.
Technology & Infrastructure Oversight
Oversee all IT operations including:
Network and infrastructure
End-user systems and support
Vendor and contract management
Cybersecurity and risk management
Ensure technology platforms are scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-effective.
Clinical Applications & Health Information Management
Provide senior level oversight for:
Electronic Health Record (EHR) and other clinical systems
Practice management and revenue cycle technologies
Telehealth platforms
Clinical workflows and optimization
Partner with clinical and operational leaders to ensure systems support high-quality, patient-centered care.
Oversee health information governance, including data quality, documentation standards, and lifecycle management.
Data, Analytics & Reporting
Lead development of enterprise data capabilities, including:
Reporting and dashboards
Quality, outcomes, and compliance reporting
Population health and performance analytics
Ensure data is accurate, accessible, secure, and actionable for leadership, clinical teams, and external reporting.
Compliance, Security & Risk
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITECH, state and federal reporting requirements).
Oversee cybersecurity strategy, incident response planning, and privacy safeguards.
Collaborate with compliance and legal functions on audits and risk mitigation.
Serve as the organization’s security officer
Team Leadership & Culture
Directly manage IT and HIM leaders and build a high-performing, mission-aligned team.
Clarify roles, expectations, and accountability across technical and clinical application teams.
Foster collaboration between technology staff and teams of various departments across the organization.
Compensation
Based on the position’s duties and requirements, this role has a starting annual salary of $147,721.60. The initial salary will be determined by the selected candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
First Circle is an SME credit-centric, multi-product NeoBank in SE Asia which is fast-growing (>100%), profitable, and internationalising soon.
We started life as an SME lender in the Philippines in 2016 to solve the SME credit gap by using technology to systemise underwriting, deliver exceptional UX, and automate away delivery costs. We’ve delivered our clients the fastest, cheapest, most flexible credit line available to businesses anywhere in Southeast Asia. We’ve been rewarded with both fast growth and exceptional unit economics, a rare combination in our space.
Over the past two years we’ve expanded our product range to include business bank accounts & payments, e-Invoices, corporate credit cards, rooftop solar, and most recently deposits catalysed by securing a full bank charter in the Philippines. In 2027, we’ll expand our geographical coverage to include at least two new markets in APAC.
Our excellent track record results from our people & culture. We combine high standards & intensity with a collegiate environment. Our barometers of success are the rate of personal growth of our people, how long high performers choose to stay, and ensuring we raise the bar with every hire.
Stage:
Profitable
150% YoY growth
$25-50m revenue
Responsibilities
As VP of Engineering, you will be the most senior technical leader in the business, reporting directly to the CEO. You will own engineering output end-to-end: from system design and domain architecture to delivery velocity, team culture, and the platform decisions that define the next chapters of our journey.
This isn't a role for a detached executive. We are looking for a technically excellent leader who stays hands-on with the hardest problems and raises the bar on engineering quality. You'll build the organisation that makes us the leading SME neobank in Southeast Asia.
What you'll own
Team and hiring. Scale engineering from 25+ to 100+, including org design, hiring bar, career paths and performance frameworks. Hire and develop strong engineering leaders.
Architecture. Set domain boundaries, data modelling standards and integration patterns across our microservices. Lead design decisions on ledgers, transaction state, reconciliation and authorisation.
Delivery. Improve velocity and quality, measured by DORA metrics, and balance feature work against technical debt. Co-own the technical roadmap with Product.
Regulation and security. Own the technical side of regulatory and licensing requirements across our markets, including technology risk, outsourcing and data rules, as well as PCI-DSS.
Platform and data. Own our Azure platform, cloud cost, data infrastructure and our AI-assisted engineering strategy.
External relationships. Hold the technical relationship with key partners, such as issuer processors and core banking providers. Represent engineering to the board, investors and regulators.

jobs.title: Director of Data and AI
jobs.text:
"Transform data into commercial value and shape the future of AI at Castle Trust Bank."
At Castle Trust Bank, we pride ourselves on being a fintech challenger bank, providing specialist property mortgages, retail finance lending and savings accounts to a wide range of customers.
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Data & AI to define and deliver the Bank's data and AI strategy, helping turn data into a trusted business asset while enabling the responsible adoption of AI across the organisation.
This role is based in Basingstoke, with some travel to London, on a hybrid basis with 3 days in the office and 2 days at home.
The role and what you'll lead and deliver
Reporting to the Chief Technology & Operations Officer, you will lead the Bank's data and AI agenda, working closely with Executive and Board stakeholders to support growth, innovation and better customer outcomes.
Data & AI Leadership
Define and deliver the Bank's Data & AI strategy aligned to business growth plans.
Lead the development of data platforms, architecture, governance and analytics capabilities.
Drive the adoption of AI across the organisation, delivering measurable business value.
Establish robust governance to ensure data and AI are used responsibly within a regulated environment.
Provide strategic insight and management information to support decision-making across the Bank.
Lead and develop a high-performing data function, spanning data engineering, governance, business intelligence and analytics.
What you'll bring
Essential
Significant leadership experience in Data, Analytics or AI within financial services or a similarly regulated environment.
Proven experience delivering data strategy, data platform modernisation and analytics capabilities.
Strong understanding of data governance, AI governance and regulatory expectations.
Ability to translate technical capability into clear commercial outcomes.
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills at Executive and Board level.
Strong leadership capability with experience building and developing teams.
Why join Castle Trust Bank?
As well as taking on a high-profile leadership role, you'll have the opportunity to shape how data and AI support the Bank's future growth, influence strategic investment decisions and play a key role in our ongoing technology transformation.
In addition, you will receive:
Competitive salary
Annual performance bonus (up to 25% of base salary, based on individual and company performance)
Generous contributory pension through Hargreaves Lansdown
Life Assurance
28 days' holiday + option to buy/sell (up to maximum of 30 days' per year)
Additional paid volunteering day
Private healthcare through BUPA
Free access to BHSF Rise EAP to support colleague health and wellbeing
Gym discounts
Season ticket travel loans (if applicable)
A supportive, inclusive culture where your work has real impact
Caught your attention?
If so, we'd love to talk to you and tell you more about what it's like to work at Castle Trust Bank - The Place To Work!

jobs.title: VP, Product Engineering
jobs.text:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
We are in search of a VP of Engineering for our Channels division, the action layer of the Braze technology platform. Our channels are where the Braze platform meets the end user, where our customers create rich messaging that is delivered to their end users via our channels: Email, Push, SMS/MMS/RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, In-App Messages, Content Cards, Banners, Landing Pages, Feature Flags, Webhooks, and more to come.
You will lead this multi-team division through its next stage of technical and product transformation. This role presents formidable engineering challenges that call for a collaborative and cross-functional approach, necessitating close coordination with product and design teams. You will manage the team and help to grow the organization, leading software engineering via architecture design, growing engineering teams and skillsets, setting vision and goals, process and protocol, and hiring. On the product front - you will solve a number of interesting problems, from developing highly differentiated and sophisticated channel products, to thinking about how we build and position the broad portfolio of channels. On the engineering front - maturation of our systems into a more modular, efficient technology platform, all while delivering best-in-class product, is a major goal. And across both fronts, you will lead this organization through the AI transition: channel products that are increasingly intelligent and agentic, and an engineering org that leverages AI-assisted development to raise its own velocity and quality bar.
WHO YOU ARE
Several years of relevant experience as a manager of experienced managers with a strong track record of transformative success
A durable, motivated, ambitious, high-energy leader
A great people leader, capable of growing a world class team
A great technical leader, who can operate at different levels of granularity, from high level vision to partnering on detailed technology decisions
Deep credibility in large-scale distributed systems, with the ability to go toe-to-toe with senior engineers on architecture, reliability, and cost efficiency
Fluent in AI-assisted engineering, with an informed point of view on how AI agents and tooling change the way engineering organizations build, operate, and are shaped
A great process leader, who understands when to add and remove processes to help the org execute the best it can
An excellent communicator and writer, whose impact and leadership is obvious in the artifacts they create to guide their team
For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $284,762 and $480,536/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $320,000 and $540,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.
WHAT WE OFFER
Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.
From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:
Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®
ABOUT BRAZE
Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.
Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.
BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you
OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS
At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:
To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com.
Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.
Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)
Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.
To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here.
Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

items: Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

blocks.text: ABOUT BRAZE

Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Foundations
jobs.text:
About Atria:
The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.
Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.
After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026.
About this role:
Atria is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Foundations group — the Platform, DevOps, and Data Engineering teams that the rest of the engineering organization is built on. Foundations exists to accelerate overall engineering throughput via the shared services, infrastructure, and data systems that let product teams ship for members and clinicians without reinventing authentication, caching, EMR data sync, pipelines, or deployments every time. You will own the technical strategy and roadmap across all three teams and be accountable for reliability, security, and delivery across the systems Foundations owns. This role directly manages the 12 member Foundations team, including 3 Tech Leads
Key Responsibilities
Ownership & Execution:
Own the health, technical direction, and output of the Foundations group (Platform, DevOps, and Data Engineering), including the shared services, infrastructure, and data systems the rest of engineering depends on.
Maintain end-to-end accountability for complex, multi-team Foundations initiatives from concept through deployment: EMR integrations, the MySQL-to-Postgres migration, background jobs, feature flags, and data platform enhancements.
Own the reliability, security, and operational health of platform, data, and cloud infrastructure, including SLOs, capacity planning, on-call rotation management, alerting, and incident response governance.
Drive initiatives from definition through delivery, maintaining accountability for outcomes.
Identify problems proactively and propose solutions without waiting to be asked.
Collaboration & Communication:
Serve as the primary escalation and request path into Foundations for the rest of the organization.
Partner proactively with Product Engineering and Data & Analytics leadership to anticipate infrastructure needs early and build scalable solutions ahead of demand.
Work cross-functionally with product, data, clinical, security, and executive stakeholders to deliver.
Communicate early when blocked, working with colleagues to unblock the team.
Drive and contribute to a culture of direct, constructive feedback.
Craft & Quality:
Own architectural direction across integration patterns, caching infrastructure, shared services, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure to ensure consistency and reuse across teams.
Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges, maintaining rigorous design standards for reliability, performance, and security through architecture and design reviews.
Champion AI-assisted engineering workflows across Foundations; establishing the patterns, tooling, and guardrails that let teams use AI to accelerate delivery safely and consistently.
Hold a high bar for the work: simple, maintainable, and built to last.
Use AI tools actively to amplify output and accelerate delivery, and teach others how to do so.
Continuous Improvement
Establish and promote engineering standards across the group, including architectural patterns, code conventions, and documentation best practices.
Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development across Foundations, mentoring engineers and Tech Leads to a rising bar.
Champion observability and telemetry standards (Datadog, Sentry, Mixpanel), and drive post-incident reviews and systemic improvements when things break.
Create structures to enable the team to easily measure what we build.
Share learnings, workflows, and effective patterns with the team and promote them sharing with one another.
Raise the standard of the work over time.
Compensation: $230,000 - $290,000

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.
You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: VP Product Interoperability
jobs.text:
Overview
As VP Product, Interoperability, you will own and execute Cotiviti’s market strategy, product roadmap and commercial growth for health plan interoperability — extending our leading industry position and expanding our impact into broader payer / provider collaboration. You will bring unique insight into payer priorities, challenges, and blind spots; prioritize market needs; run competitive analysis; engage experts within and outside our organization; and lead product launches that expand our client value proposition and advance Cotiviti’s market position. Hands-on knowledge of payer administrative processes and payer / provider interoperability is essential, along with a genuine passion for solving hard problems and improving the healthcare system.
Reporting to the SVP of Product, you will have full ownership and accountability for product vision, definition, packaging, and market success across Cotiviti’s interoperability platform and commercial solutions. You will lead a matrixed, multi-level team, prioritizing and enhancing our existing solutions while delivering next-generation payer / provider collaboration solutions. You will bridge product vision, operational design, and commercial success — defining Cotiviti’s approach across the product lines you support. You will advocate and solution to ensure that all Cotiviti’s product offerings are FHIR native and leveraging our Interoperability Platform[CC1.1].
Cotiviti is evolving our market approach to become the utility layer for healthcare—reducing friction and significantly improving coordination across the system. In this role, you will play a key role in defining and executing Cotiviti’s expanded vision and improving healthcare. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a leader who combines deep product and market domain expertise, healthcare knowledge, business acumen, creativity, sound business judgment, and sharp analytical thinking.
Responsibilities
You will lead a cross-sectional, matrixed team, driving a customer- and sales-focused approach to building and launching new products, capabilities, and offerings into the marketplace. Here’s what you’ll own:
Vision
Leverage deep subject matter expertise to provide input into Cotiviti’s strategic plan across business units.
Collaborate with executive leadership to develop targets for annual bookings, revenue, expenses, and client satisfaction.
Serve as a voice of the customer in new product management and development.
Strategic & Product Leadership
Develop multi-year roadmaps that provide deep insight into how we can become integral to the payer/provider collaboration journey, from provider workflows through post-adjudication.
Provide executive leadership for Cotiviti’s interoperability business, including product strategy, market strategy, operational strategy, revenue growth, client outcomes, and long-term business expansion.
Develop and influence corporate strategy related to interoperability, provider connectivity, healthcare data exchange, and payer-provider collaboration.
Serve as Cotiviti’s executive representative with key clients, strategic partners, regulators, industry consortiums, and market influencers.
Operational & Technical Leadership
Provide unique insight into the internal mechanics and challenges of payer platforms, processes, and administrative inefficiency, as well as payer/provider interoperability.
Process Improvement
Drive process re-engineering efforts leveraging AI and emerging technologies to drive transformative changes and improve the system.
Financial & Risk
Provide knowledge of how payers identify and eliminate administrative waste in claims processing, prior authorization, and other core operational processes through advanced data analytics tools, including areas of strength and gaps.
Leverage expertise in how payers currently perceive and manage costs with siloed or competitive approaches.

jobs.title: Vice President – Data Governance
jobs.text:
We are seeking a seasoned leader to drive our enterprise-wide Data Governance strategy and implementation. This role will establish robust governance frameworks, ensure data quality and compliance, and foster a data-driven culture across the organization.
Responsibilities
Lead adoption of the Data Governance Framework, policies, and standards.
Drive initiatives to improve data quality, consistency, security, and compliance.
Facilitate Data Governance Committee meetings and provide oversight to senior leadership.
Define enterprise-wide data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models.
Oversee metadata management, business glossary, data lineage, and lifecycle management.
Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Technology, and business teams to embed governance controls.
Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and internal standards.
Champion governance awareness, training, and onboarding programs.
Monitor KPIs and report governance performance to senior management.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Management, or related field (Master's preferred).
10+ years in Data Governance/Data Management, with 5+ years in leadership.
Strong knowledge of governance frameworks, metadata, lineage, and master data management.
Experience with tools such as Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, or Alation.
Background in banking/financial services regulations is highly desirable.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills.
Certifications such as CDMP, DAMA, DCAM, or COBIT.
Experience in digital transformation or enterprise data modernization.
Knowledge of data privacy and risk governance in financial services.

jobs.text:
Overview
Director, Product Management for value-based payments is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing, developing, and executing the product strategy for the business. This role typically involves a combination of strategic thinking, team leadership, and hands-on involvement in product development and lifecycle management.
In this role, using subject matter expertise and market insights, you will support the current solution/product offerings and will be instrumental in guiding the development of new product offerings, delivering value with existing customers, and driving revenue opportunities. You will work with current clients as well as sales prospects to advance product innovation and growth in value-based care contracting and performance with payers and providers. The successful candidate will have experience working with or in a health plan, devising and implementing various value-based care contracting models with providers.
You will be leading a team of product managers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support and collaborate with cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, sales personnel, and customer managers to ensure effective solution design, development, and delivery. This role will be responsible for collaborating with sales and marketing to enable effective product commercialization.
Overall, the Director of Product Management plays a crucial role in shaping the direction of a company's products, ensuring they align with market needs and contribute to the overall success of the business.
Responsibilities
Product Strategy: Developing and articulating a clear product strategy aligned with the overall business goals. This involves understanding market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes. Working with corporate marketing to assess competition and lead product roadmaps and launch to provid3differentiated value in the market.
Team Leadership: Managing and leading a team of product managers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support. Ensuring that the team is motivated, aligned with company objectives, and delivering on product roadmaps.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborating with other departments such as engineering, marketing, sales, and customer support to ensure a unified approach to product development and delivery. Effective communication and alignment across these functions are critical. Utilize AI tools effectively to accelerate innovation via collaboration.
Roadmap Planning: Creating and managing product roadmaps that align with the company's strategic objectives. Prioritizing features and enhancements based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
Market Analysis: Staying informed about market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies. Conducting market research to identify opportunities and threats, and using this information to inform product decisions.
Financial Management: Managing the financial aspects of the product management function, including budgeting, resource allocation, and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure product success.
Product Development: Providing oversight and guidance throughout the product development lifecycle. Using AI tools to enable product discovery, prototyping, and accelerated development in an AIDLC. Ensuring that products are delivered on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
Customer Focus: Advocating for the customer and ensuring that products meet or exceed customer expectations. Gathering customer feedback and using it to drive product improvements.
Innovation: Encouraging a culture of innovation within the product team. Exploring new ideas and technologies that can contribute to the company's competitive advantage.
Risk Management: Identifying and mitigating risks related to product development and launch. Proactively addressing challenges and adjusting strategies as needed.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Utilize AI for product development.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation. Required This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (business, engineering, computer science, etc.).
10+ years of experience in product management or related roles.
5+ years experience working in a health plan environment devising and contracting value-based care contracting models.
Experience in leadership and managerial positions, preferably as a Senior Product Manager or similar.
Proven track record of successfully bringing products to market.
Ability to use AI tools effectively in an AI development life cycle for product concept, development, and launch.
Strong understanding of product development processes, including ideation, design, development, testing, and launch.
Ability to think strategically and align product initiatives with overall business objectives.
Understanding of AI applications in healthcare.
Experience in developing and executing product strategies that drive business growth.
Demonstrated leadership skills with experience managing and developing high-performing teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas to different stakeholders.
Strong presentation skills for both internal and external audiences.
Deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to advocate for the customer in product decision-making.
Understanding of how product decisions impact the financial performance of the business.
Experience identifying and mitigating risks associated with product development and launch.

Communicating with others to exchange information.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Critical thinker and problem solver with strong analytic modeling and technical skills.
Physical Requirements and Working Conditions
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
No adverse environmental conditions expected.
Base compensation ranges from $165,000 to $215,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration
