jobs.title: Associate Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
Office location: Cambridgeshire, UK – This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or be willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.
Are you an experienced data scientist who loves building models that make a real impact, and is ready to lead and grow a talented team?
As Associate Director of Data Science at Jagex, you'll lead a team of data scientists, setting their direction and supporting their development, while continuing to build and own models yourself. Working closely with senior stakeholders across Player Support, Marketing, Analytics, and our Game Teams, you'll develop the algorithms and models that power our business and help shape the experience of millions of RuneScape players.
This is an exciting opportunity to combine hands-on delivery with team leadership, owning our MLOps practice and making sure the models we build are deployed, monitored, and maintained reliably once they're live.
What you'll be doing:
Lead a team of data scientists, setting direction, managing workload, and supporting their growth and development.
Build and own data science models that support teams across the business.
Lead the exploration of new business areas and data science models that can be embedded within the business, drawing on both industry developments and internal use cases.
Own the team's MLOps practice, including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retraining pipelines, working closely with Data Engineering.
Lead the delivery of data science initiatives from ideation through to production.
Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Player Support, Marketing, Analytics, and the Game Teams on all things data science.
Coach and mentor data scientists on both technical delivery and stakeholder management.
Stay current with the latest data science and MLOps tooling and practice, bringing that knowledge into the team.
What we're looking for:
Significant experience applying data science to complex commercial, product, or player-facing problems.
Strong practical knowledge of statistical methods, predictive modelling, and machine learning, including evaluating model performance.
Hands-on experience with MLOps in a production environment, including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retraining.
Experience leading or mentoring data scientists, with evidence of coaching and workload management.
A track record of taking analytical or modelling work from exploration through to live, adopted use.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with senior, non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical work into plain language for business audiences.
What we offer:
When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including:
Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
Employee Assistance Programme & onsite Counselling.
Life Insurance.
Discretionary annual performance bonus.
Enhanced family leave policies from day 1.
Flexible working hours.
25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more!
Inclusion & Accessibility Statement
We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.
If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you’re invited to interview.
About Jagex:
We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company- home to one of gaming’s most enduring success stories. We create deep, community-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years.
As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025 representing a major step in building a multi-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape’s history. For more information, visit www.jagex.com.
Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, We are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission- to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We’re looking for people to join us who share our ambitions & values - We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences which inspire our communities. Our values guide everything we do: We Embrace Fellowship by collaborating and sharing openly. We Hone our Craft by always learning and improving; We Honour our Vows by being honest and transparent; We are our Customers’ Heroes by striving to understand our team & player needs, and We Seize The Day by making the most of every opportunity.
Join us. The next era of RuneScape - and the next chapter of Jagex: The RuneScape Company - starts now.
We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.
If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you’re invited to interview.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Analytics — Insurance & Investments
jobs.text:
Job Summary
The Head of Data & Analytics leads the organization's enterprise data, analytics, and business intelligence function, turning complex data into actionable insights for strategic, operational, financial, risk, customer, and investment decisions.
Within Insurance & Investments, the role typically covers analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer behavior, fraud, risk, portfolio/investment performance, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute the enterprise Data & Analytics strategy and roadmap.
Lead data governance, data management, data quality, and data stewardship.
Establish enterprise-wide analytics standards, frameworks, and KPIs.
Lead Business Intelligence (BI), advanced analytics, predictive analytics, and data science.
Develop dashboards, management reporting, executive insights, and decision-support tools.
Support insurance analytics covering:
Underwriting
Claims
Pricing

Loss/risk analysis
Support investment and asset-management analytics covering:
Portfolio performance
Investment risk

jobs.title: Co-founder & CTO, AI for predictable drug discovery and development
jobs.text:
We're building AI to predict clinical trial and drug development outcomes, and quantify how much confidence those predictions deserve.
We're looking for a technical co-founder to join our biology and commercial founders. As Co-founder & CTO you take a built, already-used platform and lead its development, the research programme that measures and improves its predictions, and the first technical team. The aim is to spin the company out of DSV over the coming months.
THE OPPORTUNITY
Drug development involves decisions about targets, treatment approaches, delivery and patient populations. Each decision depends on evidence that may not transfer well to the setting that matters: treating people. A treatment working in mice, for example, does not tell us how much confidence to place in its chances in humans.
Around nine in ten drugs entering clinical trials never reach approval. The causes run from efficacy to safety to commercial choice, and the claim here is narrower than blaming that number on translation: the field still lacks a systematic way to measure how far a given experimental result should carry into a specific therapeutic decision.
We want to measure how reliably different kinds of biological evidence predict human outcomes. Our approach is to link the evidence available when a decision was made, the judgement made from it, and what happened next. Those records become the data from which we can learn which evidence predicts which outcomes, and under what conditions. That is difficult to test. Outcomes can take years to arrive, suitable labels are often missing, and a failed trial does not necessarily reveal which earlier assumption was wrong.
The platform is already running. It has produced a scientific result through work with the Allen Institute, described in a public preprint. You can also see the engine run.
There is no established dataset or method that settles the measurement question. Defining what to measure, building reliable evaluations and choosing appropriate methods are central to the role, and the next funding round will fund that programme.
Clinical trial outcome prediction is a central test: predicting a specific trial outcome and explaining the biological reasons, using evidence available before the result. An LLM may already know a historical outcome, so retrospective tests need safeguards against contamination as well as confirmation on prospective cases. This article sets out our approach.
The aim is to make therapeutic development more predictable, and use those predictions to change which treatments get developed and how.
Read more in our thesis.
THE ROLE
This is a deeply hands-on role. The founding team covers biology and commercial development. You will be responsible for the technology and the research needed to evaluate it. There is no engineering team yet: you will be building the system yourself and should expect to remain hands-on for at least the first year. You will:
Develop the platform. Take ownership of the existing system, set technical priorities and implement improvements.
Build the measurement programme. Define the prediction tasks, link evidence available at decision time to subsequent outcomes, and develop and compare modelling approaches. Test predictive performance and calibration, and identify where the system is reliable and where it is not.
Prevent misleading evaluations. Address leakage, label quality and contamination. Retrospective tests need particular care when an LLM may have encountered the outcome during training. We explain the issue in this article.
Hire the first technical team once funding is in place.
Support fundraising. Explain the technical approach, evidence, limitations and development plan to investors.
The modelling approach is open. You will choose methods based on the problem and the available data, whether those involve Bayesian or hierarchical inference, graph learning, calibration, classical statistics or a combination.
Location: Flexible, UK-based preferred · Commitment: Full-time from spin-out · Equity: Founder equity, with technical authority from day one.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We're building an AI company that works on drug development, not a drug company that uses AI. The hard part is measuring what the evidence justifies, and biology is where we point that. So the depth we're searching for is in AI and statistics.
You have led a team or a substantial technical programme at Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta AI or a comparable frontier AI lab. Your own work is recognised, and your name opens doors with investors and people we want to hire. That credibility is part of why this role exists. You remain hands-on and will build the platform yourself.
You might know very little biology, and that's okay. The science is held by the founding team. What we look for is real curiosity about the biology and the drive to learn it quickly from the people who already know it.
You will be building the platform yourself. With the rest of the founding team you set what it is for and where it goes, and then you make it work.
These are essential:
You bring a recognised technical track record from a frontier AI lab and remain hands-on.
You hold your own in a room of researchers and a room of investors.
You lead from the front. This is a founding seat, not a board seat and not an advisory one.
You can go full-time from the spin-out.
HOW TO APPLY
Send a CV and a short note. In the note, tell us what you would measure first, and what you think we've got wrong about the mission above. Include links to work you have built or published. No separate cover letter is required.
One request, and we ask it of everyone. If your application reports a result (an accuracy, an improvement, a benchmark number), be precise about three things: what the baseline was, how the data was split, and how wide the interval around it is. A figure on its own tells us nothing.
If a founding seat isn't the right fit but the problem pulls at you, we're also open to advisory roles; say so in your note.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We are on the lookout for a Director of Software Engineering to lead our Elasticsearch Distributed Systems organisation which focuses on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering.
As Director of Software Engineering, you will be leading an organisation of approximately 40 engineers and managers to tackle the deep distributed systems challenges that allow Elasticsearch to excel at scale. Your customers are every Elasticsearch user and each solution team which builds upon Elasticsearch.
Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. We collaborate every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.
What You Will Be Doing
Develop and execute a long-term engineering strategy for Elasticsearch's distributed systems, aligning technical priorities with product direction and business objectives.
Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency, including foundational capabilities supporting Serverless Elasticsearch.
Lead the evolution of Elasticsearch's core distributed architecture, including cluster coordination, data allocation, indexing, replication and recovery.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for complex engineering initiatives and programs, helping engineering managers and technical leaders navigate architectural decisions and competing priorities.
Own engineering outcomes across your organisation, balancing technical complexity, customer impact, reliability, operational requirements and long-term maintainability.
Lead, mentor, hire and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, establishing high performance standards and building a strong pipeline of future leaders, fostering an inclusive culture of collaboration and technical excellence.
Take ownership of organisational planning, staffing and resource allocation, ensuring teams have the capabilities and support needed to deliver on strategic priorities.
Partner with Product Management, engineering leaders and other teams across Elastic to define priorities and deliver complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering organisations.
Act as a senior escalation point for critical technical and operational challenges, working closely with engineering, Support and SRE teams to drive effective resolution.
Communicate engineering strategy, organisational priorities and progress to senior executives, influencing decisions that have a significant impact on Elastic and its customers.
Run performance management with consistency (promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution) and working with your managers to do the same.
What You Bring
A proven track record of leading large-scale engineering organisations, including experience managing engineering managers and developing senior technical leaders.
Previous hands-on software engineering experience, with strong computer science fundamentals and substantial technical depth in distributed systems.
Extensive experience designing, building or operating complex, large-scale distributed systems, ideally involving database engines, distributed storage or large-scale data processing.
Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency, consistency, replication, fault tolerance, recovery and performance optimisation.
Experience establishing engineering strategy, making architectural trade-offs and delivering complex initiatives involving multiple teams and significant technical dependencies.
A track record of building effective engineering organisations, including organisational planning, senior-level hiring, performance management and leadership development.
Strong operational experience, with a deep understanding of system reliability, production troubleshooting and the challenges of operating distributed systems at scale.
Experience partnering with senior engineering and product leaders to establish strategic priorities, allocate resources and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
The ability to navigate complex organisational challenges, influence senior stakeholders and make informed decisions in situations with significant technical or business consequences.
A compassionate approach to leadership, with a genuine commitment to coaching, developing and supporting the people you work with.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting technical strategy and organisational priorities to senior executives.

blocks.text: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role

We are on the lookout for a Director of Software Engineering to lead our Elasticsearch Distributed Systems organisation which focuses on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering.

As Director of Software Engineering, you will be leading an organisation of approximately 40 engineers and managers to tackle the deep distributed systems challenges that allow Elasticsearch to excel at scale. Your customers are every Elasticsearch user and each solution team which builds upon Elasticsearch.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. We collaborate every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.
What You Will Be Doing

items: Develop and execute a long-term engineering strategy for Elasticsearch's distributed systems, aligning technical priorities with product direction and business objectives.
Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency, including foundational capabilities supporting Serverless Elasticsearch.
Lead the evolution of Elasticsearch's core distributed architecture, including cluster coordination, data allocation, indexing, replication and recovery.

Provide technical leadership and oversight for complex engineering initiatives and programs, helping engineering managers and technical leaders navigate architectural decisions and competing priorities.
Own engineering outcomes across your organisation, balancing technical complexity, customer impact, reliability, operational requirements and long-term maintainability.

Lead, mentor, hire and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, establishing high performance standards and building a strong pipeline of future leaders, fostering an inclusive culture of collaboration and technical excellence.
Take ownership of organisational planning, staffing and resource allocation, ensuring teams have the capabilities and support needed to deliver on strategic priorities.
Partner with Product Management, engineering leaders and other teams across Elastic to define priorities and deliver complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering organisations.
Act as a senior escalation point for critical technical and operational challenges, working closely with engineering, Support and SRE teams to drive effective resolution.
Communicate engineering strategy, organisational priorities and progress to senior executives, influencing decisions that have a significant impact on Elastic and its customers.
Run performance management with consistency (promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution) and working with your managers to do the same.

blocks.text: What You Bring

items: A proven track record of leading large-scale engineering organisations, including experience managing engineering managers and developing senior technical leaders.
Previous hands-on software engineering experience, with strong computer science fundamentals and substantial technical depth in distributed systems.
Extensive experience designing, building or operating complex, large-scale distributed systems, ideally involving database engines, distributed storage or large-scale data processing.
Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency, consistency, replication, fault tolerance, recovery and performance optimisation.
Experience establishing engineering strategy, making architectural trade-offs and delivering complex initiatives involving multiple teams and significant technical dependencies.
A track record of building effective engineering organisations, including organisational planning, senior-level hiring, performance management and leadership development.
Strong operational experience, with a deep understanding of system reliability, production troubleshooting and the challenges of operating distributed systems at scale.
Experience partnering with senior engineering and product leaders to establish strategic priorities, allocate resources and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
The ability to navigate complex organisational challenges, influence senior stakeholders and make informed decisions in situations with significant technical or business consequences.
A compassionate approach to leadership, with a genuine commitment to coaching, developing and supporting the people you work with.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting technical strategy and organisational priorities to senior executives.

jobs.title: Head Of Treasury Technology
jobs.text:
A Career with Point72’s Technology Team
As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm’s IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We’re a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. Our commitment to building and innovating in the AI space provides the framework intended to drive smarter decision making and enhance how we build and operate our platforms and applications.
As a member of Point72’s Technology team, we encourage and support your professional development from day one—helping you advance your technical skills, contribute innovative ideas, and satisfy your own intellectual curiosity—all while delivering real business impact for our multi-billion-dollar global business.
What you’ll do
In this role, you will be responsible for supporting Point72’s Treasury function with best-in-class technology solutions. You will align the business needs with technology delivery, provide guidance with strategic business architecture, and execute key business projects in line with business optimization needs. Specifically, you will:
Lead the technical product buildout to optimize the current application inventory stack while architecting a platform that scales to the firm’s future needs with regards to liquidity, margin and collateral, and key business stakeholder management
Develop software and analytics to further develop firmwide mandates such as liquidity risk, margin risk management, collateral management, and funding optimization
Manage and lead key stakeholder relationships, especially between Treasury management and Technology
Lead and grow a group of product specialists, analysts, quantitative strategists, and developers within Technology
Ensure alignment of financing, margin, and stock loan business requirements to broader firm technology architecture strategy
Provide thought leadership and product input on tooling solutions for margin and collateral optimization
Support business and Treasury on liquidity regulatory enquiries
Partner with cross function peers to create, administer, track, and close out project deliverables as they pertain to Treasury
Ensure resources are assigned to projects in line with business analysis and development groups, and monitor commitments in line with the project management team
Ensure teams understand business processes and gaps in capabilities, as well as appropriate data sources, interfaces, and process changes required to address the gaps
What’s required
Ability to lead a technical team, provide technical and functional guidance, and manage stakeholders needs
Ability to communicate complex technical and risk ideas to non-technical stakeholders.
Working knowledge of data science technologies including machine learning (ML) and ML frameworks
Working knowledge of cloud-ready architectures and technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Microservice Architecture, Streaming, Serialization protocols, NoSQL, and in-memory databases.
Working knowledge of web architectures and technologies such as Python, Java, GraphQL, APIs, node, React, and Angular.
Experience using AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with the ability to build MCPs, Skills, and more.
Strong knowledge of treasury fundamentals across liquidity risk, margin modeling, collateral management, and stress testing, including related optimization models, reporting, and analytics
Working knowledge of stress event management, planning, and forecasting as it pertains to liquidity, as well as collateral stressing, substitution, and rehypothecation
Excellent understanding of financial products within capital markets business, as well as knowledge of capital metrics including RWA
Understanding of financial markets and associated operational support functions
Commitment to the highest ethical standards
We take care of our people
We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:
Fully-paid health care benefits
Generous parental and family leave policies
Volunteer opportunities
Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, people of color and the LGBT+ community
Mental and physical wellness programs
Tuition assistance
A 401(k) savings program with an employer match and more
About Point72
Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people’s long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/.
The annual base salary range for this role is $300,000-$400,000 (USD), which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.

jobs.title: Director- Engineering. (Hospitality) SN7
jobs.text:
Job Description
The Cluster Director of Engineering is a key member of the cluster leadership team, responsible for
overseeing all engineering, maintenance, facilities management, technical services, and asset
protection functions across multiple hotels within the portfolio.
This role combines strategic leadership, technical expertise, and project management capabilities to
support hotels with different technical requirements. The Cluster Director of Engineering will play a
critical role throughout the pre-opening, opening, and operational phases, ensuring successful
project handovers, operational readiness, regulatory compliance, maintenance excellence, and longterm
asset preservation.
The successful candidate will lead engineering teams across the cluster, oversee technical operations
and capital projects, and work closely with ownership, consultants, and contractors to ensure the
hotels are delivered, maintained, and operated to the highest standards of safety, reliability,
efficiency, and sustainability.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead all engineering, maintenance, and facilities management operations across the hotel
cluster, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all assets.
• Develop and execute engineering strategies that support hotel business objectives, brand
requirements, owner priorities, and long-term asset value enhancement.
• Lead the engineering transition from project delivery to hotel operations, including testing &
commissioning, inspections, snagging, defect management, and operational handover.
• Participate in design reviews and technical workshops to ensure projects are delivered in
accordance with operational requirements and engineering best practices.
• Review and validate engineering-related OS&E requirements, maintenance equipment,
workshop tools, spare parts inventories, and procurement plans to ensure operational
readiness and cost effectiveness.
• Prepare, manage, and control Engineering Pre-Opening Budgets (POB), ensuring all
engineering readiness activities are completed within approved budgets and timelines.
• Develop and implement preventative and predictive maintenance programmes for all
building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire & life safety systems, vertical
transportation, kitchen equipment, and utilities infrastructure.
• Oversee capital expenditure projects, asset lifecycle planning, refurbishment works, and
replacement programs across the cluster.
• Drive operational efficiencies through preventive maintenance, energy management
initiatives, contract optimization, and engineering best practices.
Champion sustainability, energy conservation, water management, and ESG initiatives across
all properties.
• Ensure full compliance with all regulatory, environmental, health & safety, and life safety
requirements.
• Establish emergency preparedness plans, crisis response procedures, and business continuity
measures for all hotels.
• Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams through coaching, training,
succession planning, and performance management.
• Establish strong working relationships with ownership, project teams, consultants,
contractors, and local authorities to ensure successful project delivery and ongoing asset
stewardship.

jobs.title: CTO - Dutch Flower Group
jobs.text:
Over Dutch Flower Group
Dutch Flower Group (DFG) is een internationale familie van meer dan 30 gespecialiseerde ondernemingen die gezamenlijk actief zijn binnen de internationale sierteeltketen. De bedrijven leveren bloemen, boeketten en planten via uiteenlopende afzetkanalen, waaronder groothandel, retail, tuincentra en online verkoopkanalen.
Binnen DFG worden lokaal ondernemerschap en een sterke eigen identiteit gecombineerd met de schaal, kennis en slagkracht van de groep. Digitalisering en datagedreven werken vormen een van de zes strategische groeipijlers richting 2030.
De uitdaging
Dutch Flower Group zoekt een Chief Technology Officer die richting geeft aan de volgende fase van digitalisering binnen de groep. De CTO krijgt de ruimte om de technologische koers richting 2030 mede vorm te geven en technologie, data en AI zichtbaar te verbinden aan de strategische en dagelijkse behoeften van de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.
De CTO opereert binnen een uitgesproken decentrale organisatie, waarin bedrijven verschillen in identiteit, marktpositie, cultuur en digitale volwassenheid. De opdracht is daarom niet gericht op centralisatie als doel op zich. De CTO bepaalt samen met de bedrijven waar samenwerking, standaardisatie en gezamenlijke investeringen aantoonbare waarde toevoegen.
Dit vraagt bovenal om een verbindende en situationeel sterke CTO die uiteenlopende stakeholders en belangen weet samen te brengen. Iemand die beweging creëert vanuit inhoud, relaties en vertrouwen, zonder voortdurend terug te vallen op hiërarchie, formeel mandaat of escalatie.
De rol
De CTO ontwikkelt en realiseert de meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data en vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete commerciële en operationele waarde.
Binnen de decentrale structuur van Dutch Flower Group bouwt de CTO bruggen tussen de bedrijven, de centrale organisatie en verschillende disciplines. De CTO versterkt de verbinding tussen IT en de business, stimuleert kennisdeling en samenwerking en geeft richting aan keuzes rond onder meer architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties, infrastructuur, cybersecurity, data en AI.
Daarnaast geeft de CTO leiding aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de IT-organisatie en zorgt ervoor dat prioriteiten aansluiten bij de behoeften van klanten en de verschillende DFG-bedrijven. Op het gebied van cybersecurity en continuïteit heeft de CTO een expliciet groepsbreed mandaat.
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Ontwikkelen en realiseren van de visie en meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data.
Vertalen van technologie, data en AI naar zichtbare commerciële en operationele waarde.
Verbinden van bedrijven, stakeholders en disciplines rond gezamenlijke technologische vraagstukken.
Richting geven aan keuzes rond architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties en infrastructuur.
Versterken van de samenwerking en kennisdeling tussen de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.
Doorontwikkelen van de IT-organisatie en multidisciplinaire teams.
Vergroten van de aansluiting tussen IT en de dagelijkse bedrijfspraktijk.
Vaststellen en bewaken van groepsbrede kaders voor cybersecurity en continuïteit.
Realiseren van veranderinitiatieven en investeringen met aantoonbaar resultaat.
Opbouwen van duurzame relaties met aandeelhouders, directies en IT-verantwoordelijken binnen de groep.

Dutch Flower Group zoekt een Chief Technology Officer die richting geeft aan de volgende fase van digitalisering binnen de groep. De CTO krijgt de ruimte om de technologische koers richting 2030 mede vorm te geven en technologie, data en AI zichtbaar te verbinden aan de strategische en dagelijkse behoeften van de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.

De CTO opereert binnen een uitgesproken decentrale organisatie, waarin bedrijven verschillen in identiteit, marktpositie, cultuur en digitale volwassenheid. De opdracht is daarom niet gericht op centralisatie als doel op zich. De CTO bepaalt samen met de bedrijven waar samenwerking, standaardisatie en gezamenlijke investeringen aantoonbare waarde toevoegen.

Dit vraagt bovenal om een verbindende en situationeel sterke CTO die uiteenlopende stakeholders en belangen weet samen te brengen. Iemand die beweging creëert vanuit inhoud, relaties en vertrouwen, zonder voortdurend terug te vallen op hiërarchie, formeel mandaat of escalatie.
De rol
De CTO ontwikkelt en realiseert de meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data en vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete commerciële en operationele waarde.

Binnen de decentrale structuur van Dutch Flower Group bouwt de CTO bruggen tussen de bedrijven, de centrale organisatie en verschillende disciplines. De CTO versterkt de verbinding tussen IT en de business, stimuleert kennisdeling en samenwerking en geeft richting aan keuzes rond onder meer architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties, infrastructuur, cybersecurity, data en AI.

Daarnaast geeft de CTO leiding aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de IT-organisatie en zorgt ervoor dat prioriteiten aansluiten bij de behoeften van klanten en de verschillende DFG-bedrijven. Op het gebied van cybersecurity en continuïteit heeft de CTO een expliciet groepsbreed mandaat.
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

items: Ontwikkelen en realiseren van de visie en meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data.
Vertalen van technologie, data en AI naar zichtbare commerciële en operationele waarde.
Verbinden van bedrijven, stakeholders en disciplines rond gezamenlijke technologische vraagstukken.
Richting geven aan keuzes rond architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties en infrastructuur.
Versterken van de samenwerking en kennisdeling tussen de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.
Doorontwikkelen van de IT-organisatie en multidisciplinaire teams.
Vergroten van de aansluiting tussen IT en de dagelijkse bedrijfspraktijk.
Vaststellen en bewaken van groepsbrede kaders voor cybersecurity en continuïteit.
Realiseren van veranderinitiatieven en investeringen met aantoonbaar resultaat.
Opbouwen van duurzame relaties met aandeelhouders, directies en IT-verantwoordelijken binnen de groep.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Operations (009-01361)
jobs.text:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates
Job Role: Head of Product and Operations
Work Schedule: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, Australian Business Hours
Compensation range: $3,000 AUD - $4,500 AUD / Monthly (before tax and deductions)
Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.
Who The Client Is: We’re a community-driven platform built to connect local businesses with fundraisers in a way that benefits everyone. By making it easy for merchants to share offers and for groups to raise funds, we create a simple, win-win model that drives growth, engagement, and impact without the usual barriers. Our mission is to keep commerce and community working hand in hand, making support effortless and rewarding.
Role Overview: We are not looking for a virtual assistant, general administrator or software developer.
We’re looking for a senior Product & Operations leader with previous experience working within a SaaS, marketplace, membership, subscription, fintech, loyalty/rewards, or comparable digital platform.
The successful candidate will take significant responsibility away from the Founder, owning the day-to-day operation of the platform and coordinating the technology, systems, and processes required for the company to scale.
This role requires someone who can identify problems, investigate root causes, determine effective solutions, and follow them through to completion with minimal direction.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Ownership
Own and maintain the company’s product roadmap.
Translate commercial requirements into clear development specifications.
Prioritise features, improvements and bugs.
Manage external developers and technology partners.
Challenge development estimates and timelines where appropriate.
Establish acceptance criteria for development.
Coordinate releases.
Maintain product and technical documentation.
QA & Technology Management
Take ownership of QA and regression testing.
Test development before production release.
Maintain bugs and issue registers.
Manage development priorities and delivery.
Understand web/mobile applications, APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure sufficiently to manage technical suppliers.
Coordinate security, backups, platform reliability and technical issues.
The successful candidate does not need to code, but must be technically confident enough to manage developers effectively.
Fundraiser Operations
Manage the operational process from:
Signed → Onboarding → Setup → Launch → Active
Including fundraiser accounts, pages, payment configuration, dashboards, reporting and support.
Merchant Operations
Manage:
Signed → Onboarding → Offer Setup → Approval → Live → Ongoing Management
Including merchant information, locations, offers, codes, terms and offer accuracy.
Member & Payment Operations
Oversee:
Registration → Payment → Fundraiser Allocation → Membership Activation → Usage → Renewal
Including Stripe/payment issues, failed payments, refunds, membership status and reconciliation.
Customer Support
Establish and manage support processes for:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Build systems, FAQs, documentation and automation that reduce repetitive support requirements.
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain management reporting covering:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Membership sales
Revenue
Fundraising distributions
Payments
Renewals
Customer support
Product development
Platform performance
Management should have a clear weekly view of the health of the business.
Automation & Scalability
A major part of this role is identifying manual processes and progressively automating them.
We want someone constantly asking:
“How can the company support 1,000 fundraisers and 100,000+ members without needing a huge operations team?"

jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
About the role
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
What you’ll do
Sell
Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements
Deliver
Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time
Manage People
Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume
You may be a fit if
You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

jobs.text:
At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.
Additionally, you will enjoy:
• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
• Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
• Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
• Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
• Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career
Job Description
While this position is primarily remote, candidates must live in one of the posted locations to be considered.
We are looking for an Engineering Director to join our team in the East Region! You will bring residential, industrial and commercial building expertise to a range of our clients. Engineering management’s primary responsibilities will be to ensure the region achieves performance goals, develop strategies to improve our services, consistently delivers high-quality work on time and within budget, and provides professional growth opportunities for engineers. Engineering management will work closely with regional program managers and directors to provide the best services possible to our clients. Leading the engineering team and working with engineering leaders to collaboratively share resources, develop tools, and strategies to overcome common challenges.
​​
You’re a great fit if you can…
Lead a team of engineering managers, engineers, and energy analysts with accountability for overall budget and strategic direction
Oversee engineering aspects of contracts and proposals
Develop region-wide engineering staffing plan (types and quantities of hires, reporting structure)
Technical oversight for all work within assigned territory; including impact evaluation results
Responsibility to regional VPs for timely and high-quality execution of technical work.
Significant responsibility for supporting business development; lead complex BD work
Accountable for growth in capabilities of engineering team and coordination and support of other engineering teams across the company
Proactively identify and resolve problems that impact the long-term objectives and direction of the business
Create formal networks and serves as an internal and external spokesperson for the engineering team
Exciting candidates have…
10+ years of engineering experience
8+ years of engineering team management
Engineering Degree required
PE preferred

jobs.title: VP, Product Strategy & Operations
jobs.text:
Overview
We are looking for a VP of Product Strategy & Program Management to build and lead the operational and strategic backbone of our Product organization. This leader will own the connective tissue between product strategy and product execution - ensuring our roadmap is grounded in rigorous market intelligence, our launches land with commercial and customer impact, our cross-functional programs run predictably, and our product documentation is accurate, discoverable, and enterprise-grade.
This is a builder role. You'll stand up and mature four disciplines - Market Analysis, Launch Excellence, Program Management, and Product Documentation - inside a product organization that is scaling its maturity and rigor. You'll partner directly with the CPO, product line leaders, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success to make sure great products actually reach the market and the market actually understands them.
Responsibilities
What You'll Own
Market Strategy & Analysis
Lead competitive intelligence, market sizing, and segmentation analysis that directly informs roadmap prioritization and portfolio strategy
Build repeatable frameworks for tracking market dynamics, buyer needs, and competitive positioning
Translate market insight into inputs product leaders and executives can act on - not just reports that sit on a shelf
Launch Excellence
Own the end-to-end launch framework: readiness criteria, cross-functional launch plans, tiering models, and post-launch retrospectives
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success to ensure every release has a commercial and adoption plan, not just a ship date
Establish the metrics that define launch success and hold the org accountable to them
Program Management
Build and lead a program management function that drives predictability across complex, cross-functional product initiatives
Own portfolio-level visibility: roadmap execution tracking, dependency management, risk escalation, and executive reporting
Instill lightweight but durable operating rhythms (planning cycles, status reporting, escalation paths) appropriate for a scaling PM organization
Product Documentation
Lead the team responsible for product documentation, release notes, and internal/external knowledge resources
Ensure documentation quality keeps pace with product complexity, particularly for enterprise and technical buyers
Build scalable documentation processes that reduce support burden and improve customer self-sufficiency
Team & Organizational Leadership
Hire, develop, and lead a team of market analysis, launch, program management, and documentation specialists
Define career pathing and craft standards for a discipline that is often under-resourced and under-defined - you'll be building the operating model, not inheriting one
Act as a force multiplier for the CPO, translating strategic priorities into operational execution across the product org
Qualifications
Qualifications
10+ years in product strategy, product operations, program management, or a related discipline, with at least 3–5 years leading teams
Track record of building or significantly maturing a product operations, strategy, or program management function inside a scaling or transforming organization

jobs.title: Vice President of Enterprise Technology
jobs.text:
About AutoRABIT
AutoRABIT is revolutionizing DevOps and data protection for Salesforce teams operating in complex, highly regulated environments. Our platform integrates CI/CD, compliance, release orchestration, and AI powered automation to improve software delivery, reduce risk, and increase velocity. With a foundation in Lean principles, we are focused on eliminating waste, driving innovation, and delivering scalable value for our customers.
Position Summary
AutoRABIT is seeking a strategic and hands on Vice President of Enterprise Technology to lead the organization's Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Corporate IT functions. This executive will be responsible for scaling and operating a secure, highly available, and scalable AI-focused technology environment that supports both our internal teams and our global customer base.
This role is instrumental in advancing AutoRABIT's operational maturity while supporting our FedRAMP authorization efforts and ongoing compliance with federal security requirements. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for operational excellence in global high growth SaaS environments.
Working closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, the Vice President of Enterprise Technology will define the technology operations strategy, strengthen enterprise production infrastructure and internal technical stack, and ensure our systems meet the reliability, security, and performance expectations of enterprise and government customers.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Technology Leadership
Lead the SRE and Corporate IT organizations while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Develop and execute the enterprise technology strategy in partnership with the CTO.
Build and mentor high performing technical leaders and engineering teams.
Drive organizational maturity through scalable operational processes, automation, and modern technology practices.
Site Reliability Engineering & Operations
Own platform reliability, availability, incident response, observability, compliance, and operational readiness.
Establish and monitor Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and operational KPIs.
Lead major incident management, root cause analysis, and post incident reviews.
Champion automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Enterprise Infrastructure & IT
Lead the strategy and execution of enterprise IT services including identity management, endpoint management, networking, collaboration platforms, and corporate systems.
Ensure secure, scalable technology solutions that support a distributed workforce.
Oversee IT service delivery, ensuring timely resolution of support requests while actively managing and assisting with IT tickets and escalations as needed.
Evaluate and modernize enterprise technology platforms to improve employee productivity and operational efficiency.
Security, Compliance & FedRAMP
Partner with Security and Compliance teams to support FedRAMP authorization and ongoing compliance initiatives.
Ensure operational processes align with NIST 800-53 controls and other regulatory frameworks.
Collaborate with Engineering to embed security, governance, and compliance into operational workflows.
Support audits, continuous monitoring activities, and customer security assessments.
Executive Leadership
Partner with executive leadership to align enterprise technology initiatives with company objectives.
Present operational metrics, risks, and strategic recommendations to the executive team.
Manage departmental budgets, resource planning, and vendor relationships.
Serve as the executive leader during critical customer escalations and major production incidents.
Required Skills & Experience
10+ years of experience leading enterprise infrastructure, cloud operations, SRE, platform engineering, or enterprise technology organizations.
5+ years of executive or senior leadership experience managing multiple technical organizations.
Proven experience leading Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Enterprise Operations teams.
Hands on technical expertise with modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience supporting FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, or other regulated compliance frameworks.
Strong understanding of enterprise IT, cloud architecture, networking, identity management, and security best practices.
Experience with Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and DevSecOps methodologies.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience leading remote, geographically distributed technical teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading enterprise technology organizations within a SaaS company.
Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps or enterprise software delivery platforms.
Experience supporting enterprise or government customers.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Security Specialty, or similar certifications are preferred.
Compensation
Base Salary: $250,000 to $280,000 USD + variable
Must be a US citizen/permanent resident, and capable of obtaining a Government Security clearance if required and live in and work from the US. Green card holders qualify, but H1B or other work visa holders do not qualify for this role.
THIS IS A 100% REMOTE JOB, but requires 10% travel and an in-person component to the interview process.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect / Technical Architect Director - Data Foundation Deli
jobs.text:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Customer Success
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.
This role leads the advisory, architecture, and delivery of enterprise Data Foundation engagements for Salesforce Professional Services customers. Drawing on deep data experience (10+ years for the Senior Technical Architect level; 15+ years for the Director level), you run discovery, set the technical vision, design/approve the target architecture, and drive delivery across a progressive, customer-calibrated maturity journey — advising customer stakeholders (up to CxO level at the Director tier) along the way.
You bring the Data Foundation Delivery to life, including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and the ability to operate across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft). As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. Every foundation is built with governance, quality, security, and privacy embedded from day one, and serves both traditional analytics for people and agentic AI for machines.
You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. This is a customer-billable delivery role — a hands-on/senior individual contributor accountable for engagement outcomes and technical leadership, not an internal people-management position.
What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)
Advisory & Strategy
Lead discovery: stakeholder interviews, current-state assessment, use-case and KPI definition; at senior levels, serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs and shape the business case
Assess data maturity and build a phased, customer-calibrated roadmap
Align customer stakeholders and sponsors; contribute to/own the business case and expected outcomes
Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360, regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)
Represent the practice in complex, high-stakes engagements
Architecture & Delivery
Design/set/approve target-state architecture across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360 / Informatica IDMC / MuleSoft)
Deliver both platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — integrate Salesforce cleanly with (or position it as the center of gravity within) the customer's existing multi-vendor technology investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)
Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines
Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)
Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management
AI-Augmented Delivery
Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP
Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)
Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery
Governance & Enablement
Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model
Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP (Director level)
What You Bring (Preferred Experience)
Unified Identity & Harmonization — identity resolution, match/merge, golden records
Master Data Management — domains, survivorship, hierarchies, 360 views
Unstructured Data Management — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, RAG grounding
Data Architecture & Semantic Modeling — conceptual/logical/physical models, semantic layer, glossary
Data Integration, Orchestration & Activation — API-led connectivity, CDC, real-time events, activation
Data Trust, Security & Privacy — classification, access control, masking, Einstein Trust Layer
Data Governance & Stewardship — catalog, lineage, data quality, stewardship & policy
Industry Data Models & Accelerators — FSC, Health Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud blueprints
Data Platform & Infrastructure — lakehouse, compute, catalog, cloud foundation
Analytics, BI & Data Observability — dashboards, self-service BI, freshness/quality monitoring
Required Qualifications
10+ years (Senior Technical Architect) / 15+ years (Director) of hands-on data experience across data & analytics consulting, engineering, architecture, MDM, integration, and governance
Demonstrated delivery/leadership of enterprise data platform, MDM, integration, governance, or AI-readiness programs
Hands-on/deep expertise with one or more of Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft
Strong-to-authority-level data modeling (conceptual/logical/physical) and semantic/metadata modeling
Working-to-strong command of data governance, quality, security, and privacy (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA)
Executive-grade communication, up to proven CxO-level advisory at senior levels; ability to guide delivery teams and lead multi-workstream delivery
Experience integrating a vendor platform into heterogeneous/complex enterprise landscapes — balancing platform-agnostic and platform-centric approaches
Hands-on-to-deep fluency with AI-augmented delivery — using AI tools as a core part of the workflow and building reusable prompt/skill/agent assets
A forward-looking, and at senior levels recognized/published, perspective on enterprise data, AI, and the agentic future of SaaS
Certifications
Certifications are preferred, not required — a proven delivery and thought-leadership track record carries the most weight.
Preferred Certifications
Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
Salesforce Certified Data Architect
Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Director)
MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Sr. Architect level)
TOGAF (Director)
Additional Pluses
Informatica IDMC / MDM certification
Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Sr. Architect level)
MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Director level)
DAMA CDMP or CDMC
Preferred / Differentiating Strengths
Experience/track record delivering agentic AI / RAG on a governed data foundation
Industry depth/expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing (industry data models)
Track record/history building reusable accelerators and prompt/skill/agent libraries
Prior Professional Services / customer-facing advisory or leadership experience at enterprise scale
How Success Is Measured (First 12 Months)
Certification Attainment: complete required certifications to be compliant and ready for customer engagements
Discovery-to-roadmap / Customer impact: consistently produce customer-calibrated maturity assessments and roadmaps that secure signed charters; ramp quickly to be billable on one or more engagements
Delivery / Architecture standard: ship working, governed capability increments each phase, with consistent, governed, dual-purpose foundations across the portfolio
Advisory impact / Business outcomes: measurable stakeholder alignment and adoption; clear business (not just technical) outcomes realized
AI-augmented delivery: apply AI tooling to reduce delivery effort while improving consistency; contribute reusable prompt/skill/agent assets to the practice, adopted team-wide at senior levels
Thought leadership: bring a credible agentic-SaaS-future perspective into engagements; at Director level, own a defined, published practice POV shaping customer engagements and market positioning
Governance / Enablement: leave every engagement with a sustainable stewardship and operating model; delivery teams ramped and productive through technical leadership
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
Accommodations
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
Posting Statement
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.The typical base salary range for this position is $172,500 - $313,700 annually. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.
Founded by the team that scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ in ARR and secured more than $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.
Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely.We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.
We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Product Engineering organization, the team responsible for Turnkey's core product. This spans our TEE- and HSM-based key verification and signing systems, the APIs, SDKs, and interfaces built on top of them, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable. This is a senior leadership role reporting to our CTO/Co-Founder Jack Kearney, owning both the technical direction and the people leadership of the org. If you're excited about the potential that web3 has to radically change the world for the better and have a sincere desire to help facilitate that change, join us as we redefine decentralized development.
What You'll Do
Strategic Vision and Leadership
Own the engineering strategy and technical vision for Turnkey's Product Engineering organization, spanning key management, the APIs and interfaces built on top of it, transaction processing, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable.
Build, manage, and grow a high-performing engineering org, including hiring and developing engineering managers and senior ICs
Partner closely with Product and Design leadership to translate customer and market needs into a clear technical roadmap
Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends in web3 and guide their integration into our product
Contribute to company-wide strategic planning and technical decision-making as a member of the engineering leadership team
Organizational & People Leadership
Define and evolve the org structure, leveling, and career paths for the Product Engineering team as it scales
Drive recruitment, onboarding, and retention of top engineering talent across the org
Set and uphold engineering rituals (planning, incident review, on-call, etc.) that keep the org fast-moving and accountable
Coach and develop managers and senior engineers, building a durable leadership bench
Architectural Oversight & Technical Direction
Provide technical guidance across security-critical product systems, ensuring intelligent architectural decisions that scale with customer demand without compromising trust
Oversee the design and implementation of TEE- and HSM-based key management and signing systems, the APIs, SDKs, and dashboards built on top of them, transaction construction and broadcast systems, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable
Ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of product infrastructure, addressing the complexities of decentralized systems and adversarial threat models
Define and drive processes that ensure quality and consistency across product development, from design through deployment
What We're Looking For
Proven experience managing engineering managers and/or leading a multi-team engineering org (not just individual teams)
Deep understanding of modern application architectures and security-critical systems (e.g., HSMs, TEEs, key management), with the ability to lead in-depth technical discussions and make final calls on tradeoffs
A track record of shipping security-critical or developer-facing products (key management, signing infrastructure, APIs, or SDKs) at scale
Excellence at holding a high bar on software quality and engineering process, even while moving fast
A healthy amount of paranoia :-)
Style Points
Prior experience working in fast-paced crypto/web3 and/or FinTech companies, especially with exposure to custody, key management, or HSM/enclave-based systems
Experience scaling an engineering org through a significant growth stage (e.g., Series B → C, or comparable)
Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it's going
Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.
Compensation range
$250,000—$290,000 USD
