jobs.title: Customer Success Director, Customer Data Platform (CDP)
jobs.text:
We are Rokt. We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We’ve built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.
The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.
At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation, which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability.
Target total compensation ranges from $262,000 - $390,000, including a fixed annual salary of $165,000 - $220,000, variable quarterly compensation, an employee equity plan grant, and world-class benefits. This is the expected range for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.
Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.
Rokt mParticle is widely recognized as one of the leading real-time customer data platforms (CDP), serving hundreds of global brands and helping them turn data to insights and insights to action. In January 2025 mParticle merged with Rokt and became Rokt mParticle. Your work would directly impact the continued growth and success of the CDP.
About the Role:
Rokt mParticle is looking for an experienced Customer Success Director to work with our top tier customer base which includes some of the world’s best consumer-facing brands at a global level. You will report into the Head of GTM mParticle. Our Customer Success team is tasked with strengthening and expanding our relationships at all levels of the client organization. The candidate qualified for this role has proven experience supporting high revenue, large scale customers, on a global level. This is an individual contributor role with the potential to materialize into people leadership overtime.
An ideal CSD possesses a clear understanding of the partners' organization and their overall business strategy, and has frequent dialogue with key stakeholders. The CSM drives expansion of data-driven use cases and up-sells platform products and features. In order to do so, the CSM should possess the ability to understand a customer’s business needs & articulate the value of an enterprise platform to collect and connect data for consumer-focused initiatives.
This is a highly collaborative individual who works closely with mParticle’s Solutions, Sales & Product teams to provide client feedback and influence our product roadmap. Success in this role is defined by client retention, expansion and satisfaction
We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here.
How your future team uses AI:
The Customer Success team uses AI as an account intelligence partner to synthesize customer activity, assess account health, and turn customer goals into measurable success plans. AI helps CSMs identify risks and growth opportunities earlier, while CSMs apply the judgment, trust, and strategic leadership needed to strengthen relationships and drive outcomes.
AI supports the more hands-on technical side of the role as well, helping teams troubleshoot issues such as faulted integrations and get clients to answers faster. And increasingly, AI isn't just how we work—it's part of what we bring to our clients. Client Success teams demonstrate and drive adoption of AI-powered mParticle capabilities like Audience Agent, helping customers understand how they can use these tools to get more value from their data.
How You Will Contribute:
Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within strategic accounts; act as the main point of contact and advocate for the customer.
Partner with Fortune 50, 100, and 500 customers to understand their business goals and objectives, and develop tailored success plans that drive measurable outcomes (e.g., reducing customer acquisition costs, increasing retention, optimizing campaign performance).
Provide expert guidance on the mParticle platform, helping customers maximize value through use case enablement, best practices, and ongoing consultation.
Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions Consulting, Sales, Product, and other cross-functional partners) to develop and execute strategic account plans that align with customer goals and mParticle business objectives.
Track and report on customer health metrics, adoption trends, and success outcomes; lead stakeholder business reviews (QBRs) to highlight achievements and align on future goals.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Science
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .
Reddit is seeking a Senior Director of Consumer Data Science to lead a multi-team organization that partners across Consumer, Product, Engineering, and the broader business. You will set the strategy and operating model for consumer data science, strengthen the systems and standards that make scientific outputs reliable, actionable, and scalable, and guide high-impact decisions through measurement, experimentation, causal inference, and ML.
This leader will help define how Reddit measures and improves relevance across the consumer journey—from retrieval and ranking to feed, search, recommendations, and community discovery—and will shape the organizational capabilities required to advance these systems over the long term. Accordingly, the role requires the technical depth to evaluate architecture and analytical investments, guide state-of-the-art ML system improvements, and the leadership presence to align senior leaders around difficult tradeoffs.
What you’ll do
Partner with senior leaders across Consumer, Product, Engineering, and business functions to define company-level bets, priorities, and tradeoffs.
Set the data science strategy for Reddit’s feed, recommendation, search, retrieval, and ranking systems, including objective design, candidate generation, ranking quality, relevance evaluation, experimentation, and long-term optimization.
Establish the measurement and experimentation framework for relevance optimization, including offline evaluation, online experimentation, counterfactual analysis, guardrail metrics, metric integrity, and the connection between model improvements and consumer and community outcomes.
Translate complex user and community behavior into clear, impartial insights that improve product strategy and consumer outcomes.
Establish durable standards for measurement, experimentation, causal inference, reproducibility, privacy, responsible AI use, and self-serve measurement, at scale.
Build multi-team roadmaps, operating cadences, and clear accountability that turn company direction into durable delivery.
Exercise strong technical judgment across architecture choices, analytical systems, hiring, and sponsorship of high-leverage programs.
Build or rebuild systems and practices that make analytical work reliable, adoptable, and scalable rather than dependent on individual heroics.
Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional Directors, managers, and IC5+ leaders across multiple teams or pillars.
Set a high talent bar through succession planning, calibration, and clear expectations for coaching, performance, accountability, and growth.
Create durable cross-org forums and operating mechanisms that improve coordination, culture, and decision quality.
Align senior product, engineering, and business leaders on measurement strategy, difficult tradeoffs, and decisions with material multi-year impact.
Represent Reddit externally and internally as an acknowledged thought leader and visible culture shaper for rigor.
Partner with teams advancing ML and analytical systems that deepen understanding of Reddit’s UGC and community ecosystem.
Skills and Qualifications
Deep data science expertise in measurement, experimentation, causal inference, ML, data platforms, and analytical systems, with the technical judgment to set company-scale standards.
Experience in UGC or community ecosystems and a strong point of view on how data science can improve consumer experiences while protecting analytical quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
Proven ability to connect model and system improvements to consumer value, content quality, trust, diversity, healthy participation, and long-term business outcomes—not only short-term engagement metrics.
Senior leadership experience leading multi-team or multi-pillar organizations and delivering attributable business impact through durable roadmaps, operating mechanisms, and long-range bets.
Proven organization builder with a track record of recruiting and retaining exceptional senior leaders, developing Directors and managers, and creating a healthy, high-trust leadership bench.
Exceptional communication and influence with experience aligning senior product, engineering, and business leaders; resolving conflict; and communicating uncertainty, risks, and tradeoffs with intellectual honesty.
Pay Transparency:
This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.
The base salary range for this position is:
$317,000—$443,800 USD
In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.
During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.
Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: CTO - Digital & AI
jobs.text:
Join EVA Pharma, a leading pharmaceutical company dedicated to empowering the fight for Health and Well-being as a fundamental human right. Recognized and certified as a best place to work, we are committed to fostering a supportive and innovative environment for our team members.
Job Summary:
We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded, technology-driven and value-oriented CTO – Digital & AI to shape the Group's technology vision and lead its digital and AI agenda across Eva Pharma Group, including EVA Medicine, Limitless Care and Care Point.
This is a Group-level leadership role focused on leveraging technology, data and AI to build competitive advantage, accelerate growth, enable new business models, enhance organizational capabilities and enhance customer and patient impact.
About the Role:
Reporting directly to the Group CEO, the CTO will define the Group's long-term technology, digital and AI vision and translate it into a strategic roadmap aligned with CEO and Board priorities.
The CTO will act as a strategic partner to the business — identifying how technology, data and emerging AI capabilities can transform business models, strengthen organizational capability, improve customer and patient experiences, and unlock new opportunities. The role will lead and align senior technology leaders across Digital, Product, Engineering, ERP, Data & AI, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity, ensuring a coherent Group-wide technology strategy, architecture and operating model.
The role will be accountable for ensuring that technology investments and initiatives deliver measurable business impact, value and return on investment, with clear priorities, outcomes and success measures.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Strategic Leadership
Define and lead the Group's technology, digital and AI strategy, aligned with business strategy and long-term growth ambitions
Set the Group's technology vision, enterprise architecture principles and strategic priorities across EVA Medicine, Limitless Care and Care Point
Establish technology investment principles and governance, linking major investments to strategic value, business outcomes and measurable ROI
2. Digital Transformation Initiatives
Recommend and propose technologies and digital solutions that address business needs and unlock new opportunities
Shape digital and AI-enabled business models, identifying opportunities for growth, efficiency and differentiation
Build a future-ready technology organization — leadership model and capabilities — to support the Group's transformation and growth
3. Process Improvement
Drive process optimization across the Group through digital and technology-enabled solutions
Provide strategic oversight of cybersecurity, data governance, resilience and technology risk
4. AI
Lead the Group's AI agenda, identifying, scaling and embedding high-impact AI use cases across the business
Ensure responsible AI governance and practices across all AI initiatives

jobs.text:
Who We Are:
Interra Health is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone.
The Role
The Head of Product Management owns the product management discipline across Interra Health’s core platform — Eligibility, Prescribing & Affordability, Access, and Routing. At the center of this platform is the movement, transformation, and actionability of healthcare data: clinical and administrative data flows, FHIR-based interoperability, and the informatics infrastructure that connects payers, providers, and health systems. This leader sets the strategic direction of the PM function, builds and develops a high-performing team, and ensures every product investment is grounded in deep healthcare data expertise and tied to measurable customer and business outcomes.
We’re looking for a product leader who has done this work in healthcare — someone with firsthand knowledge of how healthcare data actually moves: how FHIR APIs enable real-time clinical data exchange, how claims and eligibility data flows between payers and providers, how informatics and data products translate raw clinical data into actionable insights. The right candidate makes hard calls when stakeholders conflict, owns outcomes rather than activities, and builds systematic market and customer intelligence that keeps the roadmap ahead of the industry. This role is for a leader who can hold the vision while staying close enough to the work to elevate rigor at every level.
Key Responsibilities
Own healthcare-grounded product strategy. Develop multi-year roadmaps built around healthcare data flow opportunities — FHIR-based interoperability, clinical and administrative data exchange, informatics and data products, population health, and quality measurement. Understand the competitive landscape and emerging standards well enough to position Interra’s data capabilities ahead of the market.
Own the hard decisions. Act as the final decision-maker when stakeholder opinions conflict — balancing customer requests, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technical constraints. Demonstrate a history of making difficult tradeoffs and standing behind outcomes, including decisions affecting providers, payers, health systems, or public health organizations.
Build systematic customer and market intelligence. Push teams to validate assumptions with real users rather than internal consensus. Create and maintain feedback loops with customers, clinical stakeholders, and industry partners that systematically inform roadmap and prioritization decisions.
Set and communicate a unified product vision. Translate company-level strategy into actionable product plans and clear prioritization frameworks across all owned domains. Represent the PM function at the executive level and in major customer forums.
Build and develop the PM team. Hire, mentor, and develop Product Managers and team leads. Establish a high bar for product rigor, discovery practices, and delivery quality. Create career development pathways and hold high expectations for talent across the function.
Drive cross-functional execution. Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Product Ownership, and Core Services to drive aligned execution. Facilitate resolution of cross-domain dependencies and tradeoffs.
Enable go-to-market success. Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations to drive successful product launches with clear positioning inputs, enablement materials, and measurable success criteria.
Apply AI to product work. Model and encourage effective use of AI tools across the PM function — for research synthesis, discovery acceleration, and roadmap analysis — while maintaining standards for rigor and sound judgment.
What You'll Bring
Degree & Experience: Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, MS, or equivalent experience preferred. 10+ years in product management with at least 4–6 years leading and developing PM teams. Demonstrated track record of owning multi-product or multi-domain strategy and delivery.
Healthcare data flows, interoperability, and informatics: Hands-on experience building or owning products that depend on healthcare data moving correctly. Working knowledge of FHIR-based interoperability, clinical data exchange, and how claims and eligibility data flow between payers and providers. Understands how informatics and data products turn raw clinical data into something actionable. Familiar with relevant standards (HL7, X12, NCPDP) and regulatory context (ONC, CMS interoperability rules).
Decision-making under complexity: Demonstrated history of making difficult tradeoffs — balancing customer requests, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technical constraints — and owning outcomes on both sides of those decisions.
Market-driven product thinking: Ability to develop multi-year roadmaps tied to market opportunities, track competitive landscapes, and anticipate emerging healthcare trends before they become obvious to the industry.
Preferred: Experience with prescription management, eligibility, or clinical affordability workflows. Exposure to PE-backed or high-growth SaaS environments.
Core Competencies
Knowledge & Application: Participates with senior leadership to establish strategic plans and objectives for the PM function. Makes final implementation decisions and ensures operational effectiveness across multiple product lines. Brings deep, practical expertise in healthcare data flows, FHIR-based interoperability, and clinical informatics — credibility that shapes both strategy and day-to-day product decisions. Accountable for outcomes that directly impact business results and the healthcare organizations that depend on Interra’s data infrastructure.
Complexity & Problem Solving: Works on complex, not clearly defined problems at the intersection of healthcare data architecture, interoperability standards, clinical workflows, regulatory requirements, and business strategy. Navigates the technical and organizational complexity of getting healthcare data to move reliably, securely, and in a form that is useful to end users. Evaluates tradeoffs across domains with long-horizon consequences (3–5 years).
Collaboration & Interaction: Engages regularly with senior management, executives, major customers, and healthcare industry stakeholders. Negotiates matters of significance; reconciles competing perspectives — clinical, operational, and commercial — to drive aligned product outcomes.
Pre-Employment Drug Screening: This position is subject to a pre-employment drug screening, where permitted by applicable law. Any required screening will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
Working Conditions
• Fully remote within the United States
Periodic travel (~20%) for team meetings, customer visits, and industry events
Operates in a fast-paced, PE-backed, post-merger SaaS environment with evolving systems and processes
🌍Remote work environment with a flexible work schedule to encourage work-life balance
✈Annual company offsite
🌴Generous leave package including flexible time off policy that encourages team members to take time off to relax and recharge; plus 13 paid holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave
💙 Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus a company funded FSA & HSA (dependent on which medical plan you choose)
💰401(k) company match
💸One-time workspace reimbursement to help you optimize your remote workspace
Interra Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Compensation Range: $215K - $265K

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, MetaDefender Endpoint
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Reports to: Chief Product Officer (CPO)
Scope: Full ownership of the MetaDefender Endpoint portfolio — commercial and community | Partners daily with global R&D | Global / Remote-friendly
The Position
Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.
We are seeking an exceptional product leader to own the vision, strategy, and execution of MetaDefender Endpoint — the endpoint foundation that delivers peripheral media protection, advanced compliance, remote access control, vulnerability detection, and patch management to secure critical assets and maintain organizational security. This is a senior leadership role with end-to-end ownership of a broad endpoint portfolio spanning multiple high-value use cases, every endpoint agent flavor across desktop and mobile, a free global community edition, and a platform strategy that other OPSWAT product lines build on. You will set the roadmap, work hands-on with top global R&D teams every day, and build the business and partnerships that scale endpoint across the globe.
The Product & Portfolio
MetaDefender Endpoint secures devices inside critical IT and OT networks and powers a portfolio of endpoint use cases. This role owns that portfolio end to end:
Peripheral Media Protection: the foundational use case — scanning and sanitizing removable media and peripheral devices before their content can be accessed, protecting devices inside critical IT and OT networks from USB and removable-media threats.
Advanced Compliance: continuous endpoint posture and compliance assessment — verifying device health, configuration, and security controls against regulatory frameworks and organizational policy, with audit-ready evidence.
Vulnerability Assessment: continuous asset inspection and file-based vulnerability assessment with CVSS-based risk prioritization to surface the vulnerabilities that matter most, before and after software is installed.
Patch Management: a strategic growth direction for the company — centralized patch management across on-premises, air-gapped, and cloud environments, automatically patching third-party applications and OS updates on flexible schedules and with audit-ready evidence.
Zero Trust Access: real-time device posture and compliance checks that feed continuous, least-privilege, per-application access — layering device health onto identity so every access decision reflects who the user is and whether their device is healthy.
Endpoint as a platform: the shared endpoint foundation that OPSWAT’s other product lines — such as Managed File Transfer, Network Access Control, and Endpoint Malware Scanning — build their endpoint capabilities on, so each team ships on a single, common endpoint architecture without losing the agility and domain expertise it owns.
The role owns every flavor of the endpoint agent — from Windows and macOS desktop clients to iOS and Android mobile apps — delivering a consistent endpoint experience across desktop and mobile platforms.
Beyond the commercial offering, this role also stewards the free MetaDefender Endpoint community — an open, no-cost download that lets anyone experience OPSWAT’s technologies firsthand — growing adoption, gathering feedback, and building a pipeline into the commercial portfolio.
About This Role
This is a hands-on, technically-engaged product leadership role — not a pure strategy or coordination seat. You own the full endpoint portfolio across its commercial use cases, every agent flavor, and its community edition, and you are accountable for the outcomes: adoption, growth, and customer success. You partner with global R&D on a day-to-day basis — in the details of architecture, prioritization, and release — and you champion the platform strategy that lets multiple use-case teams build on a shared endpoint foundation while preserving each team’s speed and expertise. You bring an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI in the day-to-day work of the team to maximize efficiency and output. You build, mentor, and lead a team of product manager, product designer, product marketing, and engineering professionals, set the bar for product excellence, and represent endpoint to customers, partners, and executive leadership.
What You Will Be Doing
Own product vision & strategy: define, refine, and champion the vision and roadmap for the MetaDefender Endpoint portfolio — compliance and patch management, zero trust access, and vulnerability management — aligned to business goals and evolving market conditions.
Drive patch and compliance as a growth engine: make centralized, cross-environment patch management (including air-gapped and OT) a flagship direction, and translate it into differentiated roadmap and go-to-market.
Champion the endpoint platform: lead the strategy to establish MetaDefender Endpoint as the single architecture that use-case teams (e.g., Managed File Transfer, Network Access Control, and Endpoint Malware Scanning) develop on — enabling reuse and consistency while protecting each team’s agility and ownership of its business goals.
Own every agent flavor: drive a consistent, high-quality endpoint experience across all agent platforms — Windows and macOS desktop clients and iOS and Android mobile apps.
Lead with an AI-first mindset: bring AI into the day-to-day work of the product organization — from research and requirements to analysis and delivery — to maximize efficiency and output across the team.
Grow and steward the community edition: own the free MetaDefender Endpoint community experience end to end — adoption, engagement, feedback loops, and conversion into commercial value.
Work hands-on with R&D: partner with global R&D teams daily — writing crisp requirements, making trade-offs, and driving execution through to high-quality, timely releases.
Build business and partnerships: develop the business case, pricing, and packaging, and cultivate technology and channel partnerships that expand endpoint’s reach and ecosystem.
Lead market & competitive analysis: stay ahead of emerging trends, assess competitive products, and identify customer needs to inform prioritization and positioning.
Drive user-centered development: advocate for the end user by gathering feedback, analyzing usage data, and driving continuous improvement in usability, functionality, and satisfaction.
Orchestrate cross-functional delivery: partner closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and support to deliver high-quality releases and seamless integration into the broader OPSWAT portfolio.
Track performance: establish clear KPIs, monitor product and adoption performance, and use insights to guide enhancements across both commercial and community.
Communicate with stakeholders: clearly articulate strategy, updates, and results to internal teams, executive leadership, and customers — fostering alignment and enthusiasm.
Build and lead the team: build, mentor, and lead a high-performing, cross-disciplinary team of product managers, product designers, product marketing, and engineering professionals, setting a strong bar for product craft and execution.
What We Need From You
Product leadership experience: 10+ years in product management with several years leading and growing PM teams, ideally within cybersecurity, endpoint, or infrastructure software.
Broad endpoint portfolio ownership: a track record managing a wide range of endpoint use cases — such as compliance, patch management, vulnerability management, and secure/zero-trust access — not a single narrow feature area.
Deep domain knowledge: strong grasp of cybersecurity, endpoint security best practices, data protection, threat prevention, patch and vulnerability management, and device posture/compliance.
Hands-on and technical: comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with R&D day to day, engaging credibly on architecture and trade-offs, and going deep in the product rather than staying at the surface.
Multi-platform endpoint experience: experience delivering endpoint or agent software across operating systems and device types — Windows and macOS desktop, and iOS and Android mobile.
Platform product thinking: experience building or evolving a shared platform that multiple teams develop on, balancing consistency and reuse with team autonomy and speed.
AI-first ways of working: an AI-first mindset — you actively apply AI tools to your own and your team’s daily work to move faster and raise quality.
Community / product-led growth: experience growing a free, community, or product-led offering and converting adoption into commercial outcomes is a strong plus.
Business & partnership builder: demonstrated ability to build the business — pricing, packaging, GTM — and to establish technology and channel partnerships.
Track record of delivery: proven experience managing products from concept through launch, with results in user adoption, revenue growth, or market penetration.
Analytical & decisive: strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a data-driven approach.
Exceptional communicator: outstanding interpersonal and executive communication skills, enabling collaboration across cross-functional teams and credibility with customers and leadership.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
Ways of working: familiarity with Agile methodologies or similar frameworks.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
Own a strategic, high-visibility portfolio at a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader — endpoint sits at the center of compliance, patch, vulnerability, and zero-trust access.
Shape a platform: the endpoint architecture and practices you establish will enable product lines across OPSWAT.
Run both a commercial business and a global free community that puts OPSWAT technology in the hands of users everywhere.
Work hands-on with world-class global R&D teams on products that protect critical infrastructure.
Global reach, a high-growth mindset, and the chance to shape products that matter.
Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.
What We Need
We are seeking a visionary Vice President of Product based in the U.S. or Ontario, Canada to lead the strategy, development, and execution of our industry-leading network automation platform powered by Agentic AI. This role is ideal for a product leader with deep expertise in enterprise networking and a strong, forward-looking point of view on how AI will transform network operations.
As VP of Product, you will define how our platform evolves to solve complex challenges for enterprise customers—bringing together automation, AI-driven intelligence, and intuitive user experiences. You will also lead a globally distributed product organization, ensuring alignment and execution across regions.
What You'll Do
Define Product Vision & Differentiation: Establish a clear, compelling product vision and articulate how we uniquely differentiate in the network automation and AI landscape.
Lead AI-Driven Innovation: Develop a strong, opinionated perspective on how Agentic AI should be applied to enterprise networks, translating that into impactful product capabilities.
Own the Product Lifecycle: Lead end-to-end product management—from ideation through launch and continuous iteration.
Lead a Global Product Organization: Oversee and mentor a distributed product team across the North America and Beijing, driving alignment, collaboration, and high-quality execution.
Drive B2B Product Excellence: Build products that address complex enterprise needs, with a deep understanding of B2B buying cycles, stakeholders, and value realization.
Customer-Centric Leadership: Translate customer insights into scalable, intuitive solutions that deliver measurable business impact.
Cross-Functional Execution: Partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure cohesive product delivery.
Market Insight & Strategy: Maintain a deep understanding of the competitive landscape, enterprise networking trends, and emerging AI capabilities.
What You Bring
B2B Product Leadership: Proven experience leading product management in B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments.
Enterprise Networking Expertise: Strong background in enterprise computer networking (e.g., network operations, infrastructure, observability, or automation).
AI Thought Leadership: A forward-thinking and well-formed point of view on applying AI—particularly Agentic AI—to enterprise systems and workflows.
Global Leadership Capability: Experience leading distributed teams across geographies, with the ability to align teams across cultures and time zones.
Bilingual Communication: Fluency in both English and Mandarin, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams.
Strategic & Conceptual Thinking: Ability to synthesize complex inputs into clear product direction and long-term vision.
Opinionated & Decisive: Brings strong product instincts and is confident forming and defending strategic perspectives.
Intuitive Problem Solver: Comfortable navigating ambiguity and identifying non-obvious solutions to complex challenges.
Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.
What We Offer
Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.
For this role, the estimated base is $250,000 - $315,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.
The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.
NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities.
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.
If you have a disability that prevents or limits your ability to use or access the site, or if you require any other accommodation in the application process due to a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation. To make a request, please contact our People Team at: and we will be happy to assist you.
In compliance with applicable laws, NetBrain conducts holistic, individual background reviews in support of all hiring decisions.
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
FLiiP is a fast-growing fitness technology company building a SaaS platform that helps gyms and fitness businesses run and grow their operations. Working at the intersection of software and the fitness industry, the team is focused on delivering technology that supports day-to-day business management while creating a strong experience for customers and end users.
We're backed by two venture capital firms that have invested CAD 4.4M in FLiiP, and we're part of the Google for Startups Accelerator. And we're just getting started.
As Director of Engineering, you will shape how engineering operates and scales as the company grows. This is a high-impact leadership role with broad reach across our web, mobile, and data engineering teams. You will be a key driver of technical excellence, team performance, and the integration of AI into our engineering DNA.
You'll report directly to the COO/CTO and work closely with Product, Design, and Customer-facing teams to ensure we ship fast, ship right, and continuously raise the bar.
Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Development
Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineers and data scientists across web, mobile, and data disciplines
Support individual growth through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development plans
Drive a culture of ownership, accountability, performance and continuous improvement
Manage hiring to scale the team as FLiiP grows
Engineering Excellence
Define and enforce engineering best practices, quality standards, and deployment processes
Manage on-call rotations and ensure system reliability
Own our SOC 2 and GDPR compliance posture from an engineering security perspective
Champion technical debt reduction and proactive platform reliability
Support your team during incident or when it is required
AI & Innovation
Lead the design and continuous improvement of our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC)
Embed AI tooling and practices across the engineering team to increase velocity and quality
Collaborate with the data science team on AI/ML product initiatives to drive innovation with product
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with Product and Design peers to align engineering execution with product strategy
Partner with Customer Success and Support to resolve escalations requiring technical depth
Report on engineering performance with clear, data-driven metrics

jobs.title: Head of Employee Tech & Experience (ETX)
jobs.text:
About the Team
Employee Tech & Experience (ETX) helps people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. Across Helpdesk, Executive Support, Systems Operations, Logistics and AV, we make technology simple, reliable and secure. Employee needs guide what we build, improve and choose to eliminate.
About the Role
Reporting to the Head of Global IT, you’ll lead ETX globally, building on the team’s capabilities and customer-zero work to continually advance the employee experience. You’ll shape ETX’s strategy, investment priorities and operating model in partnership with leadership across the company, turning new capabilities into measurable amplification. You’ll develop leaders and strengthen teams where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
This role is based at our San Francisco headquarters and requires an in-office presence.
In this role, you will:
Lead the next stage of ETX’s global growth across Helpdesk, SysOps, Logistics and AV, with a shared strategy and accountability for employee outcomes.
Continually elevate the employee experience through research and design, directing investment to simplify entire user journeys, remove unnecessary effort and amplify what employees can accomplish.
Accelerate ETX’s agent-led and customer-zero work as capabilities advance: continually challenge which workflows need to exist, extend what agents can own end to end and evolve the operating model to deliver measurable amplification.
Develop leaders who earn trust, grow others and sustain an environment where people feel valued, take pride in their work and enjoy working together. Give people meaningful ownership and opportunities to stretch and grow, with clear priorities and sustainable workloads.
Scale global services to support company growth, with clear commitments to reliability, security, responsiveness, and effective controls. Measure performance through employee effort, service quality, and time to resolution.
Shape priorities and investment with leadership across the company, accelerating execution across functions with accountability for adoption and measurable improvements in how employees work.
Translate employee friction into lasting improvements in policy, service design, and ownership. Hold ETX accountable for restoring productivity, communicating with empathy, and addressing the underlying causes of recurring failures.
You might thrive in this role if you:
Have led global organizations through growth and transformation, with measurable improvements in employee experience and reliability.
Start with what employees need. Use research and design to challenge assumptions and remove unnecessary work.
Rethink how the organization works as AI advances, expanding what agents can own and delivering measurable amplification.
Build leadership teams that help people grow, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
Set direction and investment priorities with leadership across the company. Own execution, adoption and lasting results.
The impact you’ll have
You’ll help people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. You’ll compound the impact of ETX’s agent-led work, turning advances in AI into measurable amplification, giving people back time and making technology simpler and more reliable as we grow. You’ll develop leaders who grow others, sustaining a culture where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy achieving together what once felt out of reach.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Fractional Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Catch Creation
Catch Creation is a global eCommerce company built for the digital age. We create, grow, and manage online brands that inspire customers and deliver real value through exceptional products and experiences. Our team thrives in a fully remote environment, combining creativity, data-driven strategy, and innovation to build scalable eCommerce solutions that perform.
From concept to conversion, we specialize in developing brands that stand out in competitive markets—driven by a passion for design, storytelling, and customer satisfaction. Every product we launch reflects our commitment to quality, authenticity, and growth.
At Catch Creation, we believe great ideas can come from anywhere—and our remote-first culture allows talented people from around the world to collaborate, innovate, and bring those ideas to life.
TYPE
Fractional / Contract
DURATION
6–12 Months
LOCATION
Remote — USA/Canada
HOURS/WEEK
10–20 hrs (flexible)
About Catch Creation & Muddy Mat
Catch Creation is a global e-commerce company that creates, grows, and manages online brands. Our flagship brand, Muddy Mat, is a 9-figure revenue, bootstrapped, profitable DTC pet products company the #1 selling indoor mat for cleaning dog paws, loved by millions of pet owners across America.
We operate across TV, DTC e-commerce, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and expanding retail partnerships with Home Depot, Costco, and Walmart. Our portfolio also includes Cloud K9 (anti-anxiety dog beds) and Wizz (pet stain remover). We are remote-first, lean, and move fast.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a hands-on, entrepreneurial Fractional CTO to provide senior technology leadership during a critical growth phase. You will work directly with the Founder/CEO and leadership team to own our technology strategy, lead our engineering team, and ensure our platforms can scale with the business.
This is not a consulting role where you write recommendations and disappear. We need someone who will embed with the team, make decisions, and drive execution.
What You’ll Do
Technology Strategy & Architecture
Own and execute our overall technology roadmap and platform architecture
Evaluate and recommend technology solutions that support multi-channel e-commerce growth
Ensure scalability, security, and reliability across all tech systems
Represent technology in leadership and strategic planning meetings
Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and manage our existing engineering team day-to-day
Set clear priorities, KPIs, and delivery expectations for the tech team
Identify gaps and make hiring recommendations where needed
Foster a culture of ownership, speed, and quality
Platform & Systems
Oversee and optimize our Shopify multi-store setup, including integrations, apps, and checkout flows
Manage integrations with order tracking tools, upsell/downsell sequences, and third-party platforms
Audit existing tech infrastructure and implement improvements for performance and reliability
Ensure our systems support Amazon, TikTok Shop, DRTV, and retail channel operations
What We’re Looking For
Required
Proven experience as CTO, VP Engineering, or equivalent senior tech leadership role
Deep hands-on experience with Shopify and e-commerce tech stacks at scale
Track record of building, leading, and scaling engineering teams
Experience with multi-channel e-commerce: DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop, or retail integrations
Strong communicator who can translate between technical and business teams
Based in the USA or Canada
Preferred
Prior fractional or advisory CTO experience
Familiarity with DRTV (direct response television) tech and operations
Experience at a high-growth DTC brand ($50M–$500M revenue range)
Exposure to 3PL/fulfillment tech and supply chain systems
Who You Are
You’ve done this before you know how to step into a fast-moving company, get up to speed quickly, and lead without needing hand-holding. You think like an operator, not just an architect. You’re equally comfortable reviewing a pull request and presenting a 12-month technology roadmap to the CEO.
You don’t hide behind process. You ship. You own outcomes. And you know that in a lean company, your impact is visible and immediate.
How to Apply
Please apply with your resume and a brief note covering:
Your relevant e-commerce / Shopify experience
Examples of engineering teams you’ve led
Your availability and preferred engagement structure (hours/week, start date)
Your rate or compensation expectations
We move quickly. Strong candidates will be contacted within a few business days.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Product Design - AI & Context
jobs.text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
We're looking for an experienced Design Leader to oversee our Context Platform Pillar, which homes several critical company initiatives including Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, Community, and more. Think of it as the team that drives the most important context for AI agents to help you design better products.
In this role, you'll tackle strategic challenges from building new products to evolving and scaling existing ones - all while empowering your teams to deliver ambitious, high-quality work. If you're a leader who is especially deep in understanding modern AI + Design Systems workflows, and very passionate about empowering Designers through platform-wide investments in Figma's ecosystem, this role is for you.
As a Design leader at Figma, you'll guide and grow a team of world-class designers, with the opportunity to expand this group as the scope and impact of our work evolves. In this deeply cross-functional role, you'll work in close collaboration with product management, engineering, research, marketing, and other teams to shape both product and business strategy in our next chapter.
This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
What you'll do at Figma:
Hire, manage, and develop a multi-team design group spanning Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, and Community
Partner with Product and Engineering leads in this area to improve team processes and execution and coach individual teams through setting roadmap and strategy
Develop a perspective on your team's product areas and successfully advocate for it across the organization
Lead critique, sprint, and design review practices across the pillar
Advance your own skills at people management in a supportive and growth-oriented environment
Operate hands-on across both people management and strategy and execution
We'd love to hear from you if you have:
5+ years of design management experience, ideally including experience managing managers and leading teams through ambiguity and change
Deep understanding of the latest AI developments, modern tooling, and component-driven design practices
Strong hands-on expertise with Figma's tools, with the ability to mentor and guide design teams effectively
Proven track record of partnering cross-functionally to solve complex design challenges and drive meaningful outcomes
Strong strategic thinking and communication skills, demonstrated through influencing teams, adapting quickly, and taking a proactive, solution-oriented approach
While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:
Background contributing to open-source or developer-facing design tools
Experience partnering with Research and Marketing on platform-wide initiatives
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Pay Transparency Disclosure
Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.
Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.
Annual Base Salary Range:
$290,000—$376,000 USD
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.
Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:
Holding interviews in an accessible location
Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
Changing the mode or format of interviews
To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.
By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.
Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:
Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.
Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Assure Health:
Assure Health is a fast-growing remote patient monitoring and virtual care provider that has proven to improve outcomes for patients and lower the cost of care. They are a 50-state provider network and have built a best -in-class technology platform to deliver excellent, relationship-driven care for patients with chronic conditions in collaboration with health systems and health plans.
The Role:
This is an exciting opportunity to work with a well-funded healthcare startup and build out the Engineering function. As a high-impact member of the leadership team, the VP of Engineering will be responsible for creating a world-class development organization, scaling, and leading the engineering team. The VP of Engineering will help drive the success of the overall business by collaborating with stakeholders internally and externally to set technical direction. The VP of Engineering will have been brought through the ranks as a hands-on Engineer and also have some leadership experience. This role will be both hands on and strategic. The ideal candidate will be based in South Florida, but we are open to it being remote for the right candidate.
Responsibilities:
Establish engineering processes and define our engineering standards
Identify and implement core technologies, while removing technical hurdles
Lead architecture discussions during feature development with both internal and external stakeholders (specifically clients) to ensure that projects are built in a sound, reliable, performant way.
Work cross-functionally, supporting the successful implementation of core features
Build solutions for appropriate scalability at speed
Hire, develop, and lead an A+ engineering team
Have a perfectionist-like mind, naturally monitoring and fine-tuning systems for performance
Engage in troubleshooting, testing, and maintaining core product software; optimize, scale, and improve existing code
Guiding incident response and vulnerability remediation efforts
Establish a culture of high productivity, collaboration, and big impact, and empowering each team to bring their vision to life
Provide software and technology research, analysis, and recommendations internally and to our clients
Skills and Qualifications:
7+ years of hands-on engineering experience, writing and shipping high-quality production code, especially highly reliable and scalable distributed system
Ideally 2+ years of experience recruiting, leading, and mentoring an engineering team
Engineering experience in a healthcare startup that has grown from under 50 employees to a few hundred employees is ideal
Experience building healthcare compliant systems
Experience with implementations at healthcare organizations
Experience obtaining HiTRUST certification is a plus
Worked with JavaScript, Node.js, ElectronJS, and React Native
Previous involvement with Salesforce development
Experience working with AWS and have some DevOps experience
Experience implementing core business strategies with technology by creating processes that scale, advancing architecture, and developing roadmaps
Possess a continuous improvement mindset to develop a scalable MVP and iterate in a data-driven approach
Able to execute on ideas and influence decision making in a clear and effective manner
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.
Mission
As a Director of Product on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.
This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy,, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

jobs.title: Director - Technology
jobs.text:
Role in One Breath
You'll join the Simple Machines UK leadership team as a senior technology and people leader with deep roots in software engineering. You'll help ensure the success and growth of our existing enterprise clients while opening new relationships, shaping propositions and solutions, and helping us win significant new work.
You'll provide senior technology leadership to our clients, lead major pursuits and develop our technology people, with genuine influence over what we build, what we take to market and where Simple Machines goes next in the UK and Europe.
Help lead the UK business. Grow our strategic accounts. Win new clients. Build an exceptional technology team.
What This Role Actually Involves
This is a hands-on technology leadership role. You'll be deep in the work, helping our teams and clients successfully deliver complex software engineering programmes, while leading across architecture, clients, growth and people. You'll influence as much as direct: selling ideas, building alignment and bringing clients, teams and other business units on the journey.
Engineering and delivery leadership
• Get close to our most complex software engineering engagements and help ensure they succeed
• Lead the engineering of modern software solutions, increasingly including AI-native and agentic applications and systems
• Work directly with engineers, technical leads and architects to solve difficult technical and delivery problems
• Review architecture and engineering approaches, challenge decisions and step in where senior technical leadership is needed
• Drive strong engineering practices and ensure emerging AI and agentic solutions are engineered with enterprise-grade rigour
• Own the technical quality of our work and ensure what we deliver is something we are proud to stand behind
Architecture and technical leadership
• Shape software, solution and enterprise architecture across major client programmes
• Make pragmatic architecture decisions balancing engineering quality, enterprise constraints and delivery
• Provide technical assurance across our portfolio while remaining close to the engineering
• Stay technically current and credible with our most senior engineers and architects
Clients, influence and strategic accounts
• Help ensure the continued success and growth of our strategic enterprise accounts
• Act as a trusted technology adviser to senior client stakeholders
• Sell ideas and approaches to clients and internal stakeholders, building alignment and bringing people with you
• Work across consulting, delivery, data and AI to shape joined-up solutions and propositions
• Lead difficult technology, architecture and stakeholder conversations when senior intervention is required
Go-to-market and growth
• Open new client relationships and lead early-stage technology conversations
• Turn client problems into compelling propositions, architectures and delivery approaches
• Personally shape proposals, pitches, RFPs and major pursuits
• Ensure what we sell is technically credible, commercially compelling and deliverable
• Work across Simple Machines to assemble the capabilities and support required to win and grow work
People leadership
• Lead, mentor and develop our UK technology team
• Develop senior engineers, technical leads, principal engineers and architects through real client work
• Set a high bar for engineering craft, architecture and technical leadership
• Help attract exceptional technical talent and build a high-performance, low-ego engineering culture

jobs.title: Director Product Management - Identity & Activation
jobs.text:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.
The role
We are looking for a Director Product Manager to advance our identity resolution capabilities and build future-proof identity and activation solutions. jobs.title: VP Engineering and R&D - AI Startup
jobs.text:
Are you a technology leader who is not only passionate about AI but is also excited to be at the forefront of solving one of the most challenging problems that have plagued IT for years and could result in organizations becoming highly challenged or possibly extinct as digital transformation sweeps every sector?
Are you looking for a role with the opportunity to:
Execute core research in AI knowledge management that leads to patentable technologies?
Take an idea from research to a commercially successful cloud-based enterprise software product?
Build a solution that will have a meaningful impact on one-third of the US economy - both for-profit and not-for-profit organizations?
Are you seeking the potential to:
Be the first to bring a unique combination of AI and data management to the market?
Work with experienced, successful Silicon Valley entrepreneurs with 4X startup experience leading to IPO and acquisition exits?
Be mentored by a team of research advisors known in the industry as thought leaders?
Participate in a Silicon Valley-style equity opportunity within a venture with the potential for significant value creation?
Work with a company built around a remote model before COVID-19 made it a requirement?
Give back to your community through a 1-1-1 philanthropic model as pioneered by Marc Benioff’s Salesforce?
The Essentials:
Master or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Operation Research or other equivalent quantitative fields
Experience in AI with a demonstrated understanding of expert systems, knowledge management, and digital assistants
Experience managing a team of data scientists and AI researchers and engineers using Agile methodologies and tools
Previous startup experience with a proven track record of leading teams that drive innovation and deliver products in a fast-paced, high-energy environment
Excited to work with new technologies and approaches
Experience working within an SBIR NSF (Small Business Innovation Research - National Science Foundation) Program grant award model
Responsibilities:
Get to know our customer (or know them already) and use that empathy to inform shaping the product’s vision and requirements and building an exceptional product
Serve as a thought leader and technology strategy driver along with the CEO and Co-Founders to make decisions on the product technology architecture including building block components - with a preference for open source technologies
Build, build, build - especially in the early days, you will be rolling up your sleeves and writing code, from core platform to fixing bugs
Help form a top-performing team of talented and responsible software engineers, data scientists and product designers, and provide them the freedom to be creative and innovative
Lead product engineering including research and development of unique proprietary and patentable intellectual property that yields competitive advantages
Embody the company’s culture and mission by fostering a culture that is passionate about building awesome products that deliver measurable value and a customer experience that delights
Evangelize the company’s technology vision, roadmap and capabilities with customers, investors, employees, and other stakeholders
Stay current on technology advances in the field of AI - especially digital assistants, knowledge engineering, data-driven reasoning, expert systems - and in the field of data management - including column databases and other advanced decision analytics technologies
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
C-PLan.IT is an early stage startup on a mission to enable mid-market organizations to measure and maximize value from IT investments. We are building an AI Digital Assistant delivered as-a service in real time to support IT investment decision making and value optimization.
Unlike competitive solutions that focus on cost or asset management only C-Plan.IT specializes in IT investment management with a particular focus on digital transformation objectives.
The benefits of using C-Plan.IT increase as the platform’s membership grows toward the bold goal of becoming the world’s largest IT investment platform with $100B annual IT investments under management across 2000 organizations in the next 10 years.
Privately funded, we are a fully remote company with a 100% distributed team allowing us to hire the best people regardless of where they are located.
