jobs.title: Director Of Engineering - Platform Services
jobs.text:
About Truveta
Truveta is the world’s first health provider-led data platform, with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care.
Achieving this vision requires a talented and diverse team with expertise across healthcare, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and artificial intelligence. We are looking for people who are motivated by purposeful work and committed to building technology that can improve healthcare outcomes.
This position is based in Hyderabad, India.
Who We Need
Truveta is expanding its engineering presence in India to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges at global scale. We are seeking a collaborative and experienced engineering leader who can operate effectively across ambiguity, scale, and evolving requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. You should be comfortable balancing hands-on technical leadership with people management and working with distributed teams across India and the United States.
If you are motivated by purposeful work, enjoy building teams and platforms from the ground up, and want to shape how data, AI, and engineering systems are powered internally, Truveta may be the right fit for you.
This Opportunity
We are seeking a Director Of Engineering (POD Lead) to lead the Platform Services team in India.
The Platform Services team will build, manage, and operate the infrastructure that supports engineering teams across India and globally. The team will also own critical backend and platform services, including authentication, authorization, customer and consumer identity and access management, CI/CD, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, developer productivity tools, observability, and shared engineering services.
These services form the backbone of Truveta’s engineering platform and have dependencies across multiple Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Product, and Security teams.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role with people-management responsibilities. You will be accountable for technical direction, delivery excellence, platform reliability, and team growth. You will work closely with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams in India and the United States.
What You’ll Do
Technical and Platform Leadership
Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Platform Services and internal engineering platforms.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure and backend services.
Guide architecture decisions across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, identity, security, developer tooling, and shared services.
Build and operate platforms that support engineering, data, machine learning, annotation, and internal workflow requirements.
Lead the development and management of Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud-native services.
Build and improve authentication, authorization, identity management, and access control services.
Drive the development of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code, and developer self-service capabilities.
Establish engineering standards for system design, API development, testing, code quality, observability, and operational readiness.
Improve platform availability, scalability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and operational efficiency.
Provide hands-on technical guidance through design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, production-readiness reviews, and incident responses.
Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term platform scalability, maintainability, and technical health.
Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce operational overhead, and improve engineering productivity.
Product and Delivery Leadership
Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and define priorities.
Translate business and engineering needs into clear technical strategies, milestones, and delivery plans.
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple platform initiatives.
Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively address execution risks.
Define and track success metrics related to platform adoption, reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions to stakeholders and senior leadership.
POD and People Leadership
Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team in India.
Provide technical direction, coaching, and support to engineers at different career levels.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Establish effective processes for planning, execution, prioritization, and retrospective learning.
Encourage engineers to take ownership of services throughout their lifecycle, from design and development through production operations.
Create an inclusive environment where team members can contribute, learn, and grow.
Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration
Work closely with engineering teams across India and the United States to develop shared platforms and services.
Partner effectively with U.S.-based stakeholders across time zones.
Represent the India Platform Services team in architecture, planning, and organizational forums.
Serve as a key technical voice in discussions about platform strategy, engineering effectiveness, and future growth.
Build strong relationships with internal customers and ensure that platform services meet the needs of the broader organization.
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years of experience in technical leadership, engineering management, or people management.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for shared platforms, infrastructure, backend services, or developer tooling.
Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and production-grade backend services.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies.
Strong understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, service discovery, and infrastructure operations.
Experience building engineering infrastructure, internal platforms, workflow-heavy systems, or developer productivity tools.
Experience with authentication, authorization, identity management, or security-focused backend services.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Go, Python, or similar.
Experience with modern API architectures, microservices, event-driven systems, and service integration patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence.
Familiarity with open-source technologies and the ability to evaluate and adopt open-source solutions.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices and Agile delivery methods.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, clinical data, or other highly regulated domains.
Experience building platforms that support data engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or annotation workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or other major cloud platforms.
Experience with identity and access management technologies and protocols such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
Experience with service mesh, API gateways, secrets management, policy enforcement, and zero-trust security models.
Experience defining service-level objectives, reliability standards, and platform maturity models.
Experience leading teams through significant organizational or platform growth.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering organizations.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, cost management, and optimization.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
We're hiring a VP of Engineering to take full ownership of one of our core engineering domains. You'll report to our CTO and own your domain outright, including strategy, architecture, delivery, and the team. This is a hands-on leadership role.
Responsibilities
Take full technical and delivery ownership of a core area of the business, which could span AI, trading, retail, or another part of the platform
Architect and build the core systems in your domain, from real-time generation and demand modelling through to high-volume consumption pipelines and the customer-facing app
Build and lead the engineering team in your domain, including hiring, structure, and standards
Set technical direction alongside the CTO and the wider leadership team
Ship alongside your team on the hardest problems

jobs.title: Director of Engineering- Integrated Sensor Team
jobs.text:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM
The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.
Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB
As Director of Engineering for GenLogs’ Integrated Sensor team, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling the hardware and software systems at the heart of our sensing network.
This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and cloud/software platforms. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.
You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.
This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.
WHAT YOU’LL DO Lead & Develop the Engineering Organization
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and software engineering.
Build a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.
Set Technical Direction
Define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture for the Integrated Sensor product line across hardware, edge, and cloud systems.
Guide architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across the full product lifecycle.
Ensure engineering investments balance near-term product delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
Establish engineering standards and practices that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution.
Partner with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that can improve the product and engineering organization.
Drive Product Delivery
Partner closely with Product and Deployment to translate business and customer requirements into executable engineering plans.
Own engineering execution against product and technology roadmaps, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and delivery expectations.
Create effective planning and development processes that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Remove organizational and technical blockers and ensure teams maintain a strong bias toward action.
Ensure hardware and software development are coordinated effectively across design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish mechanisms for learning from field deployments and incorporating operational feedback into product and engineering decisions.
Build Reliable, Scalable Systems
Ensure the Integrated Sensor platform is designed for reliability in demanding, real-world field environments.
Drive improvements in system availability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience.
Establish rigorous testing and validation practices across hardware, embedded software, and cloud systems.
Partner with Deployment and Operations to improve installation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of deployed systems.
Develop processes for diagnosing and resolving complex production and field issues with urgency and ownership.
Ensure engineering teams build systems that can scale from current deployments to a national-level sensing network.
Collaborate Across the Company
Serve as the senior engineering partner to Product leadership for the Integrated Sensor product line.
Work closely with Deployment to ensure engineering solutions are practical, supportable, and optimized for real-world deployment.
Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to ensure sensor systems produce accurate, reliable, and usable data.
Communicate technical strategy, roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to company leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment around technical and business priorities.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading engineering teams and organizations.
5+ years of people management experience, including experience managing senior engineers and/or engineering managers.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across two or more of the following: hardware, embedded systems, edge computing, backend software, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
Experience building and operating products that combine physical hardware with software systems.
Proven experience scaling engineering teams, processes, and technical infrastructure as a company or product grows.
Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production systems.
Experience establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence.

blocks.text: GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM

The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.

Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB

As Director of Engineering for GenLogs’ Integrated Sensor team, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling the hardware and software systems at the heart of our sensing network.

This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and cloud/software platforms. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.

You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.

This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.

items: Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team spanning hardware, embedded/edge software, and software engineering.
Build a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.

jobs.title: Engineering Director - Platform
jobs.text:
We are looking for an Engineering Director to own the technology platform behind the GoMining ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep engineering expertise with strong product and business thinking.
You will own the Platform end-to-end — technology strategy, architecture, engineering organization, roadmap, reliability, delivery, and its impact on the wider business.
The Platform powers multiple GoMining products and includes core application infrastructure, authentication and authorization, integrations, shared services, analytics infrastructure, user restrictions, native applications, reliability, and other foundational capabilities.
This is not a role where success is measured simply by uptime, delivery, or engineering output.
We expect the Engineering Director to understand where technology creates or limits business value, make trade-offs between long-term architecture and immediate commercial priorities, and build a platform that allows the entire company to move faster.
Responsibilities
Platform Strategy & Architecture
Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GoMining Platform.
Build scalable shared infrastructure used across multiple products and engineering teams.
Define which capabilities should be centralized at Platform level and which should remain within individual product teams.
Drive major architectural and technical decisions.
Identify scalability and architectural bottlenecks before they become business-critical.
Balance long-term platform investments with immediate product and commercial priorities.
Reliability & Engineering Excellence
Own platform reliability, availability, latency, scalability, and operational performance.
Define and improve SLAs, DORA metrics, engineering performance, and incident-management practices.
Improve release stability, engineering velocity, and system resilience.
Lead post-incident improvements and eliminate systemic reliability issues.
Maintain a high engineering bar without unnecessary bureaucracy.
Core Platform Capabilities
Own shared authentication, authorization, registration, and 2FA infrastructure.
Develop common account controls, user restrictions, and security mechanisms.
Own integrations and shared backend capabilities required across GoMining products.
Develop shared analytics and event infrastructure.
Support common infrastructure across web and native applications.
Partner with Product, Design, Security, and engineering teams on cross-company capabilities.
Product & Business Impact
Platform at GoMining is not an isolated infrastructure function.
You will work directly with product leaders, General Managers, and C-level stakeholders to understand where technology can unlock growth and where platform limitations are holding the business back.
Prioritize engineering initiatives based on technical risk and business impact.
Understand how platform decisions affect revenue, conversion, customer experience, and product velocity.
Identify technical changes that can unlock meaningful business results.
Balance competing priorities across multiple product teams.
Make clear trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security, and business value.
Measure Platform not only through technical metrics, but through how effectively it accelerates the company.
Engineering Leadership
Lead and develop the Platform engineering organization.
Own team structure, hiring, performance, priorities, and execution.
Build a culture of strong engineering ownership and accountability.
Stay close enough to architecture and technology to challenge decisions and make informed trade-offs.
Develop strong technical leaders within the team.
Raise the technical and execution bar across the organization.
AI-First Engineering
Actively use AI tools and agents in your own work.
Introduce AI-assisted workflows across engineering, specifications, QA, analytics, and operations.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work.
Use AI to increase engineering velocity and quality.
Build a team where AI becomes part of the engineering operating model.

jobs.title: VP, Data Operations & Governance (f/m/x)
jobs.text:
CEPRESis the leading and fastest growing digital investmentplatform for private capital markets, an institutional asset class which becamevery relevant in global investment portfolios of sovereign wealth fund,insurances, pension plans and others. This global institutional client basebenefit from our award-winning investment solutions for their investmentactivities while we connect via the CEPRES platform thousands of professionalsto the largest private investment network worldwide.
CEPRESGmbH / Corp is headquartered in Munich and New York,with additional offices in Denver, Heidelberg, and several locations in middleeast. Our team is incredibly diverse with over 20 nationalities globally. Wevalue smart and innovative people who also work effectively in a teamenvironment and who are global players.
Role Overview
The VP, Data Operations &Governance is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing theend-to-end lifecycle of investment data across the CEPRES Platform. This roleleads global data operations and analyst teams, driving the collection,processing, validation, and delivery of high-quality investment data whilecontinuously improving efficiency, scalability, and accuracy.
The VP will focus on optimizingdata operations to meet evolving client and business requirements, ensuringprocesses, workflows, and data delivery capabilities support a high-qualityclient experience. This includes establishing KPIs and SLAs to maintainconsistent quality, productivity, turnaround times, and service performanceacross global operations.
The role is also responsible forbuilding and developing a high-performing global organization, fosteringaccountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Byleveraging process improvements, automation, and scalable operating models, theVP will drive operational effectiveness while ensuring CEPRES can supportincreasing client demands and business growth.
Working closely with Product,Engineering, Commercial teams, and senior leadership, the VP will act as a keybridge between client needs and data operations, translating clientrequirements into scalable operational solutions and data delivery enhancementswhile ensuring the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and service.
Experience with privatemarkets or financial data is strongly preferred.
Key Responsibilities
Data Operations & Quality
Lead anddevelop a high-performing global data management organization, including dataanalysts and operations specialists, ensuring the capabilities, processes, andaccountability needed to deliver high-quality financial data and operationalexcellence.
Driveoperational performance by managing KPIs and SLAs that support clientrequirements, data quality standards, delivery timelines, and overall serviceexcellence.
Lead thealignment and standardization of operational reporting, KPI definitions, andperformance measures across the data organization, ensuring consistentperformance tracking and continuous process improvement.
Establishscalable processes and tools that ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness,and timeliness across all datasets.
Optimize datamanagement processes from end-to-end within the data value flow to increaseefficiency and reduce cost.
Create aculture of continuous improvement, using KPIs, and automation to optimizeworkflows and elevate data quality.
Drive adoptionof documentation, standardization, and best practices across the data analystfunction.
Ensure fullcompliance with data governance, privacy, and security frameworks
Build and runKPI driven data flow and quality measurement systems that optimizesproductivity serving as a basis for senior management reporting.
Developcapacity and workforceplans aligned with business demand, ensuring the right organizationalstructure, skills, and resources are in place to support growth.
Ensuresuccessful execution of contractual commitments by overseeing service deliveryperformance, monitoring compliance with agreed SLAs and obligations, andproactively addressing risks to client satisfaction and business outcomes.
Technology and AI
Drive adoptionof emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI tools, to improve dataquality, automation, and decision-making capabilities.
Partner with tech,product, and business leadership to prioritize data initiatives and ensuretimely, high-quality delivery.
Establish andenforce data governance, quality, and security standards across all systems andteams.
Governance, Quality &Compliance
Driveinitiatives to measure and improve data quality, consistency, andcompleteness.
Implement andenforce data governance policies, data access controls, and lineage trackingwhile ensuring CEPRES’ strict data compliance and security regulations.
Stakeholder Enablement &Collaboration
Serve as astrategic partner to product, engineering, commercial, and executiveteams.
Provideinternal and external stakeholders with the tools, documentation, and trainingneeded to work effectively with data.
Requirements
Required:
Bachelor’s ormaster’s degree in computer science / engineering or equivalent, MBA in financeand related subjects in place
10+ years of relatedexperience in data operations, stewardship or Data Strategy, governance and/oranalytics, with 5+ years in a team leadership role.
Strongunderstanding of data pipelines and related technologies and software deliverylifecycle processes.
Good grasp onthe new LLM technologies and practical application to data products andworkflows.
Proven abilityto manage custom, client-facing analysis and project delivery in a financial orB2B environment.
Solid grasp ofdata privacy and security standards in terms of data governance
Excellentcommunication and collaboration skills with both technical and commercialstakeholders.
Strong projectand operational management capabilities, with the ability to prioritizecompeting demands, manage risks, and drive continuous process improvement.
Preferred:
Background in privatemarkets, asset management, venture capital, or investment data.
Proven trackrecord of leading data engineering/data science teams at scale, with theability to translate business strategy into a technical data roadmap andinfluence senior stakeholders
Benefits
Career Path in Private MarketsJoin a fast‑growing company in one of the most dynamic areas of finance. You will learn from an international team, receive regular feedback, and have opportunities to grow your responsibilities over time.
Culture That Drives OwnershipWe value collaboration, transparency, and an entrepreneurial mindset—people who take initiative, deliver results, and support each other.
Commitment to Our PeopleA diverse, inclusive, and international workplace with benefits and support designed to help you thrive.
Attractive compensation packagethat reflects your skills, contributions, and growth potential.
At CEPRES, we're committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We celebrate diversity and encourage applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply.

Votre rôle
Relevant du directeur général, vous dirigerez toute l’équipe produit et technologie et serez responsable de la feuille de route et de la livraison. Vous définirez avec le directeur général les orientations produit, les priorités majeures et les investissements structurants, tout en exerçant votre autonomie sur les décisions courantes et l’exécution.

Piloter la feuille de route à partir des échanges clients, des données d’utilisation et des objectifs commerciaux. Collaborer avec les ventes et le service client, puis mesurer l’adoption et l’impact.
Diriger l’exécution : définir la portée, organiser les priorités, lever les obstacles et accompagner l’équipe jusqu’à la mise en production et à la validation des résultats.
Programmer et livrer certaines fonctionnalités, en respectant les exigences de tests, de revue de code et de sécurité. Créer aussi des prototypes et des outils internes.

ProgressionLIVE develops web and mobile software for field service operations, used by hundreds of Canadian organizations across HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction, transportation, and maintenance.
Your role
Reporting to the General Manager, you will lead the full product and technology team and own the roadmap and delivery. You will jointly agree with the General Manager on product direction, major priorities, and significant investments, while exercising autonomy over day to day product decisions and execution.
You will combine product judgment, team leadership, and direct technical contribution. Your software development experience will enable you to coach developers, build their AI skills, and personally code and ship selected product features. You will draw on the team’s expertise for specialized technical decisions.
Your responsibilities
Own the roadmap, drawing on customer conversations, usage data, and business objectives. Collaborate with sales and customer service, then measure adoption and impact.
Lead execution: define scope, sequence priorities, remove obstacles, and guide the team through release and validation of results.
Personally code and ship selected features, meeting testing, code review, and security standards. Build prototypes and internal tools as needed.
Recruit and develop the team. Coach developers through pair programming, code reviews, training, and knowledge sharing.
Define and lead an AI enabled operating model for product and engineering. Empower developers, QA, and DevOps to use AI effectively across the full development lifecycle, from research and specification through implementation, testing, code review, documentation, debugging, deployment, and incident response.
Identify and automate repetitive or low-value activities. Prototype high-leverage agentic workflows and internal tools, evaluating them based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, reliability, and team capacity, not just adoption rates.
Establish practical standards for responsible AI use (security, privacy, IP, quality, accountability). Build a culture of experimentation while ensuring people remain accountable for correctness and security.
Identify customer-facing AI opportunities that create meaningful, differentiated value, distinguishing genuine capabilities from novelty-driven features. Partner with customers and the team to validate and prioritize.
Balance new capabilities, technical debt, reliability, and security. Evaluate tradeoffs with the team and maintain clear quality and privacy standards.
Our technology environment
Java, Spring, Hibernate, Vue 3, TypeScript, AWS, GitHub Actions, and Terraform. Our mobile applications support offline use and synchronization. Experience with every technology is not required.

jobs.title: Head of Product - B2C
jobs.text:
Renmoney Microfinance Bank is on a mission to empower individuals and businesses across Nigeria by building a comprehensive financial ecosystem. From lending and savings to insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle services, we are creating innovative solutions that drive financial inclusion and economic growth.
Your Mission
As Chief Product Officer (CPO), you will own the vision and strategic direction of Renmoney’s retail product ecosystem. This includes core lending and banking products, as well as adjacent services such as insurance, remittances, and lifestyle solutions. Given the seniority of the CPO position and its strategic impact on the business, the role requires relocation to Lagos, Nigeria for the on-site work in the headquarters of the company.
You will work closely with the executive team to:
Drive product innovation and profitability.
Enhance customer experience and adoption.
Ensure products are competitive, compliant, and scalable in Nigeria’s fast-evolving financial services landscape.
You will lead multidisciplinary teams across Product Management, Design, Data, and Technology — ensuring that what we build creates measurable value for customers, partners, and the business.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Vision
Define and deliver Renmoney’s ecosystem product strategy, balancing growth, profitability, and risk.
Translate market opportunities into scalable product roadmaps across lending, banking services, insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle.
Stay ahead of regulatory requirements and competitive dynamics in Nigeria.
Product Development & Execution
Lead the design and rollout of customer-centric products tailored to Nigeria’s retail segments.
Champion research, data analytics, and customer feedback to shape product decisions.
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital channels to improve efficiency and customer experience.
Establish robust product governance and compliance processes.
Ecosystem & Partnerships
Build and manage strategic partnerships with fintechs, telcos, insurers, remittance providers, and lifestyle platforms.
Develop cross-sell, bundled, and embedded finance opportunities that expand customer value.
Negotiate favorable commercial terms that balance growth and cost efficiency.
Leadership & Performance
Lead and grow a high-performing product team with a culture of accountability, innovation, and delivery.
Partner with Risk, Finance, and Collections to optimize pricing, yields, impairments, and capital allocation.
Track and report KPIs: adoption, profitability, NPS/CSAT, revenue contribution, and ecosystem expansion.

jobs.title: VP, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Vice President, Software Engineering — Seven Bridges
Location: Remote. US preferred. India or EMEA candidates considered.
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Who are we?
Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. Seven Bridges, Pierian, and UgenTec came together to form Velsera; we are headquartered in Boston, MA, with [current headcount] colleagues across [current country count] countries.
The Seven Bridges Platform is our research genomics platform — roughly 130 containerized services, multi-cloud, running in commercial and FedRAMP Moderate environments, where scientists run CWL, WDL, and Nextflow workflows over petabyte-scale genomic data. Current priorities are federated data management, compliance as a product capability, and governed AI.
Reporting line and scope
You report to the CTO and own engineering for the Seven Bridges Platform: architecture, delivery, and production operations, including reliability, cost, technical debt, and observability. The team is primarily in India, with a smaller group in Serbia; you lead across both sites and work daily with stakeholders in other time zones. You hold architecture authority for the platform, co-own boundary decisions with security, federal compliance, and quality leadership, and partner with a cross-business AI Engineering team.
The role is roughly 40% hands-on technical work and 60% people leadership and organizational delivery. Hands-on means owning architecture decisions of record, leading design reviews, reviewing code and infrastructure changes, and prototyping where needed. You should be credible to your most senior engineers, with a clear view of what this class of platform should become and the ability to take a team and a business there.
What will you do?
Own the technical vision for the platform over the next three years, and turn it into an architecture and roadmap the team and the business believe in.
Own architecture decisions of record, design reviews, multi-tenant isolation, and complexity reduction across the service estate.
Keep delivery governed and modern: infrastructure-as-code under CI with policy-as-code, short-lived credentials, progressive rollout, and change evidence that holds up to audit in a federally authorized environment.
Own reliability: SLOs and error budgets on the paths customers depend on, on-call design that works across two sites, and turning repeat incidents into architectural change.
Ship governed AI in the product and apply AI to how the team builds, both under a governance policy co-owned with Risk & Compliance, and both measured.
Build the team: management depth you can trust with delivery, the specialist skills the roadmap needs, and maintaining a thriving team through a period of growth.
Requirements
What do you bring to the table?
Must have
12+ years in software engineering, including several years leading multi-team organizations through managers.
Distributed-systems and platform architecture ownership at scale — multi-tenant isolation, service decomposition, and the judgment to reduce complexity.
Domain depth in scientific or biomedical data platforms — genomics, bioinformatics, life sciences, or comparable data-intensive, workflow-driven scientific computing.
Delivery inside a regulatory boundary such as FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or GxP.
Reliability and modern delivery engineering: SLOs, error budgets, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with policy-as-code and progressive rollout.
Production AI/LLM capability shipped under a compliance regime, or AI-assisted engineering you landed, governed and measured — beyond pilots.
A track record of setting technical vision for a platform and carrying an organization there.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have
CWL/WDL/Nextflow, GA4GH standards (DRS/WES), FHIR or OMOP.
Federated or cross-institutional data access at scale — bringing analysis to data held by someone else.
Federal program delivery and artifact literacy — authorization packages, significant-change requests, and corrective-action plans.
Architecture depth in inference topology: hosting trade-offs, retrieval that inherits per-tenant authorization, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails.
Shipping reusable product capability out of grant- or program-funded work.
Competences
Vision
The ability to step back from the daily routine, explore ideas for the future, and see the platform in a broader context and in the longer term.
articulates where the platform must be in three years, and why
combines scientific, regulatory, and technology trends into one coherent direction
spots opportunities for the platform early and acts on them
Technical Depth
Personal command of the technology the platform is built on, enough to shape and challenge its biggest decisions.
reads code, designs, and test results first-hand rather than relying on summaries
changes a team’s technical direction with evidence rather than authority
is treated as a peer by senior engineers in design review
Managing
The ability to lead and develop others so they perform at their best — setting direction, providing the means, and holding the bar.
builds a management layer capable of running delivery without them, then holds it accountable
makes hiring and performance decisions promptly and explains them plainly
builds confidence and momentum and creates a thriving team environment
Focus on Quality
Setting high standards and treating quality, security, and compliance as design constraints rather than gates to be cleared.
designs for auditability, traceability, and reproducibility from the outset
converts recurring incidents into architectural and process change
declines shortcuts that would trade a compliance position for a delivery date
Decision Quality Under Ambiguity
The ability to make timely, defensible decisions on incomplete information, and to revisit them when the evidence changes.
commits to a sequence when the data is partial, and states what would change their mind
separates reversible from irreversible decisions and spends attention accordingly
records the reasoning as well as the outcome
Benefits
Our core values
People first. We create collaborative and supportive environments by operating with respect and flexibility to promote mental, emotional and physical health. We practice empathy by treating others the way they want to be treated and assuming positive intent. We are proud of our inclusive diverse team and humble ourselves to learn about and build our connection with each other.
Patient focused. We act with swift determination without sacrificing our expectations of quality. We are driven by providing exceptional solutions for our customers to positively impact patient lives. Considering what is at stake, we challenge ourselves to develop the best solution, not just the easy one.
Integrity. We hold ourselves accountable and strive for transparent communication to build trust amongst ourselves and our customers. We take ownership of our results as we know what we do matters and collectively we will change the healthcare industry. We are thoughtful and intentional with every customer interaction understanding the overall impact on human health.
Curious. We ask questions and actively listen in order to learn and continuously improve. We embrace change and the opportunities it presents to make each other better. We strive to be on the cutting edge of science and technology innovation by encouraging creativity.
Impactful. We take our social responsibility with the seriousness it deserves and hold ourselves to a high standard. We improve our sustainability by encouraging discussion and taking action as it relates to our natural, social and economic resource footprint. We are devoted to our humanitarian mission and look for new ways to make the world a better place.
Velsera is an Equal Opportunity Employer:
Velsera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information

items: CWL/WDL/Nextflow, GA4GH standards (DRS/WES), FHIR or OMOP.
Federated or cross-institutional data access at scale — bringing analysis to data held by someone else.
Federal program delivery and artifact literacy — authorization packages, significant-change requests, and corrective-action plans.
Architecture depth in inference topology: hosting trade-offs, retrieval that inherits per-tenant authorization, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails.
Shipping reusable product capability out of grant- or program-funded work.

blocks.text: Competences
Vision
The ability to step back from the daily routine, explore ideas for the future, and see the platform in a broader context and in the longer term.

items: articulates where the platform must be in three years, and why
combines scientific, regulatory, and technology trends into one coherent direction
spots opportunities for the platform early and acts on them

blocks.text: Technical Depth
Personal command of the technology the platform is built on, enough to shape and challenge its biggest decisions.

items: reads code, designs, and test results first-hand rather than relying on summaries
changes a team’s technical direction with evidence rather than authority
is treated as a peer by senior engineers in design review

blocks.text: Managing
The ability to lead and develop others so they perform at their best — setting direction, providing the means, and holding the bar.

items: builds a management layer capable of running delivery without them, then holds it accountable
makes hiring and performance decisions promptly and explains them plainly
builds confidence and momentum and creates a thriving team environment

blocks.text: Focus on Quality
Setting high standards and treating quality, security, and compliance as design constraints rather than gates to be cleared.

items: designs for auditability, traceability, and reproducibility from the outset
converts recurring incidents into architectural and process change
declines shortcuts that would trade a compliance position for a delivery date

blocks.text: Decision Quality Under Ambiguity
The ability to make timely, defensible decisions on incomplete information, and to revisit them when the evidence changes.

items: commits to a sequence when the data is partial, and states what would change their mind
separates reversible from irreversible decisions and spends attention accordingly
records the reasoning as well as the outcome

jobs.title: Director, Product (M/F/X)
jobs.text:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française
Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !
Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s
HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !
Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.
Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !
L'opportunité:
HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients.
Vos missions:
Construire et développer une équipe produit performante
Fédérer, inspirer et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire — en posant une vision claire, en instaurant des rythmes de travail qui permettent d'avancer vite, et en investissant dans les personnes qui porteront le prochain chapitre de HelloFresh France.
Définir et challenger la vision produit
Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français.
Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes.
Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact.
Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale
Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence.
Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale.
Aligner produit et stratégie marketing
Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente.
Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi.
Votre profil:
Expérience : 8 à 10 ans minimum dans le Produit, la Stratégie ou un rôle de leadership commercial similaire, idéalement dans l'alimentaire, le FMCG, les meal kits ou l'abonnement.
Outils : Maîtrise avancée d'Excel / Google Sheets et de PowerPoint / Google Slides ; curiosité et aisance avec l'IA indispensables.
Leadership : Au moins 3 ans de management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires à différents niveaux de carrière — avec un vrai sens du coaching, une direction claire et l'envie de faire grandir les gens
Un(e) leader qui passe à l'action. Vous donnez le cap, vous emmenez votre équipe avec vous, et vous mettez la main à la pâte pour que ça se concrétise.
Orienté(e) client et rigoureux(se) dans l'analyse. À l'aise pour interroger vos propres données et challenger vos hypothèses. Capable d'aller dans le détail, de faire le lien avec la vision d'ensemble, et de restituer les insights avec clarté.
Orienté(e) business. Vous comprenez comment les décisions produit se répercutent sur les coûts et les revenus — et vous vous tenez responsable des résultats, pas seulement des réalisations.
Fédérateur(rice) transversal(e). Vous installez rapidement la confiance, faites avancer les choses par l'influence, et savez inscrire les bonnes priorités dans les agendas des autres équipes.
Bon(ne) résolveur(se) de problèmes — à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté, déterminé(e) à trouver des solutions, avec un réflexe naturel pour l'action.
Excellent(e) communicant(e). Vous écrivez et présentez avec clarté et conviction — que ce soit pour un narratif stratégique, une mise à jour pour le leadership ou un brief produit.
Organisé(e) et structuré(e), avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité à tenir des délais serrés.
Passionné(e) de food, avec la capacité à transformer les tendances et les signaux marché en offres produit attractives.
Ce que nous t’offrons :
Un environnement dynamique et international, avec une culture d'entreprise forte
Une courbe d’apprentissage rapide garantie !
Une équipe française bienveillante, passionnée, proactive et dynamique
Des bureaux au cœur de Paris, dans le 1er arrondissement
Nos avantages : de délicieuses réductions sur nos Box HelloFresh, tickets restaurant Swile, réduction sur le transport, un accès privilégié à Gymlib
Le déroulé du processus de recrutement :
Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c’est un match, nous t’invitons à une série d’entretiens et à réaliser un case study. Nous nous engageons à organiser rapidement les entretiens, afin de t’accueillir chez HelloFresh au plus vite !
Tes débuts chez HelloFresh :
A ton arrivée, nous te concoctons des sessions d’onboarding qui te permettront de rencontrer chaque manager et de t’imprégner ainsi du fonctionnement de HelloFresh. Tu auras aussi du temps pour faire plus ample connaissance avec ton équipe avant de plonger dans le vif de tes missions !

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO - AI Catalyst Discovery Venture
jobs.text:
The Venture
Discovering a better catalyst still runs on trial and error: form a hypothesis, synthesise a few candidates, test, repeat, for years, at a cost measured in millions. Most of the search space is never touched. It is one of the slowest, most expensive bottlenecks between the chemicals industry and a lower-carbon future.
We're building the company to change that. Spun out of A*STAR, our platform closes the loop between computation and the lab: machine learning proposes catalyst compositions worth making, simulation screens them, and an automated experimental workflow validates the winners, feeding every result back to sharpen the next cycle. It reaches candidates a traditional programme never would, in a fraction of the time and cost.
The beachhead is CO₂ to methanol and green chemicals, where industry pull is real and the economics work. Most catalyst work is improving a recipe that already exists, and the incumbent supplier usually keeps that business. The opportunity is a new process with no incumbent catalyst, and an unusual number of those are arriving between now and 2030. The core discovery IP is being licensed from A*STAR, with the inventor on board as an advisor. What the venture needs now is a founding technical leader to own the science and build the company around it.
The Role
You'll be the founding CTO. You'll own everything from the discovery campaign to a catalyst a customer can actually run in their process, taking a validated workflow and turning it into the engine of a real business. You'll work alongside a commercial co-founder (CEO), a dedicated ATUM venture team, and the inventor-advisor.
Together, we'll:
Direct the catalysis: which chemistries we pursue, how we design the discovery campaigns, how we read the results
Own the licensed workflow and the automated experimental loop end to end
Take candidates from prediction to a manufacturable, deployable catalyst, not a paper
Build defensible IP the company owns, including new catalyst compositions worth patenting
Sit across the table from chemical customers and turn their process problems into targets we can solve
Build the lab foundation and the science team behind it
This is not a job. It's a founding journey where you share the risk, the upside, and the impact.

jobs.title: Corporate Vice President - Enterprise PKI & Cryptographic Engineering
jobs.text:
Location Designation: Hybrid - 3 days per quarter
Technology, Data, AI and Ventures:
Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes.
Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world-class financial services company competes in the AI era - all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last.
The Corporate Vice President – Enterprise PKI & Cryptographic Engineering is a senior, hands-on technical leader accountable for the architecture, engineering, and modernization of New York Life's enterprise Public Key Infrastructure, certificate lifecycle, and cryptographic services across data center, cloud (AWS, Azure, and GCP), applications, devices, workloads, and non-human identities. This is a builder role, not a purely advisory one: you'll move from architecture into hands-on design, automation, and production delivery.
You'll own PKI and certificate lifecycle automation end to end, serve as the CISO organization's PKI and cryptographic subject matter expert for the Security Review Board and IS Exception process, and help position NYL for cryptographic agility and post-quantum readiness.
What You'll Do:
Design, engineer, and modernize enterprise PKI services and trust hierarchies — offline root CAs, issuing/subordinate CAs, and cloud-native issuance — spanning users, applications, devices, workloads, APIs, and non-human identities.
Engineer and administer Microsoft AD CS, including CA configuration, certificate templates, auto-enrollment, trust chains, CRLs, OCSP, and recovery capabilities.
Own Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM): drive discovery, inventory, issuance, renewal, revocation, and reporting from fragmented manual processes toward centralized, policy-driven automation.
Build automation and reusable, self-service certificate APIs using ACME, SCEP, EST, REST, PowerShell, and Python; integrate with ServiceNow, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and DevOps tooling.
Engineer HSM/KMS backed CA and signing services, including key ceremonies, backup, rotation, access control, and disaster recovery, across on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Serve as the PKI and cryptographic engineering subject-matter expert for the Security Review Board and Architecture Review Board, and provide authoritative technical risk recommendations on IS Exception requests.
Maintain strong knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID where they intersect with certificate services, certificate-based authentication, device identity, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management.
Maintain the enterprise cryptographic inventory and drive cryptographic agility, short-lived certificates, and post-quantum migration readiness.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data & Digital Product Architecture
jobs.text:
Job Description
The Senior Director, Data & Digital Product Architecture is responsible for designing and industrializing the enterprise’s data and digital product solutions — turning bespoke, one-off work into reusable, production-ready assets built on a centralized, enterprise-agnostic Silver model.
This role leads Data Architecture as part of its umbrella, owning the enterprise solution architecture that binds data and digital product capabilities together and weaving AI and automation across modeling and solutioning to compress the modeling cycle that has historically slowed the path to production. The Senior Director directs the design of the scalable, enterprise-agnostic data model and partners closely with Data Engineering, Data Analysis & Products, Digital Product, and Analytics teams to architect reusable solutions and refactor raw work onto governed, shared sources.
This role is a critical counterpart to the Data Engineering pillar of the DataOps team. The role provides hands-on leadership across data architecture, solution design, AI-accelerated modeling, product integration, and automation so that architectural intent and engineering investment result in reusable, adopted, and scalable data and digital product assets.
Key Responsibilities
Data Architecture Leadership
Lead the Data Architecture function, owning the design of the scalable, flexible, enterprise-agnostic data model that underpins the enterprise medallion architecture.
Set architectural direction, standards, and reference models that Data Engineering and Analysis teams build against.
Direct the ingestion, structuring, and layering strategy in partnership with IT and Data Engineering to ensure a durable, reusable foundation.
Solution Architecture & Design
Own the end-to-end solution architecture that connects data and digital product capabilities to the centralized, enterprise-agnostic medallion architecture models.
Design reusable, scalable solution blueprints and reference patterns aligned to the enterprise medallion architecture rather than siloed, point builds.
Translate architectural intent into buildable, production-ready solution designs that engineering and product teams can execute against.
AI-Accelerated Modeling & Solution Industrialization
Weave AI and automation across modeling and solutioning to compress modeling time — the historic inhibitor to reaching production.
Refactor raw, bespoke solutions onto the centralized, agnostic Silver layer so value is captured once and reused many times.
Establish repeatable patterns and accelerators that turn learning-stage work into durable, production-ready assets.
Data & Digital Product Integration
Integrate data and digital product solutions onto shared, reusable sources, ensuring alignment with the enterprise medallion model rather than siloed builds.
Partner with Digital Product and Analytics teams to embed automation and AI into product workflows where combined capabilities produce stronger outcomes.
Ensure integrated solutions are designed for reuse across multiple use cases, not bespoke consumption.
Reusability, Standards & Enablement
Centralize AI-assisted modeling patterns, templates, and reusable components so every asset compounds the value of the next.
Establish standards for how data architecture, solution design, AI, and automation are applied across engineering and solutioning to ensure consistency and scale.
Enable Data Engineering and Analysis teams to adopt architectural patterns and automation accelerators effectively within their workflows.
Required Experience & Capabilities
Senior leadership experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data modeling, data/analytics solution delivery, automation, or applied AI within an enterprise data environment.
Demonstrated experience leading a data architecture function and designing scalable, enterprise-agnostic data models.
Demonstrated experience designing and industrializing bespoke or prototype solutions into reusable, production-ready assets.
Strong knowledge of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), reusable modeling, and enterprise-agnostic data design.
Hands-on understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated code evaluation, and controlled promotion to production.
Proven ability to apply AI and automation to accelerate modeling, integration, and solutioning while preserving quality and governance.
Strong communication, influencing, and change leadership skills; experience in complex, regulated enterprises preferred.
Measures of Success
The enterprise data model and architecture are scalable, reusable, and consistently adopted across use cases.
Solution designs are consistently reusable, scalable, and aligned to the enterprise medallion architecture.
Modeling and solution cycle time is measurably reduced through AI and automation.
Bespoke and raw solutions are consistently refactored onto reusable, agnostic Silver sources.
Data and digital product assets reach production faster through governed, automated pipelines.
Acceleration is achieved without compromising governance, quality, or security controls.
If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 184,400 - 307,400 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.
This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus and long term incentive plan.

jobs.title: Product Director, Consumer Channels
jobs.text:
Does this position interest you? You should apply –even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.
A Brief Overview
Safelite is the leader in auto glass service, continuously raising the bar for experiences that are easy, fast, and done. Digital is central to that ambition and to how we serve consumers, clients, and colleagues.
We are seeking a Digital Product Director, Consumer Channels to lead the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Safelite's consumer digital experiences. This includes the direct-pay and insurance journeys across discovery, quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
Reporting to the VP, Digital Product, you will lead the consumer digital product portfolio and the product managers responsible for it. You will connect customer behavior, growth strategy, business performance, and emerging technology to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.
This is a hands-on product leadership role. You will set direction across the portfolio while staying close to customer behavior, product performance, and the work itself. You will develop product talent, raise the quality of product practice, and ensure the team is investing in the opportunities that create the greatest customer and business value.
What you will do
Lead the consumer product portfolio
• Define the product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Safelite’s consumer digital experiences.
• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio
Drive growth and journey performance
• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.
Build an AI-enabled product practice
• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences
• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.
Lead and develop the product team
• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.
Lead through partnership
• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all policies and standards
Education Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience Required
Experience Qualifications
7-9 years of product management or digital product experience, including significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products at scale. Required
Experience leading and developing product managers, with a track record of raising product judgment and team performance. Required

blocks.text: Does this position interest you? You should apply –even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.
A Brief Overview

Safelite is the leader in auto glass service, continuously raising the bar for experiences that are easy, fast, and done. Digital is central to that ambition and to how we serve consumers, clients, and colleagues.

We are seeking a Digital Product Director, Consumer Channels to lead the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Safelite's consumer digital experiences. This includes the direct-pay and insurance journeys across discovery, quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.

Reporting to the VP, Digital Product, you will lead the consumer digital product portfolio and the product managers responsible for it. You will connect customer behavior, growth strategy, business performance, and emerging technology to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on product leadership role. You will set direction across the portfolio while staying close to customer behavior, product performance, and the work itself. You will develop product talent, raise the quality of product practice, and ensure the team is investing in the opportunities that create the greatest customer and business value.
What you will do
Lead the consumer product portfolio
• Define the product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Safelite’s consumer digital experiences.
• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio
Drive growth and journey performance
• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.
Build an AI-enabled product practice
• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences
• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.
Lead and develop the product team
• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.
Lead through partnership
• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.

Complies with all policies and standards
