jobs.title: Director, Account Technology
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
As Director, Account Technology, you will stand at the intersection of breakthrough technology, strategic customer partnerships, and some of the most important innovations happening in semiconductors today.
This is a rare opportunity to lead ASM's technology engagement with one of the world's most influential semiconductor manufacturers and help shape the future of next-generation memory architectures that will power artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and the data-driven world of tomorrow.
Over the next decade, the semiconductor industry will make some of its largest-ever investments in advanced memory technologies. The winners will help unlock new levels of AI performance, computing power, and technological progress. As a key technology leader for ASM, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring we are at the forefront of that transformation.
You will translate complex customer technology challenges into strategic opportunities, influence the direction of ASM's products and roadmaps, and lead the programs that determine where the industry goes next. Success in this role will have a direct impact on technology adoption, customer investment decisions, product evolution, and long-term business growth. Quite simply, the work you do here will help shape technologies that impact millions of people worldwide.
The Opportunity
This role sits at the center of three critical missions:
Shape the Customer Technology Strategy
Become the trusted technical advisor to senior customer technology leaders.
Develop a deep understanding of customer challenges, technology roadmaps, integration requirements, manufacturing constraints, and future device architectures. Translate those insights into actions that influence ASM's long-term strategy and technology investments.
You will become the bridge between what the customer needs next and what ASM builds next.
Influence Product and Technology Innovation
The best Account Technology leaders don't simply respond to customer requests. They influence the future.
You will work directly with Product Development, Engineering, Product Marketing, Service, and Business Unit leaders to identify technology gaps, hardware opportunities, process improvements, and future innovation priorities.
Your insights will help shape the next generation of deposition technologies and ensure ASM remains the partner of choice for future technology nodes.
Build and Lead a World-Class Technical Team
You'll build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of technical leaders capable of operating as a true extension of the customer's technology organization.
You'll create an environment where technical excellence, customer obsession, innovation, and collaboration drive exceptional results.
What You'll Do
Lead technology engagement strategy for a key strategic customer across advanced memory technologies, DRAM, NAND, and emerging applications.
Build trusted relationships with senior customer technology executives and key decision makers.
Understand customer technology challenges, process integration requirements, device roadmaps, and manufacturing constraints.
Translate customer needs into actionable priorities for ASM's Product Development, Service, Engineering, and Business Unit organizations.
Drive hardware, process, and technology improvements that strengthen ASM's competitive position and accelerate customer adoption.
Define and lead complex NPI programs from concept through qualification and volume production.
Ensure customer feedback directly influences future product and roadmap decisions.
Protect and expand existing technology positions while identifying new opportunities for growth.
Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing technical organization.
Create alignment across Product Marketing, Product Development, Service Engineering, Operations, and executive leadership teams.
What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone capable of becoming one of the industry's next great technical leaders. You may come from a leading equipment supplier, memory manufacturer, or semiconductor technology organization. What matters most is your ability to connect technology, customer strategy, product innovation, and leadership.
You likely bring:
15+ years of semiconductor industry experience.
Leadership experience managing technical teams and developing talent.
Strong knowledge of semiconductor process integration and device interactions.
Experience in deposition, thin films, ALD, PECVD, LPCVD, PEALD, or adjacent process technologies.
The ability to understand both technology and business drivers.
A track record of influencing decisions across complex organizations.
Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
A passion for solving difficult technical problems and turning them into competitive advantage.
Why this role at ASM?
Few companies can influence where the semiconductor industry goes next.
At ASM, you'll work with world-class engineers, industry-leading technology, and customers investing billions in the future of AI, advanced computing, and next-generation memory. This is more than a leadership role. It's an opportunity to help shape the technologies that will define the next decade.
Most technical leaders influence a product. This role influences an entire technology ecosystem. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of customer strategy, technology innovation, and product development, helping determine how next-generation memory technologies are developed, qualified, and brought into high-volume manufacturing.
Success in this role will directly impact future product roadmaps, major technology decisions, and some of the industry's most significant R&D investments. You will help shape ASM's strategy, build high-performing teams, and influence technologies that power the future of artificial intelligence.
For the right person, this is a career-defining opportunity. You won't simply help win business. You'll help define what comes next.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. Role Overview
As Director of Software Engineering, you will lead ASM’s global software engineering strategy and execution across multiple product lines and technology platforms. You will be responsible for shaping the future of semiconductor equipment software, driving innovation, and enabling scalable, high-performance solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers.
This role requires a visionary leader who can align software development with business goals, foster cross-functional collaboration, and build high-performing teams across geographies. You will play a critical role in ASM’s transformation into a software-driven organization, ensuring our products remain competitive and future-ready.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the global software engineering strategy aligned with ASM’s business objectives.
Develop and maintain a multi-year software roadmap across product lines and technology platforms.
Champion software innovation and architectural excellence to support long-term scalability and performance.
Organizational Development
Build and lead a world-class software engineering organization across multiple global sites.
Mentor and develop senior engineering leaders and managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
Drive talent acquisition, retention, and career development strategies to support organizational growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Product Management, Hardware Engineering, Process Engineering, and Quality teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Ensure alignment between software development and customer requirements, market trends, and business priorities.
Lead cross-functional initiatives to improve development velocity, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Operational Excellence
Oversee execution of multiple concurrent software programs, ensuring timely delivery and high quality.
Implement best practices in software lifecycle management, including CI/CD, DevOps, and Agile methodologies.
Establish and monitor KPIs for software performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
Technology Leadership
Guide software architecture decisions to support modularity, reuse, and future extensibility.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends to inform strategic decisions.
Promote a data-driven approach to decision-making and continuous improvement.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 8 years in leadership roles.
Proven track record of leading large-scale software organizations and delivering complex products.
Strong background in C++ and modern software development practices.
Experience with software architecture, release planning, and baseline management.
Demonstrated ability to lead globally distributed teams and manage cross-functional initiatives.
Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in the semiconductor capital equipment industry.
Familiarity with technologies such as ALD, PECVD, epitaxy, and vertical furnaces.
Experience in fast-paced, customer-driven environments.
Proficiency with tools like Jira, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of software quality assurance and regulatory compliance.

jobs.text:
Rockstar is recruiting for a nonpartisan nonprofit organization that leverages technology to equip the next generation of Americans with the skills to bridge divides. The client primarily works with college campuses, offering a comprehensive, evidence-based suite of products and services for stakeholders at every level—from college presidents to incoming students. Since launching in 2017, the organization has partnered with hundreds of campuses across the country. The organization was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation. This is a pivotal moment to join the team, as the organization is growing rapidly and advances in AI are creating new possibilities for how technology can help people engage in better dialogue across differences. In this role, the selected candidate will be at the forefront of shaping how these tools are leveraged to expand reach and impact.
About the Role
As the software product leader, this individual will report to the Co-Founder and Executive Director. The selected candidate will own the technical vision, strategy, and execution for the e-learning platform, and will be responsible for developing a product roadmap, ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and accessible. While the initial focus will be the flagship e-learning platform, Perspectives, the product leader will also drive technical innovation across the full suite of offerings, using emerging technologies (including AI) to expand impact, efficiency, and scale.
This individual will serve as a player-coach: managing one product team member (a Product Specialist), while partnering closely with an external development agency to deliver high-quality releases on time and on budget.
Responsibilities
Technical Product Leadership & Strategy
- Serve as the Executive Director’s technical thought partner, shaping how and what is built in alignment with the overall product strategy.
- Stay current on trends and emerging technologies in EdTech, AI, and related fields to inform product strategy and innovation.
- Lead the technical strategy to ensure scalability, stability, security, accessibility, and responsible AI integration across all products.
- Translate product priorities into a clear, actionable technical roadmap.
- Set and track product OKRs and KPIs.
Product Health & Scalability
- Own system monitoring, data pipeline integrity, and risk tracking to safeguard product performance and stability.
- Prototype, validate, and deliver AI-powered features and new AI-driven products that advance the organization’s mission.
- Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and accessibility standards.
Team & Vendor Management
- Manage a Product Specialist, fostering professional growth and high performance.
- Lead relationships with all tech vendors — including development agency, platform hosting providers, and accessibility/security partners.
- Manage the technical product budget, negotiate vendor contracts, and ensure high performance from all technical partners.
- Maintain effective agile rituals for a hybrid internal/agency model, in partnership with the Product Specialist.
Cross-Functional Execution
- Collaborate with Education and Implementation teams to ensure products support effective content delivery and meet partner and user needs.
- Work with Partnerships (Sales) to fulfill technical contract requirements, including integrations and security/privacy documentation.
- Partner with Operations on privacy, security, and AI guardrails.
- Ensure cross-functional alignment on product development, launches, and feedback loops.
Job Requirements
About You
- 7+ years of B2B SaaS product management experience, including 3+ years leading or mentoring other product team members.
- Experience in EdTech or a related field, with knowledge of data privacy/security and accessibility requirements; higher ed compliance experience preferred.
- Proven success delivering products on a modular platform or third-party LMS.
- Hands-on experience building AI-driven products; LLM experience strongly preferred.
- Skilled in product discovery and learning methods, including A/B testing, user research, and analytics.
- Track record of successfully managing budgets, vendor contracts, and delivery schedules.
- Strong communicator, able to translate technical complexity for executives, developers, and non-technical stakeholders.
- Deeply aligned with the organization’s mission and excited to help bridge divides and promote constructive dialogue.
- Experience in startup or scaleup environments, comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous contexts.
Benefits
- Compensation — $155,000-$170,000
- A Mission-Driven Culture — the organization practices what it preaches, so the work culture is characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness
- Remote-First — the organization was founded as a remote-first organization, and works hard to maintain a strong team culture across vast distances
- Unlimited PTO — as well as 13 company holidays
- Other Benefits — employer-supported health, vision and dental plans, subsidized parental leave, 3% 401k match, short- and long-term disability insurance, life and AD&D insurance, $1,000 annual professional development budget.

jobs.title: Head of Product Management
jobs.text:
As one of Canada’s largest and fastest growing cryptocurrency trading platforms, Ndax has set the bar high for the country’s fintech industry and is constantly leading the way in terms of security and innovation. We are on a mission to empower more Canadians to unlock the full potential of digital finance.
To address the various needs in the Canadian cryptocurrency space, Ndax has assembled a multidisciplinary team with diverse backgrounds, including finance, technology, engineering, compliance, marketing, and more.
We are proud to have been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Workplaces by Great Place to Work®.
Role Overview
The Head of Product Management is a key member of the executive team. You will own the full product strategy and execution across Ndax. You will define the vision, lead a multi-disciplinary product organization, and deliver products that strengthen Ndax’s position as the most trusted platform for digital asset trading in Canada.
Responsibilities
Own the entire product lifecycle: discovery, design, development, launch, adoption, and optimization.
Lead all teams under the product scope, including Product Management, Design, UX Research, and Product Data.
Build, coach, and scale a high-performing product team with clear KPIs and accountability.
Drive user growth, engagement, and retention through customer-centric product decisions.
Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Marketing, and Operations to deliver seamless and secure experiences.
Ensure all products meet Canadian regulatory standards.
Monitor performance, analyze data, and use insights to drive product improvements.
Develop partnerships and integrations that strengthen Ndax’s ecosystem presence.
Represent Ndax’s product vision with the executive team, board members, and external stakeholders.
Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with company goals.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
(P-1384)
About the Team
At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer-obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.
In this role, you will work closely with leaders across the company, within engineering, as well as with product management, field engineering, recruiting and HR. You will lead critical initiatives that enhance developer productivity and drive innovation in the developer platform space. You will be at the forefront of integrating AI tools into the developer workflow, shaping the future of AI-assisted development.
The impact you will have:
Solve real business needs at a large scale by applying your software engineering
Ensure consistent delivery against milestones and strong alignment with the field working "two-in-a-box" with product leadership
Evolve organizational structure to align with long term initiatives, build strong "5 ingredient" teams with good comms architecture
Manage technical debt, including long term technical architecture decisions and balance product roadmap
Leading and participating in technical, product, and design discussions
Building, managing, and operating a highly scalable services in the cloud
Growing leaders on the team by providing coaching, mentorship, and growth opportunities
Partnering with other engineering and product leaders on planning, prioritization and staffing
Creating a culture of excellence on the team while leading with empathy
What we look for:
15+ years of industry experience building and supporting large-scale distributed systems
Building, growing, and managing high-performance teams
Ability to attract and hire engineers who meet the Databricks hiring principles
Existing experience building and running cloud platforms -or- demonstrated ability to quickly learn new concepts in the SaaS space (e.g technical background and fast learner).
Experience working cross-functionality with product management and directly with customers; ability to deeply understand product and customer personas.
BS in Computer Science or Masters or PhD
About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
Benefits
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
Compliance
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Product Director, Copy Trading / Trading Bot
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
About The Opportunity
The trading bot domain has emerged as one of OKX's most critical and rapidly growing sectors over the past two years. It constitutes a significant share of our platform's daily active traders and trading volume. With this swift growth, escalating user demands, and a promising future for this business, we are committed to allocating more resources to this sector. Our aim is to build top-tier products and ultimately grow this line into a billion-dollar enterprise.
What You’ll Be Doing
Develop strategies to boost trading bot volume and user acquisition. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design, engineering, and data analysis.
Based on trading users' needs, design trading bots efficient for particular market situations.
Conduct user research and competitor assessments to identify potential opportunities for product innovation and optimization, enhancing user conversion and retention.
Advocate for robust engineering solutions and scalable product/system architecture designs, ensuring efficient new product development.
Manage projects with efficient scope, timeline, and stakeholder coordination, prioritizing quick iterations and impactful outcomes.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience, preferably in Financial Engineering, Mathematics or Engineering.
5+ years of product management experience, particularly within the crypto or internet industry.
Strong grasp of strategy design and backend logic.
Passion for problem-solving and delivering exceptional user experiences.
Self-motivated, independent, persistent, objective, with strong logical thinking, capable of project ownership.
Curious with a strong ability for self-learning, open to exploring innovative projects for driving product growth.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to influence and present ideas effectively.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in Crypto/FX/Stocks trading, including quant trading, bot trading, or technical analysis.
Strong understanding of the industry and market dynamics.
Fluency in Mandarin will be a plus to work with cross tech teams based in Greater China Region.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Corporate Director, Product Unit - Surface Modification
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Position Overview
As the Corporate Director of Surface Modification, you will lead and evolve a strategic business and technology vertical within ASM. This role is accountable for advancing Surface Modification capabilities—including pre-clean, post-treatment, and standalone platforms—by driving innovation, execution excellence, and cross-functional alignment across a broad, global engineering and product ecosystem.
Responsibilities
Executive leadership for the Surface Modification (SM) Group, managing a high-performing, multidisciplinary organization of ~25–30 professionals across hardware engineering, process development, product support, and product management.
Define and execute the strategic vision and growth roadmap for Surface Modification technologies, including emerging standalone products and enabling modules for integrated pre-clean and post-treatment.
Collaborate closely with Key Product Unit (KPU) and Global Product Marketing (GPM) leadership to align technology innovation with overall business objectives and market opportunities.
Ensure operational excellence and delivery across all development programs, meeting quality, cost, and timeline commitments while enhancing competitiveness and customer value.
Cultivate a customer-centric organization by partnering with key customers and the Key Account Technology (KAT) team to understand evolving needs and secure successful product qualifications.
Serve as the executive sponsor for complex cross-organizational initiatives, aligning R&D, marketing, and operations on shared goals.
Drive organizational development by building and scaling leadership capacity, including direct management of seasoned managers and development of future leaders.
Contribute actively to ASM’s long-term strategic planning and play a pivotal role in shaping the company’s product and technology portfolio in advanced materials engineering.
Qualifications
Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
13+ years of progressive experience in the semiconductor industry (capital equipment preferred), with significant leadership roles spanning surface engineering, process technology, or adjacent domains (CVD, PVD, plasma treatment, etc.).
Proven track record in incubating and delivering new product platforms from concept through commercialization in a global, fast-paced innovation environment.
Demonstrated success leading managers and senior technical professionals, with a strong emphasis on talent development and organizational scalability.
Strategic thinker with exceptional execution discipline and the ability to influence across functions and cultures.
Strong customer orientation and experience navigating technical engagements with global semiconductor manufacturers.
Familiarity with product lifecycle management (PLC), operational efficiency frameworks, and go-to-market strategies.
Effective decision-maker with a pragmatic and collaborative leadership style
Exceptional communicator and problem solver with strong interpersonal and organizational skills
Committed to developing talent, fostering collaboration, and building high-performance cultures
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Engineering Director, DBA
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer/Engineering Director who will be responsible for the design, deployment, optimisation, and full lifecycle management of enterprise-level cloud database platforms. Lead the implementation of multi-cloud architectures for Alibaba Cloud and AWS databases, ensuring high availability, high performance, and cost optimization.
What You'll Be Doing
Database Architecture Design & Optimization
Design, deploy, and optimize cloud databases on Alibaba Cloud (RDS, PolarDB, Redis, MongoDB) and AWS (RDS, Aurora, ElastiCache, DynamoDB).
Select appropriate database types (relational/NoSQL/NewSQL) and service models (managed services vs. self-built clusters) based on business requirements.
Operations & Monitoring
Implement high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) solutions, such as Alibaba Cloud cross-zone deployments, AWS Multi-AZ, and cross-region replication.
Monitor database performance and health using cloud-native tools (Alibaba Cloud CloudMonitor, AWS CloudWatch) and third-party tools (Prometheus, Grafana).
Performance Tuning & Incident Resolution
Analyze slow queries, lock conflicts, and resource bottlenecks (CPU/IO/memory), optimizing SQL statements and index designs.
Rapidly resolve production database incidents (e.g., replication lag, connection pool exhaustion, storage scaling).
Security & Compliance
Manage database access controls via Alibaba Cloud RAM policies and AWS IAM roles to ensure data security.
Perform regular database upgrades and audit log analysis to comply with GDPR, Multi-Tier Cloud Security Certification (MLPS), and other regulations.
Automation & Cost Management
Automate database deployment and operations using Terraform, Ansible, or cloud-native tools (Alibaba Cloud ROS, AWS CloudFormation).
Optimize cloud costs via auto-scaling, reserved instances, and storage tiering (e.g., AWS S3 Glacier).
Cross-Team Collaboration
Support development teams in database design reviews, SQL code standardization, and DevOps processes (e.g., database change management in CI/CD).
Team Management
Manage a team of DBAs to ensure timely completion of projects and efficient resolution of incidents.
What We Look For In You
Technical Skills
Expertise in database services of at least one major public cloud (Alibaba Cloud or AWS), with familiarity in the other.
In-depth understanding of core principles of mainstream databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis) and advanced SQL optimization/troubleshooting skills.
Experience with database migration tools (AWS DMS, Alibaba Cloud DTS) and cross-cloud synchronization solutions.
Experience Requirements
5+ years of DBA experience, including at least 2 years managing public cloud databases.
Hands-on experience with large-scale (TB-level) databases, sharding, and read/write splitting.
Experience leading cloud database migrations, DR drills, or hybrid cloud projects is preferred.
Soft Skills
Strong documentation skills for creating SOPs and contingency plans.
Excellent communication skills to coordinate development, operations, and business teams.
Certifications & Education
Alibaba Cloud ACP/ACE (Database) or AWS Certified Database – Specialty certifications preferred.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Head of Infrastructure Technology
jobs.text:
About Your Tasks
Infrastructure Management
Oversee the design, deployment, and maintenance of IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage systems, and other hardware and software components.
Develop and implement strategies for infrastructure capacity planning, performance optimization, and disaster recovery.
Ensure high availability and reliability of IT services through proactive monitoring and maintenance practices.
Team Leadership
Lead and manage a team of IT professionals, including network engineers, system administrators, and support staff.
Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, encouraging professional development and continuous learning.
Set performance goals, conduct regular performance evaluations, and provide coaching and mentorship to team members.
Security and Compliance
Implement and enforce security policies and procedures to protect the organization's IT infrastructure from threats and vulnerabilities.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO/IEC 27001.
Conduct regular security assessments, audits, and penetration testing to identify and mitigate risks.
Vendor and Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with external vendors and service providers, negotiating contracts and ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including executives, department heads, and project managers, to align IT infrastructure initiatives with business objectives.
Communicate infrastructure status, issues, and recommendations to senior management in a clear and concise manner.
Project Management
Lead infrastructure projects from initiation to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and meet quality standards.
Develop and manage project plans, budgets, and timelines, coordinating resources and stakeholders as needed.
Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement corrective actions to keep projects on track.
Innovation and Improvement
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential impact on the organization's IT infrastructure.
Identify opportunities for infrastructure improvement and innovation, driving initiatives to enhance performance, scalability, and efficiency.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging the adoption of best practices and new technologies.

jobs.text:
This role can be based remotely in India.
Position Summary
We are seeking an exceptional Principal Technologist to join our team in India. This pivotal role will work closely with our account teams to engage with C-suite executives and senior technical leaders at MongoDB’s most strategic customers. You will bridge the gap between complex data architectures and AI to power business transformation, positioning MongoDB as the premier platform for modernizing legacy systems and building next-generation AI applications. As a recognized technical thought leader, you will shape industry perspectives through regular activities including high-impact technical evangelism and thought leadership, executive roundtables, presentations delivered to customers, keynotes at MongoDB and industry events, and regularly briefing tier-1 press, media, and analysts as a credible and trusted company spokesperson.
Qualifications
10+ years of experience in customer and market-facing roles at the principal or Field CTO level
Recognized technical leader with deep hands-on experience with enterprise-scale applications
Influence & Scalability: Demonstrated success in scaling your technical influence and earned credibility. Experience speaking at major tech conferences, hosting technical webinars, or contributing deeply to the developer community (via technical blogs, open-source contributions, or whitepapers) is highly desired
Deep portfolio and history of published content, presentations at events, interviews or quotes in the the press and media
Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to command a room with credibility, deliver compelling keynote presentations, and influence technology strategies with a CxO audience
Strong understanding of database architectures, distributed systems, and cloud computing concepts, with experience in distributed systems design, including scalability, fault tolerance, and consistency models
Familiarity with modern application development frameworks and hands-on proficiency with state of the art AI capabilities
Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
What We Offer

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Job Description | About the Role
The Product Manager ascertains what’s next for the product. Head of Product is a visionary who is also rich with applied experience. We’re looking for someone will work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, and marketing to bring unique value-based features to market across B2B2C.
This role moves at a fast pace while maintaining excellent quality and a positive working attitude to strategize the Fabulous product roadmap.
Expectations | Duties
Outreach and Data Accumulation
Connect with users: dig into user data, both qualitative and quantitative
Ascertains trends while being a champion for user-first experiences
Collaborate with researchers, data scientists, and business development teams to understand user needs and identify new product opportunities.
Immerse yourself in the psychology, pain points and behavior of users to develop strong intuition about solutions that will work for them.
Develop compelling roadmaps and metric targets that keep us on track towards our desired goals and continuously measure progress towards them.
Lead product ideation and prioritization within a key product area.
Evaluate ideas and lead product prioritization and releases
Have a consistent pipeline of fresh ideas that can help move the needle, through user research/feedback, driving brainstorms sessions, and doing competitive research
Ruthlessly prioritize these ideas in a robust, data-informed way, with an aim to have the most impact with limited resources – time, engineering resources, user volume, etc.
Leverage data to drive product development and experimentation.
Lead a cross-functional team through the product development cycle–UI/UX, engineering, QA, and data analysis.
Be the overall point-person to build compelling products and features for users.
Write design documents and web updates for new content/features/initiatives with input from curriculum, design & engineering partners.
Initiate data-driven experimentation and analysis on new products and features.
